role: Persistent free auto-attacker / ramping sustain-bruiser whose damage type and riders are reshaped by sword stances
signature_mechanic: Liebe Unite: a permanent, free (1 random pip), cooldown-0 end-of-turn auto-attack that deals 15 damage to a random enemy every turn for the rest of the game. Its damage type and rider effects are reshaped by whichever of three SELF-cast "sword" stances Asta has equipped. Below 40 HP he may equip two swords at once and stack their modifiers.

abilities.name: Demon-Slayer Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: Grants permanent +5 damage_mod to Liebe Unite while equipped; each Liebe Unite hit applies a stacking 10 Nullify barrier_effect to the struck enemy (stacks indefinitely, display_mag).
abilities.effects_summary: Equips a sword stance (only one normally; two below 40 HP). While equipped: Liebe Unite deals +5 damage and applies 10 stacking Nullify/barrier to enemies it hits. The JSON-described mark/taunt is effectively DEAD CODE: slayer_mark_trigger (taunt 1 turn on marked enemy) is never registered in execute(), only slayer_trigger (the Nullify barrier) is. No direct damage on cast.

abilities.name: Demon-Dweller Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: Triggers only when Liebe Unite deals damage: heals 10 HP, or if already at 100 HP gains 10 permanent non-stacking refreshing Shield instead.
abilities.effects_summary: Equips the sustain sword stance. While equipped: each time Liebe Unite deals damage, Asta heals 10 HP (or converts overheal into a flat 10 permanent Shield at full HP). Provides steady self-sustain every turn the auto-attack fires. No direct damage on cast.

abilities.name: Demon-Destroyer Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: Grants permanent +10 damage_mod to Liebe Unite AND converts Liebe Unite's damage type to Affliction (confirmed in asta4 liebe_trigger). Downside: Asta self-takes 10 Affliction damage every time Liebe Unite deals damage.
abilities.effects_summary: Equips the aggressive sword stance. While equipped: Liebe Unite deals +10 damage and is converted to Affliction (bypasses barriers/shields/DR), but Asta suffers 10 Affliction recoil each time it fires. High-risk: the recoil self-damages and accelerates Asta toward his own low-HP thresholds.

abilities.name: Liebe Unite
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 15 Normal to a random non-invuln enemy at end of every turn, permanently. Damage type becomes Affliction if Demon-Destroyer equipped. +5 (Slayer) and/or +10 (Destroyer) damage_mods stack -> up to 30 with dual-wield. Below 70 HP: permanent retaliate (10 dmg to first enemy to use a new harmful skill on Asta each turn). Below 40 HP: may dual-wield swords.
abilities.effects_summary: Sets up the permanent auto-attack engine: 15 dmg to a random enemy every turn (fires immediately on cast too). Adds two one-time HP-threshold triggers: <70 HP grants a permanent counter (10 dmg retaliation; note code uses 10, the trigger's text string claims 20 - text is stale); <40 HP grants dual-wield (mark allowing two sword stances). The whole kit revolves around this skill; swords only matter because they buff/reshape it.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Liebe Unite tops out at ~30 damage/turn single-target once dual-wielding Slayer (+5) and Destroyer (+10) below 40 HP, converted to Affliction (bypasses all mitigation). Plus the permanent <70HP counter (10/turn to attackers) and ever-growing stacks of 10 Nullify barriers on whichever enemies get hit. No true burst window - all damage is incremental and time-accrued; ceiling is bounded by random targeting (cannot focus) and the self-Affliction recoil from Destroyer.
damage_profile.notes: Random target each turn means damage is spread, not focused. Affliction conversion (Destroyer) makes the auto-attack bypass barriers/shields/DR. Asta's own offense is entirely passive: he casts swords/Liebe and then the engine ticks for free every turn at 0 effective ongoing action cost. The <70HP counter adds 10 reactive single-target damage per turn against attackers.

economy.color_dependency: 3-color (Green + Blue + Red) but only 1 specific pip each, plus 1 random for Liebe Unite. Each sword is a single-pip self-cast; full Slayer+Destroyer power needs both Green and Red. Moderate color dependency, flexible because each stance is independently affordable.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Front-loaded setup then near-zero ongoing cost. Liebe Unite is cooldown 0 and permanent (cast once). Swords are cooldown 1 and only re-cast to swap stances. After turn 1-2, the auto-attack engine runs itself with almost no action spend.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Weak/slow early (just 15 random dmg/turn until swords online); scales as sword damage_mods come online, HP drops below 70 (counter) then 40 (dual-wield = stacking both mods + Affliction conversion), and Nullify barriers / Dweller shields accumulate over many turns. A long-game engine, not a tempo threat.

invuln_or_counter: <70 HP permanent counter: 10 dmg to first enemy to use a new harmful skill on Asta each turn

win_conditions: Outlast the enemy in a long game - the free permanent auto-attack + self-sustain (Dweller heal/shield) grinds the opponent down while Asta becomes harder to kill
Reach low-HP thresholds safely so the counter (<70) and dual-wield (<40) come online, then run Slayer+Destroyer for max-output Affliction auto-attacks
Accumulate enough Nullify barrier stacks (via Slayer) to choke enemy energy while the auto-attack chips them down
internal_synergies: Liebe Unite is the hub: every sword stance only has value because it modifies Liebe Unite's per-turn auto-attack
Demon-Destroyer (+10, Affliction conversion) pairs with the <40 HP dual-wield so its self-recoil pushes Asta into the dual-wield window where he can also run Slayer for +15 total
Demon-Dweller's self-heal/shield directly offsets Demon-Destroyer's 10 Affliction recoil, letting the high-risk stance be run sustainably once dual-wielding
Destroyer's recoil and enemy attacks intentionally drive Asta below 70 (counter) and 40 (dual-wield), turning his own fragility into a ramp trigger
Slayer's stacking enemy Nullify barriers provide passive energy denial that compounds with the permanent auto-attack frequency
strengths: Extremely action-efficient: after a 1-2 turn setup, deals 15-30 free damage every turn for the rest of the game with no further action or cooldown cost
Strong self-sustain (Dweller heal + overheal-to-shield) makes him hard to kill in a grind
Affliction conversion (Destroyer) lets the auto-attack bypass barriers, shields, and DR - very hard to mitigate
Built-in anti-dive/anti-focus counter below 70 HP punishes enemies for targeting him
Cheap, flexible single-pip stances; engine keeps ticking even if Asta is stunned/CC'd since the auto-attack is a passive ticking trigger
Passive energy denial via stacking Nullify barriers
weaknesses: Cannot focus damage - Liebe Unite hits a RANDOM enemy each turn, so he can't burst a priority target or secure kills
Zero targeted active offense and zero hard CC - all four visible skills are SELF-casts; he can't interact with the board on demand
Very slow ramp / weak early game; relies on reaching low-HP thresholds, which is risky against burst that can skip past the windows and kill him outright
Demon-Destroyer's self-recoil is dangerous without Dweller online and can accelerate his own death
Random targeting wastes damage into invuln/tanky targets; no built-in target selection
JSON-advertised Slayer taunt is dead code (never registered), so the kit has less CC than its descriptions imply
Low single-instance damage - easily outpaced by dedicated burst or AoE characters in short games

power_assessment.reasoning: Asta is a niche long-game sustain engine with a strong identity: a permanent, free, CC-immune auto-attack that ramps to ~30 Affliction damage/turn while self-healing and denying energy. In extended fights he is durable and action-efficient, and the Affliction conversion makes his chip damage very hard to mitigate. But he is held back by RANDOM targeting (no focus, no kill pressure, no control), a slow ramp gated behind self-endangering low-HP thresholds, and a total absence of on-demand active offense or hard CC - purely reactive/automated. Against burst or coordinated focus he can be removed before his engine matters. Around average: excellent in slow attrition matchups, mediocre into tempo/burst comps. Rated 5.5 in isolation.
outlier_flags: Dead code: asta1 slayer_mark_trigger (taunt) is defined but never registered in execute() - the taunt described in JSON does not function
Stale text: asta4 liebe_first_threshold description string says '20 damage' but liebe_retaliate_trigger deals 10 - actual value is 10
Unusual design: 100% of the visible 4-skill kit is SELF-targeted; the character has no manually-targeted ability at all
Misleading naming: Slayer's 'mark' is actually a stacking 10 Nullify barrier_effect, not a damage-amp mark

abilities.name: Molecule Punch
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Energy damage to one enemy and stuns/locks that enemy's Helpful skills for 1 turn (partial stun denying their support/buff/heal abilities). cd 0, Blue:1 spammable single-target poke + soft skill-denial. (Inferred from JSON; no .gd exists.)

abilities.name: Subatomic Explosion
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: AoE 15 damage to all enemies and 'Shatters' them (Shatter=def_negate per engine convention: strips/negates their Damage Reduction & defensive barriers). JSON 'for 2 turns' likely a 2-turn DoT (15/turn x2) OR a 2-turn Shatter window. Sibling Shatter abilities use Piercing damage but class here is Energy. cd 2. (Inferred; no .gd exists.)

abilities.name: Molecule Armor
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Grants self or one ally 10 Damage Reduction for 3 turns. This slot then SWAPS to Molecule Helmet (atomeve5). Cheap flexible single-target mitigation + gateway to the offensive Helmet swap state.

abilities.name: Molecule Shield
abilities.conditional_scaling: per ally whose Shield is fully destroyed: +5 to Eve's damage on new skills for 1 turn (caps ~+15 on a 3-ally team)
abilities.effects_summary: Grants whole team 20 Shield for 1 turn (Invisible to enemy). Reactive ramp: for each ally whose Shield is completely destroyed, Eve gains +5 damage on new skills for 1 turn, converting incoming pressure into offense. Team protection + conditional self-damage buff. cd 3.

abilities.name: Molecule Helmet
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap state (entered from Molecule Armor). Applies a Nullify absorbing one enemy's next 40 damage; until that Nullify is consumed/removed the enemy is BLINDED (attacks miss) and SILENCED (cannot use abilities). Strong single-target lockdown / energy-denial. Swaps back to Molecule Armor. cd 3. (Inferred; no .gd exists.)

role: Defensive support / control bruiser — molecule-manipulation skirmisher who shields the team, strips enemy defenses, and locks single targets down
signature_mechanic: Armor/Helmet swap toggle (atomeve3 <-> atomeve5): the slot-3 button flips between a defensive ally-DR grant (Armor) and an offensive single-target Nullify+Blind+Silence lockdown (Helmet), letting Eve pivot between protecting an ally and hard-shutting an enemy each cycle. Backed by Shatter (defense-negation) on her AoE and a team Shield that converts ally shield-breaks into bonus damage. CRITICAL DATA CAVEAT: the ground-truth ability .gd files (abilities/atomeve1-5.gd) and character/atomeve.gd DO NOT EXIST on disk or in git — only an orphaned character/atomeve.tscn (node mislabeled 'Aang'), art assets, and abilities_data.json registry entries exist. This entire profile is inferred from JSON descriptions + sibling-ability engine conventions; Atom Eve is an unimplemented stub.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Low and flat. No per-stack/per-kill scaling on damage. Only ramp is Molecule Shield's reactive +5 per fully-destroyed ally shield (cap ~+15 for one turn on a 3-ally team), pushing a next Molecule Punch to ~35 ST or Subatomic Explosion to ~30 AoE, but requires allies to break their 20 shields first. atomeve2's 'for 2 turns' could double its AoE to ~30 over two turns. Firmly low tier; Eve is not a damage dealer.
damage_profile.notes: Raw numbers small (20 ST / 15 AoE). Effective AoE is amplified by Shatter stripping enemy DR/barriers so the 15 lands in full against tanky teams. Minimal burst; this is a utility kit. Damage values inferred from JSON, not verified .gd.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Visible 4-skill bar needs only Blue:2 specific (Molecule Punch + Subatomic Explosion) plus 4 flexible Random pips — easy to fuel from any energy. The hidden Helmet swap (atomeve5) adds Blue:1 + Red:1, a minor Red dependency only when toggling into lockdown. Primary identity Blue with a Red splash.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/sticky. Molecule Punch cd 0 (spammable). Subatomic Explosion cd 2, Molecule Armor cd 2, Molecule Shield cd 3, Molecule Helmet cd 3. Always has a play; control/shield tools on short-to-medium cooldowns for steady tempo rather than burst windows.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low. Only soft ramp is Molecule Shield's conditional +5 damage; kit functions fully from turn 1 with no stack/resource build-up.

hard_cc: Silence (Molecule Helmet — target cannot use abilities while Nullify persists)
soft_cc: Helpful-skill stun (Molecule Punch — locks target's Helpful/support skills for 1 turn)
Blind (Molecule Helmet — target's attacks miss while Nullify persists)
Shatter/defense-negation (Subatomic Explosion — strips enemy Damage Reduction)
invuln_or_counter: Nullify next 40 damage from target (Molecule Helmet — directional damage absorption on an enemy)
10 Damage Reduction for 3 turns to self/ally (Molecule Armor)
20 team Shield for 1 turn (Molecule Shield)

internal_synergies: Molecule Armor <-> Molecule Helmet swap: shield an ally with Armor, the slot flips to Helmet so the next cycle hard-locks an enemy (Nullify+Blind+Silence) — defensive and offensive halves share one button slot.
Subatomic Explosion's Shatter strips enemy DR, so it and follow-up Molecule Punches land full value against defensive/tank comps — anti-armor enabler.

Molecule Shield reactive damage: if allies' 20 shields break, Eve gains +5 dmg per break, turning her follow-up Punch/Explosion into a bigger hit; the team-protect tool doubles as her only damage ramp.
Molecule Punch's helpful-skill stun pairs with Molecule Helmet's Silence to comprehensively deny an enemy support's kit (no buffs, no heals, no abilities at all).
strengths: Versatile utility: team + single-ally shields, defense-stripping AoE, and a strong single-target lockdown in one cheap kit.
Excellent enemy lockdown via Molecule Helmet: Nullify + Blind + Silence simultaneously neutralizes a key threat (it can't act and can't connect).
Low color dependency and a cd-0 spammable attack — easy to fuel, never idle.
Shatter on her AoE makes her a natural counter to tank/DR-heavy compositions.
Team-wide shield with a built-in reactive damage payoff rewards trading into her protection.
weaknesses: Very low raw damage (20 ST / 15 AoE) with almost no scaling — cannot close games alone; relies on teammates to convert her control into kills.
Molecule Helmet's lockdown is conditional on the Nullify persisting; once the 40 absorbed damage is spent (or it's cleansed) the Blind/Silence drop — a heavy hitter burns through it fast.
Best control is single-target: no AoE hard CC, so weaker into wide/swarm aggression beyond the one Shatter hit.
Shields are short (Molecule Shield only 1 turn) and modest (20), overwhelmed by burst; the +5 ramp requires allies to actually eat damage.
Minor Red splash needed to access the Helmet lockdown adds a small fueling constraint exactly when she wants to pivot offensive.
win_conditions: Lock down the enemy's key carry/support with Molecule Helmet (Blind+Silence) while teammates burst the rest.
Out-sustain aggressive teams with stacked Damage Reduction (Armor) + team Shield, weathering burst and grinding them out.
Enable an anti-tank teammate by Shattering enemy defenses with Subatomic Explosion so their damage lands clean.
Stall to a damage advantage by denying enemy actions (helpful-skill stun + Silence) faster than they deny hers.

power_assessment.reasoning: Rated in isolation with heavy caveats. As designed in JSON, Atom Eve is a well-rounded defensive support/control unit: cheap, color-flexible, never idle (cd-0 attack), with strong single-target lockdown (Nullify+Blind+Silence), team shielding, an anti-tank Shatter AoE, and a clever Armor/Helmet swap. That utility breadth is above-average for a support. But her damage is bottom-tier with essentially no scaling, her hard control is single-target and conditional (dies when the Nullify is spent/cleansed), and her shields are short and modest. Strong glue/enabler, weak solo threat — squarely mid-tier. Confidence LOW because the ground-truth .gd files do not exist; all mechanics inferred from JSON + sibling conventions, and the character is an unimplemented stub that cannot currently be played.

INFERRED_DAMAGE: damage types/numbers not verified vs .gd; atomeve2 'for 2 turns' wording ambiguous (2-turn DoT vs 2-turn Shatter window).
STACKED_DEBUFF_LOCKDOWN: Molecule Helmet applies Nullify + Blind + Silence at once for only Blue:1/Red:1 — potentially undertuned cost for a 3-in-1 disable if implemented.

role: single-target piercing/affliction burst assassin with ramping damage and anti-defense tech
signature_mechanic: Nitroglycerin Storage: a permanent passive that grants +5 flat damage PER STACK every time Bakugo uses any non-Strategic skill, and the bonus applies to EVERY damage instance of EVERY damaging skill. This ramps his already piercing-heavy kit unboundedly; Hauser Impact is the big burst payoff that consumes/resets all stacks.

abilities.name: Detonating Touch
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Nitroglycerin stack applied to EACH of its 2 damage instances (so +10/stack total on this skill); delayed 10 Affliction only fires if target uses a new non-Strategic skill within the window
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Normal + 10 Piercing on hit. Applies a 1-turn detonation trigger (dur 2): if the target uses a new non-Strategic skill, they take 10 Affliction damage and the trigger is consumed. Zero cooldown spammable; each cast also feeds a Nitroglycerin stack.

abilities.name: AP Shot
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Nitroglycerin stack on its single Piercing instance; AI weights heavily (+75) into targets that have damage reduction
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Piercing dealt while ignoring invulnerability (bypassing flag true). Applies def_negate (Shatter) for 2 turns (dur 3) and an ignore-Shield-effects debuff for 2 turns, so the target ignores Shield effects. Strong anti-tank/anti-defense pick.

abilities.name: Stun Grenade
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (Strategic, so does NOT build a Nitroglycerin stack)
abilities.effects_summary: AoE soft-CC: stuns all enemies' Strategic skills for 1 turn (dur 2). Self-applies a 1-turn ability swap that turns this slot into Hauser Impact (the hidden big-burst finisher) for the next turn. Pure tempo/setup tool, no damage.

abilities.name: Explosive Dash
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (Strategic, no stack)
abilities.effects_summary: Self panic button: Bakugo becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend). Long 4-turn cooldown survivability tool.

abilities.name: Hauser Impact
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Nitroglycerin stack applied to EACH of its 3 damage instances (so +15/stack on this skill) right before stacks are consumed; this is the ramp payoff. Hidden alt accessed only via Stun Grenade's 1-turn swap.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal + 15 Piercing + 10 Affliction (45 raw) to one enemy; 25 of that bypasses defenses (Piercing skips flat/%DR, Affliction bypasses shields/barriers/DR). Casting it resets all Nitroglycerin Storage stacks (consumes the ramp).

abilities.name: Nitroglycerin Storage
abilities.conditional_scaling: self-ramp engine: stacks indefinitely
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent passive (dur -1). Each time Bakugo uses a NON-Strategic skill, gains a stackable +5 flat DAMAGE_MOD that applies to every damage instance of every damaging skill. Strategic skills (Stun Grenade, Explosive Dash) do not build stacks. Using Hauser Impact removes all stacks.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Effectively uncapped via Nitroglycerin Storage (+5 flat per stack PER damage instance). With N stacks, Detonating Touch deals 20 + 10N (2 instances), AP Shot 15 + 5N, and Hauser Impact 45 + 15N (3 instances) before resetting. At even ~5 stacks Hauser Impact hits 120 raw with 100 of it bypassing defenses; the ramp grows every non-Strategic cast with no upper bound. Stacks only fall off when Hauser Impact consumes them.
damage_profile.notes: Base numbers are modest, but the kit is dominated by armor penetration: AP Shot is fully Piercing and ignores invulnerability AND shields; Detonating Touch is half Piercing; Hauser Impact lands 15 Piercing + 10 Affliction (both bypass defenses). True 'effective' damage against tanks/shielded targets is far higher than raw because so little of it is mitigable. AoE is 0 damage (Stun Grenade is utility only). The detonation Affliction (10) is conditional, not guaranteed DoT.

economy.color_dependency: Light-moderate Red dependency. Visible bar (slots 1-4) needs only 2 Red pips (Detonating Touch 1, AP Shot 1) plus 3 Random; Stun Grenade and Explosive Dash are pure Random. The hidden Hauser Impact costs Red:2, so the burst payoff is more Red-hungry but only fires off Stun Grenade's swap.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Detonating Touch is 0-cooldown spammable (and feeds the ramp every turn). AP Shot 1cd, Stun Grenade 2cd, Explosive Dash 4cd. Bakugo can act and build stacks every single turn with the cheap 0/1-cd core.
economy.ramp_dependency: High but self-sufficient. Damage starts low and climbs; he wants to bank Nitroglycerin stacks via cheap non-Strategic casts, then either keep snowballing single-target pressure or cash out with the swapped Hauser Impact. Punished if forced to spend turns on Strategic skills (which don't build stacks) or if killed before ramp matures.

soft_cc: Stun Grenade: AoE 1-turn stun limited to enemies' Strategic skills
invuln_or_counter: Explosive Dash: self 1-turn invulnerability (4cd panic button)

win_conditions: Snowball Nitroglycerin stacks with cheap 0/1-cd non-Strategic casts, then delete a priority target with a stacked Hauser Impact (or sustained stacked Detonating Touch / AP Shot)
Hard-counter tanks and defensive comps: AP Shot ignores invulnerability + shields and Shatters; Hauser Impact's Piercing+Affliction bypass DR/barriers, so durable frontliners melt
Use Stun Grenade to lock down an enemy strategic-reliant setup turn, then swap into Hauser Impact for the burst payoff while they are disrupted
internal_synergies: Nitroglycerin Storage + every damaging skill: the +5/stack applies to each damage instance, so multi-hit Detonating Touch (2 hits) and Hauser Impact (3 hits) scale 2x-3x faster than single-hit skills
Stun Grenade -> Hauser Impact swap: Stun Grenade is the only access route to the hidden Hauser Impact, and the swap timing lets you cash a ramped stack count into burst
Detonating Touch's delayed Affliction + Stun Grenade: stunning Strategic skills funnels enemies toward non-Strategic actions, which is exactly what trips Detonating Touch's detonation condition
AP Shot's Shatter/ignore-Shield + Hauser Impact: strip a tank's defenses with AP Shot, then follow with bypassing burst
Cheap 0/1-cd core means almost every turn builds a stack, so the ramp and the kit's tempo reinforce each other
strengths: Elite anti-defense profile: Piercing-heavy output plus invuln-ignore, Shatter, ignore-Shield, and Affliction bypass make him a hard counter to tanks, shields, and DR stacking
Uncapped self-ramp that applies per damage instance, giving disproportionate late-game burst
Very cheap, low-cooldown kit with a 0-cd spammable primary; strong tempo and consistent stack generation
Built-in self-peel (1-turn invuln) and AoE strategic lockdown despite being a damage character
Mostly flexible energy cost on the visible bar (only 2 specific Red pips needed turn-to-turn)
weaknesses: Low base numbers before ramp: early turns deal little, so he is weak in short games or when bursted down before stacking
Single-target only for damage; zero AoE damage (Stun Grenade is pure utility), so he is poor at board clears and team fights spread across targets
Ramp tension: Hauser Impact, his biggest payoff, RESETS all stacks, forcing a snowball-then-spend rhythm rather than infinite scaling
No healing, no shields for the team, no cleanse, no energy denial, no real hard CC (stun only hits Strategic skills)
Hauser Impact is gated behind Stun Grenade's 1-turn swap and Red:2, so the burst is conditional and color-hungry
Conditional Affliction (Detonating Touch) does nothing if the target sits on Strategic skills or does not act

power_assessment.reasoning: A focused single-target assassin with an exceptionally clean anti-defense package and a genuinely uncapped ramp. Raw base damage is low (peak 45 single-target turn-one), but the per-instance +5/stack scaling, combined with Piercing/Affliction/invuln-ignore/Shatter/ignore-Shield, means his EFFECTIVE damage against the durable targets he's meant to kill is very high and grows every turn. Excellent tempo (0/1-cd core), self-invuln peel, and AoE strategic lockdown round out a complete-feeling kit. He sits at a strong-but-not-broken 7: held back by zero AoE damage, no sustain/utility for allies, vulnerability before ramp matures, and the self-imposed stack-reset on his finisher. In a long single-target slugfest he can become a top-tier carry; in fast or spread fights he underperforms.
outlier_flags: per-instance damage_mod scaling (multi-hit skills double/triple the ramp benefit) is a potential balance outlier worth flagging vs roster
uncapped permanent stacking with no decay could spiral in long games
AP Shot stacks invuln-ignore + Shatter + ignore-Shield on a 1-cost 1-cd skill - unusually strong anti-defense density for the cost

abilities.name: Physical Hunt
abilities.conditional_scaling: Grants a stacking +5 self damage-boost (dur 9 = self ~4 turns, stack_mag, displayed) buffing all of Ban's skills; ramps each cast. Double-counted by ban2.
abilities.effects_summary: No damage. Debuffs target: -5 non-Affliction damage dealt for 4 turns (dur 8, refreshes). Grants Ban a stackable, displayed +5 damage boost to all skills. Swaps slot 4 (Zero Sign) out for Hunter Festival (ban5).

abilities.name: Banishing Kill
abilities.conditional_scaling: Receives DOUBLE bonus from Ban's damage boosts (modifier_value=2 set in startup): each +5 boost stack from ban1/ban5 adds +10 here. So 20 + 10*(boost stacks).
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing damage (skips flat + %DR) to target; Bypassing class. Scales hardest with Ban's stacking damage boosts at 2x rate.

abilities.name: Courechouse Assault
abilities.conditional_scaling: Two-mode via self-mark; benefits from Ban's +5 stacking damage boost on direct hits.
abilities.effects_summary: First cast: 10 Normal + applies 10/turn DoT (dur 5) and self-marks for 2 turns. While self-marked: 10 Normal + stuns target's Strategic skills for 1 turn (dur 2) instead of DoT.

abilities.name: Zero Sign
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Ban becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend / panic button). Swapped out when Physical Hunt is active (replaced by Hunter Festival).

abilities.name: Hunter Festival
abilities.conditional_scaling: Grants +5 stacking self damage boost PER affected enemy (3 enemies = +15 in one cast); huge ramp accelerator, also double-counted by ban2.
abilities.effects_summary: No damage. All enemies: -5 non-Affliction damage dealt for 3 turns (dur 6, refreshes). Ban gains a stacking +5 damage boost for each affected enemy. Swaps back to Physical Hunt. Alt skill (swapped in by ban1).

abilities.name: Undead Ban
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent Immortality (cannot be killed). When damage drops Ban to 1 HP, he is banished for 1 turn (duration 3-4 based on turn timing) and returns at 20 HP. Recurring self-revive / survivability passive.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded via stacking damage boosts: each ban1 cast = +5 to all skills (+10 to ban2); each ban5 cast = +5 per enemy (up to +15/cast, +30 to ban2). After a few ramp turns ban2 trivially exceeds 40-60 Piercing single-target. No hard cap on stacks.
damage_profile.notes: Turn-1 realistic single-target ceiling ~40: ban3 (10) + ban2 (20) plus the start of a 10/turn DoT; pure pre-ramp burst is modest. ban5 itself deals 0 damage (pure debuff/ramp), so peak AoE damage in one turn from his own kit is 0. True ceiling is mid/late-game ban2 hits after boost stacks accumulate.

economy.color_dependency: White (index 2). 3 of 5 visible pips are White (ban1, ban2, ban3); ban2 and ban4 each need a Random. Heavy White dependency but cheap per-skill (mostly 1-pip).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast: two 0-cd 1-pip spammables (ban1 ramp, ban3 DoT/stun), ban2 on 1cd, ban4 invuln on 4cd, ban5 alt on 3cd. Can ramp and poke nearly every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Output is back-loaded behind stacking damage boosts from ban1/ban5; early turns are low-damage setup. Payoff is in ban2 (double-scaled). Reward for surviving, which ban6 immortality enables.

hard_cc: Strategic-skill stun 1 turn (ban3 marked mode)
soft_cc: -5 enemy damage debuff single-target (ban1)
-5 enemy damage debuff AoE (ban5)
invuln_or_counter: self invulnerability 1 turn (ban4, 4cd)
immortality + banish-revive at 20 HP (ban6 passive)

role: Ramping single-target Piercing bruiser with immortality sustain and damage-denial debuffs
signature_mechanic: 'Snatch' damage-boost ramp: ban1/ban5 simultaneously debuff enemy damage (-5) and grant Ban a stacking +5 damage boost; Banishing Kill (ban2) double-counts every boost stack and ignores DR, so the kit converts survival turns into ever-larger Piercing nukes. Backed by permanent immortality (ban6) that banishes Ban and revives him at 20 HP instead of dying.
internal_synergies: ban1/ban5 stacking +5 damage boosts feed ban2 at DOUBLE value (modifier_value=2), making ban2 the ramp payoff
ban5 grants +5 per enemy (up to +15/cast) -- AoE ramp accelerant that also amplifies single-target ban2
ban1 and ban5 swap into each other, letting Ban pick single-target vs AoE ramp+debuff each turn
ban6 immortality lets Ban safely invest turns ramping instead of dying, turning longevity into damage
ban1/ban5 -5 enemy damage debuffs (refreshing) extend survival, compounding the ramp loop
ban4 invuln + ban6 banish-revive give two independent panic/survival layers
strengths: Permanent immortality + 20 HP banish-revive (ban6) is extremely durable; very hard to permakill
Uncapped damage scaling: ban2 grows +10 per boost stack, ignores DR and bypasses, becoming a near-unblockable nuke late
Cheap, fast tempo: multiple 0-cd 1-pip skills allow ramping and poking every turn
Built-in enemy damage suppression (single + AoE -5, refreshing) doubles as team protection
ban4 invuln (4cd) gives a clean panic button on top of the passive
Strategic-skill stun (ban3 marked) is a flexible soft lockout vs key enemy actives
weaknesses: Front-loaded turns are low damage: ban5 deals 0, ban1 deals 0, ban3 only 10 -- needs ramp time before threatening
Heavily White-color dependent (3 White pips); starved of White energy he stalls
All damage is single-target; ban5 (his only ALL-target skill) deals no damage, so he cannot AoE-pressure
Immortality counters (true-banish, HP-set, 'cannot be revived') and stack-wipes blunt his whole game plan
Affliction damage bypasses his -5 debuffs and chips through his immortality loop
ban2 gated by 1cd + a Random pip, capping single-target burst frequency
No healing/shields/cleanse for allies -- purely selfish sustain
win_conditions: Survive early via immortality/invuln while stacking ban1/ban5 damage boosts, then snowball ban2 Piercing nukes that ignore DR and out-scale enemy defenses
Grind out attrition matchups by being effectively unkillable (banish-revive) while enemy damage is suppressed by refreshing -5 debuffs
Use ban3 Strategic stun to deny a key enemy active at the right moment, buying ramp turns

power_assessment.reasoning: Exceptional survivability (permanent immortality + 20 HP banish-revive + 4cd invuln + refreshing enemy damage debuffs) paired with uncapped, DR-ignoring single-target scaling via the double-counted ban2 is a strong, self-sufficient package. He is cheap and fast (0-cd ramp tools) and reliably converts longevity into damage, a proven attrition-winner pattern. Held back by a slow start (multiple 0-damage setup skills), single-target-only output (ban5 deals no damage), heavy White color dependency, and clear hard counters (immortality removal, Affliction, stack-wipes). Strong in long fights, mediocre in fast burst races. Rated in isolation; AoE-light and ramp-dependent enough to not be top-tier.
outlier_flags: uncapped_damage_scaling (ban2 +10 per boost stack, no cap)
permanent_immortality_with_self_revive (very hard to permakill)
ban5 ALL-target skill deals 0 damage (pure ramp/debuff, unusual)
ban2 double-counts damage boosts via modifier_value=2 set in character startup (easy to overlook)

role: single-target piercing assassin with a defensive stance/taunt-tank transformation
signature_mechanic: Mode-swapping assassin/tank: Speed Star is a 0-cooldown piercing nuke that, on its enhanced re-cast, hands Black Star a free turn of invulnerability while it also makes Big Wave uncounterable; activating Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode trades that aggression for a bypassing taunt-tank stance that swaps Speed Star and Big Wave into The Unexplored Path (uncounterable counter-punisher) and Shadow Star (DoT + thorns), turning the enemy's attacks and counters against them.

abilities.name: Speed Star
abilities.conditional_scaling: Flat 20; no damage scaling. On first cast it enhances itself for ~1 turn (mark 'Speed Star', cost_change to Random:1, and a counter-ignore buff applied to Black Star Big Wave).
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing to one enemy. First cast self-applies: Speed Star mark, cost change to 1 Random, and grants Black Star Big Wave Uncounterable. Enhanced re-cast (cost 1 Random) deals 20 Piercing again AND makes Black Star Invulnerable for 1 turn, with cooldown set to 2.

abilities.name: Black Star Big Wave
abilities.conditional_scaling: Flat 35; no scaling. Becomes Uncounterable while Speed Star mark is active (via counter-ignore buff from Speed Star).
abilities.effects_summary: 35 Piercing to one enemy + Stun for 1 turn (dur 2). Uncounterable when Speed Star is active. Primary burst + hard CC.

abilities.name: Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Stance/transformation. Self: +5 Damage Reduction and ability swaps for 3 turns (Speed Star -> The Unexplored Path, Big Wave -> Shadow Star). On target enemy (bypassing): Taunt for 3 turns + a +10 vulnerability specifically to The Unexplored Path. Turns Black Star into a bypassing taunt-tank/counter-punisher.

abilities.name: Tsubaki: Smoke Bomb
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Panic button: Black Star becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If used during Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode, also marks self so his skills Bypass invulnerability for the following turn (enables guaranteed follow-up through enemy invuln).

abilities.name: The Unexplored Path
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 if target has an active Counter effect; +10 more if target is taunted by Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode (via the vuln applied by skill 3). Both stack -> up to 45.
abilities.effects_summary: Swapped form of Speed Star during Sword Mode. 25 Normal, Uncounterable. +10 vs targets with Counter effects, +10 vs targets taunted by Sword Mode. Hard counter to counter/parry characters; reaches 45 against a counter-using, sword-mode-taunted target.

abilities.name: Shadow Star
abilities.conditional_scaling: Thorns: if target is taunted by Sword Mode, they take 15 Piercing each time they deal new (non-effect) damage to Black Star.
abilities.effects_summary: Swapped form of Big Wave during Sword Mode. 10 Normal on hit + a 10 Normal/turn DoT, plus a thorns trigger: while the target is taunted by Sword Mode, they take 15 Piercing whenever they hit Black Star with a new skill. Punishes the taunted enemy for attacking him.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Default mode burst window: enhanced Speed Star (20 Piercing) + Black Star Big Wave (35 Piercing, uncounterable + stun) = 55 single-target Piercing in one turn, all barrier/DR-bypassing, plus self-invuln. Sword Mode peak: The Unexplored Path can hit 45 (25 + 10 counter + 10 taunt-vuln) Normal; Shadow Star adds ~10 + DoT + 15 Piercing thorns per enemy retaliation. No AoE anywhere.
damage_profile.notes: All of Black Star's primary damage is single-target. The 55-burst turn is his ceiling and bypasses shields/DR (Piercing). Sustained output is low (Shadow Star DoT ~10/turn plus situational 15 thorns). He is a precision spike + survivability character, not a damage racer.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate, dual Green/White. Visible bar: Speed Star Green:1, Big Wave Green:1+White:1, Sword Mode White:1, Smoke Bomb Random:1. Heavier on Green/White; enhanced Speed Star and Smoke Bomb relax to Random so flexible mid-sequence.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast cheap spam on Speed Star (cd 0, rises to 2 only when enhanced) plus low-cost defensives. Big Wave on a 3-turn cooldown is the main gated burst; both stances (Sword Mode, Smoke Bomb) sit on 4-turn cooldowns. Overall low cost, frequent action.
economy.ramp_dependency: None for damage. Mild setup dependency: best burst turn requires sequencing Speed Star (turn 1 to enhance) then enhanced Speed Star + Big Wave (turn 2); Sword Mode value depends on landing/keeping the taunt and on the enemy actually using counters/attacking him.

hard_cc: Stun (1 turn, Black Star Big Wave)
Taunt (3 turns, bypassing, Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode)
soft_cc: Vulnerability (+10 to The Unexplored Path, applied by Sword Mode taunt)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerability 1 turn (enhanced Speed Star)
Invulnerability 1 turn (Tsubaki: Smoke Bomb panic button)
Bypass-invuln self-buff (Smoke Bomb during Sword Mode)
Uncounterable on Big Wave / The Unexplored Path
Thorns 15 Piercing retaliation vs attackers of taunted target (Shadow Star)

internal_synergies: Speed Star first cast -> enhanced Speed Star: free 1-turn invuln AND grants Big Wave Uncounterable in the same window, so the 55 burst lands through counter/parry defenses.

Sword Mode taunt -> The Unexplored Path: the taunt applies a +10 vulnerability specifically to Unexplored Path, and the same taunt feeds Shadow Star's 15 Piercing thorns whenever the taunted enemy hits him.
Sword Mode (taunt + DR + bypass on taunt) -> Smoke Bomb: during Sword Mode, Smoke Bomb additionally makes his skills Bypass invulnerability, so a taunted enemy who turtles still eats his damage.
The Unexplored Path explicitly punishes Counter effects (+10), and Big Wave/Unexplored Path are Uncounterable, making the whole kit a hard answer to counter-based defenders.
Two independent 1-turn invuln sources (enhanced Speed Star + Smoke Bomb) plus Sword Mode DR give strong uptime survivability between bursts.
win_conditions: Pick off a priority target with the 55 Piercing uncounterable burst (enhanced Speed Star + Big Wave + stun) that ignores shields/DR/counters.

Flip to Sword Mode against an aggressive or counter-reliant enemy: taunt-tank them, punish their attacks with Shadow Star thorns, and chip with the boosted Uncounterable Unexplored Path while staying alive via DR + invuln.
Out-survive and out-tempo single threats by weaving two 1-turn invulns and frequent cheap actions while denying counter/parry value.
strengths: Piercing burst (55 in a turn) bypasses barriers, shields, and DR, and is made Uncounterable in the burst window.
Hard counter to counter/parry/Counter-effect characters (Uncounterable skills + The Unexplored Path's +10 vs counters).
Excellent self-survivability: two separate 1-turn invulnerabilities plus 5 DR and a strong 3-turn bypassing taunt.
Very cheap, fast tempo (Speed Star cd 0, mostly 1-cost skills); flexible Random pips on its enhanced/defensive actions.
Bypassing taunt + invuln-bypass make him a sticky disruptor that enemies can't easily ignore or turtle past.
Hard single-target CC (stun + 3-turn taunt) and reliable thorns retaliation.
weaknesses: Zero AoE: contributes nothing to multi-target fights beyond locking one enemy; weak into wide/team comps.
Low sustained DPS once the burst window is spent (Shadow Star DoT only ~10/turn); not a damage racer.
No team utility at all: no healing, shields, cleanse, energy denial, or buffs for allies.
Much of the kit value is conditional (taunt must stick, enemy must use counters/attack him, Sword Mode setup required); against passive or CC-immune targets a lot of the kit is dead.
Stance commitment: entering Sword Mode (cd 4) removes his raw assassin burst, and the two modes can't be used at once.
Dual Green/White color requirement on Big Wave can strain energy in off-color teams.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, mechanically rich 1v1 duelist/assassin. His piercing, uncounterable, invuln-backed 55-damage burst window is genuinely strong against single high-value or counter-reliant targets, and the Sword Mode stance gives rare flexibility (bypassing taunt-tank + thorns + counter-punish) plus excellent self-survivability via two invulns and DR. He is held back from a higher tier by having literally no AoE, no team support, low sustained damage, and a kit whose upside is heavily conditional (taunt sticking, enemies using counters/attacking him). Strong, low-cost tempo and anti-counter tech keep him solidly above average in single-target/duel scenarios.
outlier_flags: anti-counter-specialist (The Unexplored Path / Uncounterable suite is a hard tech answer to counter-based characters)
dual-mode kit (4 visible skills but effectively 6 via stance swap)
stacked-invuln survivability (two independent 1-turn invuln sources)
fully single-target / zero-AoE outlier

role: Burst Assassin / Piercing single-target striker
signature_mechanic: Rasengan rotation: the passive (boruto5) every turn swaps the visible 3rd slot to a random Rasengan among Vanishing (delayed Piercing+stun), Wind Release (AoE Piercing splash), and Compression (shield-shatter Piercing + conditional stun). Boruto Shadow Clones (boruto2) is the enabler — it shields him, extends Karma Taijutsu duration, and discounts ALL three Rasengans by 1 Random energy.

abilities.name: Karma Taijutsu
abilities.conditional_scaling: While marked by Boruto Shadow Clones, also applies a 15 NORMAL damage-over-time effect lasting 1 turn (dur arg 3 = self-referenced enemy 1 turn), effectively doubling output to 30 over two ticks.
abilities.effects_summary: 1-pip spammable filler: 15 NORMAL to one enemy, 0 cooldown. Under Shadow Clones it adds a 15-damage delayed/extended tick (the 'lasts 1 more turn' rider).

abilities.name: Boruto Shadow Clones
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enables the whole kit: while active, Karma Taijutsu gains its bonus tick and all three Rasengans cost 1 less Random.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff (dur arg 8/9 = 4 self-turns): 30 Shield, a mark extending Karma Taijutsu by 1 turn, and a -1 Random cost_mod applied to Vanishing/Compression/Wind Release Rasengan. The core setup button; 3-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Vanishing Rasengan
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1, Random:1 (Random becomes free under Shadow Clones)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Delayed payload: marks enemy, then next turn deals 25 Piercing AND stuns 1 turn via a ticking trigger.
abilities.effects_summary: Default state of the rotating 3rd slot. Marks target (invisible), then on the following turn deals 25 PIERCING (skips flat+%DR) and 1-turn stun. Setup-then-hard-CC tool.

abilities.name: Thunderclap Arrow
abilities.conditional_scaling: Counter only fires if an enemy uses a Harmful skill on Boruto within 1 turn.
abilities.effects_summary: 1-turn counter/panic button (dur arg 2): the first enemy to hit Boruto with a Harmful skill takes 15 PIERCING and Boruto becomes Invulnerable for the rest of that turn. Defensive deterrent + reactive chip; 3-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Rasengan Specialist
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent (dur -1).
abilities.effects_summary: Passive: each turn re-rolls the visible 3rd slot to a different random Rasengan (Vanishing / Compression / Wind Release) via ability_swap. Gives Boruto a rotating-but-uncontrolled Rasengan menu.

abilities.name: Wind Release: Rasengan
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1, Random:1 (Random becomes free under Shadow Clones)
abilities.conditional_scaling: None.
abilities.effects_summary: Swap-in Rasengan (AoE): 20 PIERCING to main target, 10 PIERCING splash to all other enemies. 0 cooldown — the only true AoE and only spammable Rasengan when rolled.

abilities.name: Compression Rasengan
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1, Random:2 (one Random becomes free under Shadow Clones -> effective 2)
abilities.conditional_scaling: If target had NO shield, also stuns 1 turn (ignores stun-immunity flag — add_hostile_effect ...true).
abilities.effects_summary: Swap-in Rasengan (heaviest single-target): strips all Shield from target, then deals 35 PIERCING Bypassing. If the target had no Shield, also 1-turn forced Stun. Anti-shield finisher.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No stat/stack scaling — damage is fixed. The 'ceiling' is realized through energy efficiency (Shadow Clones discount) and combo sequencing, not growing numbers. Highest realistic single-turn is Compression Rasengan 35 Piercing + Karma Taijutsu 15 Normal = 50, plus the queued Vanishing Rasengan 25 landing on a later turn.
damage_profile.notes: All Rasengans deal PIERCING (skip flat + %DR); Compression is additionally Bypassing (ignores shields after shattering). Peak single-target 50 = Compression(35) + Karma(15). Wind Release gives 20 main + 10 to each other enemy (AoE peak ~30 on the focused target, scaling with enemy count via splash). Vanishing's 25 Piercing is delayed one turn and carries a stun. Sustained ~30/turn pairing Karma's doubled tick under Shadow Clones with a 1-pip Rasengan.

economy.color_dependency: Low-to-moderate. Only Blue is required, and only 1 Blue pip total (on the slot-3 Rasengan). All other costs are Random. Single-color (Blue) identity matches character_colors=[1].
economy.cooldown_tempo: Good. Two 1-pip 0-cooldown spammables (Karma Taijutsu; Wind Release when rolled). Setup/defensive buttons (Shadow Clones, Thunderclap Arrow) on 3-turn cooldowns. Rasengans on 0-1 cooldown. Shadow Clones must be re-cast every 3-4 turns to maintain the discount window.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Boruto wants Shadow Clones up first for the Shield, Karma extension, and -1 Random Rasengan discount; with it active the visible bar costs are very cheap (Rasengans effectively 1 pip / Blue+free). Without it the kit still functions but is pricier and squishier.

hard_cc: Vanishing Rasengan 1-turn stun (delayed)
Compression Rasengan 1-turn stun (conditional on no shield, forced/ignores immunity)
invuln_or_counter: Thunderclap Arrow: counter that deals 15 Piercing to first Harmful attacker and grants self Invulnerable for rest of turn

internal_synergies: Boruto Shadow Clones is the hub: -1 Random makes every Rasengan a 1-pip (Blue + free) nuke, the 30 Shield + extended Karma Taijutsu tick give it a tempo/damage swing, and the Shield also feeds Thunderclap Arrow survivability.
Rasengan Specialist (passive) + Shadow Clones discount means whichever Rasengan is rolled is cheap — the discount targets all three by name, so the random swap never wastes the buff.
Compression Rasengan + Vanishing Rasengan both apply 1-turn stuns; chaining stun -> Compression (which forced-stuns a shieldless, hence stunned-and-defenseless target) creates a lock loop.
Karma Taijutsu under Shadow Clones doubles to ~30 over two ticks for just 1 Random pip, making it strong filler that fills the turn while a Rasengan is on cooldown or being queued.
Thunderclap Arrow's invuln pairs with the queued Vanishing Rasengan: you can play defensively (counter + invuln) while a 25 Piercing + stun payload ticks down on the enemy.
win_conditions: Land Shadow Clones to open the discount/shield window, then chain cheap Piercing Rasengans (especially Compression for shield strip + forced stun) to burst a key target through defenses.
Use Vanishing -> Compression stun chains to lock a high-value enemy out of turns while Piercing damage ignores their mitigation.
Grind value with 1-pip Karma Taijutsu (doubled tick) + Wind Release AoE splash while Thunderclap Arrow + Shield keep Boruto alive against focus fire.
strengths: Almost entirely PIERCING damage — bypasses flat and percentage DR, making him a hard counter to armor/DR-stacking tanks; Compression is additionally Bypassing (ignores shields).
Excellent energy economy: only 1 specific (Blue) pip, rest Random; Shadow Clones discount turns Rasengans into 1-pip nukes.
Two independent 1-turn stuns (one forced/ignores immunity), plus a counter that grants self-invulnerability — strong control + defensive package for a striker.
Self-sufficient defenses: 30 Shield, invuln counter, and a low color requirement keep him flexible on any team.
Shield shred (Compression strip + Bypassing) makes him a clean answer to shield/barrier comps.
weaknesses: Rasengan slot is RANDOM — the passive forces which Rasengan is available each turn, so the player cannot reliably pick Compression (shield-break) or Wind Release (AoE) when needed; consistency suffers.
Fixed damage with no scaling — output does not grow over a long game, so he relies on tempo bursts rather than a rising ceiling.
Heavily dependent on Shadow Clones (3-turn cooldown); if it is cleansed/denied or on cooldown he is pricier, squishier, and loses the Karma double-tick.
Vanishing Rasengan's damage and stun are delayed a full turn, telegraphed and counter-able by cleanse/invuln/healing before it lands.
No healing, no cleanse, no team utility — purely a selfish single-target assassin; modest raw numbers (peak ~50) mean he can be out-bursted by dedicated nukers.
Low AoE outside the occasionally-rolled Wind Release; struggles to spread pressure on demand.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, well-rounded Piercing assassin. The damage type alone (near-all Piercing, with a Bypassing finisher) is a major structural strength versus DR/shield metas, and the Shadow Clones discount gives him excellent economy (1-pip Rasengan nukes). He brings two stuns, a self-invuln counter, and a shield — a complete toolkit for one character. He sits below top tier because raw numbers are fixed and modest (single-target peak ~50), and the signature Rasengan rotation is RANDOM rather than chosen, hurting reliability of his best tools (Compression's shield-break, Wind Release's AoE). Strong, flexible, low-color, but not a degenerate carry.
outlier_flags: Compression Rasengan forced stun uses add_hostile_effect(...true), bypassing stun-immunity — slightly above-curve control on a 35 Piercing Bypassing hit.
Rasengan slot randomness is unusual: a 4th visible skill the player does not fully control.

role: Ramping AoE bruiser with rage-scaling burst and a self-protect/heal panic button
signature_mechanic: Legendary Super Saiyan passive (broly5): every Harmful skill Broly RECEIVES grants a permanent, stackable +5 flat damage to ALL his abilities; at 4+ stacks his Explosive Wave (broly3) is permanently swapped for Planet Geyser Wave (broly6, 30 Piercing AoE). Being attacked literally powers him up.

abilities.name: Gigantic Slam
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Legendary Super Saiyan stack via global damage_mod (broly5); no internal scaling
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal dmg + stun on target's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn (stun_effect dur 2, exclude Strategic). Cheap, flexible-cost, low-cooldown single-target damage+soft-lock.

abilities.name: Eraser Cannon
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per LSS stack on the upfront hit and on the lingering damage tick; counter deals fixed 10
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal dmg upfront + applies a lingering damage_effect (20/turn, dur 5) AND a counter trap (COUNTER_USE) on the target: if the target uses a new Harmful skill it is countered, they take 10 dmg, and the Eraser Cannon damage effect ends. Both a DoT and an anti-aggression counter that discourages the target from attacking.

abilities.name: Explosive Wave
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per LSS stack to all enemies; permanently replaced by Planet Geyser Wave (broly6) at 4+ stacks
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Normal dmg to ALL enemies + Shatters them for 2 turns (def_negate dur 4). Shatter strips invuln/defense, enabling follow-up burst. Extremely cheap (1 Green) spammable AoE with anti-defense utility. Disappears once Broly ascends.

abilities.name: Powered Shell Protect
abilities.conditional_scaling: Heal scales with LSS stacks: 10 HP per stack (uncapped — grows as Broly is attacked)
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerable for 1 turn (invuln_effect dur 2) + heals 10 HP per Legendary Super Saiyan stack. Panic button / sustain; healing ramps with the same stacks that drive his damage, so a heavily-attacked Broly gets a large heal + 1 turn of immunity on a 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Legendary Super Saiyan
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stacks indefinitely (dur -1, permanent). Each Harmful skill RECEIVED = +5 permanent global damage. 4+ stacks triggers one-time ability swap.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden passive watcher (HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER). Every harmful skill Broly receives applies a permanent stackable +5 damage_mod to ALL his abilities and fuels broly4's heal. At >=4 stacks, permanently replaces Explosive Wave (broly3) with Planet Geyser Wave (broly6). Cannot be set up by Broly himself — depends on enemy aggression.

abilities.name: Planet Geyser Wave
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per LSS stack to all enemies; consumes ALL Legendary Super Saiyan stacks on use (resets ramp)
abilities.effects_summary: Ascended replacement for Explosive Wave (unlocked at 4+ stacks). 30 PIERCING dmg to ALL enemies (skips flat + % DR). With 4 stacks that is (30+20)=50 Piercing AoE; more stacks scale higher, but using it strips ALL stacks, dropping his global damage bonus and his broly4 heal back to zero. A nuke-and-reset payoff button.

damage_profile.notes: Base (0 stacks): Gigantic Slam 25 ST; Explosive Wave 15 AoE; Eraser Cannon 20 + DoT. With the +5/stack global mod, peaks scale linearly. Single-target peak realistically ~50: Gigantic Slam 25 + (5*~5 stacks) ~50, or stacking it on top of Eraser Cannon's DoT. AoE peak ~50: Planet Geyser Wave 30 Piercing + 20 (4 stacks) = 50 to ALL enemies, ignoring DR/shields. Higher stack counts push both peaks above 50, but Geyser consumes all stacks so it is a one-shot spike. Eraser Cannon's lingering damage_effect (20/turn) plus counter 10 adds sustained pressure.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Theoretically uncapped: +5 global damage per Harmful skill received, permanent (dur -1) and never decays except when Planet Geyser Wave consumes the stacks. A Broly left under fire can reach very high per-hit numbers (e.g. 6 stacks => +30 to every ability), and broly4 heals 10/stack uncapped. Ceiling is gated entirely by how much the enemy chooses to attack him.

economy.color_dependency: Light-to-moderate Green dependency: broly2 needs 1 Green, broly3 needs 1 Green, broly6 (ascended) needs 2 Green. broly1 and broly4 are fully random/flexible. Mono-Green identity (character_colors=[0]) but most pips are cheap and several are random, so he is easy to fund.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. broly1 (CD1) and broly3 (CD1) are near-spammable cheap damage; broly6 (CD2) is a low-cooldown AoE nuke; broly4 (CD4) is the only long cooldown; Eraser Cannon CD3. Broly can act meaningfully every turn with cheap 1-cost options.
economy.ramp_dependency: High but PASSIVE/inverted: his scaling (broly5) is driven entirely by enemies attacking him, not by his own setup. He cannot accelerate his own ramp; against a passive/evasive enemy he stays at base stats and never ascends. Against heavy aggression he snowballs hard.

hard_cc: Gigantic Slam: stuns target's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn (partial stun)
soft_cc: Explosive Wave / Eraser Cannon Shatter+counter discourage defensive/aggressive play
invuln_or_counter: Powered Shell Protect: self-Invulnerable 1 turn
Eraser Cannon: COUNTER_USE trap countering the target's next new Harmful skill for 10 dmg
Explosive Wave: Shatter strips enemy invuln/DR (anti-defense)

win_conditions: Get attacked: bait enemy aggression to stack Legendary Super Saiyan, snowballing global damage and broly4 healing until every ability one-shots squishies
Ascend to Planet Geyser Wave (4+ stacks) and detonate a 50+ Piercing AoE that ignores DR/shields, ideally as a finishing AoE wipe
Grind out cheap, low-cooldown AoE (Explosive Wave + Shatter) into single-target stun/burst while outlasting via invuln + ramping heal
internal_synergies: broly5 (passive) buffs the flat damage of EVERY other ability simultaneously, including the alt broly6 and the heal magnitude of broly4 — one stack source feeds the whole kit
Explosive Wave Shatter strips enemy invuln/DR, setting up Gigantic Slam / Eraser Cannon / a Piercing Geyser to land cleanly
Eraser Cannon's counter punishes the same enemy aggression that fuels Broly's ramp — attacking him either stacks LSS or eats a counter
broly4 turns the downside of being focused (taking damage) into sustain: more Harmful received = bigger heal
Planet Geyser Wave converts accumulated ramp into one Piercing AoE spike, then resets — synergizes with finishing a damaged enemy team
strengths: Inverted/defensive scaling: enemies powering him up by attacking is a strong, low-effort snowball that also fuels his heal
Outstanding economy/tempo — multiple 1-cost, CD1 abilities, mostly Green/random, easy to fund every turn
Flexible toolkit: single-target partial-stun, spammable AoE, anti-defense Shatter, a counter trap, self-invuln, and self-heal in only 4 visible slots
Piercing ascended AoE ignores DR/shields/barriers — hard to wall out
Self-sufficient survivability (invuln + ramping heal) lets him sit in the front and absorb focus, which is exactly what feeds his power
weaknesses: Ramp is out of his control — a patient/evasive opponent who refuses to attack him keeps Broly at base damage and prevents ascension
Planet Geyser Wave consumes ALL stacks, so his AoE nuke also deletes his accumulated damage bonus AND collapses broly4's heal — a painful reset that punishes premature use
No team support, no cleanse, no energy denial, no ally protection — purely selfish
Stun only blocks non-Strategic skills (Strategic/defensive moves still go off); soft control overall
Slow starter: at 0-3 stacks his numbers are modest (15 AoE / 25 ST) and his identity hinges on enemy cooperation
Loses Explosive Wave's repeatable Shatter once ascended (swapped out for Geyser), trading sustained anti-defense for a single nuke

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, economically efficient bruiser with a flavorful inverted-scaling identity. Cheap low-cooldown AoE+Shatter, a partial-stun, a counter trap, self-invuln and a ramping self-heal give him answers to most situations in just 4 slots, and his Piercing ascended nuke bypasses the defensive tools many characters rely on. He is held back from top tier by control he doesn't own: his entire scaling/heal engine depends on the ENEMY choosing to attack him, and his payoff button (Planet Geyser Wave) hard-resets the very ramp that makes him scary. Base-state numbers are only average. Against aggressive comps he snowballs into an A-tier threat; against disciplined opponents he is a solid-but-unremarkable B. Net: a strong, fair mid-high pick.
outlier_flags: Uncapped permanent scaling (+5 global per Harmful received) — potential balance outlier vs prolonged-aggression or multi-hit-DoT enemy comps
broly2 applies a lingering damage_effect of 20 with duration 5 in addition to the 20 upfront hit — heavy single-target pressure for a 2-cost CD3; verify the DoT duration/stacking is intended
broly4 heal (10/stack) is uncapped and shares the same stack source as his damage — can produce very large heals if stacks run high
Self-buff damage_mod applies globally to every ability, so true peak damage is gated only by stack count, not by any per-ability cap

role: Piercing DoT controller / ramping attrition assassin who ignores invulnerability and defense
signature_mechanic: Scatter, Senbonzakura: a permanent (-1 duration) 10 Piercing-per-turn DoT that bypasses invulnerability. While active it installs a 1-Red cost-change so each turn Byakuya can either move the DoT to a new target or spike the current target for 20 Piercing. After 4 skills used, his Bankai passive applies Scatter to ALL enemies and makes the DoT permanently AoE, while swapping in a 90-Piercing AoE nuke.

abilities.name: Scatter, Senbonzakura
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent DoT (duration -1) deals 10 Piercing/turn for the rest of the game; the active mode upgrades the same turn's hit to 20 Piercing on the already-marked target. Becomes AoE after Bankai (all enemies take 10/turn).
abilities.effects_summary: Apply: 10 Piercing on cast + permanent 10 Piercing/turn DoT that bypasses invulnerability; installs a permanent self cost-change (next casts cost 1 Red). Active mode (1 Red): retarget the DoT to a new enemy (10 Piercing + move DoT) OR hit the current marked target for 20 Piercing. No cooldown.

abilities.name: Bakudo #61: Six-Rod Light Restraint
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Hard CC: Shatter (def_negate, dur 4 = 2 turns) + Stun (dur 4 = 2 turns) on one enemy. Swaps Byakuya's own slot 2 to Hado #4: Pale Lightning for 2 turns (ability_swap dur 5). Stun removed on death.

abilities.name: Senka
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent stacking -5 damage debuff (damage_mod, stackable, per_stack, dur -1) on successful trigger; stacks each time it lands across the game.
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible delayed trap: marks an enemy; if they DON'T use a new skill, after the next turn deals 15 Piercing and applies a permanent stacking -5 damage debuff. If the target acts, the trap is cancelled (and a visible mark is applied). Soft-control / tech: punishes passive turns, rewards forcing the enemy to react.

abilities.name: Bakudo #81: Airtight
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend panic button). Defensive survival tool.

abilities.name: Bankai: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi
abilities.conditional_scaling: Triggers once after Byakuya uses 4 skills; converts the single-target DoT engine into a permanent AoE one.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive transformation: after 4 skills used, applies Scatter, Senbonzakura to ALL enemies (10 Piercing/turn AoE DoT for the rest of the game, bypasses invuln) and makes byakuya1's targeting permanently ALL. Also swaps slot 2 (Bakudo #61) to White Imperial Sword permanently. Cleanses/re-applies Scatter to cast correctly.

abilities.name: Hado #4: Pale Lightning
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Temporary slot-2 replacement during Bakudo #61's stun window: 20 Piercing to one enemy. Lets Byakuya follow up the stun with guaranteed damage on a defenseless (Shattered) target.

abilities.name: White Imperial Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: Damage is split evenly across living enemies (90/N): 30 each vs 3, 45 each vs 2, 90 vs a lone enemy (execute spike).
abilities.effects_summary: Post-Bankai slot-2 nuke: 90 Piercing split among all living enemies, bypasses invulnerability. Becomes a 90-damage single-target finisher when only one enemy remains.

damage_profile.notes: Pre-Bankai single-target burst is modest: Hado #4 (20) during a stun window, or Scatter active-spike (20). Real one-turn peak comes post-Bankai from White Imperial Sword: 90 Piercing total, which is 30 each vs 3 enemies but a full 90 single-target execute when one enemy is left. On top of any single-turn hit, the AoE Scatter DoT adds 10 Piercing/turn to every enemy that persists for the rest of the game. All primary damage is Piercing (skips flat+%DR) and Scatter bypasses invulnerability, so effective damage is near-unmitigated.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded over time: post-Bankai Scatter ticks 10 Piercing/turn on EVERY enemy (30/turn vs a full 3-enemy team) for the rest of the game, ignoring defense and invuln. Senka adds a permanent stacking -5 damage debuff with no cap. Against a stalling team the cumulative DoT is the win condition; the longer the game, the further ahead Byakuya gets.

economy.color_dependency: Tri-color Blue/White/Red identity (character_colors [1,2,3]). Visible kit uses Red:1+Rand:1 (Scatter), Blue:1+Rand:1 (Bakudo #61), White:1 (Senka), Rand:1 (Airtight) = 4 specific + 2 random across the 4 visible skills. Spread but not deeply demanding; Scatter's recurring 1-Red active and the post-Bankai 3-color nuke (B+W+R) make Red the most load-bearing color.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. The core damage engine (Scatter) is cooldown-0 and self-sustaining once seeded, so Byakuya can press it or spike every turn. Control (Bakudo #61) and panic invuln (Airtight) are on 4-turn cooldowns; Senka on 2. Most turns he pays only 1 Red to keep value flowing.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Front-loaded value is low; he must invest ~4 skill activations to trigger Bankai, after which the kit jumps to permanent AoE DoT + a 90-damage AoE nuke. Strong scaling into long games, weaker in fast burst races.

hard_cc: Stun (2 turns) + Shatter/def_negate via Bakudo #61
soft_cc: Senka delayed trap (punishes inaction with damage + permanent -5 damage debuff)
invuln_or_counter: Self Invulnerable 1 turn (Bakudo #81: Airtight)
Senka acts as a conditional counter/punish trap

win_conditions: Seed Scatter early, reach Bankai (4 skills), then let the permanent AoE 10/turn Piercing DoT grind the whole enemy team down while ignoring defense and invulnerability.
Use Bakudo #61 stun + Hado #4 (and later White Imperial Sword) to lock down and burst priority threats on defenseless targets.
Win long, attrition-style games where uncleansable Piercing DoT + stacking -5 damage debuffs from Senka outpace enemy healing/defense.
internal_synergies: Bakudo #61 applies Shatter (def_negate) + Stun, then swaps in Hado #4 so the follow-up 20 Piercing lands on a defenseless, action-locked target.
Bankai converts Scatter to AoE AND swaps the slot-2 stun into White Imperial Sword, so reaching transformation simultaneously upgrades the DoT engine and adds a 90-Piercing AoE nuke.
Scatter's permanent DoT and Senka's permanent -5 damage stacks both ignore enemy mitigation (Piercing / bypass invuln), reinforcing an unkillable-pressure plan.
The 1-Red Scatter active lets him keep paying for control/utility while still advancing the DoT, and the active retarget spreads pressure or spikes a focus target.
Airtight invuln buys time to ramp to Bankai against aggressive openers without losing the DoT (Scatter still ticks through his own invuln turn).
strengths: Permanent, uncleansable-in-practice Piercing DoT that bypasses both defense (Piercing) and invulnerability (Bypassing) — extremely hard to mitigate.
Post-Bankai the DoT becomes AoE on the whole team for the rest of the game: 30 effective damage/turn vs 3 enemies with zero further investment.
Cooldown-0, 1-Red core engine gives outstanding tempo and energy efficiency turn to turn.
Real hard CC (2-turn stun + Shatter) plus a self-invuln panic button — both offense and self-preservation.
Strong, essentially unbounded scaling into long games; one of the cleaner ramp-to-AoE-DoT payoffs in the roster.
White Imperial Sword is a flexible AoE-or-execute finisher (30x3 or 90 single-target) that also ignores invuln.
weaknesses: Low front-loaded burst: pre-Bankai single-turn damage tops out around 20, so he loses fast races and can be bursted before ramping.
Bankai gates the whole power spike behind using 4 skills — clumsy openings or being focused early delays his payoff.
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no energy denial — purely a damage/control profile with thin defensive depth (one 4-CD invuln).
Tri-color (B/W/R) cost spread plus a recurring Red tax can strain a multi-color team's energy economy.
Scatter DoT can be wiped by effects that remove hostile effects; his win plan collapses if the DoT is repeatedly cleansed.
Senka is conditional and easily defused (target just uses a skill), so it often yields only the soft tempo win rather than the damage.

power_assessment.reasoning: A very strong attrition/scaling design. The signature mechanic — a permanent Piercing DoT that bypasses both defense and invulnerability, on a 0-cooldown 1-Red engine — is hard to answer, and Bankai upgrading it to a free permanent AoE 10/turn on the whole team (plus a 90 bypassing AoE nuke) gives an essentially unbounded long-game ceiling. Add genuine hard CC (2-turn stun + Shatter) and a self-invuln, and he covers damage, control, and survival. He is held back from top-tier by low early burst, a 4-skill ramp gate before the payoff, and complete lack of healing/shields/cleanse, making him vulnerable to fast burst comps and DoT cleansing. Rated in isolation; recalibrate vs roster in Phase 2.
outlier_flags: Permanent (-1 duration) AoE DoT that bypasses BOTH defense (Piercing) and invulnerability (Bypassing) — near-unmitigable recurring damage is a balance outlier.
Free passive transformation that converts a single-target engine into permanent team-wide AoE DoT with no resource cost.
Senka applies an UNCAPPED permanently-stacking -5 damage debuff (per_stack, dur -1) — unbounded debuff scaling.
White Imperial Sword scales inversely with enemy count to a 90 single-target Piercing execute when one enemy remains.

role: Single-target piercing assassin with an absorption-fueled transformation ramp
signature_mechanic: Genetic Perfection transformation engine: Absorption applies a 25 Nullify barrier (blocks the target's OUTGOING damage) plus a 15 Affliction DOT; if the enemy dies under Absorption OR lets the Nullify barrier expire unbroken, Cell transforms (max 2). Transformations swap in stronger bypassing abilities (Rampant Energy Rain, then Inherited Kamehameha + Inherited Death Beam) and boost Perfected Combat (+5 dmg per transformation, cap +10).

abilities.name: Perfected Combat
abilities.effects_summary: Pure single-target nuke; +5 damage per Genetic Perfection transformation, capped at +10 (max 40). Piercing skips flat+%DR.
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 damage per transformation, capped at 2 transformations (+10 max)

abilities.name: Inherited Solar Flare
abilities.effects_summary: Applies Stun (dur 2 = 1 turn) and Shatter/def_negate (dur 2 = 1 turn). Hard CC + defense-strip combo, no damage. Replaced by Rampant Energy Rain after 1st transformation.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Absorption
abilities.effects_summary: Applies 25 Nullify barrier (blocks target's OUTGOING damage / energy-denial) + 15 Affliction DOT for 2 turns, and deals 15 Affliction immediately on cast. Stuns (dur 2) if target HP<=30 (execute-condition CC). Core transformation trigger: if target dies under Absorption or fails to break the Nullify, Cell transforms. Replaced by Inherited Death Beam after 2nd transformation.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Bonus Stun gated on target HP<=30; drives transformation ramp

abilities.name: Cellular Regeneration
abilities.effects_summary: Heals 15 HP instantly, then applies a 15 HP/turn healing DOT whose duration scales with missing HP (1 + 2*floor(missing/15) ticks). Free self-sustain on a 4-turn cooldown; bigger heal-over-time the lower Cell's HP.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Healing DOT duration scales with missing HP (extra turn per 15 HP missing)

abilities.name: Genetic Perfection
abilities.effects_summary: Passive transformation manager. On enemy death-under-Absorption or unbroken-Nullify-expiry, increments a transformation stack (cap 2). 1st: Inherited Solar Flare -> Rampant Energy Rain. 2nd: Rampant Energy Rain -> Inherited Kamehameha and Absorption -> Inherited Death Beam. Also feeds Perfected Combat's +5/transformation scaling.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stacks 0->2, permanently upgrades kit and Perfected Combat damage

abilities.name: Rampant Energy Rain
abilities.effects_summary: Channeled AoE: each turn deals 10 Energy to 3 random enemies (can multi-hit same target since pool is rebuilt with duplicates). Fires immediately on cast. Channel breaks if Cell acts again or is stunned. Unlocked by 1st transformation, replacing Inherited Solar Flare in slot 1.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Sustained while channel persists; random target distribution

abilities.name: Inherited Kamehameha
abilities.effects_summary: 40 Piercing bypassing nuke (ignores DR and can be targeted through stealth/protection). Unlocked by 2nd transformation, replacing Rampant Energy Rain in slot 1.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Inherited Death Beam
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Piercing bypassing damage + Isolate (dur 2 = 1 turn, cuts target off from ally-targeted effects). Cost 1, 0 cooldown — a cheap spammable bypassing isolate-nuke. Unlocked by 2nd transformation, replacing Absorption in slot 2.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Fully transformed (2x): one turn can stack Inherited Kamehameha (40 Piercing bypass) + Inherited Death Beam (25 Piercing bypass) = 65 single-target bypassing for 3 energy, plus the Affliction DOT may still be ticking. Perfected Combat caps at 40. Rampant Energy Rain delivers 30/turn AoE (10 to 3 random picks, can concentrate up to 30 on one target by chance). Practical ceiling is the ~65 bypassing burst once both inherited beams are online.
damage_profile.notes: Pre-transformation peak single-target is just Perfected Combat 30 Piercing + Absorption's 15 immediate Affliction = 45 in a turn. All headline damage is Piercing/Affliction/Bypassing, so it ignores DR and barriers — effective damage is very high against tanky/shielded targets. Death Beam's 0 cooldown + 1 cost makes the post-transformation single-target floor extremely cheap.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Base kit needs 2 Green (Perfected Combat, Solar Flare) + 2 Random across the 4 visible skills (~5 pips visible: cell1 2, cell2 1, cell3 2, cell4 free). Post-transformation kit pivots to Blue (Rampant Rain, Kamehameha, Death Beam all want Blue). Cell's character_colors [Green, Blue] cover both phases, so color strain is minimal.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/flexible. Perfected Combat 0 CD, Absorption/Solar Flare 1 CD, free Regeneration on 4 CD. Post-transform Death Beam is 0 CD/1 cost (spammable) and Kamehameha 2 CD. Low overall cooldown pressure.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high. The strongest abilities (Kamehameha, Death Beam, Rampant Rain) are locked behind 2 transformations, which require setting up Absorption and either killing the target under it or having the Nullify expire unbroken. A defensively passive enemy (lets barrier expire) accelerates it; an aggressive enemy who breaks the Nullify denies the trigger.

hard_cc: Stun (Solar Flare, 1 turn)
Stun (Absorption, conditional on target HP<=30)
soft_cc: Isolate (Death Beam, 1 turn)

power_assessment.reasoning: Strong, well-rounded assassin with multiple win paths. Pre-transformation he already has a 0-CD piercing nuke, a hard stun+shatter, free scaling self-heal, and Absorption — which is genuinely strong: a 25 Nullify barrier that blocks the enemy's OUTGOING damage (de facto energy/damage denial) PLUS an unavoidable Affliction DOT and an execute-stun on low-HP targets. The transformation payoff is excellent: fully ramped he gets 40 Piercing-bypass + 25 Piercing-bypass-with-isolate for only 3 energy in a turn (65 bypassing single-target that ignores DR, barriers, and stealth/protection), plus a 0-CD 1-cost spammable Death Beam and a 30/turn AoE channel. Damage type profile (Piercing/Affliction/Bypassing throughout) means his effective damage against tanks and shielded comps is far above the raw numbers. Light color dependency ([Green, Blue]) and low cooldowns round out a flexible, low-friction kit.
outlier_flags: Absorption's Nullify is described as blocking the holder's OUTGOING damage — a powerful and somewhat unusual energy/damage-denial barrier that is also the engine for the transformation ramp; verify intended interaction with damage-dealing enemies
Two valid transformation triggers (death OR unbroken-barrier-expiry) make the ramp reliable against both aggressive and passive opponents, lowering the usual risk of a ramp archetype
Rampant Energy Rain rebuilds its target pool with duplicates each pick, so all 3 hits can land on one enemy by chance — up to 30 concentrated single-target from an 'AoE' channel
Post-transformation single-target floor (Death Beam: 25 Piercing-bypass + Isolate for 1 energy, 0 CD) is very cheap and efficient

strengths: All headline damage is Piercing/Affliction/Bypassing, ignoring DR, barriers, and stealth/protection — very high effective damage vs tanky/shielded comps
Absorption is a triple-threat: outgoing-damage Nullify (energy denial), Affliction DOT, and conditional execute-stun, while also driving the transformation ramp
Strong, cheap post-transformation burst: 65 bypassing single-target in one turn for 3 energy once both inherited beams are online
Free scaling self-sustain (Cellular Regeneration) that gets stronger the lower his HP
Hard CC available early (Solar Flare stun + shatter) plus Isolate post-transform
Light, dual-phase color identity (Green early, Blue late) with low cooldown pressure
Two redundant transformation triggers (enemy death OR unbroken Nullify) make the ramp reliable against both aggressive and passive opponents
weaknesses: Best kit is gated behind 2 transformations — early game is comparatively modest (no real AoE, capped 30-40 single-target nuke)
Transformation trigger depends on Absorption sticking; an enemy who breaks the Nullify and survives denies a transformation
No teammate support, shields-for-allies, or cleanse — purely selfish
No invuln/counter/defensive immunity beyond self-heal; squishy assassin profile if focused
Rampant Energy Rain is a channel that breaks if Cell acts or is stunned, so it competes for his action and is fragile to CC
Affliction DOT damage is low (15/turn) and slow to matter on its own
win_conditions: Land Absorption, secure a transformation (kill under it or let the Nullify expire), then snowball into the inherited bypassing beams
Reach full (2x) transformation and burst priority targets for 65 bypassing single-target damage that ignores all mitigation
Use Solar Flare stun+shatter and Death Beam isolate to lock down and pick off a key enemy
Out-attrition shielded/tanky comps by leaning on Piercing/Affliction/Bypassing effective damage plus free self-heal
internal_synergies: Absorption + Genetic Perfection: Absorption is the sole transformation trigger, gating the entire power spike
