Absorption's conditional stun (HP<=30) + Perfected Combat / inherited beams: soften with DOT, then execute
Genetic Perfection -> Perfected Combat: each transformation adds +5 (cap +10) to slot-1 nuke even before the slot is swapped out
Solar Flare shatter (def_negate) sets up bigger follow-up damage before it is replaced by Rampant Energy Rain
Cellular Regeneration's missing-HP scaling lets Cell play aggressively/take trades and recover for free
Death Beam's Isolate + bypassing damage cuts a target off from ally heals/shields while ignoring their own mitigation

abilities.name: Illusion: Flame Pillar
abilities.conditional_scaling: Empowered (Rokudo Takeover mark) makes it hit all enemies; damage is fixed 25 Affliction per target on unbroken-Nullify expiry
abilities.effects_summary: Applies 15-point Nullify (barrier_effect, dur 2 = 1 turn) to target. If the Nullify expires without being broken, enemy takes 25 Affliction (bypasses barriers/shields/DR). Empowered: AoE to all enemies.

abilities.name: Illusion: Snake Bind
abilities.conditional_scaling: Empowered extends stun to 2 turns (stun_dur 4) AND adds a 15 Piercing damage-over-time effect (Effect.damage_effect dur 3) on expiry; cost rises by 1 Random
abilities.effects_summary: Applies 25-point Nullify (barrier, dur 2). On unbroken expiry: 15 Piercing damage + stun (dur 2 = 1 turn). Empowered: stun dur 4 (2 turns) + additional 15 Piercing DoT effect, but costs +1 Random.

abilities.name: Rokudo Takeover
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cost reduced to 0 when Chrome HP <= 40 (panic-button / low-HP synergy)
abilities.effects_summary: Self-heal 15 HP; applies 'Rokudo Takeover' mark for 3 turns (Effect.mark dur 7 = self-facing 3 turns), Empowering chrome1/2/4; portrait_change + target_change so Flame Pillar becomes ALL-target. Free at <=40 HP.

abilities.name: Illusion: Broken Ground
abilities.conditional_scaling: Empowered removes the self-cancel: damage reduction is no longer removed when enemies use a Harmful skill
abilities.effects_summary: AoE -5 damage debuff (damage_mod_effect -5, dur 7 = 3 turns) on all enemies. Normally removed when an affected enemy uses a Harmful skill (HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER). Empowered: debuff sticks regardless of Harmful use.

damage_profile.notes: Damage is delayed and conditional, not immediate. chrome1 Empowered applies 25 Affliction Nullify to ALL enemies, but it only resolves NEXT turn if the Nullify expires unbroken (enemy must spend a full turn's worth of damage to break a 15-point barrier, or eat 25 Affliction). chrome2 delivers 15 Piercing + stun on a 25-point Nullify; Empowered adds a 15 Piercing DoT effect (dur 3). True 'peak in one turn' from Chrome's own resolution is ~25 Affliction (AoE Empowered Flame Pillar) or 15 Piercing + stun single-target — but the damage lands a turn after application. No same-turn nuke exists.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Low/fixed numbers (15-25 per hit). Ceiling is reached by Empowering both Flame Pillar (25 AoE Affliction) and Snake Bind (15 Piercing + 15 Piercing DoT + 2-turn stun) during the 3-turn Rokudo window. No stacking/per-kill growth — ceiling is set by hitting full enemy team with Nullify each turn (~25 x team Affliction) plus persistent Broken Ground -5 damage and lock-down stuns. Total throughput modest; this is a control/attrition kit, not a damage-scaler.

economy.color_dependency: Light Blue/White-leaning but cheap. chrome2 needs 1 White, chrome3 needs 1 Blue; chrome1 and chrome4 take Random. Only 2 specific-color pips (1 White, 1 Blue) across the whole kit, so easily splashable. Empowered chrome2 adds 1 Random.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Staggered cooldowns: chrome1 CD1 (near-spammable), chrome2 CD2, chrome3 CD3, chrome4 CD4. The CD3 transformation roughly matches its 3-turn duration, so Empower can be kept up with brief gaps. Frequent low-cost casting.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Kit is functional un-Empowered (single-target Nullify control) but meaningfully stronger Empowered (AoE Flame Pillar, longer stun + DoT on Snake Bind, unconditional Broken Ground). Wants to lead with chrome3 then chain. Low-HP makes chrome3 free, a built-in comeback/ramp lever.

hard_cc: stun (chrome2 on Nullify expiry: 1 turn base, 2 turns Empowered)
soft_cc: AoE -5 damage reduction (chrome4 Broken Ground, 3 turns)
Nullify barrier acts as a soft 'pay-or-be-punished' tax / forces target prioritization

power_assessment.reasoning: A clever, low-cost control/attrition specialist with a genuinely unique signature: 'Nullify' is an enemy-facing barrier that punishes the enemy for NOT taking damage (forcing them to either break it — spending damage/effects — or eat 25 Affliction / 15 Piercing + stun). This creates a no-win dilemma and pairs naturally with AoE damage allies who break the barriers, or solo as a slow strangle. Strengths: extremely cheap (4 pips for the visible kit, only 2 colored), low cooldowns, Affliction/Piercing damage that bypasses DR and barriers, hard stun + AoE damage-reduction, self-heal and a free-at-low-HP panic transform. Weaknesses keep it midrange: all damage is DELAYED by a turn and CONDITIONAL on the Nullify expiring unbroken — savvy opponents (or any incidental AoE/self-damage) can break the barrier and negate the punish entirely; numbers are small and fixed (15-25) with no scaling ceiling; Broken Ground self-cancels un-Empowered the moment an enemy attacks; no energy denial, no real same-turn burst, and the kit is fragile (Chrome is a low-HP frame leaning on illusions, not survivability). Rated 5: solid, characterful control with good economy, but low raw output and high counterplay against the central mechanic cap its standalone power.
outlier_flags: unique-mechanic: Nullify = offensive barrier-on-enemy with delayed-punish-on-unbroken-expiry (inverse of normal shielding)
all damage is delayed one turn and negatable by breaking the barrier — effective damage often below nominal
transformation gating with built-in low-HP free-cast comeback lever (chrome3 free at <=40 HP)
very low colored-pip dependency (2 of 4 pips Random) — easy to splash

role: Cheap illusionist control/attrition skirmisher who taxes enemies with 'Nullify' delayed-punish barriers, stuns, and an AoE damage debuff
signature_mechanic: Nullify: an offensive barrier placed ON an enemy (via barrier_effect) that inverts normal shielding — if it expires WITHOUT being broken, the enemy suffers a delayed punish (chrome1: 25 Affliction; chrome2: 15 Piercing + stun, +DoT when Empowered). Empowerment via the 'Rokudo Takeover' self-mark (3 turns) upgrades all illusions: Flame Pillar becomes AoE, Snake Bind's stun/DoT extends, and Broken Ground becomes uncancellable.
internal_synergies: chrome3 (Rokudo Takeover) is the engine: its 3-turn Empower mark drives chrome1 -> AoE, chrome2 -> longer stun + extra Piercing DoT, chrome4 -> uncancellable debuff. Cooldown 3 ~ duration 3 keeps Empower near-permanent.
Self-heal on chrome3 plus its free-cast at <=40 HP gives an aggression-while-low / comeback loop: getting low enables a free transform that also heals.

Nullify barriers (chrome1/chrome2) synergize with an ally who deals AoE or chip damage — allies break the barrier (denying the enemy the chance to safely break it themselves) OR the enemy is forced to waste their turn breaking it; either way Chrome wins tempo.
chrome4 Broken Ground -5 damage softens the team, making enemy attempts to break Nullify (and their offense generally) weaker; Empowered version can't be shrugged off by attacking.
win_conditions: Maintain Empower uptime and blanket the enemy team with AoE Nullify (chrome1) each turn so multiple enemies must choose between eating 25 Affliction or spending offense to break barriers — a slow team-wide attrition strangle.
Lock a key threat with chrome2's stun chain (2-turn stun + Piercing DoT while Empowered) while Broken Ground caps the rest of the team's damage.
Outlast: stack chip Affliction/Piercing (DR-bypassing) plus self-heal and -5 AoE damage reduction to win a grind against slower or non-burst comps.
strengths: Extremely cheap and color-flexible (4 total pips, only 1 White + 1 Blue specific; 2 Random); easy to fit into any team.
Damage types bypass mitigation: Affliction (chrome1) ignores barriers/shields/DR, Piercing (chrome2) ignores flat + % DR.
Unique pressure mechanic forces bad enemy decisions (break the Nullify or take the punish).
Hard CC (stun, up to 2 turns Empowered) + AoE soft CC (-5 damage, 3 turns) + self-sustain (15 heal) + low-HP free panic transform.
Low cooldowns and a transformation whose CD matches its duration = sustained, repeatable control.
weaknesses: All offense is DELAYED a turn and CONDITIONAL: if the Nullify is broken (by the enemy taking any damage, or by allied/incidental AoE hitting the wrong target), the punish is fully negated — effective damage can be far below nominal.
Small, fixed numbers (15-25) with no stacking/per-kill scaling ceiling; poor at closing out kills or racing burst comps.
Un-Empowered Broken Ground self-cancels the instant an enemy uses a Harmful skill, so the debuff often evaporates immediately.
No energy denial, no invuln/counter, no cleanse, low single-target instantaneous threat.
Fragile, low-HP frame dependent on the chrome3 transform; if Empower is denied or interrupted the kit drops to weak single-target control.
Vulnerable to fast aggression that simply ignores barriers and kills Chrome before attrition pays off.

abilities.name: Death Chaser
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 to attacker if Nova Chariot's reactive vuln is active (gated to Death Chaser); triggers Final Form if it hits a Stunned target or drops the target below 50 HP
abilities.effects_summary: 30 Physical to one enemy; applies Death Chaser mark (refresh) and swaps slot 0 to Sadistic Tread for ~1 turn; conditionally enters Final Form (on-stun hit or crossing the 50-HP threshold). In Final Form costs 1 less Random (effectively Green:1 only).

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.conditional_scaling: Ramping DoT: 10 -> 20 -> 30 over 3 turns (tick increments +10 before damage). In Final Form, collapses to a single instant 60 Energy hit.
abilities.effects_summary: Applies a 3-turn ramping DoT (first tick 10 Normal, then 20 then 30 Energy) for 60 total over the window; Final Form converts it into 60 Energy burst delivered immediately.

abilities.name: Darkness Eye Laser
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing (bypasses invuln, skips flat+%DR) to one enemy, then permanently caps that target's max HP at its current value (-1 dur) — hard anti-heal / anti-regen that locks the enemy's ceiling for the rest of the match.

abilities.name: Nova Chariot
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reactive: only pays off if Cooler is hit by a Harmful skill during the 1-turn window
abilities.effects_summary: Self: 25 Damage Reduction for 1 turn (invisible), usable while stunned. If a Harmful skill lands on Cooler in the window, the attacker gains a +10 'take more from Death Chaser' vuln next turn AND Cooler enters Final Form. Counter/panic-button + Final Form enabler.

abilities.name: Sadistic Tread
abilities.conditional_scaling: Requires a Death-Chaser-marked enemy; the stun it applies lets a follow-up Death Chaser auto-trigger Final Form (on-stun-hit)
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap (occupies slot 0 for 1 turn after Death Chaser): 25 Physical to a marked enemy + 1-turn Stun; refreshes the mark and the swap so the Death Chaser <-> Sadistic Tread loop can continue.

abilities.name: Cruel Transformation
abilities.conditional_scaling: Final Form granted for 1 turn on: Death Chaser hitting a stunned enemy, Death Chaser dropping a target below 50 HP, or a successful Nova Chariot trigger
abilities.effects_summary: Passive Final Form: for 1 turn Death Chaser costs 1 less Random, Supernova deals its full 60 instantly, and Cooler is stun-immune (+portrait swap). No direct damage.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No stacking scaling; ceiling is fixed. Biggest single-turn output is Final Form Supernova = 60 Energy burst. Multi-turn the Death Chaser(30)->Sadistic Tread(25 + stun)->Death Chaser(30, auto-Final-Form) loop plus a 60-total Supernova DoT and 20 Piercing creates a steady ~30-55/turn lockdown chain rather than a high burst spike.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is single-target; zero AoE. Death Chaser base 30 Physical (custom_behavior AI weighting estimates 40 with Nova Chariot vuln). Supernova totals 60 over 3 turns (10/20/30) or 60 instant in Final Form. Darkness Eye Laser is only 20 but Piercing (skips flat+%DR, bypasses invuln). Realistic single-turn ceiling ~60 (FF Supernova) or ~55 if Death Chaser 30 + a marked Sadistic Tread 25 land same window.

economy.color_dependency: Three-color spread Green/Blue/Red (character_colors [0,1,3]). Death Chaser needs Green+Random, Supernova needs Red:2, Darkness Eye Laser needs Blue:1, Nova Chariot Random:1. Moderately color-hungry: wants at least 1 Green, 2 Red, 1 Blue available to run the full kit. Final Form drops Death Chaser to Green:1.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two zero-cooldown spammable harms (Death Chaser, Darkness Eye Laser) drive constant tempo; Supernova on 3 CD, Nova Chariot on 4 CD as periodic counter/setup. Fast, repeatable engine.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate. Supernova ramps 10->20->30 if left to tick, and the Final Form loop snowballs (stun -> on-stun Death Chaser -> Final Form -> cheaper Death Chaser / instant Supernova), but core damage works turn one without setup.

hard_cc: 1-turn Stun via Sadistic Tread (on marked target)
soft_cc: Death Chaser mark (enables Sadistic Tread and the Final Form loop)
permanent max-HP cap via Darkness Eye Laser (anti-heal lockout)
invuln_or_counter: Nova Chariot: 25 self Damage Reduction for 1 turn, usable while stunned
Nova Chariot reactive: punishes the attacker (+10 Death Chaser vuln) and grants Final Form

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-knit single-target bruiser/duelist with a self-reinforcing engine: cheap spammable Death Chaser + Sadistic Tread create a mark->stun->on-stun->Final Form loop, Supernova adds ramping pressure (or a 60 burst once transformed), Darkness Eye Laser is cheap Piercing with a permanent HP-cap that hard-counters healers/regen/lifesteal, and Nova Chariot is a flexible 1-cost panic button that doubles as a counter and a third Final Form enabler (and works through stun). The kit is internally synergistic and resilient (DR + stun immunity in Final Form, unstunnable Nova Chariot). Held back from higher: no AoE, no healing/shields/cleanse, no energy denial, and damage numbers are modest (peak ~60 single-turn) so it relies on chaining rather than spiking; it can be kited or focused before the loop comes online, and the three-color cost spread strains energy. Solid, fair pick-and-counter design rather than an oppressive carry.
outlier_flags: Darkness Eye Laser's permanent max-HP cap is an unusually strong, uncleansable (-1 duration) anti-heal/sustain hoser — borderline-degenerate vs healer-reliant comps
Final Form has three independent, fairly easy triggers (on-stun hit, sub-50 drop, being attacked via Nova Chariot) making the transformation reliable to access most matches
cost-mod in Final Form effectively makes Death Chaser a 1-Green spam during the loop

role: single-target duelist/bruiser with mark-stun execute loop, anti-heal denial, and a self-triggered transformation
signature_mechanic: Death Chaser mark <-> Sadistic Tread stun loop that feeds Cruel Transformation's Final Form (cheaper Death Chaser + instant 60 Supernova + stun immunity), with three reliable Final Form triggers (on-stun hit, dropping a target below 50 HP, or being attacked through Nova Chariot)
internal_synergies: Death Chaser marks -> enables Sadistic Tread (25 + 1-turn Stun)
Sadistic Tread stun -> next Death Chaser hits a stunned target -> auto-triggers Final Form
Final Form -> Death Chaser cheaper (Green:1) and Supernova becomes instant 60 burst -> stun immunity protects the loop
Death Chaser below-50 drop -> triggers Final Form (execute synergy)
Nova Chariot reactive +10 Death Chaser vuln and grants Final Form when attacked
Darkness Eye Laser HP-cap + Supernova/Death Chaser chip locks the target's ceiling so it can never recover above the cap
strengths: Cheap, zero-cooldown core (Death Chaser + Darkness Eye Laser) for relentless single-target tempo
Reliable, self-sustaining stun-lock + Final Form loop
Permanent uncleansable HP cap hard-counters healers, regen, and lifesteal
Piercing damage on Darkness Eye Laser ignores DR and bypasses invuln
Nova Chariot is a stun-proof panic button + counter + transformation enabler
Stun immunity and 25 DR give defensive resilience during the loop
weaknesses: No AoE whatsoever — poor into wide/multi-target boards
No healing, shields, or cleanse for himself or allies
Modest raw numbers (single-turn peak ~60); relies on chaining, vulnerable to burst before the loop online
Three-color Green/Blue/Red cost spread strains energy economy
Mark/stun loop can be disrupted by removing the mark or by enemies cleansing/dodging
Supernova's value is delayed unless in Final Form; can be cleansed as a DoT
win_conditions: Establish the Death Chaser <-> Sadistic Tread stun loop and ride Final Form to snowball a single target down
Land Darkness Eye Laser early to cap and neutralize an enemy healer/sustain carry, then grind
Use Nova Chariot to punish focus-fire, flip into Final Form, and burst with instant 60 Supernova

role: AoE Affliction DoT controller / energy-tax disruptor with self-protection
signature_mechanic: Energy-cost taxation plus energy-spent scaling. Black Blood inflates Crona's own next-turn costs; Tortured Resonance taxes ALL characters (+1 Random) for its duration and swaps in Scream Chaser. The Partner: Ragnarok passive converts Crona's colored costs to flexible Random for the opening turns and self-extends every time Crona takes damage. Most actives scale off total energy spent on them, rewarding overpaying into a flexible economy.

abilities.name: Black Blood
abilities.conditional_scaling: none for damage (flat 10 per enemy); always applies a +1 random-color self-cost tax next turn
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 10 Affliction to all enemies (bypasses shields/DR) plus 5 self-Affliction to Crona. Applies cost_mod (+1 energy, random color) to Crona's OWN skills next turn (dur 3 = self 1 turn). Cheap, low-cooldown AoE chip with a self-damage and self-tax downside.

abilities.name: Tortured Resonance
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT/tax/swap duration = 1 + total_energy_spent*2; at base 2-cost spend that is a 5-turn effect. Overpaying lengthens the DoT, the global tax, and the Scream Chaser swap window.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 10 Affliction immediately to all enemies AND applies a 10-Affliction-per-turn DoT for the scaled duration (~5 turns at base). Applies cost_mod (+1 Random) to ALL characters (allies and enemies) for the same duration -- a global energy tax. Swaps Crona's slot-4 action with Scream Chaser (crona5) for the duration. Strong AoE setup + soft economy lock.

abilities.name: Scream Assault
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT and taunt duration = 1 + total_energy_spent*2 (base 1-cost spend => 3-turn DoT, ~2-turn taunt). Code uses DamageType.NORMAL despite Physical class tag.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 10 Normal to one enemy, applies a 10-Normal-per-turn DoT (dur 3 at base), and Taunts the target toward Crona (taunt dur = duration-1). Single-target soft-CC + DoT; cannot be cast on a target already carrying its DoT (targeting filter).

abilities.name: Hardened Body
abilities.conditional_scaling: Shield and Damage Reduction magnitude = 5 * total_energy_spent (base 1-cost => 5 Shield + 5 DR; scales linearly with energy poured in). Both last dur 6.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-protection: grants Shield = 5*energy and flat Damage Reduction = 5*energy, both for dur 6. At base 1 energy that is only 5/5; overpaying turns it into a real panic button. Note: Affliction/Bleed damage bypasses both, so it does not protect against other Affliction users.

abilities.name: Scream Chaser
abilities.conditional_scaling: base 25 + 10 per total energy spent (base 2-cost => 45). No cooldown, so it can be spammed each turn it is available; overpaying scales it indefinitely (energy-bound).
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt skill swapped into slot 4 by Tortured Resonance. Deals 25 + 10*energy Normal single-target damage (45 at base 2-cost) with NO cooldown -- a repeatable nuke during the swap window. This is Crona's main burst/finisher.

abilities.name: Partner: Ragnarok
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-extending: starts ~3 turns (mark dur 7) and gains +1 turn (code adds +2 to internal duration) every time Crona takes damage, so it can persist the whole match if Crona is repeatedly hit.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive that color-converts ALL of Crona's colored energy costs (Red/Blue/Green/White) to RANDOM, eliminating his color dependency for the opening turns. A DAMAGE_RECEIVE trigger extends the duration each time Crona is damaged -- and since his own Black Blood self-damage and any incoming hits feed it, the economy buff tends to stay live. Pure economic enabler, no offense.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Energy-bound rather than stack-bound. Scream Chaser (25 + 10/energy) and Hardened Body (5 Shield+DR per energy) scale linearly with energy invested, so the ceiling is set by how much energy Crona can dump in one turn (e.g. 4 energy into Scream Chaser = 65). DoTs from Tortured Resonance + Scream Assault can stack to ~30/turn Affliction+Normal on a focused target while AoE DoT ticks 10/turn on the whole enemy team.
damage_profile.notes: Peak single-target ~45 from base Scream Chaser (higher if overpaid). Peak immediate AoE = 20 (10 instant + first 10 DoT tick from Tortured Resonance per enemy). Affliction damage (crona1/crona2) bypasses shields and DR, making the AoE and DoT 'effective' even into tanky comps. Note crona3 deals Normal despite its Physical class tag.

economy.color_dependency: Nominally 4-color (Green, Blue, White, Red across the 4 visible skills) which is heavy. BUT the Partner: Ragnarok passive converts all of Crona's colored costs to Random for the opening turns and self-extends on damage, so in practice color dependency is LOW early and stays low if he keeps taking hits. Black Blood's self-tax and Tortured Resonance's global tax add color/quantity pressure.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mixed. Two low-cooldown spam tools (Black Blood cd1, Scream Assault cd1) for sustained chip/DoT. Two cd4 cornerstones (Tortured Resonance, Hardened Body). Scream Chaser is cd0 but only accessible via the Tortured Resonance swap window, gating his burst behind a 4-cd setup skill.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate. No stack ramp; power instead ramps with how much energy he can pour into scaling skills each turn and with keeping Ragnarok alive. Tortured Resonance is the key tempo investment that both sets up the swap-nuke and applies the global tax.

soft_cc: Taunt (Scream Assault, ~2 turns at base, scales with energy)

power_assessment.reasoning: Crona is a well-rounded AoE Affliction/DoT disruptor with a flexible, self-fixing economy. Strengths: (1) Affliction AoE + DoT that bypasses shields and DR, very reliable damage into tanky teams; (2) a strong soft-lock economy package -- Tortured Resonance taxes EVERY character +1 Random for ~5 turns, real tempo denial, and Black Blood adds extra pressure; (3) Partner: Ragnarok nearly erases his otherwise-heavy 4-color requirement and self-extends on damage, so he is easy to pilot and color-flexible; (4) Scream Chaser is a no-cooldown 45+ nuke during the swap window, a credible single-target finisher; (5) Hardened Body provides scalable self-defense, and Taunt gives him a peel/aggro tool. Weaknesses: raw numbers are individually modest (10s and 45), he self-damages with Black Blood, his best burst is gated behind a cd4 setup, his Shield/DR do nothing against other Affliction/Bleed attackers, and he has no healing, no hard CC, and no cleanse. He is a value/attrition piece rather than a one-turn killer -- solid and flexible but not oppressive in isolation.
outlier_flags: GLOBAL energy tax: Tortured Resonance increases skill costs of ALL characters (allies included) for ~5 turns -- unusual self-inflicting but powerful enemy disruption
Self-fixing color identity: Ragnarok converts a 4-color kit to Random and self-extends whenever Crona takes damage (including his own Black Blood self-damage)
Class/damage-type mismatch: Scream Assault is tagged Physical but resolves NORMAL damage in code
cd0 hidden nuke (Scream Chaser) only reachable via the Tortured Resonance swap, so burst is conditional

strengths: Affliction AoE and DoT bypass shields/DR for reliable damage into tanky comps
Tortured Resonance applies a multi-turn +1-Random energy tax to ALL characters -- strong tempo/economy disruption
Partner: Ragnarok converts his heavy 4-color kit to flexible Random and self-extends on damage, making him color-light and easy to pilot
Scream Chaser is a no-cooldown 45+ single-target nuke during the swap window (energy-scalable finisher)
Layered DoTs (AoE from crona2, single-target from crona3) provide strong sustained/attrition damage
Scalable self-protection (Hardened Body) plus a Taunt for peel/aggro control
weaknesses: No healing, no hard CC, no cleanse, no invuln/counter -- limited defensive/utility ceiling
Best burst (Scream Chaser) is gated behind the cd4 Tortured Resonance swap setup
Hardened Body's Shield/DR is useless against other Affliction/Bleed attackers
Self-damages himself with Black Blood and self-taxes his own next-turn costs
Tortured Resonance's global tax also hits his own allies, hurting team tempo
Individual hit numbers are modest; relies on attrition and energy investment rather than spike damage
Nominal 4-color requirement is punishing if Ragnarok lapses
win_conditions: Grind the enemy team down with shield/DR-ignoring AoE Affliction + stacked DoTs over many turns
Choke the opposing economy with the Tortured Resonance global +1-Random tax to deny key enemy turns, then capitalize with swapped-in Scream Chaser nukes
Outlast as an attrition tank: keep Ragnarok alive via incoming damage, soak with Hardened Body, and let DoTs do the work
internal_synergies: Tortured Resonance -> Scream Chaser: the cd4 setup swaps in the cd0 45+ nuke, so the tax skill is also Crona's burst enabler
Partner: Ragnarok + Black Blood: Black Blood's 5 self-Affliction feeds the DAMAGE_RECEIVE trigger that extends Ragnarok, helping keep his costs converted to Random
Ragnarok color-conversion smooths the kit's heavy Green/Blue/White/Red demands and the +1 cost taxes from Black Blood/Tortured Resonance
Scream Assault's Taunt + Hardened Body's Shield/DR let Crona body-block for allies while DoTs tick
Energy-spent scaling across Hardened Body and Scream Chaser rewards dumping the flexible Random energy Ragnarok provides into a single big turn

abilities.name: Mother Catastrophe
abilities.conditional_scaling: If Heavy Metal shield is active when cast, the delayed hit gains +2 turns delay and +20 damage (30 -> 50). Heavy Metal recast while the trigger is pending stacks further +20 each time.
abilities.effects_summary: Plants a delayed ticking trigger that resolves NORMAL damage to one targeted enemy after a 1-turn delay (duration 3, fires when down to 1). Despite 'Bypasses' wording in the JSON the resolved damage is DamageType.NORMAL (NOT a barrier-bypassing type). If the target is invulnerable when it lands, applies a 1-turn stun (anti-invuln tech). Target is invisible/untelegraphed; cannot be recast while a trigger is pending.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.conditional_scaling: If a Mother Catastrophe trigger is already pending, retroactively adds +2 duration and +20 damage to it; repeatable to keep buffing/extending the same delayed nuke.
abilities.effects_summary: Self shield of 30 (duration -1 = persists until broken). While the shield holds it makes the NEXT Mother Catastrophe cast hit harder (+20) and later (+2 dur); also buffs an already-pending Catastrophe. Pure setup/defense + nuke amplifier.

abilities.name: Queen's Embrace
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base duration 4 (2 turns). Each prior Diane Dance use (mark stacks) adds +2 duration (+1 turn) permanently for the rest of the match.
abilities.effects_summary: Team/global utility: grants 15 flat damage reduction to ALL characters (allies AND enemies) for 2 turns. Marks every enemy so they can be targeted by Ground Gladius, and swaps this slot to Ground Gladius for the duration (ability_swap slot 4->5).

abilities.name: Diane Dance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Each use permanently adds 1 stack to a Diane Dance mark, extending Queen's Embrace by +1 turn for the rest of the game (ramp).
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). Permanently buffs Queen's Embrace duration by +1 turn per cast via a stacking, displayed mark. Defensive cooldown + long-game ramp enabler.

abilities.name: Ground Gladius
abilities.conditional_scaling: Requires target to be marked by Queen's Embrace; no inherent stacking beyond the 5 Bleed follow-up.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap ability available only while Queen's Embrace is active. Deals 30 PIERCING damage (skips flat + % DR, so ignores the 15 DR it just granted) to a Queen's Embrace-marked enemy, plus 5 Bleed damage next turn (last_turn_only). Repeatable cd1 spammable hit during the Embrace window.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Single delayed Mother Catastrophe caps at ~50 NORMAL (base 30 + one Heavy Metal +20); chaining multiple Heavy Metal recasts onto a pending trigger can push it higher (+20 per recast) but each costs a turn and Green pip, so realistic ceiling is 50-70 over a multi-turn setup. Sustained pressure comes from Ground Gladius: 30 Piercing + 5 Bleed = 35 effective/turn at cd1 while Queen's Embrace is up, ignoring DR/shields.
damage_profile.notes: In a given turn Diane does little direct damage herself: Catastrophe is delayed and Ground Gladius is the only on-cast hit (30 Piercing). True burst arrives a turn later. Ground Gladius is the only reliable barrier/DR-ignoring damage (Piercing + Bleed). No AoE damage anywhere.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Visible kit needs 2 Green (Heavy Metal, Queen's Embrace) + 2 Random. Hidden Ground Gladius needs 1 Blue. Energy identity Green/Blue but cheap and flexible.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/cheap: every ability is 1 pip. cd2 on the core trio, cd4 on Diane Dance, and Ground Gladius is cd1 (spammable). Low energy strain lets her contribute every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate but optional. Diane Dance permanently extends Queen's Embrace each cast, rewarding long games, but the core loop (Catastrophe setup, Embrace DR, Ground Gladius) works from turn one. Mother Catastrophe wants Heavy Metal up first for max value.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun on invulnerable Mother Catastrophe targets (anti-invuln punish)
invuln_or_counter: Diane Dance: 1-turn self invulnerability
Mother Catastrophe: punishes/stuns enemies who go invulnerable

role: Defensive setup/control bruiser: team-wide damage reduction, delayed anti-invuln burst, and DR-ignoring Piercing/Bleed pressure
signature_mechanic: Mother Catastrophe — an invisible, delayed single-target hit (30 NORMAL, lands next turn) that can be amplified and re-delayed by Heavy Metal (+20 dmg / +2 turns per recast) and STUNS any target that is invulnerable when it resolves, hard-countering defend/invuln playstyles. Paired with Queen's Embrace, which grants global 15 DR while swapping in Ground Gladius for spammable Piercing+Bleed.
internal_synergies: Heavy Metal -> Mother Catastrophe: shield enables +20 dmg / +2 turn delay; recasting Heavy Metal onto a pending Catastrophe stacks the buff into a bigger nuke.
Queen's Embrace -> Ground Gladius: Embrace marks enemies and swaps in Ground Gladius; Gladius is Piercing so it ignores the 15 DR Embrace just granted, while enemies stay slowed by DR.
Diane Dance -> Queen's Embrace: each Dance permanently extends Embrace duration (more DR uptime + longer Ground Gladius window).
Mother Catastrophe + Diane Dance: both punish invuln/defend metas (Dance gives her own invuln, Catastrophe stuns enemy invuln).
Heavy Metal shield + Diane Dance invuln give layered self-protection while the delayed nuke ticks.
strengths: Extremely cheap kit (every ability 1 pip) with low color strain - contributes every turn.
Strong anti-defend/anti-invuln tech: Mother Catastrophe stuns invulnerable targets, blanking enemy defensive turns.
Team-wide 15 flat DR (Queen's Embrace) is a real survivability swing for the whole squad.
Ground Gladius (cd1, Piercing + Bleed) ignores DR/shields and ignores the DR she grants, giving reliable repeatable damage.
Layered personal defense: persistent 30 shield + 1-turn invuln + delayed untelegraphed threat.
Permanent Queen's Embrace ramp via Diane Dance rewards stall/long games.
weaknesses: Very low immediate/burst damage: Catastrophe is delayed and modest (30, max ~50), no on-demand spike.
No AoE damage at all - single-target only despite the 'wide-spread havoc' flavor.
Queen's Embrace gives DR to ENEMIES too, partially shielding the opponents she wants to kill.
Mother Catastrophe damage is NORMAL type (despite 'Bypasses' wording), so it is reduced by enemy DR/shields/barriers.
Ground Gladius is gated behind Queen's Embrace being active and the enemy being marked; outside that window her offense is just one slow delayed hit.
No healing, no cleanse, no energy denial - limited proactive disruption.
Catastrophe's stun only triggers if the enemy happens to be invuln on the landing turn - situational.
win_conditions: Grind out attrition: keep Queen's Embrace up for global DR and chip enemies down with cd1 Ground Gladius Piercing + Bleed while outlasting them.
Hard-counter a defend/invuln-reliant enemy: land Mother Catastrophe on their invuln turn to stun and tempo-blank them.
Ramp Queen's Embrace duration with repeated Diane Dance for near-permanent team DR in long games.
Stack Heavy Metal onto a pending Mother Catastrophe for an oversized delayed nuke to close out a low target.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, cheap utility/control character rather than a damage threat. Her standout tools are the anti-invuln stun on Mother Catastrophe and team-wide 15 DR from Queen's Embrace, both genuinely impactful in the right matchup. Ground Gladius (cd1 Piercing + Bleed, DR-ignoring) gives her a respectable, repeatable damage floor while Embrace is up. But she has no burst (delayed 30, ~50 max), no AoE, and Queen's Embrace symmetrically buffs enemy DR, blunting her own offense. Mother Catastrophe being NORMAL (not a true bypass type) also undercuts its threat into defensive comps. Solid, flexible, low-floor/medium-ceiling support-bruiser; effective in attrition/anti-defend metas, unremarkable against burst or aggressive teams. Rated around average.
outlier_flags: JSON metadata vs .gd mismatch: Mother Catastrophe base damage is 30 in the .gd, not 25 as listed in metadata; diane3 JSON also omits the enemy DR / mark / ability-swap details.
'Bypasses' wording on Mother Catastrophe does NOT correspond to a bypassing DamageType - resolved as NORMAL, so it is mitigated by DR/shields (likely design/wording bug).
Queen's Embrace granting 15 DR to enemies as well as allies is unusual and self-counters her own damage (intentional 'all characters' but worth flagging).

abilities.name: Destruction Alchemy
abilities.conditional_scaling: Flat 45 Affliction; reduced to 35 for 1 turn while Defensive Alchemy's -10 damage_mod is active. When 'improved' (cost-changed by Defensive Alchemy) and not already marked, triggers Free Transmutation passive to gain 1 random energy.
abilities.effects_summary: 45 Affliction damage (bypasses barriers/shields/DR) AND caps target's max HP to current HP (cap_health) -- permanently locks out healing/regen above that value. Can self-trigger 1 random energy via passive when improved.

abilities.name: Defensive Alchemy
abilities.conditional_scaling: Grants 20 Shield/Nullify base; reduced to 10 when marked by Battle Alchemy (cost-free version). When marked by Battle Alchemy and not yet Free-Transmutation-marked, triggers passive for 1 random energy. Then applies cost_change(Destruction Alchemy -> 2 Random) and damage_mod(Destruction Alchemy -10) for 1 turn.
abilities.effects_summary: Flexible buff/debuff: 20 Shield to an ally OR 20 Nullify (barrier) to an enemy. Self-applies a cost-and-damage modifier to Destruction Alchemy (makes it 2-Random cost but -10 dmg next turn).

abilities.name: Battle Alchemy
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Grants target ally +10 to all non-Affliction damage until end of turn (damage_mod). Self-applies: Defensive Alchemy becomes free (cost_change to {}) but gives 10 less Shield/Nullify next turn.

abilities.name: Fullmetal Alchemy
abilities.conditional_scaling: Two-mode: first use = self-Invulnerable 1 turn + self-mark (4-turn window). While marked, subsequent uses deal 20 Piercing to one enemy instead of defending.
abilities.effects_summary: Panic button: become Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend) and gain a 4-turn window. During that window, recast (0 cooldown, 1 random) to deal 20 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) to one enemy. No cooldown on either mode.

abilities.name: Free Transmutation
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Passive energy ramp: when Edward uses Defensive Alchemy or Destruction Alchemy WHILE THEY ARE IMPROVED (cost-modified by the other), he gains 1 random energy, then the passive self-disables for 3 turns. Net: roughly 1 free pip every 3 turns when comboing.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No real scaling. Damage is fixed: 45 Affliction (Destruction Alchemy) + 20 Piercing (Fullmetal Alchemy while marked) = 65 single-target in one turn if both available, both ignoring defenses. Destruction Alchemy drops to 35 the turn after Defensive Alchemy improves it. No stacking, no per-enemy or per-stack growth.
damage_profile.notes: Damage is low for a 4-skill kit but high-quality: 45 Affliction bypasses barriers/shields/DR and the max-HP cap is unique anti-sustain control. Fullmetal's 20 Piercing skips flat and % DR. Edward1 cooldown 1 means it is NOT spammable every turn -- effectively ~45 every other turn plus 20 piercing filler.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate. character_colors = [Blue, Red]. Visible kit costs Red:2 (Destruction) + Blue:1 (Defensive) + Blue:1 (Battle) + Random:1 (Fullmetal) = 2 Red, 2 Blue, 1 Random. Two-color dependent (Blue+Red). Combos relax this: Defensive can make Destruction cost 2 Random instead of 2 Red, and Battle can make Defensive cost 0.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/low. Most skills cd 0-1; Battle Alchemy cd 2. Fullmetal Alchemy cd 0 (spammable invuln/piercing). Destruction Alchemy cd 1 so the nuke is every-other-turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: Mild positive ramp via Free Transmutation passive (1 random pip every ~3 turns when comboing improved skills) plus the cost-reduction loop (Battle->Defensive free, Defensive->Destruction Random). Not a hard ramp character; functions fine turn 1, combos just lower energy strain.

invuln_or_counter: Self Invulnerable for 1 turn via Fullmetal Alchemy (default_defend), repeatable at cd 0

internal_synergies: Battle Alchemy -> Defensive Alchemy: makes Defensive free (but -10 Shield/Nullify), and casting improved Defensive triggers Free Transmutation for +1 random energy.

Defensive Alchemy -> Destruction Alchemy: converts Destruction's cost to 2 Random (color flexibility) at the price of -10 damage (45 -> 35); casting improved Destruction triggers Free Transmutation for +1 random energy.
Free Transmutation passive rewards using the cost-improved versions, creating a self-funding economy loop (but self-disables 3 turns each trigger).
Battle Alchemy can buff an ally's non-Affliction damage by +10 the same turn it sets up the Defensive discount -- doubles as team support.
Fullmetal Alchemy is independent: free-standing invuln/peel + repeatable 20 piercing filler that ignores DR, good while waiting on Destruction Alchemy's cooldown.
role: single-target Affliction nuker + anti-heal control with shield/nullify support and self-peel
signature_mechanic: Destruction Alchemy: 45 Affliction damage that ALSO caps the target's max HP to their current HP (cap_health), permanently denying healing/regen above that line -- paired with an alchemy 'improvement' loop where each skill cost-modifies another (Battle->Defensive->Destruction) and using the improved versions self-funds 1 random energy via the Free Transmutation passive.
strengths: High-quality unmitigated damage: 45 Affliction bypasses all barriers/shields/DR; 20 Piercing skips flat+% DR. Tanks and shield-stackers cannot defend against him.
Unique anti-sustain: max-HP cap shuts off healing/regen/lifesteal on a priority target, hard-countering sustain comps.
Flexible utility: same skill (Defensive Alchemy) gives ally shield OR enemy nullify; Battle Alchemy buffs ally damage.
Repeatable on-demand self-Invulnerability (Fullmetal Alchemy, cd 0) -- strong survivability/peel and bait.
Self-funding energy economy via cost-reduction combos + Free Transmutation passive; cheap kit (5 pips total).
Low cooldowns and instant casts keep tempo high.
weaknesses: No AoE whatsoever -- purely single-target; weak into wide boards.
Low raw numbers: even peak one-turn output is ~65, and Destruction Alchemy's cd 1 means ~45 every other turn. Slow to actually kill.
No hard CC, no stuns/silences, no cleanse, no team healing.
Combo loop is fiddly and self-throttling: Free Transmutation disables 3 turns after each trigger; improving Destruction costs it -10 damage; improving Defensive costs it -10 shield.
Two-color (Blue+Red) requirement before combos kick in; Red:2 on the main nuke is a meaningful early demand.
Invuln only protects Edward himself -- no team protection beyond a single 20 shield.
Damage doesn't scale at all -- falls off in longer/bigger fights relative to scaling carries.
win_conditions: Pick a key sustain/tank target and lock its max HP with Destruction Alchemy, neutralizing enemy healing while chipping with Affliction + Piercing.
Out-tempo via cheap, low-cooldown utility: shield allies, nullify threats, buff a carry's damage, and survive with repeatable invuln while the rest of the team closes the game.
Grind down a defensive/shield-heavy comp that can't mitigate his Affliction/Piercing.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, low-cost support/control with two standout high-quality tools: defense-ignoring damage (45 Affliction + 20 Piercing) and a max-HP cap that hard-counters healing/regen comps. Repeatable self-invuln and flexible shield/nullify add real utility, and the self-funding energy loop keeps his cheap kit online. But raw damage is low and unscaling (cd 1 on the main nuke caps him near ~45/other-turn), he has zero AoE and zero hard CC, and his combo loop is intentionally throttled (passive 3-turn lockout, -10 penalties for improving skills). He's a solid role-player and tech pick against sustain/shield comps rather than a top-tier carry. Rated mid in isolation.
outlier_flags: max-HP cap (cap_health) is a rare/unique anti-heal mechanic -- verify roster prevalence; could be over/under-tuned depending on how many sustain comps exist
Fullmetal Alchemy has cooldown 0 on BOTH a self-Invulnerability and a repeatable 20 Piercing -- a 0-cd invuln is worth flagging for loop/abuse potential
Affliction + Piercing total ignores essentially all defensive stats -- strong vs the meta if mitigation is common

role: Reactive copy/projection skirmisher
signature_mechanic: Unlimited Blade Works (emiya7 passive): at game start all 4 visible slots become copies of "Trace, On!". Trace, On! grants 5 permanent shield and swaps a slot into a random Projection (Nameless Blade/Kanshou/Bakuya/Rho Aias) for a turn. Each enemy gets a HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER that auto-fires a random Trace/True Projection for free whenever they use a new Harmful skill. After Trace, On! is used 6 times it permanently upgrades to True Projection, which can copy the enemy's own used Harmful skill (steal) and swaps among a growing pool of copied + base Projection skills.

abilities.name: Trace, On!
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (RNG which Projection it becomes)
abilities.effects_summary: Gives Emiya 5 permanent Shield (dur -1). Swaps this slot into a random Projection skill (rolls slots 2-5: Nameless Blade / Kanshou / Bakuya / Rho Aias) as a copy for ~1 turn. Counts toward the 6-use upgrade to True Projection. Engine fills ALL 4 visible action-bar slots with copies of this at battle start via emiya7.

abilities.name: True Projection
abilities.conditional_scaling: Steal pool grows with each enemy Harmful skill copied
abilities.effects_summary: Upgraded form of Trace, On! after 6 uses (replaces it in all slots permanently; reached via emiya7 swap-in). Places a 1-turn HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER on target enemy: if that enemy uses a Harmful skill, that exact skill replaces this slot (steals it) and is added to Emiya's permanent copy pool. If not triggered, swaps into a random base Projection OR a previously-copied skill. Does NOT grant shield (unlike Trace, On!).

abilities.name: Projection - Nameless Blade
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 10 Piercing damage (skips flat + % DR) to one enemy. Free, no rider. The cheap filler swap-target; accessed by swapping in via Trace, On! / True Projection / on-harm auto-trigger.

abilities.name: Projection - Kanshou
abilities.conditional_scaling: On-mark: Silences 1 turn if target was Kanshou-marked previously
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Piercing damage (JSON claims 20; code is 15). Applies a 'Projection - Kanshou' mark (dur 3). If the target was already Kanshou-marked, also Silences for 1 turn (silence_effect dur 2). Note: in-file split_desc text mislabels the silence condition as 'Bakuya last turn'; the mark/check both key off Kanshou.

abilities.name: Projection - Bakuya
abilities.conditional_scaling: On-mark: Stuns 1 turn if target was Bakuya-marked previously
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Piercing damage. Applies a 'Projection - Bakuya' mark (dur 3). If target already Bakuya-marked, also Stuns for 1 turn (stun_effect dur 2). The Red pip cost is the only specific-color requirement in the kit.

abilities.name: Projection - Rho Aias
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Defensive Projection: Emiya AND target ally both become Invulnerable for 1 turn (invuln_effect dur 2 on both). 2-body invuln for 1 pip; the protective option in the random swap pool.

abilities.name: Unlimited Blade Works
abilities.conditional_scaling: Steal/copy pool and upgrade count ramp over the match
abilities.effects_summary: Core passive (custom_behavior PASSes; never manually cast). At start: fills all 4 visible slots with Trace, On! copies. Places permanent HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER on every enemy: whenever an enemy uses a NEW Harmful skill, a random one of Emiya's Trace,On!/True Projection auto-fires for FREE (Trace path: +5 shield + random Projection swap-in + counts a use; True path: copy/steal). Tracks Trace uses; at 6 uses permanently converts all Trace,On! slots to True Projection.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Damage ceiling is modest and roughly flat: at best ~15 Piercing per direct cast (Kanshou/Bakuya); chaining two same-mark casts = ~30 Piercing + a hard CC over two turns. The on-harm passive can add a free extra Projection cast per enemy Harmful skill, pushing a single reactive turn toward ~25-30 effective Piercing. No multiplicative or per-stack damage scaling — the 'ramp' is breadth of stolen skills (utility), not raw numbers. Bleed/Affliction absent.
damage_profile.notes: All offense is Piercing (10/15/15), bypassing flat and % DR — reliable but never burst-y. Real strength is CC density (silence + stun via mark combos) and free reactive casts, not damage.

economy.color_dependency: Very low. The 4 visible slots all start as FREE Trace, On!. The only specific-color requirement is Projection - Bakuya's 1 Red pip (matching his [Red] identity); Kanshou and Rho Aias take 1 Random each, Nameless Blade is free. Most turns cost 0-1 pips.
economy.cooldown_tempo: No cooldowns anywhere (all 0 CD). Tempo is gated instead by RNG swap rolls and the on-harm trigger firing — Emiya cannot reliably choose which Projection he gets each turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high but utility-only ramp: needs ~6 Trace uses to upgrade to True Projection, and the steal pool grows over time. Early game he is a 0-cost shield-generator + random poke; late game he can mirror enemy harmful skills. None of this raises damage numbers.

hard_cc: Stun (1 turn, Bakuya on Bakuya-mark)
Silence (1 turn, Kanshou on Kanshou-mark)
soft_cc: Mark (Kanshou / Bakuya marks, dur 3, set up the CC follow-ups)
invuln_or_counter: Rho Aias: Emiya + target ally Invulnerable 1 turn
On-harm auto-trigger acts as a soft counter — every enemy Harmful skill auto-fires a free Projection/shield in response

win_conditions: Grind out value with free, no-cooldown Piercing pokes while stacking 5-shield blocks faster than the enemy can remove them.
Land a mark then re-fire the same blade (Bakuya->Bakuya = Stun, Kanshou->Kanshou = Silence) to lock down a key enemy across two turns.
Reach True Projection (6 Trace uses) and steal a strong enemy Harmful skill into the permanent copy pool, then re-use the enemy's own tool against them.
Use the on-harm passive as a tax: punish enemy aggression with free reactive Projections + shields, winning attrition.
internal_synergies: emiya7 passive is the engine: it fills slots with Trace, On! and grants the free on-harm auto-casts that recycle every other ability.
Trace, On! (emiya1) feeds both the shield stack AND the 6-use counter that unlocks True Projection (emiya2).
Kanshou mark + repeat Kanshou = Silence; Bakuya mark + repeat Bakuya = Stun — the twin blades are a self-contained mark->CC combo, but RNG swap makes hitting the same blade twice unreliable.
True Projection's steal grows the swap pool, increasing the odds future swaps roll into a useful (possibly enemy) skill.
Rho Aias gives him a defensive option in the same random pool, so the RNG toolbox covers offense, CC, and protection.
strengths: Extremely cheap: nearly the entire kit is free or 1 pip, almost no color dependency, zero cooldowns.
All damage is Piercing — reliably bypasses flat and percentage DR, so it never gets walled by tanks/armor.
Strong, renewable self-sustain via repeated 5-point permanent shields (from casts AND free on-harm triggers).
Reactive free value: the on-harm passive punishes every enemy Harmful action with a free Projection/shield, effectively taxing aggression.
Built-in hard CC (stun + silence) plus a 2-body invuln, plus a late-game skill-steal — broad utility from one character.
Very low resource footprint frees teammates to spend the energy pool.
weaknesses: Heavy RNG: which Projection a slot becomes is rolled, so he cannot reliably choose Kanshou vs Bakuya vs Rho Aias — combo and CC setups are inconsistent.
Low raw damage ceiling: 10-15 Piercing per hit with no multiplicative scaling; he will rarely close out kills quickly.
CC is conditional on landing the SAME mark twice, which RNG swapping actively fights against.
On-harm passive only triggers on NEW enemy Harmful skills — passive/defensive enemy comps starve his free-cast engine.
Slow ramp to True Projection (6 Trace uses) and the steal does nothing if enemies lack worthwhile skills to copy.
No healing, no cleanse, no energy denial; protection is short (1-turn invuln) and offense is grindy.
Code/description drift (Kanshou listed as 20 dmg but is 15; mislabeled silence condition) suggests the kit may not behave as players expect.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, low-cost attrition/utility character rather than a power outlier. Free no-cooldown Piercing pokes that ignore DR, renewable permanent shields, a free reactive cast on enemy aggression, hard CC (stun + silence), a 2-body invuln, and a late-game skill-steal make him genuinely flexible and resource-efficient — a solid B-tier toolbox. He is held back from being strong by low damage numbers (no scaling, ~15 max per hit), heavy RNG that undermines his own mark->CC combos and target selection, and a slow utility-only ramp. He shines in grindy attrition matchups and against aggressive Harmful-heavy enemies, but struggles to ever burst or close games and is unreliable on demand. Mid-tier overall.
outlier_flags: Unusual mechanic: all 4 visible slots are replaced at start by copies of one free ability (Trace, On!), with the 'real' abilities reached only via RNG swap — atypical and hard to evaluate against standard 4-skill kits.
Free on-harm auto-cast on EVERY enemy and EVERY new Harmful skill is a strong reactive-value engine that could over/under-perform depending on enemy comp.
JSON description damage (Kanshou 20) and a mislabeled CC condition disagree with the ground-truth .gd (15 dmg, Kanshou-keyed silence) — data-integrity flag.
All offense is Piercing (DR-bypassing) — unusually defense-proof for such low numbers.

role: True-damage single-target assassin with invuln-pivot tempo and a skill-use ramp finisher
signature_mechanic: Empower window: Hawkeye grants 1-turn Invulnerability and Empowers next-turn skills (Caladbolg hits 3x, Twinblade splits into Normal+True and each "counts as extra skill uses"), which feeds the Grand Caladbolg passive that, after 20 total skill uses in the battle, loads the next Caladbolg Barrage to deal 40 True in one hit.

abilities.name: Caladbolg Barrage
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 10 True x2 = 20. While Empowered (Hawkeye mark) hits a 3rd time for 30 total and self-advances the skill-use counter; counts as 2 skill uses (3 while Empowered). If marked by Grand Caladbolg, instead deals a single 40 True hit and consumes that mark.
abilities.effects_summary: Pure True-damage nuke that bypasses all DR/shields/barriers. Spammable (0 CD, 1 Green). Doubles/triples the kit's skill-use counter to drive the Grand Caladbolg ramp.

abilities.name: Hawkeye
abilities.conditional_scaling: Effective cooldown ramps down: remaining CD reduced by 1 each time ANY character uses a skill (via the Grand Caladbolg passive trigger on base_abilities[1]), so in a busy 6-character match it can come back roughly every ~1-2 rounds rather than 9 turns.
abilities.effects_summary: Defensive pivot + offensive enabler: self Invulnerable for 1 turn (defend), and marks self 'skills Empowered' for the following turn. Empower upgrades Caladbolg (x3) and Twinblade (Normal+True split) and pumps the skill-use ramp.

abilities.name: Twinblade Rush
abilities.conditional_scaling: While Empowered deals 20 Normal + 20 True (40 total, half of it bypassing DR/shields) and counts as 2 skill uses, advancing the ramp counter.
abilities.effects_summary: Primary single-target burst (35 Normal baseline). Empowered version trades 5 raw damage and the all-physical profile for a True-damage split (20 unmitigable) plus extra ramp tempo.

abilities.name: Eye of the Mind
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Second self-Invulnerable for 1 turn on a short 4 CD (flexible Random cost). No Empower; pure panic-button/uptime tool that staggers with Hawkeye for near-constant invuln access.

abilities.name: Grand Caladbolg
abilities.conditional_scaling: Counts total skill uses in the battle (every character feeds it; Empowered Emiya skills count double/triple). At 20 cumulative uses, consumes the counter and marks Emiya so his NEXT Caladbolg Barrage becomes a single 40 True hit. The same passive also ticks Hawkeye's cooldown down by 1 per skill use.
abilities.effects_summary: Ramp finisher + cooldown engine. Note: live .gd uses a 20-use threshold and a 40 True payoff with NO stun (the metadata JSON's '12 uses / 50 dmg / stun non-Strategic skills' text is stale).

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Per-skill peak is the 40 True Grand Caladbolg shot (one-time payoff) or a 40 True/Normal Empowered Twinblade; Empowered Caladbolg is 30 True. Because abilities are Instant and most cost only 1 pip, the practical ceiling is energy-bound (1 action per turn unless extra-action sources exist). True/half-True profile means listed numbers are near-fully effective vs tanks. No multiplicative scaling beyond the one-shot ramp upgrade.
damage_profile.notes: All primary damage is True or part-True, ignoring barriers/shields/DR, so effective damage ~= face value. Base rotation is ~20-35 per turn; Empowered turn is ~30-40; the 20-use Grand Caladbolg loads a single 40 True burst. No multi-target output at all.

economy.color_dependency: Green/Red dual-color but very cheap: Caladbolg Green:1, Hawkeye Red:1, Twinblade Green:1+Red:1, Eye of the Mind Random:1. Visible kit = 5 pips total. Light color demand; only Twinblade needs both colors at once.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Caladbolg is 0 CD (spammable), Twinblade 1 CD, Eye of the Mind 4 CD, Hawkeye nominal 9 CD but self-reduced by 1 per any skill use so it cycles far faster in real games. Effectively near-constant access to a nuke plus rotating invuln.
economy.ramp_dependency: Soft. Core damage/defense work from turn 1; only the 40 True Grand Caladbolg finisher and full-rate Hawkeye refresh depend on accumulating 20 battle-wide skill uses, which Empowered double/triple-counting accelerates.

invuln_or_counter: Hawkeye: self-Invulnerable 1 turn (CD 9, self-reducing)
Eye of the Mind: self-Invulnerable 1 turn (CD 4)

win_conditions: Out-tempo with True damage: chip a priority target down with 0-CD Caladbolg (20-30 True) and Empowered Twinblade (40) while staying alive through two rotating invulns.
Survive to the 20-skill threshold and land the Grand Caladbolg 40 True execute on a low-HP enemy.
Win the attrition war vs tanky/shield comps by ignoring all damage reduction with True damage while self-Invuln nullifies focus fire.
internal_synergies: Hawkeye Empower → Caladbolg/Twinblade upgrade is the core combo: Empowered Caladbolg both raises damage (30 True) and double/triple-advances the skill-use counter for Grand Caladbolg.

Grand Caladbolg passive both (a) builds the 40 True finisher and (b) ticks Hawkeye's cooldown down per skill use, so spamming Caladbolg simultaneously powers the finisher and refreshes the invuln/Empower engine — a self-reinforcing loop.
Two staggered invulns (Hawkeye CD-reduced + Eye of the Mind 4 CD) give near-continuous untargetability windows while Caladbolg keeps applying pressure on the off-turns.
strengths: True / part-True damage on almost every offensive skill bypasses shields, barriers, and all DR — extremely effective vs tanks and shield comps.
Very cheap, low-color-dependency kit (5 pips for 4 skills) with great cooldown tempo; Caladbolg is a free-flowing 0-CD nuke.
Two sources of 1-turn Invulnerability with a self-accelerating Hawkeye cooldown give strong survivability and immunity to focus fire.
Self-reinforcing ramp: attacking powers both the finisher and the invuln/Empower engine, so there is little tension between offense and tempo.
weaknesses: Zero AoE — purely single-target; weak into wide/swarm comps and contributes nothing to team-wide pressure.
No team support whatsoever: no healing, shields for allies, cleanse, or buffs; invulns are self-only.
No CC or energy denial — cannot lock down threats, only race them; relies on out-damaging rather than controlling.
Per-turn raw output is modest (mostly 20-40) and action-economy capped at one skill/turn; lacks a true one-turn burst spike beyond the one-time Grand Caladbolg.
Invuln is a defend (untargetable) not a shield, so persistent DoTs/Afflictions already on him or pre-placed effects can still tick through; reactive only against direct hits.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded solo carry: reliable True/part-True damage that ignores the entire mitigation layer, an extremely efficient and spammable economy, and two invuln windows for self-preservation. The Grand Caladbolg ramp + Hawkeye CD-reduction loop gives him a smooth power curve without hard ramp tax. He is held back from top tier by the total lack of AoE, CC, and team utility, plus a fairly low per-turn damage ceiling (one action/turn, mostly 20-40) — he must win a straight damage race. Strong, durable single-target duelist; not a teamfight swinger.
outlier_flags: metadata JSON for Grand Caladbolg (emiyaarcher5) is STALE: live .gd uses 20-skill threshold and 40 True with NO stun, vs JSON's '12 uses / 50 dmg / stuns non-Strategic skills'
Caladbolg's Grand-Caladbolg-marked hit is 40 True in .gd, not 50 as the JSON description implies
Hawkeye's effective cooldown is far below its listed 9 due to per-skill-use self-reduction

role: Self-damage ramp bruiser who transforms mid-game into a high-output single-target Titan
signature_mechanic: Titan Transformation: stacking invisible unremovable marks on enemies; when Eren self-damages down to <=40 HP it fires once, dealing 10 dmg per mark-stack to each marked enemy, healing him 5 per total stack, and permanently swapping all 4 visible skills to far stronger Titan alternates for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Reckless Charge
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent ramp: applies a stacking +5 'Reckless Charge' damage_mod to itself each use, so base damage grows +5 per prior use (35, 40, 45...). Self-damage also grows: deals 5 + (5 * current stacks) to Eren each use.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 35 Normal dmg to one enemy; Eren self-inflicts escalating damage (5 + 5/stack) which is the engine to reach the <=40 HP transformation threshold; permanently ramps its own output. Swaps to Titan Bite after transformation.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Save
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible REFLECT_RECEIVE buff on one ally for 2 turns (dur 4): all Harmful skills targeting that ally are reflected onto Eren. Ally protection / damage-soaking that also feeds Eren's self-damage-to-transform plan. Swaps to Titan KO after transformation.

abilities.name: Titan Transformation
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mark stacks accumulate per cast (1 chosen + 1 random enemy each use, unremovable). Trigger payload = 10 dmg per stack per marked enemy + 5 heal per total stack. More casts before the threshold = larger one-time burst+heal.
abilities.effects_summary: Applies invisible stacking unremovable marks to one chosen + one random enemy. Installs a one-time HEALTH_CHANGE_TRIGGER: at Eren HP<=40, deal 10 dmg/stack to all marked enemies, heal 5/total stack, and permanently swap his 4 visible abilities to Titan alternates + portrait change. Swaps to Titan Heal after transformation.

abilities.name: Eren Rampage
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal dmg to a random enemy and grants Eren Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend). Panic-button defensive tempo tool. Swaps to Titan Eren Assault after transformation.

abilities.name: Titan Eren Assault
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Post-transformation alt of slot 4. Deals 25 Normal dmg to a chosen enemy and grants Eren Invulnerable for 1 turn. Upgraded over Rampage (targeted, +5 dmg).

abilities.name: Titan Bite
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Post-transformation alt of slot 1. Huge 65 Normal single-target nuke on a 1-turn cooldown. Eren's primary post-transform damage.

abilities.name: Titan KO
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Post-transformation alt of slot 2. Deals 30 Normal dmg and applies a full Stun for 1 turn (dur 2). Hard CC + damage; replaces the defensive reflect.

abilities.name: Titan Heal
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Post-transformation alt of slot 3. Self-heals Eren 30 HP on a 1-turn cooldown. Strong sustain to offset his low post-transform HP and keep the bruiser alive.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Pre-transform: Reckless Charge ramps +5/use indefinitely (35,40,45,...), but each use also escalates self-damage so practical ceiling is gated by his own HP. Transformation trigger scales with accumulated marks: with K casts of eren3 each enemy carries ~K stacks, so the one-time burst = 10 * stacks to EACH marked enemy (e.g. 3 stacks = 30 to each marked target), which is the AoE ceiling and grows with ramp time. Post-transform single-target ceiling ~65 (Titan Bite) per action, ~95 across Bite+KO in adjacent turns.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Normal (no piercing/bypass), so DR/barriers/shields fully mitigate Eren. The transformation damage is the only multi-target burst; everything else is single-target. Peak AoE listed (30) assumes ~3 mark-stacks on each marked enemy at trigger; it scales linearly with how long he ramped before transforming.

economy.color_dependency: Very low pre-transform: only eren1 needs 1 Green pip; everything else is Random. Post-transform Titan Bite re-adds a Green requirement (Green:1) plus heavier Random demand (Titan kit totals 9 across the 4 alts vs 5 pre-transform).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Pre-transform very low: eren1 is cooldown 0 (spammable ramp), eren3 cooldown 1. Defensive/utility tools are slower (eren2 cd3, eren4 cd4). Post-transform tightens around eren6 cd1 and eren8 cd1 with eren7 cd2.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Identity is built on ramping Reckless Charge self-damage and stacking eren3 marks until the <=40 HP transformation fires. Power, burst, and sustain all spike only after the one-time transformation, so he is intentionally weaker early and must survive to transform.

hard_cc: Full stun 1 turn (eren7 Titan KO, post-transform only)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerable 1 turn (eren4 Eren Rampage)
Invulnerable 1 turn (eren5 Titan Eren Assault)
Damage reflect on ally for 2 turns (eren2 Sacrificial Save)

internal_synergies: eren1 Reckless Charge self-damage + eren2 reflect both push Eren toward the <=40 HP transformation trigger faster, intentionally accelerating his power spike.
eren3 stacking marks reward delaying the transformation: more casts = bigger 10/stack AoE burst and bigger 5/stack self-heal when the threshold is hit.
The transformation trigger's self-heal (5 per total stack) partially refills HP at the exact moment he transforms, smoothing the low-HP danger window.
Post-transform eren8 Titan Heal (30/turn, cd1) sustains the now low-HP bruiser while eren6/eren7 deal heavy damage; eren5 invuln covers retaliation turns.
win_conditions: Survive the fragile ramp phase, intentionally drop to <=40 HP to fire Titan Transformation with a large mark stack, then win the late game with the upgraded Titan kit (65 nuke + stun + self-heal + invuln).
Use eren2 Sacrificial Save to body-block harmful skills onto Eren while simultaneously feeding his own transformation, converting incoming pressure into a faster power spike.
Stack eren3 marks heavily before transforming so the one-time trigger chunks 2+ enemies for a swing-y burst + heal.
strengths: Cheap, flexible energy: 5-pip visible kit, mostly Random, with cooldown-0 spammable main attack.
Strong, self-funding power spike: transformation upgrades all four slots at once into a 65 nuke, a stun, a 30/turn heal, and an invuln.
Built-in sustain post-transform plus two separate 1-turn invulnerability windows for tempo/defense.
Hard CC (1-turn full stun) and ally protection (damage reflect) give it more than pure damage.
Transformation timing is partly under the player's control (he can rush or delay the self-damage), giving skilled-play upside and a scaling mark burst.
weaknesses: Entirely Normal damage with zero piercing/affliction/true: hard-countered by DR, barriers, shields and invuln.
Pre-transform he is weak, fragile, and actively damaging himself; if burst down before transforming he gives huge value to the enemy for free.
Transformation is a one-shot, irreversible commitment around a fixed 40 HP threshold he can be denied (e.g. healed up, or killed through the window).
No team utility beyond the single-target reflect; almost purely selfish single-target output.
Post-transform energy cost jumps (Titan Bite 3 pips incl. Green, Titan KO 3 pips), so the strong late kit is noticeably more expensive to operate than the early kit.
Random-target tools (eren4 pre-transform, eren3's second mark) add inconsistency.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded conditional-power character with a clean design: deliberately weak, self-harming ramp phase that converts into a genuinely strong, sustainable single-target bruiser after a one-time transformation. Post-transform he has a top-tier 65 single-target nuke on a 1-turn cooldown, a 30/turn self-heal, a 1-turn stun, and an invuln — that package is above-curve. But the payoff is gated behind surviving a fragile self-damaging setup, the trigger is exploitable/deniable, all damage is Normal (fully mitigable), and he offers little team utility. Net: solidly mid-tier with real ceiling in the right matchup, dragged down by a punishable, deniable activation condition. Rated in isolation.
outlier_flags: transformation-gated power (weak pre / strong post makes single-rating coarse)
self-damage-as-resource is unusual and may be hard to balance
indefinite +5/use ramp on eren1 is technically unbounded though self-capped by HP
mark-stack burst scales with ramp time (variable AoE ceiling)

abilities.name: Titania's Rampage
abilities.cost_breakdown: Red:1, Random:1 (drops to Random:1 once Clear Heart Clothing is active)
abilities.effects_summary: Mode A (no Clear Heart): 15 Piercing now + a Piercing DoT (damage_effect 15 Piercing, dur5 ~ stated 3 turns) and activates Clear Heart Clothing (self-buff dur7: immune to stuns/counters, this skill costs 1 Random). Mode B (Clear Heart already on): 25 Piercing, bypassing. If Nakagami's Armor active, also stacks a permanent -1 cooldown on this skill.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mode-gated: 25 burst when armor pre-equipped vs 15+DoT on activation; CD ramps -1 per use while Nakagami's Armor up

abilities.name: Circle Blade
abilities.cost_breakdown: Green:1, Random:1 (drops to Random:1 once Heaven's Wheel Armor is active)
abilities.effects_summary: Mode A (no Heaven's Wheel): 15 Piercing to target + ticking_trigger (dur3) that next turn deals 10 Piercing to ALL enemies; activates Heaven's Wheel Armor (self-buff dur5: immune to Affliction, this skill costs 1 Random). Mode B (Heaven's Wheel on): 10 Piercing + Stun 1 turn (dur2) + Shatter/def_negate 1 turn (dur2), bypassing. If Nakagami's Armor active, also stacks a permanent -1 cooldown on this skill.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mode-gated: delayed AoE on activation vs single-target stun+shatter when pre-equipped

abilities.name: Nakagami's Starlight
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1, Random:1 (drops to Random:1 once Nakagami's Armor is active)
abilities.effects_summary: Mode A (no Nakagami's): 30 Piercing + removes 1 energy from target; activates Nakagami's Armor (self-buff dur3: makes Erza's other skills stack a permanent -1 cooldown when cast, this skill costs 1 Random). Mode B (Nakagami's on): 15 Affliction health-drain (steals 15 HP, bypasses barriers/shields/DR).
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mode-gated: heavy 30 Piercing + energy denial on activation vs 15 Affliction lifesteal when pre-equipped; enables the kit-wide cooldown ramp

abilities.name: Queen of Fairies
abilities.effects_summary: Self-utility/panic button: gain 10 Shield (dur2) and Invulnerability to Strategic skills for 1 turn (dur2). Removes any active Armor and equips a RANDOM armor of the three, then resets that corresponding skill's cooldown to 0. If Nakagami's Armor was active, also stacks a permanent -1 cooldown on Queen of Fairies.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (random armor swap; resets one skill's CD)

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No raw damage scaling; ceiling is tempo, not numbers. Hard single-target peak is 30 Piercing (Nakagami's Starlight activation). With Clear Heart's DoT layered (15 Piercing/turn) per-turn output sits around 25-30. AoE peaks at the delayed 10 Piercing to all enemies (Circle Blade tick). Because all damage is Piercing (skips flat+%DR) and the bypassing/Affliction modes skip barriers/shields/DR, effective damage is consistently near face value. The real ceiling is the Nakagami's Armor cooldown ramp, which can drive every skill toward near-zero cooldown for repeated 25-30 Piercing hits.
damage_profile.notes: Piercing on every offensive hit makes Erza very reliable into armor/DR comps; Affliction mode (15 lifesteal) bypasses shields entirely. Numbers are modest individually but the discount-cost + CD-ramp loop makes throughput high over a match. Stun+Shatter (Heaven's Wheel mode) adds control rather than damage.

economy.color_dependency: Tri-color: one each of Red (erza1), Green (erza2), Blue (erza3) plus a Random each; Queen of Fairies is free. character_colors=[Green,Blue,Red]. Spread across three energy types so she leans on diverse energy but never needs two of the same color in one cast. Each damage skill drops to a single Random pip once its armor is equipped, sharply lowering ongoing cost.
economy.cooldown_tempo: All four skills are CD2 (every-other-turn). Tempo accelerates via Nakagami's Armor, which stacks a permanent -1 cooldown on every subsequent skill cast, and Queen of Fairies resets a random skill's CD on demand, so effective tempo trends toward spammable mid-to-late game.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high. Power spikes once armor is equipped (cost drops to 1 Random and bypassing/upgraded modes unlock); the cooldown-reduction engine specifically requires routing through Nakagami's Armor. First cast of each skill is the weaker 'activation' mode, so she ramps into her payoff over 1-2 turns per stance.

hard_cc: Stun 1 turn (Circle Blade in Heaven's Wheel mode)
soft_cc: Shatter / def_negate 1 turn (Circle Blade in Heaven's Wheel mode)
Energy removal 1 pip (Nakagami's Starlight activation)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerable to Strategic skills 1 turn (Queen of Fairies)
Immune to stuns and counter effects (Clear Heart Clothing stance)
Immune to Affliction damage (Heaven's Wheel stance)

role: Tri-color piercing bruiser with armor stances — reliable single-target burst, energy denial, and stance-based control/defense
signature_mechanic: Armor Requip system: each damage skill toggles a corresponding self-armor (Clear Heart / Heaven's Wheel / Nakagami's). First cast 'activates' the armor (weaker activation effect, grants a stance-specific immunity, and discounts that skill to 1 Random); recasting while the armor is up triggers an upgraded bypassing mode (extra burst, stun+shatter, or Affliction lifesteal). Nakagami's Armor additionally turns every subsequent cast into a permanent -1 cooldown stack, and Queen of Fairies is a free panic-button that grants shield+Strategic-invuln and randomly re-equips/resets a stance.
internal_synergies: All offensive damage is Piercing, so it ignores flat+%DR universally — consistent value with no setup
Each armor discounts its own skill to 1 Random pip, so repeated stance use becomes very cheap
Nakagami's Armor stacks permanent -1 cooldown on every later skill (incl. Queen of Fairies), compounding into near-spammable tempo
Clear Heart Clothing's stun/counter immunity protects the requip loop from disruption
Heaven's Wheel grants Affliction immunity, covering Erza's main DR-bypass weakness from enemies
Queen of Fairies refreshes a random armor and resets that skill's CD, letting her cycle stances or re-enter a discounted skill for free
Bypassing/upgraded modes (25 Piercing, 15 Affliction lifesteal) reward staying in a stance rather than swapping every turn
win_conditions: Establish Nakagami's Armor to start the cooldown-reduction snowball, then loop discounted bypassing skills for sustained 25-30 Piercing per turn
Out-value DR/armor-heavy comps since all damage is Piercing/Affliction and bypasses mitigation
Use energy removal (Starlight) to choke an opponent's economy while chipping with reliable Piercing
Survive burst windows with Queen of Fairies (10 Shield + Strategic invuln) and the 15-HP Affliction lifesteal, grinding the game out
strengths: Every offensive hit is Piercing (skips flat+%DR) and the upgraded modes bypass barriers/shields entirely — extremely reliable damage
Built-in self-sustain (15 HP Affliction drain) plus a free 10 Shield + Strategic-invuln panic button
Strong cooldown/cost ramp: armors discount skills to 1 Random and Nakagami's permanently cuts cooldowns
Multiple layered immunities (stuns/counters, Affliction, Strategic) make her hard to disrupt or lock down
Decent control package: Stun + Shatter and single-pip energy denial
Flexible free panic button that also re-arms a stance and resets a cooldown
weaknesses: Modest raw numbers — no big single-hit ceiling (caps ~30) and weak AoE (only a delayed 10 to all)
Ramp-dependent and front-loaded weak: first cast of each skill is the lesser activation mode, so she needs 1-2 turns to come online
Stance system is finicky — to get a specific upgraded mode you must already have that armor up, and Queen of Fairies' re-equip is RANDOM, so panic-button use can knock her out of the desired stance
Tri-color cost (Red/Green/Blue) before discounts makes early energy demanding
Cooldown-ramp engine is gated behind Nakagami's Armor specifically; without it tempo stays plain CD2
Limited burst means she can struggle to close out tanky targets quickly or punish fragile carries before they react

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, sticky bruiser whose strength is reliability rather than raw power. All-Piercing offense plus bypassing/Affliction modes mean her damage almost never gets mitigated, and she bundles self-shield, lifesteal, energy denial, stun+shatter, and three separate immunities into a cheap (free ult, discounted stances) kit. That breadth is genuinely strong. She is held back from top tier by low absolute numbers (single-target peak ~30, AoE only a delayed 10), a front-loaded-weak ramp that needs 1-2 turns and Nakagami's Armor to fully online, and the randomness of Queen of Fairies' re-equip. She wins attrition and DR-heavy matchups but lacks the explosive burst or wide AoE to dominate. Solidly above-average, flexible, and low-variance.
outlier_flags: all-Piercing/Affliction kit means near-zero damage mitigation ever applies to her — unusually DR-proof
triple-immunity stack (stun/counter, Affliction, Strategic) is broad defensive coverage for one character
Nakagami's Armor permanent cooldown-reduction loop can compound into near-spammable tempo if left unchecked
Queen of Fairies is a free, low-cooldown panic button granting shield + invuln + a cooldown reset — strong value for 0 cost

role: Execute-focused single-target/AoE pierce assassin with team-wide CC lockdown
signature_mechanic: Heart of Cruelty passive: every time Esdeath damages an enemy, if their HP is at or below an execution threshold they are instantly killed. The threshold is a base 5 HP, raised +5 per stun, +5 per silence (and an extra +5 per negative-magnitude silence), and +5 per Esdeath damage-mark on the target. Her own kit (Mahapadma stun, the marks left by her attacks) inflates this threshold, so her cheap pierce attacks become guaranteed kills against CC'd or already-chipped enemies.

abilities.name: Empire's Strongest
