abilities.conditional_scaling: Pairs with Heart of Cruelty execute: triggers execute_attempt with threshold 5 +5 per stun/silence (silence double-counted) +5 if target already marked by either attack. Applies a -10 damage mark to self that also feeds future execute thresholds.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing damage to one enemy; applies an unignorable mark making the target deal 10 less damage to Esdeath until end of her next turn (mark dur 3); cannot be countered or reflected; rolls an execute check against the inflated threshold.

abilities.name: Mahapadma
abilities.conditional_scaling: Each stun it applies raises every target's Heart of Cruelty execute threshold by +5, enabling guaranteed kills with esdeath1/esdeath3 during the lockdown window.
abilities.effects_summary: Stuns ALL other characters (whole board, enemies and allies) for 2 turns (dur 4); after that stun expires Esdeath stuns herself for 2 turns unless already Mahapadma-stunned. No damage; pure mass time-stop control. 8-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Weiss Schnabel
abilities.conditional_scaling: Same execute_attempt as esdeath1 applied to every enemy (threshold 5 +5 per stun/silence, silence double-counted, +5 per existing Esdeath mark). Becomes board-wide execute during a Mahapadma stun.
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Piercing damage to all enemies; applies an unignorable -5 damage mark to each (dur 3); cannot be countered or reflected; rolls execute on every target against the inflated threshold.

abilities.name: Effortless Block
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self-target panic button: Esdeath becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend invuln_effect, dur 2). 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Heart of Cruelty
abilities.conditional_scaling: Execute threshold = 5 base, +5 per stun, +5 per silence (silence counted twice in code), +5 per Esdeath damage-mark on the target. No upper cap in code.
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent self-mark (dur -1): when Esdeath deals damage to an enemy whose HP falls to or below the execute threshold, that enemy is instantly killed. This is the engine behind every execute_attempt call in her damaging skills; hidden/auto-applied passive.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Direct damage is low and fixed (20 single / 15 AoE Piercing), but the real ceiling is the execute: against an enemy at or below the threshold she deals effectively infinite damage (instant kill). Threshold can be inflated well past 15-25+ HP by stacking stuns/silences/marks (e.g. after Mahapadma a 1-stun target executes at <=10 HP, and her own marks stack the number further), so her practical kill ceiling on a softened/CC'd target is far above her raw numbers.
damage_profile.notes: Both Piercing attacks skip flat and percent DR, so the 20/15 lands almost in full against most defenses (barriers/shields still apply unless reduced elsewhere — Piercing does not bypass barriers, only DR). Damage alone is weak; the kit is designed to chip a target into execute range then guarantee the kill, ideally during a Mahapadma lockdown.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate Blue/White dependency: esdeath1 needs Blue, esdeath3 needs White, Mahapadma needs Blue+White+Random. Two of four skills are pure single-pip spam (1 Blue, 1 White) so she stays flexible turn to turn.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent: two 0-cooldown 1-pip attacks she can fire every turn; only Mahapadma (8 CD) and Effortless Block (4 CD) gate. Very high uptime on damage/execute checks.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low mechanical ramp but high setup dependency — she wants enemies stunned/silenced/marked or pre-chipped for executes to fire. Mahapadma is the burst-setup button; outside its window executes rely on residual CC from allies or her own marks.

hard_cc: Mahapadma: 2-turn stun on ALL other characters (full board)
soft_cc: Damage-reduction marks on hit (target deals 10/5 less damage to Esdeath)
invuln_or_counter: Effortless Block: 1-turn self Invulnerability (4 CD)

win_conditions: Use Mahapadma to stun the entire enemy team for 2 turns, then execute one or more enemies that have been chipped to/below the inflated (+5 per stun) threshold with Empire's Strongest / Weiss Schnabel.
Chip targets with cheap 0-CD Piercing spam while allies apply stuns/silences, then snipe them via Heart of Cruelty executes well above her listed damage numbers.
Grind out fights with reliable uncounterable Piercing damage and damage-reduction marks while Effortless Block negates burst turns.
internal_synergies: Heart of Cruelty + Mahapadma: the mass stun raises every enemy's execute threshold by +5, turning Weiss Schnabel into a potential board-wide execute during the lockdown.
Empire's Strongest / Weiss Schnabel marks: each mark left on a target raises that target's future execute threshold by another +5, so repeated hits make the next hit more likely to execute.
Uncounterable + Piercing on both attacks: damage reliably lands to push targets into execute range regardless of DR or counter setups.
Effortless Block covers the self-stun downside of Mahapadma's tempo and the turns she spends setting up executes.
strengths: Whole-board 2-turn stun (Mahapadma) is one of the strongest control effects in the game and doubles as execute setup.
Two 0-cooldown, 1-pip Piercing attacks give relentless, DR-ignoring, uncounterable, unreflectable pressure.
Heart of Cruelty execute scales with the very CC her team applies, giving a kill ceiling far above her raw damage.
Cheap, flexible energy economy (lots of single-pip / random costs) and a reliable 1-turn invuln panic button.
Self-applied damage-reduction marks make her durable against the enemies she hits.
weaknesses: Very low raw damage (20/15) — without execute setup she is a poor damage dealer and struggles to close out healthy targets.
Mahapadma stuns her OWN allies too and then self-stuns her for 2 turns, a heavy tempo cost and team-coordination hazard.
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no energy denial — purely offensive/control with a single defensive cooldown.
Execute reliability depends on stacking stuns/silences/marks; against enemies who cleanse CC or sit at high HP the passive does little.
Effortless Block only protects herself; she offers no team protection or sustain.

power_assessment.reasoning: A full-board 2-turn stun on an 8-turn cooldown is a premium control tool on its own, and pairing it with an HP-threshold execute that scales off stuns/silences/marks gives Esdeath a legitimate, often guaranteed kill button in the window after Mahapadma. Two 0-CD 1-pip uncounterable Piercing attacks plus a 1-turn invuln keep her relevant every turn at a cheap cost. She is held back from being a clear top-tier by her very low standalone damage and the significant self-cost of Mahapadma (allies stunned, then 2-turn self-stun), making her strongest as a setup/finisher within a coordinated team rather than a self-sufficient carry.
outlier_flags: board-wide 2-turn hard CC (stuns allies too) is a high-impact swing effect
uncapped, CC-scaling instant-execute passive can vastly exceed her listed damage numbers
Mahapadma self-stun is an unusual built-in drawback that meaningfully limits its value

role: Single-target physical bruiser / cooldown-denial disruptor with a missing-HP nuke finisher
signature_mechanic: Cooldown-increase lock: Bridal Chest pushes back a random enemy skill cooldown (+1, or +2 under Galvanism), and Bridal Rampage automates this denial against random enemies for 2 turns. The kit's true payoff is Blasted Tree, a Piercing self-destruct that scales off Frankenstein's own missing HP (up to ~99 damage through DR) — she wants to be low to maximize it, while Galvanism heals her off incoming Energy skills to sustain.

abilities.name: Bridal Chest
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cooldown-mod scales: +1 normally, +2 if Frankenstein is marked by Galvanism (line 19-20). Damage itself is flat 20.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal damage to one enemy and increases the remaining cooldown of one random visible enemy skill by 1 (+2 under Galvanism). Cheap, 0-cooldown spammable cooldown-denial tool; applies a system mark for mission tracking.

abilities.name: Bridal Rampage
abilities.conditional_scaling: The 2-turn automated Bridal Chest ticks each apply the Galvanism-boosted cooldown mod (+2) if Galvanism is active. No damage scaling on the AoE itself.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal AoE damage to all enemies. Then self-applies for 2 turns: 'ignore non-damage effects' (immunity to CC/debuffs/control) and a ticking trigger that auto-casts Bridal Chest (20 dmg + cooldown push + mark) on a random living enemy each of the next 2 turns. Turns Frankenstein into a debuff-immune auto-attacker that keeps denying enemy cooldowns for free.

abilities.name: Blasted Tree
abilities.conditional_scaling: Damage = 100 - current HP (missing HP). Scales inversely with Frankenstein's own health: ~0 at full HP, up to ~99 at 1 HP. Piercing bypasses flat and % DR.
abilities.effects_summary: Frankenstein self-destructs: deals Piercing damage equal to her missing HP to one enemy, then instantly kills herself (user.instant_kill). A finisher/trade that converts her remaining HP pool into a single Piercing nuke ignoring damage reduction. AI only fires it when HP <= 30 (>=70 damage).

abilities.name: Galvanism
abilities.conditional_scaling: Heal triggers per incoming Energy skill (15 HP each, no cap on number of procs within 4 turns). Buffs Bridal Chest's cooldown-push from +1 to +2 for the duration.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff for 4 turns: heal 15 HP whenever Frankenstein is affected by a NEW Energy skill (anti-Energy-mage sustain, fires only on Energy class sources), and Bridal Chest's cooldown-increase gains +1 (+2 push total). No damage. Recovers HP that fuels later Galvanism heals but reduces Blasted Tree value.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Blasted Tree caps at ~99 Piercing (100 - 1 HP) the turn it fires, scaling with missing HP; it bypasses flat/% DR. Bridal Rampage delivers 20 AoE on cast plus two follow-up 20-damage single hits over the next 2 turns. Realistic non-suicide AI peak single-target is ~70 (Blasted Tree at HP<=30 threshold).
damage_profile.notes: Frankenstein's standing damage is low (flat 20 hits, no scaling on bread-and-butter). Her ceiling is entirely the one-time Blasted Tree self-destruct that trades her life for a Piercing nuke. She is a disruptor first (cooldown denial), damage dealer second.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate Blue+Red split. Bridal Chest needs Red, Galvanism needs Blue, Bridal Rampage needs both Blue+Red (1 each). Blasted Tree is 3 fully random (flexible). Two-color (Blue/Red) identity; no White/Green needs.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Bridal Chest is 0-cooldown (spammable every turn for 1 Red). Bridal Rampage and Blasted Tree are 3-cooldown; Galvanism is 4-cooldown. Tempo centers on cheap recurring Bridal Chest denial with periodic Rampage automation bursts.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate. No stacking ramp; the only 'ramp' is intentionally losing HP to grow Blasted Tree and pre-casting Galvanism to upgrade Bridal Chest pushes. Mostly front-loaded and self-contained.

soft_cc: cooldown increase / skill lockout (Bridal Chest +1, +2 under Galvanism)
automated cooldown-push for 2 turns via Bridal Rampage
invuln_or_counter: ignore non-damage effects for 2 turns (Bridal Rampage) — effective immunity to CC/debuffs/non-damage control

win_conditions: Grind enemy tempo to a halt by repeatedly pushing back key cooldowns with Bridal Chest (+2 under Galvanism) and the Bridal Rampage automation, denying opponents their power spikes.
Bait/absorb damage to lower her own HP, then cash out Blasted Tree for a ~70-99 Piercing nuke that ignores DR — ideal as a finisher on a high-value, armored, or DR-stacked target.
Use Bridal Rampage's 2-turn non-damage-effect immunity to push through enemy CC/control teams uncontested while auto-disrupting.
internal_synergies: Galvanism + Bridal Chest: upgrades cooldown push from +1 to +2, sharply increasing lockout pressure and Rampage tick value.
Galvanism + Blasted Tree: Galvanism's Energy-triggered heals fight enemy mages, and keeping Frankenstein alive while low feeds a bigger Blasted Tree.
Bridal Rampage + Galvanism: every automated Bridal Chest tick during Rampage inherits the +2 Galvanism push, multiplying denial across 2 turns.
Bridal Rampage immunity (ignore non-damage effects) protects Frankenstein from being CC'd out of her self-destruct setup window.
strengths: Persistent, cheap cooldown denial (0-cd Bridal Chest for 1 Red) that disrupts enemy ability economy every turn.
Blasted Tree is a high-ceiling Piercing finisher (up to ~99) that ignores damage reduction — counters tanks and DR/armor stackers.
Bridal Rampage grants a 2-turn 'ignore non-damage effects' window = strong anti-CC/anti-control immunity plus free automated AoE+denial.
Built-in anti-Energy-mage sustain via Galvanism (heals off enemy Energy skills).
Flexible costs: Blasted Tree's 3 cost is fully random; only modest Blue/Red specifics elsewhere.
weaknesses: Low baseline damage — flat 20 hits with no scaling on recurring attacks; toothless against healthy targets before her HP drops.
Blasted Tree is a one-shot that KILLS HER (instant_kill) — committing it removes her from the fight and is wasted/weak at high HP.
Anti-synergy: Galvanism heals her UP, directly reducing Blasted Tree's missing-HP payoff; the kit pulls two directions on HP.
Galvanism heal only procs off Energy-class skills — dead sustain vs physical/affliction-heavy enemies.
No hard CC, no shields/barriers, no team support; control is purely cooldown-push (irrelevant vs low/zero-cooldown enemy kits).
Bridal Rampage 'ignores non-damage effects' also blocks friendly buffs and removes player control (RNG targeting) for 2 turns.

power_assessment.reasoning: A niche disruptor/bruiser. Her cheap 0-cooldown cooldown-denial is genuinely annoying and the Blasted Tree Piercing finisher (up to ~99, ignoring DR) is a real swing tool against tanks and armored comps, while Rampage's 2-turn non-damage immunity is a strong situational defensive. But raw damage is low (flat 20s), her best play self-destructs her, and her two healing/scaling axes work against each other. Conditional and skill-dependent rather than broadly oppressive — solidly mid-tier in isolation.
outlier_flags: missing-HP-scaling nuke: Blasted Tree damage = 100 - current HP, uncommon inverse-HP scaling spiking to ~99 Piercing.
self-instant-kill on a visible action-bar skill (Blasted Tree) — voluntary suicide as a damage button.
cooldown-increase is her primary control vector; effectiveness varies wildly by opponent's cooldown structure (near-useless vs low-cooldown kits).
Galvanism heal vs Blasted Tree scaling is a built-in internal anti-synergy worth flagging for design review.

abilities.name: Zoltraak
abilities.cost_breakdown: Free (0); gains White:1 cost while Mana Release mark active
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable free nuke for 15 Normal. While marked by Mana Release, upgrades to 25 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) and costs 1 White.
abilities.conditional_scaling: On-mark: 15 Normal -> 25 Piercing when 'Mana Release' mark active

abilities.name: Flower Field
abilities.effects_summary: Applies a stacking 15-magnitude Nullify barrier debuff onto the TARGET ENEMY (hostile barrier_effect, dur 4 = 2 turns, stackable + stack_mag). Functions as an offensive anti-shield/nullify tool. Swapped out for Vollzanbel after Mana Release.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (barrier stacks across casts)

abilities.name: Mana Release
abilities.effects_summary: TRANSFORMATION TRIGGER. Self: +1 White bonus energy, 10 Damage Reduction (dur 2 = 1 turn), and the 'Mana Release' empower mark (dur 3, ~1 turn self). Swaps Flower Field->Vollzanbel and Mana Release->Judradjim for 3 (1 turn). Adds White:1 cost to Zoltraak and Random:1 cost to Flight Evasion during the window. Empowers Zoltraak to 25 Piercing.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Transformation: empowers/swaps kit for ~1 turn

abilities.name: Flight Evasion
abilities.cost_breakdown: Free (0); gains Random:1 cost during Mana Release window
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Frieren becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Free panic button on a 4-turn cooldown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Mana Concealment
abilities.effects_summary: PASSIVE (auto, execute is PASS). Permanent self mark: Frieren does NOT generate energy, and her skills are permanently Stealthed (cannot be reactively countered/targeted by enemy AI). Stealth is removed by using Mana Release.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Vollzanbel
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden empowered form of Flower Field (active after Mana Release). 30 Affliction burst (bypasses barriers/shields/DR) PLUS a permanent 10 Affliction/turn DoT (damage_effect dur -1, rest of game). DoT stacks if recast on different turns/targets.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent DoT accumulates per cast (10/turn each, forever)

abilities.name: Judradjim
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden empowered form of Mana Release (active after Mana Release). Immediately deals 20 Piercing to 2 randomly chosen valid (non-dead/banished/invuln) enemies, then a 3-turn ticking trigger repeats 20 Piercing x2 random targets at end of each turn. Uncounterable. ~40 Piercing/turn spread across the enemy team for 4 instances.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Pseudo-AoE: targets scale with how many enemies are alive; Piercing skips flat+%DR

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded via Vollzanbel: each cast adds a permanent 10 Affliction/turn DoT (rest of game) that bypasses shields/DR. Multiple casts across turns stack additively (20, 30, 40+/turn). Judradjim adds ~40 Piercing/turn spread for 3-4 turns. Late-game accumulated Affliction DoT is the true ceiling.
damage_profile.notes: Peak single-target ~55 in one turn = empowered Zoltraak 25 Piercing + Vollzanbel 30 Affliction (if both hit same target; needs 3 White energy that turn). Peak AoE/turn = Judradjim 20 Piercing x2 = 40 (random spread, not focused). Sustained = permanent 10/turn Affliction per Vollzanbel cast, stacking. All key damage bypasses defenses (Piercing/Affliction).

economy.color_dependency: Mono-White. character_colors=[2] (White only). Baseline visible kit is nearly free (Zoltraak 0, Flight Evasion 0, Flower Field Random:1, Mana Release White:1). Empowered forms cost White:2 (Vollzanbel) and White:1+Random:1 (Judradjim). Heavily White-gated once transformed.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mostly low/no cooldown: Zoltraak 0, Mana Release 0, Vollzanbel 0. Judradjim 3cd, Flight Evasion 4cd. Spam-friendly core with two longer-cooldown utility/finisher pieces.
economy.ramp_dependency: HIGH and unusual: Mana Concealment passive ZEROES her own energy generation. She is energy-starved by default and relies on the +1 White from Mana Release plus team energy to fuel White-heavy empowered forms. Damage ramps over the game via stacking permanent Affliction DoT.

invuln_or_counter: Flight Evasion: 1-turn Invulnerability (4cd, free / Random:1 when transformed)

internal_synergies: Mana Release is the hub: grants the empower mark (upgrades Zoltraak 15 Normal -> 25 Piercing), gifts +1 White to immediately afford White-costed empowered forms, gives 10 DR for the transform turn, and swaps in Vollzanbel + Judradjim.
Mana Concealment passive provides permanent Stealth (skills dodge reactive counters) and zeroes energy gen, which is why Mana Release's bonus White energy and team energy support are mandatory.
Vollzanbel's permanent Affliction DoT + Judradjim's Piercing both bypass enemy defenses, so an opponent stacking shields/DR is irrelevant to Frieren's main outputs.
Flower Field's stacking Nullify pre-strips enemy barriers, complementing the bypass damage and helping allies.
Flight Evasion provides a defensive reset so she can survive long enough for permanent DoTs to accumulate into a win.
role: Mono-White transforming caster: spammable bypass-damage dealer who ramps permanent Affliction DoT and seeds pseudo-AoE Piercing, with strong evasion/stealth survivability
signature_mechanic: Mana Release transformation: spend White to flip her near-free baseline kit into White-heavy empowered forms (Vollzanbel + Judradjim), upgrade Zoltraak to Piercing, and self-buff DR. Underpinned by the Mana Concealment passive that grants permanent Stealth but disables her own energy generation, so she trades self-sufficiency for unblockable, accumulating damage.
strengths: Damage that ignores defenses: empowered Zoltraak (Piercing), Vollzanbel (Affliction, skips shields/barriers/DR), Judradjim (Piercing) - shield/DR-stacking opponents can't mitigate her.
Snowballing, irremovable DoT: every Vollzanbel cast adds a permanent 10/turn Affliction tick for the rest of the game; stacks unboundedly across turns.
Very cheap baseline (Zoltraak free 0cd, Flight Evasion free) and low cooldowns let her act nearly every turn.
Permanent Stealth from the passive makes her skills hard to counter/intercept.
Self-protection: free 1-turn Invulnerability (Flight Evasion) plus 10 DR on transform-turn lets her stall while DoTs win.
Judradjim is Uncounterable and pressures the whole enemy team.
weaknesses: Self-imposed energy starvation: Mana Concealment zeroes her energy generation, so she leans hard on the single +1 White from Mana Release and on teammates' White energy to fuel empowered forms - mono-White means low color flexibility and vulnerability to energy-denial enemies.
Empowered window is short (swaps/buffs last ~1 turn, dur 3), so she must re-cast Mana Release repeatedly to stay in her power forms, paying White each time.
Judradjim's damage is RANDOM-target across alive enemies - no focus-fire control, can be diluted on full enemy teams or whiff onto tanks.
No hard CC, no healing, no team shields, no cleanse - purely a damage/evasion piece with limited utility for allies.
Burst is modest turn-to-turn (peak ~55 single-target requires 3 White in one turn); she wins slowly via accumulation, so she's weak vs fast burst comps or invuln/cleanse that resets her DoT pressure.
Heavily ramp/time dependent - early turns are low-impact while she sets up DoT stacks.
win_conditions: Survive (Flight Evasion invuln + DR + Stealth) long enough to stack multiple permanent Vollzanbel Affliction DoTs that out-tick enemy healing.
Use Judradjim's recurring Piercing + accumulated DoT to whittle a whole defensive/shield-stacking enemy team that can't mitigate bypass damage.
Chip down a key target with empowered Piercing Zoltraak while defenses are irrelevant.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, defense-agnostic DoT/scaling caster. Her ceiling is genuinely high: permanent, unremovable, defense-bypassing Affliction stacks plus Uncounterable pseudo-AoE Piercing mean she answers shield/DR/tank comps very cleanly, and her free 0cd Zoltraak + free invuln give strong tempo and survivability. However she is held in check by real costs: the Mana Concealment passive disables her own energy generation, making her mono-White kit dependent on Mana Release's single White and on allies; her empowered window is only ~1 turn so she must keep paying to stay transformed; and Judradjim's random targeting plus modest per-turn numbers mean she wins by attrition rather than blowing things up. No CC/heals/team support caps her ceiling. Strong but conditional - a solid mid-high pick that punishes defensive comps and struggles vs energy denial and fast burst.
outlier_flags: self-energy-denial passive (Mana Concealment zeroes her own energy gen) is an unusual drawback few characters carry
permanent rest-of-game stacking Affliction DoT (dur -1) on a 0-cooldown skill is a high-ceiling outlier
Judradjim uses true RNG target selection (battle.roll) rather than fixed/AoE targeting

universe: Original / unclear (likely Anime Arena original "AoA" roster; \"World Soul\" earth-elemental themed)
role: Defensive support / earth-elemental protector (shields, damage reduction, invuln, hard CC) with low fixed-damage poke
signature_mechanic: Stoneskin-gated combo engine: Stoneskin (damage reduction buff) unlocks Earthen Embrace and, when self-cast, empowers Earthen Surge; Rampart's team shields enable Earthen Surge's AoE mode and convert unbroken shields into invulnerability; Harmonize can only hit targets already affected by one of Gaia's skills (heal ally / true-damage enemy / self-buff Elemental Essence).

abilities.name: Stoneskin
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enabler buff: while active it unlocks Earthen Embrace, and grants Earthen Surge +15 damage if Stoneskin is on Gaia herself
abilities.effects_summary: Grants target ally 15 flat damage reduction for 4 turns. Core kit enabler that gates Earthen Embrace and powers up self-cast Earthen Surge. JSON-only, .gd missing/unverified.

abilities.name: Rampart
abilities.cost_breakdown: 1 pip index7 + 2 pips index11 (two specific colors, heavy)
abilities.conditional_scaling: If an ally's 15 shield is not broken, that ally gains 1 turn of invulnerability
abilities.effects_summary: Team-wide 15 shield for 1 turn; unbroken shields convert into a turn of invulnerability. Strong AoE defensive/peel and the enabler for Earthen Surge's AoE mode (requires all allies shielded). JSON-only, unverified.

abilities.name: Earthen Surge
abilities.conditional_scaling: +15 damage (to 35) if Stoneskin is on Gaia; becomes AoE hitting all enemies if all allied heroes have Shield (i.e., after Rampart)
abilities.effects_summary: 20 base damage to one enemy on a 0-cooldown 1-pip nuke. Scales to 35 with self-Stoneskin and converts to all-enemy AoE when the team is fully shielded by Rampart. Primary damage button. JSON-only, unverified.

abilities.name: Earthen Embrace
abilities.cost_breakdown: 1 pip index7 + 1 pip index11 (two specific colors)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Requires Stoneskin active to be usable; stunned target takes +5 direct damage during the stun; effect ends early if Gaia takes new damage
abilities.effects_summary: Gaia gains 20 shield and hard-stuns one enemy for 3 turns while that enemy takes +5 direct damage; breaks early if Gaia is damaged. Gated behind Stoneskin. Long single-target lockdown + self-protection. JSON-only, unverified.

abilities.name: Harmonize
abilities.target_type: SINGLE hero affected by one of Gaia's skills (ally, enemy, or self)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Only targets heroes already affected by a Gaia skill; outcome branches on target: ally heal 15 / enemy 15 true damage / self gains Elemental Essence buff
abilities.effects_summary: Conditional finisher/utility: 15 heal to a buffed ally, 15 TRUE damage (bypasses DR) to a debuffed/stunned enemy, or self-buff (Elemental Essence) on Gaia. Listed slot 5 (hidden alt) despite being a full action. JSON-only, unverified; 'Elemental Essence' effect undefined without .gd.

damage_profile.notes: All numbers from JSON descriptions ONLY — the gaia_*.gd scripts do not exist in the repo, so nothing is verified against ground truth. Single-target peak in one cast = Earthen Surge buffed by self-Stoneskin (20+15=35). Harmonize adds 15 true damage but is conditional (target must already carry a Gaia effect) and needs a separate action. With chaining: Earthen Embrace's +5 direct-damage amp + Surge 35 + Harmonize 15 true could net ~55 on one locked target across the combo, but not in a single ability. AoE peak = Earthen Surge in AoE mode (requires full-team Rampart shields), ~20 to all (or 35 each if Stoneskin-on-Gaia stacks with AoE — ambiguous). No DoT in kit.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Low/fixed. Damage is hard-capped at flat numbers (35 single nuke, +15 true, +5 amp); no per-stack/per-kill/ramp growth. 'Scaling' here is conditional mode-switching (AoE, true damage) not number growth. The real ceiling is defensive output: 15 DR, 15 team shield, team invuln, 20 self-shield, 3-turn stun.

economy.color_dependency: Very high / two-color locked. Every cost is a specific-color pip across exactly two colors (cost indices 7 and 11; mapped here as White+Green on the AoA earth theme, but the cost scheme uses an expanded index space and the char_def is missing, so exact colors are UNCONFIRMED). Zero random/flexible pips means Gaia is rigidly color-gated.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mixed-fast. Two 0-cooldown spammable actions (Earthen Surge nuke, Harmonize utility), a low 2-cd team-shield (Rampart), a 3-cd stun (Earthen Embrace), and a 4-cd enabler (Stoneskin). The 0-cd Earthen Surge gives consistent every-turn pressure; defensive cooldowns are short enough for good uptime.
economy.ramp_dependency: No resource ramp, but high COMBO/sequencing dependency: Earthen Embrace is locked until Stoneskin is up; Surge's AoE needs Rampart on the whole team; Surge's +15 needs Stoneskin on Gaia; Harmonize needs a pre-existing Gaia effect on the target. The kit only reaches full value after a 1-2 turn setup; raw turn-1 output is weak.

hard_cc: 3-turn single-target stun (Earthen Embrace)
invuln_or_counter: 1-turn invulnerability per ally whose Rampart shield survives unbroken

strengths: Deep defensive toolbox: flat 15 damage reduction, team-wide 15 shield, conditional team invulnerability, and a 20 self-shield — strong frontline/peel support
3-turn hard stun with a built-in +5 damage-amp window is high-value lockdown/control
Harmonize offers flexible value (heal, true damage that bypasses DR/shields, or self-buff) on a 0-cooldown
0-cooldown Earthen Surge gives reliable every-turn chip pressure and flips to AoE when the team is shielded
Cheap individual ability costs (mostly 1 pip) plus two 0-cd actions enable strong tempo once set up
weaknesses: Low, hard-capped raw damage with zero scaling — cannot close games on damage alone

Heavily combo-gated: Earthen Embrace needs Stoneskin, AoE Surge needs full-team Rampart, Harmonize needs a pre-applied Gaia effect, buffed Surge needs self-Stoneskin — clunky/weak turn-1 and easily disrupted
Earthen Embrace's stun ends early if Gaia takes ANY new damage, making her premier control fragile against chip/AoE
Rigid two-color cost with zero random pips = severe energy/color dependency and inflexibility
Pure protector with no self-heal outside a conditional self-buff, no cleanse, no energy denial, no mobility
CANNOT BE TRUSTED AS WRITTEN: ability .gd scripts are absent from the repo — Gaia appears unimplemented/cut, so all mechanics are JSON-only and may never have been balanced or coded
win_conditions: Outlast: keep the team alive with stacked DR + shields + invuln while a damage carry finishes, peeling threats with the 3-turn stun
Lockdown a key enemy with Earthen Embrace's stun + damage amp, then focus it (Surge + Harmonize true damage) before the stun breaks
Set up full-team Rampart shields to unlock AoE Earthen Surge for board-wide pressure in shield-heavy comps
internal_synergies: Stoneskin -> Earthen Embrace: Stoneskin is the hard prerequisite that unlocks the stun
Stoneskin (self) -> Earthen Surge: self-cast Stoneskin adds +15 to Surge (20->35)
Rampart -> Earthen Surge: full-team shields flip Surge into an all-enemy AoE
Any Gaia effect -> Harmonize: Harmonize can only target a hero already carrying one of Gaia's skills, so every other ability sets it up (heal a shielded/DR ally, or true-damage a stunned enemy)
Earthen Embrace's +5 direct-damage amp -> Earthen Surge / Harmonize for bigger single-target burst on the locked enemy

power_assessment.reasoning: Judged purely on JSON descriptions (no ground-truth .gd exists). As a defensive support Gaia is solidly mid-tier: an excellent protection suite (15 DR, team 15 shield + conditional invuln, 20 self-shield, 3-turn stun with damage amp, flexible 0-cd Harmonize) on cheap per-ability costs and good cooldown tempo. That control+protection density would push toward 7 in a vacuum. But it is dragged down by hard-capped no-scaling damage, severe combo-gating that makes her weak/clunky before setup, a flagship stun that self-breaks the instant Gaia takes any damage, and rigid zero-flex two-color costs. Net mid-pack, with high uncertainty because the implementation does not exist in the repo.
outlier_flags: NO IMPLEMENTATION: gaia_1..gaia_5 .gd files and character/gaia_.gd are absent from the repo — only image assets and the abilities_data.json stub remain. Gaia is unimplemented/cut; every number is unverifiable.

Cost scheme anomaly: costs use expanded indices 7 and 11 (not the standard 0-4 Green/Blue/White/Red/Random space), and with no char_def the energy-color identity could not be confirmed — energy_identity is a best-guess.
Self-breaking stun: Earthen Embrace's 3-turn stun ending on any new damage to Gaia is an unusual fragility clause worth design review.
Slot mismatch: Harmonize is indexed at slot 5 (hidden-alt range) yet functions as a full standalone action, not a transformation/passive — treated here as a 5th visible-style ability.

role: Defensive counter-duelist with piercing/true single-target burst and an ability-swap combo engine
signature_mechanic: Ability-swap combo loop: Gallant Guard (counter) and Lightning Joust (piercing strike) each set up the hidden Shield of the Just, which morphs based on which skill it replaces — Invulnerability if replacing the failed/expired Guard, or a stun if replacing a countered Joust. Guard also charges Joust to strike twice, and Joust converts Guard's counter into a full reflect.

abilities.name: Gallant Guard
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (state-setup; behavior changes if self already marked by Lightning Joust -> grants a full reflect instead of a counter)
abilities.effects_summary: Places an invisible counter on one ally vs the first Harmful, non-Strategic skill (duration 2 = 1 enemy turn). If the counter expires untriggered, it swaps Gallant Guard to Shield of the Just for 1 turn (which then grants self-Invuln on use). Also marks self so next Lightning Joust strikes twice. If Gallantmon was pre-marked by Lightning Joust, instead grants the ally a full single-target Reflect.

abilities.name: Lightning Joust
abilities.conditional_scaling: Doubles to 40 Piercing (2x20) if self is marked by Gallant Guard (i.e. used the turn after Gallant Guard)
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing to one enemy (40 if charged by Gallant Guard mark). Marks self so Gallant Guard's protection reflects instead of counters next turn. Via character counter_response_trigger: if this skill is countered, it swaps to Shield of the Just for 1 turn (offensive mode -> stun on use).

abilities.name: Yuggoth Blaster
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal damage to one enemy and applies a cost-mod (+1 Random energy to that enemy's skill costs) for 1 turn (dur 2). Soft energy-denial / tempo tax on a single target.

abilities.name: Grani Flight
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self-Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend / panic button). Long 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Shield of the Just
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mode-dependent rider: if replacing Gallant Guard -> also self-Invuln 1 turn; if replacing Lightning Joust -> also stun enemy 1 turn (dur 2)
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap-in ability (cd 0). 30 True damage to one enemy (ignores DR). Defensive mode (from expired Gallant Guard): grants self-Invuln 1 turn. Offensive mode (from countered Lightning Joust): stuns target 1 turn. Available only for 1 turn after the swap condition triggers.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Low/flat. Single-skill peak is the charged Lightning Joust at 40 Piercing (two 20 hits). Shield of the Just adds 30 True but only when swapped in. A scripted Guard->Joust(40 Pierce)->Shield(30 True) sequence yields ~70 effective over the combo, but spread across turns and gated behind setup. No stacking or per-kill growth.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is single-target; zero AoE and zero DoT. Damage bypasses defenses heavily: 20/40 Piercing (skips flat+%DR), 30 True (skips DR), only Yuggoth's 25 is Normal. Effective damage is higher than raw numbers vs tanky/shielded targets.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate. Visible kit needs Red:2 (Gallant Guard, Yuggoth) + Green:1 (Lightning Joust) + 2 Random. Two-color (Green/Red) identity matching character_colors [0,3]. Shield of the Just adds another Red:1+Random:1 when swapped in.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast core loop: Lightning Joust cd 1 (spammable), Gallant Guard cd 2, Yuggoth cd 2, Shield of the Just cd 0. Only Grani Flight is slow (cd 4). Combo cadence is every-other-turn for the Guard/Joust/Shield interplay.
economy.ramp_dependency: None (no stacking/ramp). 'Ramp' is purely combo-sequencing: Guard charges Joust's double-hit and feeds Shield's defensive swap; Joust feeds Shield's offensive swap. Payoff is one turn of setup, not multi-turn buildup.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun (Shield of the Just, offensive/Joust-countered mode only)
soft_cc: +1 Random cost increase to a single enemy for 1 turn (Yuggoth Blaster)
invuln_or_counter: Self-Invuln 1 turn (Grani Flight, cd 4)
Self-Invuln 1 turn (Shield of the Just, defensive mode)
Ally counter vs first Harmful non-Strategic skill (Gallant Guard)
Ally full single-target Reflect (Gallant Guard when self pre-marked by Lightning Joust)

win_conditions: Outlast/duel a single priority threat by protecting an ally with counters/reflects while chipping with defense-ignoring Piercing/True damage
Land the Guard->charged Lightning Joust (40 Piercing) burst and convert into Shield of the Just for follow-up True damage + stun
Tax a key enemy caster's tempo with Yuggoth's cost increase to deny their big turn
Survive lethal windows with two independent 1-turn Invuln sources
internal_synergies: Gallant Guard marks self -> next Lightning Joust strikes twice (20 -> 40 Piercing)
Lightning Joust marks self -> Gallant Guard upgrades from counter to full reflect
Gallant Guard expiring untriggered -> swaps in Shield of the Just in defensive (self-Invuln) mode
Lightning Joust being countered -> swaps in Shield of the Just in offensive (stun) mode via character counter_response_trigger
Shield of the Just has cd 0, so the swap window is immediately exploitable
Two Invuln sources (Grani Flight + Shield defensive mode) cover survival without overlapping cooldowns
strengths: Defense-piercing damage profile: 20/40 Piercing + 30 True bypass DR/barriers, so raw numbers undersell effective damage vs tanks
Strong protective toolkit for an ally: counter, conditional reflect, and cost denial
Cheap, fast core loop (Lightning Joust cd 1 at Green:1; most skills 1-2 pips)
Multiple, independent 1-turn Invulnerability windows for self-preservation
Single-target stun + energy/cost denial give real disruption against key threats
Rich combo identity rewarding correct sequencing
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero DoT — completely single-target, poor in multi-enemy pressure or wave clears
Low raw damage ceiling (~40 peak single hit); no stacking or ramp to scale a game
Best tools (Shield of the Just's Invuln/stun) are gated behind conditional swaps that depend on the opponent's behavior
All defensive/counter value is single-target allied protection — easy to play around by attacking a different ally
No healing, no shields, no cleanse — sustain is purely dodging via Invuln
Energy denial is mild (+1 Random, 1 turn, single target) and Yuggoth's 25 is plain Normal damage
Combo complexity creates feel-bad whiffs and a high execution skill floor

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed but middle-of-the-road defensive duelist. Its damage is modest (peak ~40 single-target, no AoE/DoT, no scaling), but it punches above the raw numbers because nearly all of it bypasses defenses (Piercing + True). The real value is in a flexible protection/disruption package - ally counter/reflect, two 1-turn Invuln windows, a 1-turn stun, and a small cost tax - all on cheap, low-cooldown skills. The conditional ability-swap engine is elegant and rewards skilled sequencing, but much of the payoff (Shield of the Just's Invuln/stun) is reactive and depends on the opponent cooperating, which caps consistency. Solid in 1v1 priority-target duels and as an ally protector; weak in AoE/teamfight or as a primary win condition. Lands as a balanced B-tier specialist.
outlier_flags: Hidden 5th skill (Shield of the Just) does the heaviest lifting (30 True + Invuln/stun) but is only accessible via conditional swaps, so action-bar-only evaluation understates the kit
Effective damage notably higher than nominal due to Piercing/True bypassing DR/barriers
Reflect/counter value is entirely opponent-dependent (can whiff to zero impact)

role: Self-harming low-HP execute/ramp glass cannon with piercing single-target nukes
signature_mechanic: Branch of Sin: Woodpecker passive — every harmful skill he uses OR receives lays a separate 3-Affliction/turn (5-turn) DoT on himself; each active DoT is a "stack" that adds +5 to Ganta Gun and raises the Ganbare Gun HP-threshold by 5. He literally bleeds himself down, and the lower his HP the harder Supersonic Ganta Gun and the sub-10-HP nuke Ganbare Gun hit.

abilities.name: Ganta Gun
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 Piercing per active Branch of Sin: Woodpecker stack (each self-applied 3-Affliction DoT counts). With several DoTs stacked (e.g. 5) -> 25 + 25 = 50.
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable single-target piercing nuke (skips flat+% DR). Base damage in .gd is 25, NOT 20 as JSON/describe claims. Targeting can bypass via Reckless Rush mark.

abilities.name: Supersonic Ganta Gun
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per full 20 HP Ganta is missing AND +5 per full 20 HP the target is missing. floor((100-userHP)/20) and floor((100-targetHP)/20). At Ganta ~1 HP and target ~1 HP: 10 + 4*5 + 4*5 = 50.
abilities.effects_summary: Anemia/execute piercing nuke that grows as both Ganta and the target lose health. Cheap flexible cost. Pairs with his self-damage passive (lower his own HP = more damage) and finishing wounded targets.

abilities.name: Ganbare Gun
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gated by HP, not damage scaling: only usable when Ganta's HP <= 10 + 5*(active Woodpecker stacks). Stacks raise the usability window, not the numbers.
abilities.effects_summary: Finisher: 45 Normal to main target, then 25 Normal to ALL enemies, then 15 Normal self-damage to his ENTIRE team (including himself). Main target eats 45+25=70 Normal. Conditionally locked behind being near-death. Big AoE swing but Normal damage (blocked by shields/DR) and hurts own team.

abilities.name: Reckless Rush
abilities.conditional_scaling: Counter payoff scales by being hit: any enemy who deals new damage to Ganta while active gets marked (Bypass Invulnerability) and takes +10 from his 3 guns for 1 turn.
abilities.effects_summary: Self panic button: immortality for 1 turn (cannot die) + self-vulnerability +5 to non-Affliction. Damage-receive trigger: enemies who hit him are marked so his Ganta Gun/Supersonic/Ganbare Bypass Invulnerability AND deal +10 vs them next turn. Survivability + counter-setup; the +5 self-vuln intentionally feeds his low-HP scaling.

abilities.name: Branch of Sin: Woodpecker
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-stacking: each harmful skill USED or RECEIVED adds another independent 3-Affliction/turn (5-turn) DoT; count of active DoTs = stacks driving ganta1 (+5/stack) and ganta3 threshold (+5/stack).
abilities.effects_summary: Passive (.gd triggers on BOTH harmful-use and harmful-receive, despite JSON only saying 'uses'). Stacks self-inflicted 3 Affliction DoT for 5 turns. Drives his ramp and lowers his own HP toward the Supersonic/Ganbare payoff window. Affliction self-damage bypasses his own shields/DR.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Single target in the kill window: Ganbare Gun main (45 Normal +25 AoE = 70 on the main target) PLUS a Supersonic Ganta Gun (~50 piercing at full anemia) = ~120 to one target in a turn if energy allows; realistically capped by 1-pip Red gating and the sub-10-HP usability lock. Ganta Gun caps ~50 with 5 stacks. Sustained self-DoT stacks (multiple 3/turn instances) can total 9-15 affliction/turn ON HIMSELF — that is the ramp engine, not enemy damage.
damage_profile.notes: Two damage identities: (1) cheap spammable piercing single-target (Ganta Gun 25-50, Supersonic 10-50) that bypasses DR, and (2) a near-death Normal-damage AoE finisher (Ganbare Gun) that is shield/DR-able and also damages his own team. Peak single-target ~95 = Ganbare main 70 + Ganta Gun 25 base same turn; reaches ~120 with anemia-buffed Supersonic. Peak AoE 70 = 45+25 on main, 25 on others. Most of his 'scaling' lowers his OWN HP (self 3 Affliction DoTs + 15 team self-hit + Reckless self-vuln), making him extremely fragile.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate-Red. 3 of 5 visible pips are Red (Ganta Gun 1, Ganbare Gun 2); the two cheap utility/anemia skills (Supersonic, Reckless Rush) take Random, so he can function off-color but his core damage demands Red.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast. Both single-target guns are cd 0 (spammable every turn at 1 pip). Ganbare Gun cd 1, Reckless Rush cd 2. No long lockouts; tempo is gated by energy and the HP-threshold condition, not cooldowns.
economy.ramp_dependency: High but self-driven. He scales by repeatedly using/receiving harmful skills to stack Woodpecker and by losing HP. The payoff window (Ganbare usable, Supersonic strong) requires him to be near death, so his power curve is back-loaded and self-destructive.

invuln_or_counter: Reckless Rush: 1-turn immortality (cannot die)
Reckless Rush damage-receive counter: marks attackers for Bypass Invulnerability + +10 damage from his guns

internal_synergies: Woodpecker passive self-DoT -> stacks add +5/stack to Ganta Gun and push his HP toward the Ganbare/Supersonic kill window.
Self-damage (Woodpecker DoTs, Ganbare's 15 team-hit, Reckless +5 self-vuln) all lower Ganta's HP, directly boosting Supersonic Ganta Gun (+5 per 20 missing HP).
Reckless Rush immortality lets him drop to ~1 HP safely, then unlock Ganbare Gun and maximize Supersonic without dying that turn.
Reckless Rush counter-mark grants Bypass Invulnerability and +10 to his three guns vs whoever hits him, converting incoming damage into a hard punish.
Piercing on both guns ignores enemy flat/% DR, so his ramp isn't blunted by tanky targets (only Ganbare's Normal AoE is mitigable).
strengths: Cheap, cd-0, DR-bypassing single-target piercing pressure every turn for just 1 pip.
Strong execute profile: Supersonic scales with target's missing HP, Ganbare is a 70-on-main / 25-AoE near-death finisher.
Reckless Rush gives a real survival/counter package: 1-turn immortality plus a Bypass + bonus-damage punish on attackers.
Self-scaling that is fully self-contained (no setup from allies, no marks needed from teammates).
Reckless Rush mark also lets his guns retarget invulnerable enemies (target() bypass), answering invuln-stacking foes.
weaknesses: Extremely fragile and actively self-destructive: passive + Ganbare + Reckless all drain his own HP; multiple stacked self-DoTs can deal 9-15 Affliction to himself per turn, bypassing his own (nonexistent) defenses.
Payoff (Ganbare usable, peak Supersonic) requires being near death, a knife-edge that enemies can punish or simply outpace.
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no hard CC, no energy denial, no sustain — purely offensive glass cannon.
Ganbare Gun is Normal damage (shield/DR-able) AND damages his entire team for 15, so its AoE swing is double-edged.
Red color dependency on his hardest-hitting skills; off-Red comps weaken his core.
Ramp takes time and chip self-damage; bursty enemies can kill him before his curve matures, and his immortality is only a 1-turn band-aid on cd 2.
JSON/describe text is stale (Ganta Gun is 25 not 20; passive triggers on receive too) — actual numbers are higher/broader than tooltips imply.
win_conditions: Survive the early game (Reckless Rush immortality) while stacking Woodpecker and bleeding into the low-HP window.
Land Ganbare Gun at near-death for a 70-on-main + 25-AoE swing that can multi-kill, ideally cleaning up a softened enemy team.
Chip single targets to death with cd-0 piercing guns whose damage rises as both he and the target lose HP, finishing executes with Supersonic.
Bait attacks under Reckless Rush to mark attackers for Bypass + bonus damage, then punish with his guns.

power_assessment.reasoning: A high-skill, high-variance glass cannon. His ceiling is genuinely strong: cd-0 1-pip piercing nukes that ignore DR, a target-missing-HP execute scaler, and a 70-to-main / 25-AoE finisher, plus a 1-turn immortality + counter button. But the design is brutally double-edged: nearly every mechanic damages himself, his best payoffs are gated behind near-death, and he has zero defensive sustain (no heals, shields, cleanse, or CC). Against patient or DoT/Affliction-heavy enemies (which bypass his immortality timing and out-chip him) he folds; the immortality is only 1 turn on a 2-turn cooldown. Rated near the middle: real burst and execute upside dragged down by fragility and conditional, self-harming ramp. Numbers slightly understate him because the .gd is stronger than the stale tooltips (Ganta Gun 25 vs listed 20, passive also triggers on receive).
outlier_flags: self-damage-engine (kit intentionally lowers own HP)
near-death-gated finisher (Ganbare usable only <=10 HP)
stale-JSON-vs-gd (Ganta Gun base 25 not 20; passive triggers on use AND receive)
team-self-damage (Ganbare hits own allies for 15)
very-low-cost cd-0 piercing spam

role: Digivolution ramp transformer: starts as a disruptive blind/paralyze rogue, then permanently upgrades into either a single-target support-bruiser (Angewomon) or an AoE burst/control caster (Ophanimon)
signature_mechanic: Digivolution stack ramp: base-form skills (Lightning Paw, Cat's Eye, Nekodamashi) each grant a permanent stacking 'Digivolution' mark. Spending Gatomon Digivolve consumes the stacks to permanently swap her whole action bar for the rest of the game — 2 stacks yields Angewomon (slots gatomon5-8 + Saint Air passive), 3+ stacks yields the stronger Ophanimon (slots gatomon9-12 + Eden's Air passive). Digivolve is usable while stunned.

abilities.name: Lightning Paw
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Normal dmg; blinds target's Helpful skills 1 turn (blind dur 2, ['Helpful']); grants Gatomon +1 stacking Digivolution mark (permanent).
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (feeds Digivolution ramp)

abilities.name: Cat's Eye
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal dmg; paralyzes target's cooldowns 1 turn (paralyze dur 2); grants +1 Digivolution stack.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (feeds Digivolution ramp)

abilities.name: Gatomon Digivolve
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent transformation. Requires >=1 Digivolution stack; usable while stunned. With >=2 stacks swaps action bar to Ophanimon (Eden's Javelin/Sefirot/Final Judgement/Holy Light) + 10 heal/turn & 10 permanent DR; otherwise swaps to Angewomon (Holy Slap/Celestial Arrow/Heaven's Charm/Angel Wings) + 5 heal/turn. Consumes the Digivolution mark. Meaningful tiers: 2-stack Angewomon vs 3-stack Ophanimon.
abilities.conditional_scaling: branches on Digivolution stack count: >=2 stacks -> Ophanimon path, else Angewomon path

abilities.name: Nekodamashi
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerable 1 turn AND grants +1 Digivolution stack. Puts Angel Wings and Holy Light on shared 4-turn cooldown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (feeds Digivolution ramp while defending)

abilities.name: Holy Slap (Angewomon)
abilities.effects_summary: Angewomon slot-1. 25 Normal dmg; blinds target's Harmful skills 1 turn (blind dur 2, ['Harmful']) — denies their offense.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Celestial Arrow (Angewomon)
abilities.effects_summary: Angewomon slot-2. 25 True damage (ignores DR) to one enemy. Reliable chip vs tanks.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Heaven's Charm (Angewomon)
abilities.effects_summary: Angewomon slot-3 SUPPORT. Heals target ally 10 HP, grants 10 Shield (1 turn) and 10 DR (1 turn). Single-target peel.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Angel Wings (Angewomon)
abilities.effects_summary: Angewomon slot-4. Self invulnerable 1 turn. Shares 4-turn cooldown with Nekodamashi.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Saint Air (Angewomon passive)
abilities.effects_summary: Angewomon passive. +5 self HP regen per turn (applied on digivolve to Angewomon).
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Eden's Javelin (Ophanimon)
abilities.effects_summary: Ophanimon slot-1. 30 Piercing dmg (skips flat + %DR); fully blinds ALL target's skills 2 turns (blind dur 4, no class filter). Strong single-target lockdown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Sefirot Crystal (Ophanimon)
abilities.effects_summary: Ophanimon slot-2. 9 hits of 10 dmg (90 total) randomly distributed across living enemies; Bypassing ignores Invulnerability. Full 90 lands on one target only if they're the sole enemy.
abilities.conditional_scaling: total fixed 90; concentration depends on enemy count (more single-target with fewer enemies)

abilities.name: Final Judgement (Ophanimon)
abilities.effects_summary: Ophanimon slot-3. 30 True dmg to ENTIRE enemy team; fully blinds all 1 turn (blind dur 2). Attaches action-use trigger: if any blinded enemy uses a new skill, blind extends +1 turn for all affected — potentially locking the enemy team for many turns.
abilities.conditional_scaling: blind duration ramps each time enemies act through it (self-extending team-wide skill lock)

abilities.name: Holy Light (Ophanimon)
abilities.effects_summary: Ophanimon slot-4. Self invulnerable 1 turn AND cleanses all harmful effects from the ENTIRE team. Shares 4-turn cooldown with Nekodamashi.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Eden's Air (Ophanimon passive)
abilities.effects_summary: Ophanimon passive. +10 self HP regen per turn and +10 permanent damage reduction (applied on digivolve to Ophanimon).
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

damage_profile.notes: Base Gatomon is low-damage (15/20 single-target) — her job is disrupt + ramp. Best single-turn single-target is Ophanimon's Sefirot Crystal (9x10=90) when only one enemy is alive, also bypassing invuln; otherwise ~30 Piercing (Eden's Javelin) or 30 True (Final Judgement). Per-ability AoE peak is 90 (Sefirot total spread; Final Judgement 30x3=90 team-wide). Combined-turn theoretical ~180 across the team but gated by cooldowns/energy. Angewomon is the weakest-damage form (25 Normal + 25 True). No burst-assassin ceiling; value is denial + chip + scaling control.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Self-extending: Final Judgement's blind can lock the entire enemy team near-indefinitely (each enemy action adds +1 turn), and Ophanimon stacks 10 permanent DR + 10 HP/turn for an effectively unkillable late game. Damage is fixed-value (no per-stack growth), so the ceiling is control duration and survivability, not raw numbers.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Base visible kit (Lightning Paw R, Cat's Eye W, Digivolve R, Nekodamashi R) is 1 White + 3 Random, only 1 fixed color. Character colors Green+White. Post-digivolve costs stay cheap: Angewomon = G+R+W+R; Ophanimon heaviest at Eden's Javelin (G+R), Sefirot (W+RR), Final Judgement (WW), Holy Light (R) — leans on White and a little Green but never more than 2 of one color.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Base form is almost cooldown-free (slots 1-3 cd0) so ramping is fast; only Nekodamashi is cd4 (shared with invuln buttons). Post-digivolve the offensive skills are cd1, with control/defensive tools on cd3-4 (Sefirot cd3, Final Judgement cd4, Holy Light cd4). Moderate tempo with spammable cd1 attacks.
economy.ramp_dependency: High by design — must invest ~2-3 turns generating Digivolution stacks then a turn on Digivolve before her payoff form. Until then she is a weak disruptor; reaching 3 stacks for Ophanimon (the strong form) takes ~3 setup turns minimum.

hard_cc: paralyze cooldowns (Cat's Eye, 1 turn)
soft_cc: blind Helpful skills (Lightning Paw)
blind Harmful skills (Holy Slap)
full blind 2 turns single-target (Eden's Javelin)
full team blind w/ self-extending lock (Final Judgement)
invuln_or_counter: Nekodamashi (self invuln 1t, base)
Angel Wings (self invuln 1t, Angewomon)
Holy Light (self invuln 1t + team cleanse, Ophanimon)

win_conditions: Survive the ramp phase, reach 3 Digivolution stacks, and digivolve into Ophanimon for a dominant control + survivability mid/late game.
Land Final Judgement on an enemy team that cannot afford to pass turns, snowballing the team-wide blind into a multi-turn skill lock.
Grind out attrition wars: Ophanimon's 10 permanent DR + 10 HP/turn passive plus invuln/cleanse make her extremely hard to remove while her cd1 attacks chip the enemy down.
internal_synergies: All three base attacks/defends (Lightning Paw, Cat's Eye, Nekodamashi) feed the same Digivolution stack counter, so every base turn is progress toward the payoff form.
Nekodamashi ramps a stack while invulnerable, protecting the fragile setup phase against burst.
Digivolve is usable while stunned, so hard CC can't stop the transformation once stacks are banked.
Final Judgement's blind + action-use extend trigger punishes enemies for acting, while Holy Light cleanses her own team and Eden's Air keeps her topped up — a self-reinforcing lock-and-outlast loop.
Shared 4-turn cooldown across Nekodamashi/Angel Wings/Holy Light keeps invuln consistent through every form transition.
strengths: Layered skill-denial: class-filtered blinds, cooldown paralyze, single-target full blind, and a self-extending team-wide blind lock.
Three separate self-invulnerability buttons across forms make her very hard to burst.
Ophanimon is a premium late-game package: AoE True + Piercing damage, invuln+team cleanse, 10 permanent DR, 10 HP/turn regen.
Sefirot Crystal bypasses invulnerability, answering enemy defensive stallers.
Cheap, low-color-dependency, mostly cooldown-free base kit makes ramping fast and reliable.
Flexible: single-target support/peeler (Angewomon) or AoE control monster (Ophanimon).
weaknesses: Heavily ramp-dependent — base Gatomon is a weak chip-and-disrupt unit with no real damage; fast aggro can kill her or force defensive turns before she digivolves.
Transformation is irreversible and front-loads tempo cost (~4 invested turns) before the strong form comes online.
Raw damage ceiling is modest and fixed-value (no per-stack scaling); she wins via control/attrition, not bursting key targets.
Sefirot's 90 damage is randomly spread — unreliable as single-target finisher unless few enemies remain.
Angewomon form is notably weaker than Ophanimon; landing at 2 stacks instead of 3 is a meaningful downgrade.
Most healing/DR is self-only (outside Angewomon's single-ally Heaven's Charm), so she's a self-sustaining control piece, not a true team healer.

power_assessment.reasoning: In isolation a strong, well-rounded control/ramp character whose payoff form (Ophanimon) is genuinely oppressive: a self-extending team-wide blind lock (Final Judgement), 30 Piercing single-target full-blind (Eden's Javelin), invuln+team cleanse (Holy Light), invuln-bypassing 90 spread damage (Sefirot), plus passive 10 permanent DR and 10 HP/turn that make her nearly unkillable late. Her base form, three invuln buttons, and stun-proof Digivolve give a reliable path to that payoff. Held back from a 9 by heavy ramp dependence (weak for the first ~4 turns), modest fixed-value damage, and the randomness of her biggest hit. Net: a high-impact late-game control snowball with an exploitable early window.
outlier_flags: Final Judgement's blind-extend can theoretically lock an entire enemy team indefinitely (each enemy action re-extends the blind) — potential degenerate control loop.
Ophanimon's stacked permanent 10 DR + 10 HP/turn + three forms of invuln/cleanse may make her too durable in attrition matchups.
Sefirot Crystal Bypassing ignores invulnerability for 90 total damage — strong anti-defensive outlier.
Digivolve usable-while-stunned means hard CC cannot deny the transformation once stacks are banked.

role: Affliction-DoT bruiser/assassin with strong single-target burst, a retaliation lock, and AoE debuff setup
signature_mechanic: Affliction engine: Super Incineration Cannon plants a 3-tick 10-Affliction DoT plus a retaliation trigger punishing enemy Affliction skills for 10 more, and while active swaps the slot to Lightning Drill Cannon (40 Piercing + 1-turn full stun). Machine-Gun Blows independently ramps its own base damage by a permanent +5 every primed Affliction cast, uncapped.

abilities.name: Machine-Gun Blows
abilities.effects_summary: Hits target twice for base_damage each (5+5=10 at base). Alternates: when NOT primed it deals Normal and applies a self-MARK; when primed it deals Affliction (bypasses barriers/shields/DR) and grants itself a permanent +5 base damage_mod (dur -1, infinite), then clears the mark. Every other cast is the Affliction ramp cast: 10->20->30... two-hit totals on primed casts.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent +5 per hit (+10 per two-hit cast) each primed Affliction cast; stacks indefinitely with no cap; lands every 2nd cast.

abilities.name: Lightning Eye
abilities.effects_summary: AoE enemy-team debuff, no direct damage: Shatter/def_negate (dur 2 = 1 turn, strips DR), Blind (dur 2 = 1 turn), and Vulnerability +5 (mag 5, dur 3 ~1 turn, enemies take +5 from all sources). Per JSON also resets Rocket Boosters' cooldown and 'improves' it for 1 turn.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Super Incineration Cannon
abilities.effects_summary: Immediate 10 Affliction + 10-Affliction DoT (dur 5 -> ~3 ticks). Applies a self HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER (dur 4): enemies using a NEW Affliction skill on Genos take 10 Affliction. Applies ability_swap (dur 4) swapping slot 3 to Lightning Drill Cannon while active, bound by a control_cancel. Affliction bypasses barriers/shields/DR. Guaranteed from this skill: 10 hit + 30 DoT = 40 Affliction over the window, plus conditional retaliation.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Retaliation 10 Affliction per enemy Affliction skill used on Genos during the window; unlocks the 40-Piercing+stun finisher.

abilities.name: Rocket Boosters
abilities.effects_summary: Panic button: default_defend grants Genos full Invulnerability for 1 turn. Code computes an 'improved' (Lightning Eye mark) condition but never uses it -- the JSON-described 2-turn invuln / Self-Destruct swap is NOT implemented (genostemp.gd is an unwired Self-Destruct). Long 4-turn cooldown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none as implemented (intended Lightning-Eye-improved 2-turn invuln + Self-Destruct swap is dead code)

abilities.name: Lightning Drill Cannon
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt swapped into slot 3 while Super Incineration Cannon is active. 40 Piercing (skips flat + %DR) plus a full Stun (dur 2 = 1 turn, hard CC). Premium finisher stacking on top of the active Affliction DoT.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded via Machine-Gun Blows: every primed Affliction cast permanently adds +5 per hit with no cap, so single-cast Affliction grows 20->30->40... Combined with Lightning Eye's +5 vulnerability and the stacking Super Incineration Affliction, per-turn output ramps indefinitely; practical ceiling is game length and energy, not a hard cap.
damage_profile.notes: Best burst turn: Lightning Drill Cannon 40 Piercing + full stun, plus a ramped Machine-Gun Blows (20-30 Affliction) on a Shattered/+5-vulnerable target ~= 60-70 same-turn, with the 10/turn Affliction DoT ongoing. No AoE damage at all -- Lightning Eye is pure control (Shatter+Blind+Vulnerability). Most output is Affliction/Piercing that bypasses or ignores defenses, so effective damage exceeds raw vs tanky/shielded targets; sustained Affliction floor is ~10/turn from the Super Incineration DoT plus retaliation pings.

economy.color_dependency: Light two-color: 1 Blue (genos3) + 1 White (genos2) required across the 4 visible skills; genos1 and genos4 take 1 random each. Hidden finisher adds another Blue. Only a single pip of each color, so dependency is low and easy to fund.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Machine-Gun Blows and Super Incineration Cannon are CD 0 and spammable for 1 energy; Lightning Eye CD 2; Lightning Drill Cannon CD 1. Only Rocket Boosters (CD 4) is slow. Very high actions-per-energy.
economy.ramp_dependency: Soft: fully functional turn 1 (cheap DoT + control), but Machine-Gun Blows rewards time-on-board with permanent +5 ramp and the 40-Piercing finisher requires Super Incineration active first. Stronger the longer the game runs; no transformation gate.

hard_cc: Full stun 1 turn (Lightning Drill Cannon)
soft_cc: Blind 1 turn AoE (Lightning Eye)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerability 1 turn (Rocket Boosters, CD4)
Affliction retaliation 10 dmg vs enemy Affliction skills used on Genos (Super Incineration window)

win_conditions: Grind a single priority target with cheap repeatable Affliction (Super Incineration DoT + Machine-Gun Blows) that bypasses shields/DR, then delete it with the unlocked 40-Piercing + 1-turn stun Lightning Drill Cannon.
Out-tempo on energy: 1-cost CD-0 offensive buttons let Genos act every turn while ramping Machine-Gun Blows past enemy effective HP over a long game.
Lightning Eye Shatter + team-wide +5 vulnerability sets up a coordinated focus-fire turn capitalized by Piercing/Affliction follow-up.
internal_synergies: Super Incineration Cannon -> Lightning Drill Cannon: the DoT/trigger must be active to swap in the 40-Piercing + full-stun finisher, gating the burst behind laying Affliction first.
Lightning Eye Shatter strips enemy DR right before Super Incineration's Affliction and Lightning Drill's Piercing, and its +5 vulnerability boosts every Genos hit that turn.
Machine-Gun Blows ramp + Affliction class shares the shield/barrier-bypass identity of Super Incineration.
Super Incineration's retaliation trigger + Rocket Boosters invuln let Genos bait and punish enemy Affliction dealers while untouchable.
Lightning Eye reset of Rocket Boosters keeps the invuln available more often (the 2-turn/Self-Destruct improvement is not actually coded).
strengths: Extremely energy-efficient: a full offensive turn costs 1 pip and two key skills are CD 0.
Defense-bypassing damage: stacking Affliction (ignores barriers/shields/DR) plus 40 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) makes effective damage high vs tanks/shield comps.
Strong single-target burst with hard CC (40 Piercing + full 1-turn stun on the finisher).
Uncapped permanent ramp on Machine-Gun Blows scales him into the late game.
Self-protection (1-turn invuln) plus an Affliction retaliation lock give survivability and anti-Affliction tech.
Cheap AoE setup (Shatter + Blind + +5 vulnerability) supports team focus-fire.
weaknesses: No AoE damage at all -- Lightning Eye is pure control; he can only actually kill single targets.
No healing/shields/cleanse/energy denial; only one 1-turn invuln on a long 4-turn cooldown for defense.
Burst finisher is gated: must spend a turn activating Super Incineration before Lightning Drill Cannon is available.
Machine-Gun Blows ramps slowly (every 2nd cast); early single-cast damage is modest (10-20).
Rocket Boosters' intended 2-turn invuln / Self-Destruct swap is dead/unimplemented code, so its real value is below its description.
Affliction-heavy output is countered by Affliction-immunity, cleanse, or reflect, and relies on damage over time rather than instant tempo kills.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded single-target specialist with an unusually strong economy: 1-pip CD-0 repeatable Affliction, a cheap AoE debuff (Shatter/Blind/+5 vuln), a gated but powerful 40-Piercing + full-stun finisher, a 1-turn invuln, and an uncapped permanent ramp. Most of his damage bypasses defenses, a real edge against tank/shield comps. Held back from top tier by zero AoE damage, a thin defensive toolkit (single invuln on CD4), a setup-gated burst, and the unimplemented Rocket Boosters upgrade. Solid, flexible, energy-cheap -- a strong but not broken 7.
outlier_flags: Uncapped permanent +5 ramp on Machine-Gun Blows (genos1) -- potential late-game runaway in long matches.
Very high actions-per-energy: two 1-cost CD-0 offensive buttons may over-tempo opponents.
genos4 Rocket Boosters has dead 'improved' code; described 2-turn invuln + Self-Destruct (genostemp.gd) is not wired in -- implementation/balance discrepancy.
Layered defense-bypass (Affliction + Piercing + Shatter) makes effective damage notably higher than raw numbers vs defensive comps.

role: Mono-red ramping single-target assassin / counter-control disruptor with hard self-protection
signature_mechanic: Gate of Babylon stacks: a free self-cast banks stacks that (a) multiply the free 10-damage nuke into a multi-hit barrage (one hit per stack) and (b) fuel a free one-turn invulnerability panic button. Plus a recurring "skills/effects cannot deal damage or healing" nullify lock applied via both his counter trap and his piercing nuke.

abilities.name: Gate of Babylon
abilities.conditional_scaling: Per Gate of Babylon stack on Gilgamesh: deals 10 Normal damage once, then repeats once per consumed stack (hits = 1 + stacks). Self-cast banks +1 stack (uncapped). At 5+ stacks advances a mission objective.
abilities.effects_summary: Dual-mode free skill. On SELF: adds 1 stackable, displayed Gate of Babylon MARK (no cap). On ENEMY: deals 10 Normal damage hits = (1 + current stacks), then fully removes all Gate stacks. Zero cost, zero cooldown spammable single-target nuke that ramps with banked stacks.

abilities.name: Enkidu, Chains of Heaven
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Applies an INVISIBLE counter trap (COUNTER_USE, dur 2 = next 1 turn): if the target uses a new Harmful skill it is countered (action negated). On trigger it also applies CHAIN_NULLIFY (dur 3) so the enemy's skills and effects cannot deal damage or healing for ~1 turn. Pure denial/lock; no damage. Invisible until triggered = strong mind-game/disruption.

abilities.name: Enuma Elish
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat 35)
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 35 Piercing damage (skips flat + % damage reduction) to one enemy and applies CHAIN_NULLIFY (dur 3) so the target's skills and effects cannot deal damage or healing for ~1 turn. Reliable mid burst + offensive lockdown stapled together.

abilities.name: Gate of Babylon - Interception
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gated by Gate of Babylon stacks (requires and consumes 1 stack).
abilities.effects_summary: Free self-cast: Gilgamesh becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend). Requires and consumes 1 Gate of Babylon stack. Competes with gilgamesh1's nuke for the same stack pool, but on a 4-turn cooldown so it can't be spammed.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Gate of Babylon nuke = 10 x (1 + banked stacks), Normal damage (mitigable). Practically he banks ~3-5 stacks across early turns (each bank costs a full free action), so a realistic detonation is ~40-60 (4-6 hits) and a heavily-ramped one 70-100+. Because each hit is a separate 10-damage Normal instance, flat DR and barriers blunt it hard. Enuma Elish adds a flat 35 Piercing on a 2cd that ignores DR. Combined ramped turn (detonate ~50 + Enuma 35) can reach ~85+ single-target, all one enemy.
damage_profile.notes: No AoE and no DoT anywhere in the kit. All output funnels into one target. Burst is back-loaded behind ramp turns spent self-casting gilgamesh1; he is weak per-turn until stacked. Piercing on Enuma Elish is the only DR-bypassing damage.

economy.color_dependency: Hard mono-Red. character_colors=[3]. All paid costs are Red (Enkidu Red:1, Enuma Elish Red:2); both free skills cost nothing. Total visible-kit cost is only 3 pips, all Red — very cheap but fully Red-locked, so he is energy-starved teammates' best friend yet has zero flexibility.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two free, low/no-cooldown tools (gilgamesh1 cd0, gilgamesh4 cd4) plus Enkidu cd3 and Enuma Elish cd2. Very fast tempo: he can act meaningfully every turn for free, paying Red only when he wants the counter trap or the piercing nuke.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. His scaling win-path requires spending multiple free turns self-casting gilgamesh1 to bank stacks before detonating; those same stacks are also the only fuel for his invuln. Strong tension between offense (spend stacks on nuke) and defense (save a stack for Interception).

soft_cc: CHAIN_NULLIFY damage/heal nullify (Enuma Elish, ~1 turn)
CHAIN_NULLIFY on counter trigger (Enkidu, ~1 turn)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerable 1 turn (gilgamesh4, free, costs 1 Gate stack, cd4)
Invisible single-target counter on next Harmful skill (gilgamesh2, cd3)

win_conditions: Ramp Gate of Babylon stacks over several free turns, then detonate gilgamesh1 for a multi-hit burst to delete a key single target
Use Enkidu's invisible counter + chain-nullify to neutralize the enemy's biggest harmful skill while chipping with Enuma Elish
Outlast/disrupt: stack-fed invulnerability turns plus repeated damage/heal nullify locks to win attrition against a single threat-carry comp
internal_synergies: Gate of Babylon stacks are shared currency for both the gilgamesh1 nuke AND the gilgamesh4 invuln — banking stacks simultaneously builds burst potential and defensive reserves
Enuma Elish (Piercing, ignores DR) pairs with the Gate nuke (Normal, mitigable) so he has answers to both squishies and armored targets
Both Enkidu (on counter) and Enuma Elish apply the same CHAIN_NULLIFY lock, letting him chain back-to-back damage/heal denial on a priority enemy
Free skills (slots 1 and 4) mean his Red pips are reserved purely for control/piercing, making every turn productive
strengths: Extremely energy-efficient: two free skills and only 3 total Red pips for the whole paid kit
Uncapped, multiplicative ramp on a 0-cost 0-cooldown nuke
Free, repeatable 1-turn invulnerability panic button (fuel permitting)
Strong disruption: invisible counter (mind-game) plus two sources of damage/heal nullify
Enuma Elish's Piercing burst bypasses flat and % damage reduction, beating tanks/DR comps
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero DoT — fully single-target, struggles versus wide/multi-threat comps
Hard mono-Red dependency: a Red-denial opponent or color screw cripples Enkidu and Enuma Elish
Ramp is slow and telegraphed by stack display; detonating costs all banked stacks at once and competes with his invuln for the same resource
Gate nuke damage is Normal — barriers, flat DR, and per-hit mitigation gut a multi-hit detonation since each hit is only 10
No healing, no shields, no self-sustain beyond timed invuln; if forced to spend stacks defensively his offense collapses
Counter/nullify are conditional — a patient enemy can bait the invisible counter or simply not use a Harmful skill that turn

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, very cheap single-target specialist with a genuinely flexible toolkit: free ramp nuke, free invuln, an invisible counter, and a piercing burst that doubles as a damage/heal lock. The economy is excellent (3 Red pips total, two free skills) and the disruption package is real. He's held back from top tier by being purely single-target with no AoE/DoT, a slow telegraphed ramp whose payoff (mitigable Normal multi-hit) is blunted by DR/barriers, and an internal resource conflict where the same Gate stacks must choose between burst and survival. Strong in 1v1 / focus-fire pick comps, mediocre into spread boards. Solidly mid-tier in isolation.
