role: Tempo single-target duelist with a channel/bluff mind-game and reactive counters
signature_mechanic: Big Bang Kamehameha / Bluff Kamehameha mind-game: gogeta1 channels a 50-damage delayed hit that next turn swaps gogeta1 into the free, uncounterable gogeta5, which can either let the 50 land or cancel it to instead stun the target for 1 turn and gain a -1 Random cost discount for 3 turns. He also self-flexes his energy: gogeta2 turns Blue costs to Random and reduces all his own cooldowns by 1; gogeta3 turns Red costs to Random; gogeta5 grants a flat -1 Random discount.

abilities.name: Big Bang Kamehameha
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (fixed 50, delayed one turn; can be cancelled by gogeta5)
abilities.effects_summary: Channeled: applies a ticking trigger that deals 50 Normal damage to target next turn (also applies a system mark on the tick). Swaps gogeta1 -> gogeta5 (Bluff Kamehameha) for the duration; a channel-cancel ties the swap and tick together so using gogeta5 cancels the pending 50 damage.

abilities.name: Unrivaled Strength
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 35 Normal damage. Reduces the remaining cooldown of ALL of Gogeta's skills by 1 (tempo/CD acceleration). Converts Gogeta's Blue costs to Random for 2 turns (cost flexibility). 1 CD makes this a near-spammable filler.

abilities.name: Positive Energy Reflection
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reflected damage is conditional: only triggers if the marked enemy uses a Harmful skill within 1 turn; becomes AoE 25-to-all-enemies if the countered skill was AoE
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible counter placed on target enemy for 1 turn: if they use a new Harmful skill they are countered and take 25 Normal; if that skill was AoE, all enemies take 25 each instead. Also converts Gogeta's Red costs to Random for 2 turns (invisible). No upfront damage.

abilities.name: Unapproachable Stance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Retaliation damage scales with number of enemies that attack him (20 per Harmful skill used on him for 1 turn)
abilities.effects_summary: Self panic button: invisible harmful-receive trigger for 1 turn. Any enemy that uses a new Harmful skill on Gogeta takes 20 Normal damage. Reactive deterrent; no own damage, no mitigation, only retaliation.

abilities.name: Bluff Kamehameha
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (trades the pending 50 damage for control + economy)
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt that replaces gogeta1 while Big Bang Kamehameha is channeling. Free, uncounterable. Stuns the enemy currently targeted by Big Bang Kamehameha for 1 turn and grants Gogeta -1 Random cost on all skills for 3 turns. Using it CANCELS the pending 50 damage; fails if the channel already resolved this turn. The 50-vs-(stun+discount) choice is the core mind-game.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Roughly 85 single-target in one turn if the 50 Big Bang Kamehameha tick lands the same turn he also lands a 35 Unrivaled Strength (timing-dependent across the channel). No DoT, no per-stack growth. AoE is capped at a conditional 25-to-all reflect that only fires if an enemy uses an AoE Harmful skill into gogeta3's counter.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Normal (no Affliction/Bleed/Piercing/True), so every hit is fully subject to barriers, shields, and DR. The 50 Big Bang hit is delayed one turn and can be self-cancelled, so it is not reliable on-demand burst. Reflect/retaliation damage (gogeta3 25, gogeta4 20) is reactive and depends entirely on enemy choices. Realistic per-turn pressure is modest (35 reliable + situational reflects).

economy.color_dependency: Built on Blue+Red (character_colors [1,3]). Visible kit needs Blue:2 + Red:2 + Random:3. However the kit self-mitigates its own color dependency: gogeta2 converts Blue->Random for 2 turns, gogeta3 converts Red->Random for 2 turns, and gogeta5 gives -1 Random for 3 turns, so after a turn or two his effective costs collapse toward pure Random and get cheaper.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast. gogeta2 has CD 1 and additionally reduces ALL his cooldowns by 1 each cast, so gogeta1 (CD2) and gogeta3 (CD3) come back quickly; gogeta4 is CD2; gogeta5 is CD0/free. The kit cycles aggressively with very little downtime.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate. No stack/transformation ramp for power, but his cost-reduction/color-flex effects (gogeta2, gogeta3, gogeta5 discount) snowball his economy over the first 2-3 turns, making him cheaper and faster the longer he stays active.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun via Bluff Kamehameha (gogeta5)
invuln_or_counter: gogeta3 single-target counter on Harmful use (25 dmg, AoE-reflect if countered skill was AoE)
gogeta4 self harmful-receive retaliation (20 dmg per attacker for 1 turn)
gogeta1->gogeta5 is itself uncounterable

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, self-sufficient single-target duelist with a clever signature mind-game but no standout numbers. Strengths: excellent tempo/economy (CD1 cooldown-shredder on gogeta2, free uncounterable gogeta5, and three layered cost-reduction/color-flex effects that make him cheaper and faster every turn), built-in hard CC (1-turn stun), and two layers of counter/retaliation that punish aggression. The Big Bang/Bluff fork is genuinely strong as a mind-game: opponent must respect either a 50 burst or a stun+discount. Weaknesses cap him below top tier: all damage is Normal (fully blocked by shields/barriers/DR with no piercing or DoT), his best burst (50) is delayed and self-cancellable so it's not reliable on-demand, much of his 'damage' is reactive and enemy-dependent, and he has zero self-sustain (no heal, shield, or cleanse) so he is fragile under focus. Single-target only with negligible AoE. Solid, slippery, fair-statted bruiser-duelist rather than a power outlier.
outlier_flags: gogeta2 reduces ALL own cooldowns by 1 at only CD1 and 2 cost - unusually strong, self-compounding tempo engine
Stacking cost reducers (Blue->Random, Red->Random, plus -1 Random) can drive his effective costs near-zero, a potential economy outlier over a long match
gogeta5 is free, uncounterable, and provides a 1-turn stun - very efficient control attached to the channel

strengths: Strong tempo engine: gogeta2 (CD1, cost 2) deals 35 and reduces ALL his cooldowns by 1, cycling the whole kit fast
Self-improving economy: Blue->Random, Red->Random, and -1 Random discount stack to make his costs cheaper and more flexible over 2-3 turns
Free, uncounterable 1-turn stun via the Big Bang/Bluff fork
Genuine mind-game: opponent must respect a pending 50 burst or a stun + discount
Two reactive punish layers (gogeta3 counter, gogeta4 retaliation) that deter and tax enemy aggression
weaknesses: All damage is Normal type - fully stopped by shields, barriers, and DR; no Piercing/True/Affliction/Bleed and no DoT
Best burst (50) is delayed a full turn and self-cancellable, so it is not reliable on-demand damage
Much of his output is reactive and enemy-dependent (counters only fire if the enemy attacks)
Zero self-sustain: no heal, shield, barrier, or cleanse - fragile when focused
Purely single-target offense; AoE is a single conditional 25 reflect
Up-front cost is specific-color (Blue+Red) before his own converters come online
win_conditions: Win the Big Bang/Bluff mind-game repeatedly: force the opponent to mis-react, landing either 50 burst or a tempo-swinging stun
Out-tempo the opponent by cycling cheap, fast skills (gogeta2 CD shred) while his economy snowballs cheaper
Use gogeta3/gogeta4 counters to punish an aggressive enemy team into passivity, then grind out single-target kills
internal_synergies: gogeta1 enables gogeta5 (swap) - the entire mind-game fork
gogeta2's all-cooldown reduction accelerates re-use of gogeta1 (CD2) and gogeta3 (CD3), tightening the loop
gogeta2 (Blue->Random) + gogeta3 (Red->Random) + gogeta5 (-1 Random) compound to slash his specific-color dependency and total cost
gogeta5's stun pairs with the channel timing to lock a target while his other skills come off cooldown

abilities.name: Merciless Punch
abilities.conditional_scaling: If target is marked by Merciless Punch (i.e., this skill used last turn), applies a 10-threshold execute_attempt (instant kill if HP <= 10). Damage itself does not scale; benefits from Saiyan Rage +5-per-stack damage mods.
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal dmg; applies -10 non-Affliction damage debuff to target for 1 turn (dur 2); self-marks so next turn's Merciless Punch also executes target at <=10 HP.

abilities.name: Saiyan Rage
abilities.conditional_scaling: Ramp enabler: each time a living ally takes damage (over the 4-turn window), Gohan permanently gains +5 damage on his 3 harmful skills (stacking, dur -1) and -1 Random cost on them until his next harmful use. If an ally is already dead at cast, gohan2 is swapped for Father-Son Kamehameha (alt index 9) for 4 turns.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff. Sets DAMAGE_RECEIVE_TRIGGER on each living ally (dur 8 = 4 turns). Triggered: permanent stacking +5 dmg mod on harmful skills + one-shot -1 Random cost reduction (ends on next harmful use). Dead-ally branch: ability_swap to Father-Son Kamehameha for 4 turns. No damage, no CC.

abilities.name: Brutal Kick
abilities.conditional_scaling: If self marked by Brutal Kick (used last turn), also applies the -10 non-Affliction damage debuff to target. Always applies a 10-threshold execute_attempt (instant kill if HP <= 10). Benefits from Saiyan Rage +5-per-stack damage mods.
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal dmg + execute_attempt at <=10 HP; self-marks so next turn's Brutal Kick also adds a -10 non-Affliction damage debuff. Pairs with gohan1: alternating the two stacks both an execute and a damage debuff.

abilities.name: Gohan Dodge
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Gohan becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Pure defensive panic button, 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Father-Son Kamehameha
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 35 Piercing +15 per dead ally on Gohan's team; additionally +15 if a teammate has path_name 'goku' (NOTE: code checks Goku regardless of dead state, so a LIVING Goku also grants +15; a dead Goku grants +15 dead +15 Goku = +30). Realistically scales with dead allies in a 3v3 (up to +30 from 2 dead allies, +30 more if one is Goku). Also gains Saiyan Rage +5 stacks.
abilities.effects_summary: 35 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) single-target nuke; +15 per dead ally, +15 for Goku on team. Becomes Gohan's hidden execute/finisher; accessed via Saiyan Rage swap when an ally dies, or as default alt. No secondary effects.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Father-Son Kamehameha: 35 base + (2 dead allies x 15 = 30) + Goku-on-team 15, and if the dead Goku counts both branches an extra 15 -> ~95 Piercing in a worst-case-for-enemy scenario, before Saiyan Rage stacks. Saiyan Rage adds permanent +5 per ally-damage-instance to all three harmful skills, so late-game a Merciless Punch/Brutal Kick can climb from 25 toward 40-50+ with several stacks. Hard ceiling is gated by allies actually taking damage / dying, so it is comeback-shaped rather than free.
damage_profile.notes: No AoE in the entire kit (peak AoE = 0). No DoT. Damage is Normal on the two cheap strikes (25, blockable by DR/barriers) and Piercing on the Kamehameha (35+, ignores flat and % DR). Execute thresholds (10 HP) provide effective burst beyond raw numbers against low-HP targets. Peak single-target ~95 assumes a fully-fed Kamehameha; a more typical mid-game Kamehameha with one dead ally is ~50 Piercing.

economy.color_dependency: Light Green/White dependency. Visible kit (gohan1-4): Green x1, White x2, Random x3 across the four skills (Merciless Green+Rand, Saiyan White, Brutal White+Rand, Dodge Rand). Father-Son Kamehameha adds a Green+White+Rand. Cheap and flexible thanks to many Random pips; only one Green and one/two White hard requirements at a time.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two 1-cooldown spammable strikes (Merciless Punch, Brutal Kick) give high tempo and constant pressure; Saiyan Rage and Gohan Dodge are on 4-turn cooldowns (setup/defensive); Father-Son Kamehameha on 3-turn cooldown.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high. Damage above the flat 25/25/35 floor requires Saiyan Rage to be active AND allies to be taking damage; the Kamehameha's payoff scales with allies DYING. Kit is strongest as the game wears on / as Gohan's team is being whittled down.

soft_cc: -10 non-Affliction damage reduction debuff (Merciless Punch always; Brutal Kick when self-marked), 1 turn
invuln_or_counter: Gohan Dodge: Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend), 4-turn cooldown

internal_synergies: Merciless Punch + Brutal Kick alternation: each marks itself so the FOLLOWING same-skill cast adds its bonus (Brutal Kick gains the -10 damage debuff; Merciless Punch's mark gates its own execute). Both carry 10-HP execute_attempt, so two cheap 1-cooldown strikes give sustained chip + execute pressure.

Saiyan Rage feeds all three harmful skills: every instance of an ally taking damage permanently buffs Merciless Punch / Brutal Kick / Father-Son Kamehameha by +5 (stacking) and temporarily discounts them by 1 Random.

Father-Son Kamehameha is unlocked/swapped in by Saiyan Rage when an ally dies, and its damage scales +15 per dead ally — so the same trigger (allies dying) that surfaces the skill also powers it up. Goku on the team (especially a dead Goku) gives extra +15/+30.
Comeback identity: the worse Gohan's team is doing (allies damaged/dying), the harder his kit hits — Saiyan Rage stacks and Kamehameha scaling both reward losing allies.
signature_mechanic: Latent-power ramp: Saiyan Rage converts allies taking damage (and dying) into permanent stacking +5 damage on all harmful skills plus a Random-cost discount, and an ally's death swaps in the scaling Piercing nuke Father-Son Kamehameha — a comeback/anger archetype that grows stronger as his team is whittled down.

power_assessment.reasoning: A flexible, cheap single-target bruiser with a clean identity (anger/comeback ramp) but no AoE, no CC beyond a minor 1-turn damage debuff, no sustain, and no team utility. Floor is modest: two 25-damage Normal strikes (blockable by DR/barriers) on 1-cooldowns plus a 1-turn invuln. The 10-HP execute on both strikes is meaningful finishing pressure and the alternating self-mark loop is elegant. Ceiling is good but heavily conditional: Saiyan Rage's +5 stacks only build when allies are getting hit, and Father-Son Kamehameha's 35+ Piercing only spikes (toward ~65-95) once allies are dead — i.e., when his team is already losing. Energy is light/flexible (mostly Random with one Green + one/two White), which is a plus. Overall a solid, fair mid-tier kit: reliable chip + execute, real but gated burst, and a defensive button, dragged down by zero AoE/CC/support and ramp that pays off only in losing positions.
outlier_flags: gohan5 Goku check (line 23) tests path_name == 'goku' on ALL team characters regardless of dead state, so a LIVING Goku grants +15 and a DEAD Goku stacks to +30 — the split_desc claims '+30 if one of the dead allies is Goku', so a living-Goku +15 is likely an unintended bug.
Comeback scaling rewards allies dying, which is mechanically unusual and can feel bad for a player who is already behind.
Father-Son Kamehameha is a hidden slot-5 alt only surfaced via Saiyan Rage's dead-ally swap; if no ally dies it may never be cast, making a chunk of the kit's power inaccessible in a winning game.

role: Single-target ramp bruiser / executioner with comeback (anger) scaling; no AoE, minimal CC, self-only defense.
strengths: Cheap, high-tempo pressure: two 1-cooldown strikes (25 each) that are mostly Random-cost and color-flexible.
Dual 10-HP execute_attempt on Merciless Punch AND Brutal Kick gives strong finishing power against low-HP targets.
Father-Son Kamehameha is Piercing (ignores flat and % DR) and scales hard (+15/dead ally, +15-30 for Goku) into a 50-95 single-target nuke.
Saiyan Rage gives permanent, stacking, kit-wide +5 damage plus a Random-cost discount, so Gohan ramps over a long game.
Built-in 1-turn Invulnerability (Gohan Dodge) as a survival/tempo panic button.
Light energy identity (mostly Random + 1 Green/White) makes him easy to slot into many teams.
weaknesses: Zero AoE anywhere in the kit and no DoT — purely single-target, weak into wide boards.
No hard CC, no stuns/silences, no energy denial; only a minor 1-turn -10 non-Affliction damage debuff.
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no team support — entirely selfish.
Ramp is conditional and comeback-shaped: Saiyan Rage only stacks when allies take damage, and the Kamehameha only spikes when allies die, so he is weakest while ahead.
Base 25 damage on the two main strikes is Normal type and fully blockable by DR/barriers/invuln before any ramp.
Father-Son Kamehameha is a hidden alt gated behind an ally death (or default-swap), so its burst may be unavailable in many games.
win_conditions: Grind out single targets with spammable 25-damage strikes and finish them via the 10-HP execute_attempt on Merciless Punch / Brutal Kick.
Activate Saiyan Rage early and let allies absorb damage to stack permanent +5 buffs, snowballing Gohan's three harmful skills as the match drags on.
Punish a losing/attrition game: once an ally dies, swap in Father-Son Kamehameha and land 50-95 Piercing nukes that ignore DR, ideally with Goku on the team for the bonus.
Use Gohan Dodge to time-walk through a key enemy turn and preserve tempo while ramping.

role: Blue-energy single-target/AoE energy nuker with a piercing AoE and a self-protect/cleanse button
signature_mechanic: Lapse->Reversal combo (Lapse: Blue self-marks to give Reversal: Red +10 next turn) paired with Hollow Purple's barrier-ignoring Piercing AoE, all subsidized by the Six Eyes Blue-cost-discount passive that procs when he is attacked.
internal_synergies: Lapse: Blue (gojo1) applies a self-mark that grants Reversal: Red (gojo2) +10 damage the following turn — verified: mark source name 'Lapse: Blue' matches marked_by() check in gojo2.
Six Eyes (gojo5) reduces Blue cost by 1 after Gojo is damaged, directly offsetting his all-Blue kit so he can keep casting while focused.
Infinity Barrier (gojo4) lets him survive the turn he is targeted, and that incoming damage can also proc Six Eyes' discount — defensive turn that fuels future offense.
Lapse: Blue's channel-cancel disrupts enemy charge/channel abilities while still dealing damage and setting up the combo.
strengths: Hollow Purple deals Piercing AoE (45 main / 15 splash) that bypasses flat and percentage damage reduction — strong against tanks and DR comps.
Reliable, low-cooldown damage every turn (Lapse: Blue CD1) plus a 2-turn 45-damage combo finisher.
Infinity Barrier is a cheap (1 Blue) invuln that also full-cleanses harmful effects — excellent panic/cleanse button.
Six Eyes passively makes his expensive Blue kit cheaper exactly when he is under pressure.
Channel cancel on Lapse: Blue is a useful disrupt against channeled/charge abilities.
Flexible turn-to-turn economy thanks to 2 Random pips and the cost discount.
weaknesses: No healing, no shields/barriers, no hard CC — purely a damage dealer with one defensive cooldown.
Extreme mono-Blue color dependency: every visible skill needs Blue, so Blue energy denial or color screw cripples him.
No scaling/ramp: damage is flat and modest (single-target peak 45), so he can be out-DPSed by ramp/scaling carries over a long game.
Infinity Barrier is on a 4-turn cooldown — long windows where he has no defensive option and is a squishy carry.
Hollow Purple (his only AoE) is locked behind a 3-turn cooldown, so sustained AoE pressure is weak.
The Lapse->Reversal +10 combo telegraphs and costs two turns of setup for a small bonus; easily disrupted if he must use Infinity Barrier or is stunned in between.
win_conditions: Use Infinity Barrier to invuln through burst/CC windows and outlast the enemy's tempo while chipping with Lapse: Blue every turn.
Pick the right turn for Hollow Purple to land Piercing AoE that ignores enemy DR/tanks, swinging the HP race.
Execute the Lapse: Blue -> Reversal: Red combo for a 45-damage focused kill on a softened target.
Leverage Six Eyes cost discounts to keep casting while focused and convert incoming damage into tempo.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, well-rounded damage dealer: every-turn chip + a 2-turn 45 burst combo + a Piercing AoE that bypasses DR + a cheap invuln-with-cleanse panic button + an economy-smoothing passive. That is a complete, low-risk kit with no dead slots. He is held back from being top-tier by flat, non-scaling damage (single-target peak only 45), no healing/shields/hard-CC, and a long-CD (4) defensive button that leaves big vulnerable windows on a squishy carry. The all-Blue cost makes him a clean target for energy/color denial. Solidly above-average but not an outlier — strong floor, modest ceiling.
outlier_flags: Hollow Purple is barrier/DR-ignoring Piercing AoE (45+15s) — above-curve effective damage vs tank/DR comps and worth watching.
Infinity Barrier bundles full invuln + full harmful-effect cleanse for only 1 Blue pip; cost may be undertuned for the value, though gated by CD4.
Entire visible kit requires Blue (5 Blue pips across 4 skills) — extreme single-color dependency is a balance/consistency outlier worth flagging.

role: single-target piercing burst/ramp duelist with self-cost engine and defensive escape tools
signature_mechanic: Kamehameha self-throttle loop: using the full-cost Kamehameha discounts itself to 1 Blue / -15 damage for a turn; using THAT reduced version instead funnels a -1 Blue cost-reduction onto Spirit Bomb (stacking until Spirit Bomb fires, which consumes them). Kaioken x20 transformation overlays +10 damage, Piercing, and self-affliction onto Kamehameha and swaps Instant Transmission's slot for the cheap Kaioken Rush nuke.

abilities.name: Kamehameha
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1, Random:1 (full); reduced version costs Blue:1 only
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reduced version deals 20 (35-15) for 1 Blue. Under Kaioken x20: becomes Piercing, +10 damage (45), self-deals 5 affliction. Reduced-version casts feed -1 Blue to Spirit Bomb each time.
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable (cd 0) chip nuke that throttles itself: full cast applies cost_change and -15 damage_mod to self for ~1 turn (the 'reduced' state); casting the reduced state instead stamps a -1 Blue cost_mod onto Spirit Bomb. No CC. Under Kaioken mark it self-burns 5 affliction per use.

abilities.name: Kaioken x20
abilities.conditional_scaling: Buffs Kamehameha by +10 damage and makes it Piercing for the duration; enables the cheap Kaioken Rush swap.
abilities.effects_summary: Transformation/buff: self 10 flat damage_reduction (dur 6 = 3 turns) + ticks 5 affliction to self per turn for 3 turns (immediate 5 also dealt on cast). Applies a mark + damage_mod (+10 to Kamehameha, makes it Piercing and adds 5 self-affliction on use) and ability_swap turning slot 4 (Instant Transmission) into Kaioken Rush. Self-harm cost for offense ramp.

abilities.name: Spirit Bomb
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:3 (reduced -1 Blue per stacked Kamehameha cost_mod, consumed on use)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Effective cost ramps down via Kamehameha reduced-cast cost_mods (each -1 Blue), erased when Spirit Bomb fires. Damage fixed at 60.
abilities.effects_summary: Big single-target nuke: 60 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) plus a 1-turn stun (stun_effect dur 2). Core burst/control payoff; its Blue cost is paid down by repeatedly spamming the discounted Kamehameha.

abilities.name: Instant Transmission
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Defensive: Goku becomes invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend). Cheap 1-random-pip panic button. Gets swapped OUT of slot 4 for Kaioken Rush while Kaioken x20 is active, so you choose between the escape and the extra nuke.

abilities.name: Kaioken Rush
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap-in (only while Kaioken x20 active, replaces Instant Transmission). 30 Piercing to one enemy and self-deals 10 affliction. Low cd (1), cheap (1 Red): efficient near-spammable piercing pressure, but bleeds Goku's own HP.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Burst, not DoT. One-turn ceiling on a single enemy ~ Spirit Bomb 60 Piercing + Kaioken-buffed Kamehameha 45 Piercing = 105 (only with energy and Kaioken active, skipping Kaioken Rush that turn). Realistic per-turn output 45-60. No multi-target damage anywhere; AoE = 0.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is single-target. Spirit Bomb (60 Piercing) and Kaioken-buffed Kamehameha (45 Piercing) are the heavy hits; both Piercing so they ignore flat+%DR. Kaioken Rush adds 30 Piercing on a 1-cd. Offense is gated by Blue energy and the slow Kamehameha->Spirit Bomb discount ramp. Self-affliction (5/turn from Kaioken plus 5 or 10 per offensive cast) is a downside, not enemy DoT.

economy.color_dependency: Heavy and dual-color. Damage core (Kamehameha 1 Blue, Spirit Bomb 3 Blue) is Blue-dependent; the Kaioken line (Kaioken x20, Kaioken Rush) needs Red. Visible kit is 4 Blue + 1 Red + 1 Random. Spirit Bomb's Blue can ramp down toward 0 via the Kamehameha discount engine.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Kamehameha cd 0 (spammable filler/engine), Kaioken Rush cd 1 (near-spam piercing once transformed). Big tools on cd 4 (Spirit Bomb, Kaioken x20, Instant Transmission) -> bursty windows every ~4 turns with smooth filler between.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-high. Spirit Bomb wants several discounted-Kamehameha casts to become cheap, and Kaioken x20 must be online to unlock the +10/Piercing Kamehameha and Kaioken Rush. Peak output needs setup turns and sustained Blue income.

hard_cc: Spirit Bomb 1-turn stun
invuln_or_counter: Instant Transmission: 1-turn invulnerability
Kaioken x20: 10 flat damage reduction for 3 turns

win_conditions: Ramp Blue energy and chain discounted Kamehameha casts to make Spirit Bomb cheap, then land the 60 Piercing + stun on a key target
Pop Kaioken x20 to convert Kamehameha into a Piercing +10 nuke and spam cheap Kaioken Rush, racing the opponent down before self-affliction matters
Use Instant Transmission invuln + 10 DR to survive burst windows and out-tempo with cd-0/cd-1 piercing chip
internal_synergies: Kamehameha (reduced cast) stacks -1 Blue cost_mod onto Spirit Bomb, making the 60-piercing nuke cheap; Spirit Bomb consumes the stacks on fire
Kaioken x20 buffs Kamehameha (+10, Piercing, at the cost of self-affliction) AND swaps Instant Transmission for Kaioken Rush, converting a defensive slot into offense
Piercing on Spirit Bomb / Kaioken-Kamehameha / Kaioken Rush ignores enemy flat+%DR, so the whole offense beats armor/DR comps
Instant Transmission invuln + Kaioken's 10 DR cover the survivability cost of the self-affliction plan
strengths: Almost all damage is Piercing (ignores flat+%DR), so output stays reliable vs tanks/DR comps
Strong single-target burst ceiling (Spirit Bomb 60 + buffed Kamehameha) with a built-in 1-turn stun for control/setup
Excellent tempo/efficiency tools: cd-0 Kamehameha engine and cd-1 Kaioken Rush keep cheap pressure flowing
Self-protection package (1-turn invuln plus 10 DR for 3 turns) lets him survive enemy burst windows
Low raw kit cost and a self-feeding cost-reduction engine reward good sequencing
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero healing/shielding for allies; purely a selfish single-target duelist
Self-affliction is significant: Kaioken x20 ticks 5/turn for 3 turns AND adds self-damage to Kamehameha (5) and Kaioken Rush (10), risking self-kill in long races
Affliction self-damage bypasses his own 10 DR, so his defensive layer does not mitigate his own ramp cost
Heavy Blue dependency (Spirit Bomb is Blue:3 base) makes him energy-starved if Blue is scarce; ramp is slow without it
Mutually-exclusive choices: transforming trades away the invuln slot for Kaioken Rush, weakening defense
Stun is only 1 turn and single-target; no cleanse, no energy denial, limited disruption

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded single-target piercing duelist with a clever self-cost engine, a strong burst-plus-stun payoff (Spirit Bomb), spammable filler, and self-survivability (invuln + DR). All-piercing offense is a meaningful edge against DR/tank comps. Held back by no AoE, no team utility/healing, meaningful self-affliction that bypasses his own DR, heavy Blue dependency, and a ramp that needs setup turns to peak. A solid mid-to-upper-mid duelist rather than an oppressive pick; the self-damage and energy gating are genuine counterbalances to the piercing throughput.
outlier_flags: all-piercing damage core (ignores flat+%DR) is unusually consistent
cd-0 Kamehameha as a self-feeding cost-reduction engine is a distinctive economy mechanic
self-affliction stacking creates a genuine self-kill risk that bypasses his own damage reduction

role: Ramp-based single-target bruiser/executioner with a stance-stacking buff loop
signature_mechanic: Jajanken Stance ramp-and-spend: free stacking self-buff that grants shield + per-stack damage and upgrades Rock/Paper/Scissors, but is fully consumed the moment Gon uses any damaging skill.

abilities.name: Jajanken Stance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stacks: each cast adds +10 shield (stack_mag, stackable) and +5 stacking per-stack damage mod to Jajanken Rock and Jajanken Paper. Also applies a cost-change effect making Paper cost 1 Random while active. Removed when Gon uses any non-Stance skill.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff/ramp: +10 stacking Shield, +5 damage per stack to Rock/Paper, enables the 'improved' versions of Rock (stun), Paper (piercing+blind), Scissors (per-stack pre-damage). JSON claims +10 damage but .gd is +5 per stack. Ends on next damaging skill use.

abilities.name: Jajanken Rock
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 damage per Jajanken Stance stack (via damage_mod). Stuns only if Stance active.
abilities.effects_summary: 30 Normal single-target damage (35/40/45+ with 1/2/3 Stance stacks). If Stance active, applies Stun for 1 turn (dur 2). Consumes Stance on use.

abilities.name: Jajanken Paper
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1 (becomes Random:1 while Stance active via cost-change effect)
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 damage per Jajanken Stance stack (via damage_mod). Becomes Piercing and Blinds when Stance active.
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Normal AoE to all enemies (15/20/25 with 1/2/3 stacks). With Stance: damage becomes Piercing (skips flat+%DR) and applies Blind for 1 turn (dur 2) to every target; cost drops to 1 Random. Consumes Stance on use.

abilities.name: Jajanken Scissors
abilities.conditional_scaling: Pre-execute damage = 10 x Jajanken Stance stack_count (Normal). Does NOT receive the +5/stack damage_mod. Then an execute_attempt at 25 HP threshold.
abilities.effects_summary: Execute: instant-kills a target at <=25 HP. If Stance active, first deals 10 x stacks Normal damage, then attempts the execute (so high stacks can drop a target into execute range and finish in one cast). Targeting only allows enemies already <=25 HP, but pre-damage resolves first. Consumes Stance on use.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded in theory but tempo-gated: every Stance stack costs a full turn of doing no damage, and all stacks are consumed by a single skill. A realistic 3-stack invest yields Rock 45 + 1-turn stun, Paper 25 AoE piercing + blind, or Scissors 30 pre-damage + execute. Higher stacks (e.g. 5) push Rock to 55 and Scissors pre-damage to 50 but require 5 idle ramp turns, so practical ceiling is ~50-60 single-target.
damage_profile.notes: No true DoT. All damage is Normal except Paper-with-Stance which is Piercing. Scissors deals 0 listed base damage; its value is the 25-HP execute plus per-stack chip. Stance buff (+5/stack) applies only to Rock and Paper, not Scissors.

economy.color_dependency: Green-primary (Stance is free; Rock needs Green+Random, Scissors needs Green, Paper needs Blue but drops to Random while Stance active). Mostly Green with a light Blue splash; very cheap overall.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Stance is free with cd 1 (can be cast nearly every turn to ramp). Rock and Paper have no cooldown (spammable). Scissors cd 2. Tempo is gated not by cooldowns but by the ramp-then-spend stance loop.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. The kit's payoff (stun, blind, piercing, big damage, execute setup) all key off Jajanken Stance stacks, and stacks are spent in a single attack. Gon must invest idle turns stacking, making him slow to come online and vulnerable to burst/CC while ramping.

hard_cc: Stun (1 turn, Rock, requires Stance)
soft_cc: Blind (1 turn AoE, Paper, requires Stance)

win_conditions: Ramp Jajanken Stance to a few stacks while soaking damage with stacking shields, then unload an empowered Rock (damage + stun) or AoE Paper (piercing + blind) for a tempo swing.
Use Scissors as a low-HP closer: chip a target into 25-HP execute range (or use stacked pre-damage) and instantly remove it.
Grind out a war of attrition where free Stance casts give net-positive shield value each turn and enemies struggle to push through the stacking shield.
internal_synergies: Jajanken Stance is the hub: it shields Gon, boosts Rock/Paper damage, and unlocks the stun/blind/piercing/pre-damage upgrades on the other three skills.
Stance shield (stacking +10) lets Gon survive the ramp turns needed to build offensive payoff.
Paper-with-Stance turning Piercing lets its AoE bypass enemy shields/DR — strong vs shield-heavy comps.
Scissors pre-damage (10/stack) can push a target into its own 25-HP execute window in a single cast at high stacks.
Rock stun buys an extra ramp/setup turn by denying an enemy action.
strengths: Extremely cheap kit (4 total pips across 4 skills; Stance is free).
Free, low-cooldown self-shield that stacks — strong sustain/survivability during ramp.
Flexible payout: single-target burst + stun (Rock), AoE piercing + blind (Paper), or execute (Scissors).
Piercing AoE option counters shield/DR-stacking enemies.
Built-in execute gives reliable finishing pressure on low-HP targets.
Both hard CC (stun) and soft CC (AoE blind) in one kit.
weaknesses: Heavy ramp dependency: every Stance stack is an idle (non-damaging) turn, and all stacks are consumed by a single skill — burst potential is slow to realize.
Fragile while ramping; CC (stun/silence) or burst can interrupt the stance loop before payoff.
All key effects (stun, blind, piercing, big damage) require Stance to be active, so a forced damaging action with no stacks is weak.
Scissors does not benefit from the +5/stack damage mod and only targets enemies already near 25 HP unless stacks carry the pre-damage.
No healing, no cleanse, no energy denial, no real counter/invuln; purely shield-based defense.
Single-target focused; AoE (Paper) is low base damage without stacks.
Predictable telegraph — opponents can see stacks building and play around the spend turn.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, very cheap toolkit with shielding, stun, AoE blind, piercing, and an execute — solid coverage for 4 pips. But the core stance mechanic is a true ramp: stacks cost idle turns and are fully consumed in one attack, so peak damage (~45-55 single-target) is tempo-expensive and burst is slow to come online. Defensively the stacking free shield is good but there is no healing/cleanse/counter, leaving him exploitable by CC and burst during the ramp. Net: a flexible, self-sufficient bruiser that is balanced-to-slightly-below-average in a fast meta, better in grindy attrition matchups. Marked down for ramp fragility, marked up for cost efficiency and effect breadth.
outlier_flags: JSON metadata stale: lists +10 permanent damage and 'free' Paper, but .gd gives +5 per-stack and Blue:1 base cost (Random while Stance active)
Stance damage_mod boosts only Rock/Paper, not Scissors — JSON wording is ambiguous
Scissors base damage_amount is 0; value is entirely execute + per-stack pre-damage

role: Mono-blue piercing-DoT controller with a permanent attrition engine and a desperation-mode suicide lockdown finisher
signature_mechanic: "Ice, Make..." stance: the free slot-1 setup that grants stun-immunity/act-while-stunned, stacks a +10 damage counter for One-Sided Chaotic Dance, and progressively transforms his kit (Ice, Make... -> Ice, Make Unlimited -> One-Sided Chaotic Dance). At HP<=30 the Disciple of Ur passive permanently locks in the stance and swaps Shield for the Iced Shell suicide finisher.

abilities.name: Ice, Make...
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stacks a damage_mod counter (+10 per stack) applied to One-Sided Chaotic Dance; each cast adds a stack -> ramps gray8 indefinitely
abilities.effects_summary: Self stance/setup: grants ignore-STUN + 'can use skills' mark for 1 turn (dur 3 self) enabling all other Ice-Make abilities (they are gated by this mark); applies stacking per-stack +10 damage_mod vs One-Sided Chaotic Dance; swaps slot 1 to Ice, Make Unlimited, or to One-Sided Chaotic Dance if Unlimited already active

abilities.name: Ice, Make Freeze Lancer
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat); requires being marked by Ice, Make...
abilities.effects_summary: 15 piercing immediately to all enemies PLUS a 15 piercing DoT for 2 turns (dur 3) on each enemy = up to ~45 piercing per enemy over 3 turns. Gated behind the Ice, Make... mark.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Hammer
abilities.conditional_scaling: none; requires Ice, Make... mark
abilities.effects_summary: 25 piercing to one enemy + hard stun for 1 turn (dur 2). Gated behind the Ice, Make... mark.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Shield
abilities.conditional_scaling: none; requires Ice, Make... mark
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend / panic button). 4-turn CD. Permanently replaced by Iced Shell once Disciple of Ur triggers.

abilities.name: Disciple of Ur
abilities.conditional_scaling: Triggers once at HP<=30
abilities.effects_summary: Health-change trigger: first time Gray's HP <= 30, permanently grants the Ice, Make... stance (perma ignore-STUN + can-act mark, no longer needs to recast gray1) and permanently swaps Ice, Make Shield (slot 4) for Iced Shell. Defines his low-HP desperation mode.

abilities.name: Ice, Make Unlimited
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent (game-long) recurring effect via ticking triggers; scales with how early it lands
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent battlefield engine: Gray's whole team gains 5 Shield each turn and the entire enemy team takes 5 piercing damage each turn for the REST of the game (control_cancel-protected). Then swaps slot-1 Ice, Make... to One-Sided Chaotic Dance. Unlocked by casting gray1 once.

abilities.name: Iced Shell
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat permanent DoT); AI values it higher the lower Gray's HP
abilities.effects_summary: Suicide lockdown finisher: permanently stuns target enemy AND applies 10 true damage/turn for the rest of the game (bypasses all DR/shields, persists through death via remove_on_death=false). Uncounterable/unreflectable; Gray then instantly dies and this death cannot be prevented. Replaces Shield after Disciple of Ur. Effectively removes one enemy from the game.

abilities.name: One-Sided Chaotic Dance
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 piercing per stack of the Ice, Make... damage_mod counter (i.e. per time gray1 has been cast this battle) -> unbounded ramp
abilities.effects_summary: Single-target nuke that grows: 5 piercing + 10 per Ice, Make... use. Becomes the slot-1 spammable late-game payoff once both Unlimited and the stance are online. No CD, 1 random pip.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: One-Sided Chaotic Dance is unbounded: 5 + 10*(Ice,Make... casts). Realistically 25-45 per cast after a few stance casts, and arbitrarily high in a long game. Plus permanent attrition: Ice, Make Unlimited deals 5 piercing/turn to the WHOLE enemy team forever, and Iced Shell adds a permanent 10 true/turn on one enemy. In a drawn-out game total damage output is effectively limited only by turn count.
damage_profile.notes: Single-target burst is low early (Hammer 25 + stun, or Freeze Lancer 15 on-hit). Peak single-target in one isolated turn ~30 (Hammer 25 + a Freeze Lancer/Unlimited tick, or a ramped Chaotic Dance). Peak fresh AoE one turn is only 15 (Freeze Lancer hit), but Freeze Lancer's 15/turn DoT (2 turns) plus Unlimited's 5/turn team-wide makes sustained AoE pressure ~20/turn per enemy. All his damage except Iced Shell is PIERCING (skips flat+%DR) and Iced Shell is TRUE (skips DR) and bypasses death-prevention - extremely mitigation-resistant.

economy.color_dependency: Mono-Blue. character_colors=[1] (Blue). Two visible damage abilities require a specific Blue pip (Freeze Lancer Blue:1, Hammer Blue:1); Iced Shell needs Blue:2. Random pips are flexible. Low absolute Blue demand but everything routes through Blue.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very low cooldowns: slot-1 stance is CD1 (and free), Freeze Lancer CD1, Hammer CD1; transformed abilities (Unlimited, Iced Shell, Chaotic Dance) are CD0. Only Ice, Make Shield is CD4. He can act nearly every turn; gray1 must be (re)cast each turn pre-passive to keep the gate-mark up for the other Ice-Make abilities.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Real power comes online over time: spend a turn on Ice, Make... to enable gray2-4 (gated by its mark), land Ice, Make Unlimited for the permanent engine, ramp One-Sided Chaotic Dance via repeated stance casts, and ideally reach HP<=30 desperation mode that auto-locks the stance and unlocks Iced Shell. Snowball/attrition payoff, weak turn 1.

hard_cc: Ice, Make Hammer: 1-turn stun (single)
Iced Shell: permanent stun on one enemy (uncounterable, persists through Gray's death)
invuln_or_counter: Ice, Make Shield: 1-turn self invulnerability (CD4 panic button)

internal_synergies: Ice, Make... (gray1) is the linchpin: its mark gates gray2/3/4 (all check user.marked_by('Ice, Make...')), so he must keep the stance up; each cast also stacks the +10 damage_mod that powers One-Sided Chaotic Dance.
Casting Ice, Make Unlimited (gray6) swaps slot 1 to One-Sided Chaotic Dance, converting the now-redundant stance slot into a scaling nuke once the permanent shield/DoT engine is running.

Disciple of Ur (gray5) at HP<=30 permanently grants the stance (so the gate-mark and stun-immunity no longer need re-casting) AND swaps Shield for Iced Shell - turning low HP from a liability into the trigger for his strongest tools.
Iced Shell's permanent stun + true-damage DoT survives Gray's own death (remove_on_death=false), so his self-sacrifice leaves a lasting board-wide advantage.
Ice, Make Unlimited's team-wide 5 Shield/turn stacks with Ice, Make Shield invuln and stun-immunity to make him very durable while his piercing/true attrition grinds the enemy team down.
Almost all damage is Piercing or True, so his shield/DR-bypass offense and his shield-based defense ignore enemy mitigation.
strengths: Permanent, uninteractable attrition engine (Ice, Make Unlimited): 5 piercing/turn to the entire enemy team + 5 Shield/turn to his whole team for the rest of the game - huge value in long matches and vs wide/low-HP comps.
Mitigation-proof damage profile: nearly all piercing (skips flat+%DR), Iced Shell is true (skips DR) and bypasses death-prevention - very hard to tank.
Strong layered self-survivability: stun-immunity/act-while-stunned, 1-turn invuln, team-wide recurring shields, and a passive that rewards being low.
Iced Shell is near-guaranteed removal: uncounterable, unreflectable permanent stun + permanent true DoT on a key enemy that persists after he dies - a decisive finisher / answer to a problem target.
Excellent cooldown tempo and a free slot-1 ability; cheap mono-color kit (total visible cost 4).
Unbounded single-target scaling via One-Sided Chaotic Dance the longer the game runs and the more he uses the stance.
weaknesses: Very slow start: turn 1 he typically just casts the free stance; gray2/3/4 are all gated behind its mark, so he has near-zero immediate pressure or burst.
Low raw burst - peak single-target in a turn is only ~25-30 until Chaotic Dance ramps; he loses straight DPS races to dedicated assassins.
Setup-fragile: the gate-mark only lasts 1 turn pre-passive (dur 3 self), so being denied a turn or forced off the stance can lock him out of Hammer/Freeze Lancer/Shield.
His strongest finisher (Iced Shell) kills him - single-target removal at the cost of his own life; mistimed or on the wrong target it's a net tempo loss.
Reliant on reaching HP<=30 to unlock his best mode; against burst he may die before the passive pays off, and against pillow-fist comps he may never trigger it.
No healing, no cleanse, no energy denial; his whole plan is grind/attrition, so fast lethal comps or anti-shield/anti-DoT tech can outrace him.
win_conditions: Land Ice, Make Unlimited early and win the long game on team-wide shield + recurring piercing attrition while Chaotic Dance ramps.
Use Iced Shell to permanently remove an opposing key threat (permanent stun + true DoT that outlives his sacrifice).
Survive into desperation mode (HP<=30 -> Disciple of Ur), locking in the stance for free and converting Shield into Iced Shell.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed attrition/transformation tank-controller. High ceiling in slower games: a permanent, uninteractable team-wide shield + enemy-team piercing engine, mitigation-proof damage types, layered self-defense, an unbounded single-target scaler, and a decisive uncounterable permanent-stun removal in Iced Shell. But his floor is genuinely weak: near-zero turn-1 pressure, low burst, gate-mark fragility, and his best mode is gated behind both setup and dropping to <=30 HP. The Iced Shell self-kill is powerful but a high-variance, one-shot resource. Overall a solid B-tier value/attrition pick rather than a tempo powerhouse - strong into grindy/wide comps, soft into fast burst.
outlier_flags: Ice, Make Unlimited is a PERMANENT, game-long, uninteractable effect (control_cancel-protected) hitting the whole enemy team and shielding his whole team every turn - unusually open-ended scaling that could be oppressive in long matches.

Iced Shell applies a PERMANENT stun + permanent true DoT that explicitly cannot be countered, reflected, or prevented and persists after Gray's death - hard-removal that bypasses most defensive counterplay.
One-Sided Chaotic Dance has no listed cap on its +10-per-stance-use scaling (unbounded single-target growth).
Multiple permanent, never-expiring (dur -1) effects on both offense and defense; verify intended interaction with cleanse / effect-removal tech.

role: Guts-fueled single-target bruiser with team-wide damage suppression and a self-protect/refuel panic button
signature_mechanic: Guts: a permanent resource mark starting at 4 stacks (passive). Offensive skills consume up to 2 stacks each to unlock bonus damage/CC/debuffs; incoming stuns are auto-negated by spending 1 stack. When empty, the defense skill refuels +3 stacks and heals.

abilities.name: Super Awesome Punch
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 damage if at least 1 Guts stack consumed (->45); applies a 1-turn stun on the target's non-Strategic skills if at least 2 Guts stacks consumed
abilities.effects_summary: Single-target nuke (35, or 45 with >=1 stack). With >=2 stacks consumed also stuns target's non-Strategic (action-bar) skills for 1 turn (stun dur 2). Consumes up to 2 Guts.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Suppression
abilities.conditional_scaling: If >=1 stack consumed, Shatters all affected enemies (def_negate, ignore their DEF for 5 turn-ticks); if >=2 stacks consumed, additionally +5 non-Affliction vulnerability on enemies (5 turn-ticks)
abilities.effects_summary: Team-wide debuff, no direct damage. All enemies deal 5 less non-Affliction damage for 3 turns (damage_mod dur 6). >=1 stack: Shatter (strip barriers/DEF). >=2 stacks: enemies take +5 non-Affliction damage (vulnerability). Consumes up to 2 Guts.

abilities.name: Guts Explosion
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 damage per Guts stack consumed (up to 2 stacks -> +10, max 30)
abilities.effects_summary: Cheap, no-cooldown single-target poke. 20 base, +5 per stack consumed (max 30 with 2 stacks). Spammable Guts dump for steady single-target pressure. Consumes up to 2 Guts.

abilities.name: Gutsy Defense
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mode depends on current Guts: if >=1 stack -> Invulnerable 1 turn; if 0 stacks -> refuel +3 Guts and heal 35 HP
abilities.effects_summary: Dual-mode panic button. With >=1 Guts stack: self full Invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). With 0 Guts: regains +3 stacks and heals 35 HP. Does nothing if Guts mark missing entirely.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.conditional_scaling: Resource generator; combined with on_stun_received hook (requires mag>1 to negate a stun, spending 1 stack)
abilities.effects_summary: Passive: start battle with 4 stacks of permanent Guts mark (displayed). If Gunha would be stunned, the stun is negated and 1 Guts stack is removed (anti-CC, while stacks remain >1 via the engine hook).

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true scaling ceiling — Guts is a fixed pool (4 start, refuelable +3). Per-turn output is hard-capped: best single skill is gunha1 at 45 (35+10 w/ stun rider). gunha3 caps at 30. No multi-skill combos per turn; output is gated entirely by remaining Guts stacks, which deplete 2 per offensive cast. Effective damage is amplified vs barrier comps via gunha2's Shatter + vulnerability.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is NORMAL type (no Affliction/Pierce/True bypass). gunha2 deals zero direct damage — it is pure debuff/anti-barrier. Realistic burst per turn is one offensive skill: 45 (gunha1) or 30 (gunha3). Guts is finite, so without refueling Gunha can only fire ~2 buffed offensive skills before stacks run dry and damage drops to base (35/20).

economy.color_dependency: White/Red dual-color (character_colors [2,3]). gunha1 needs both White+Red; gunha2 needs White; gunha3 needs Red; gunha4 takes any. Moderate dependency — requires reliable White and Red generation but pip counts are tiny (1-2 each).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast. gunha3 has 0 CD (spammable), gunha1 only 1 CD, gunha2 2 CD. Only the defensive gunha4 is slow (4 CD). Very high action frequency.
economy.ramp_dependency: Inverse-ramp: starts strongest (4 Guts) and depletes. Relies on gunha4's refuel-when-empty mode rather than building up. No turn-count ramp.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun of target's non-Strategic (action-bar) skills via gunha1 with >=2 Guts
soft_cc: team-wide -5 non-Affliction damage dealt for 3 turns (gunha2)
invuln_or_counter: self Invulnerability 1 turn (gunha4, requires >=1 Guts)
self stun-immunity by spending Guts stacks (passive)

internal_synergies: Guts is the hub: gunha5 seeds 4 stacks, every offensive skill spends up to 2 to unlock bonuses, gunha4 refuels +3 when empty.
gunha2 Shatter (>=1 stack) + vulnerability (>=2 stacks) softens enemies, then gunha1/gunha3 hit harder into the stripped DEF / +5 vulnerability.
Stun-negation passive and gunha4 invuln both burn or rely on Guts, creating tension between offense (spending stacks for damage) and defense (keeping stacks for stun-immunity).
gunha4 dual mode self-regulates: when you've dumped all Guts on offense, it flips to a heal+refuel, letting the engine loop back to buffed casts.
win_conditions: Open strong while Guts is full: land buffed gunha1 (45 + non-Strategic stun) on a key threat, then chip with 0-CD gunha3.
Use gunha2 to cripple enemy damage output team-wide and strip barriers, swinging a damage race in the team's favor.
Survive enemy CC for free via the stun-negation passive and gunha4 invuln, outlasting then refueling for a second offensive burst.
strengths: Resilient to stuns: passive auto-negates stuns by spending Guts, plus an on-demand 1-turn full Invulnerability — strong vs control comps.
Excellent tempo: a 0-CD single-target poke (gunha3) and a 1-CD nuke (gunha1) mean near-constant pressure for only 1-2 pips each.
Built-in self-sustain: gunha4 heals 35 and refuels Guts when empty, no team support required.
Strong anti-barrier / debuff utility: gunha2 Shatters the whole enemy team, applies team-wide damage reduction, and adds vulnerability — flexible disruptor.
Cheap kit (5 total pips across 4 visible skills) with a flexible Random pip.
weaknesses: Finite, non-renewing scaling: Guts depletes 2 per buffed cast; once empty, damage falls to base (35/20) and the stun rider/Shatter riders stop working until a slow gunha4 refuel.
Low ceiling: peak single-target is only 45 and there is zero direct AoE damage; no DoT, no execute, no multi-skill burst.
All NORMAL damage — fully stopped by barriers, flat DR, and %DR; no Affliction/Pierce/True to punch through tanks.
Tension on Guts: spending stacks on offense weakens the stun-immunity safety net, and vice versa — can't fully optimize both.
Dual-color White+Red requirement on the best skill (gunha1) plus the stun rider needing 2 stacks make peak output situational.
gunha4's invuln mode requires >=1 Guts; if drained, the defensive option becomes a refuel/heal that turn instead of protection.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, self-sufficient single-target bruiser with above-average survivability (stun negation + invuln + self-heal) and genuinely useful team utility (Shatter, team-wide damage cut, vulnerability). Tempo is excellent thanks to a 0-CD poke and 1-CD nuke for trivial cost. However, raw output is modest and hard-capped: 45 peak single-target, no direct AoE damage, no DoT, and all-NORMAL damage that barriers/DR fully mitigate. The Guts resource is finite and depletes quickly, so sustained damage sags without the slow gunha4 refuel. Solid, flexible mid-tier — rewards smart resource management but lacks a high damage ceiling or a standout win-now mechanic.
outlier_flags: gunha2 deals zero direct damage despite being the AoE skill — value is entirely in debuff/Shatter riders
on_stun_received hook requires Guts mag>1 to negate, so the final stack does not grant immunity (subtle edge case)
gunha3 0-cooldown 1-pip spammable poke is unusually cheap tempo

role: Self-sacrificing redirect-tank / scaling Piercing-Energy bruiser who ramps via Aspect of Sacrifice stacks and powers up on Resurrección
signature_mechanic: Aspect of Sacrifice: redirects 50% of a protected ally's incoming damage onto Halibel; the first hit the ally takes grants Halibel a PERMANENT stackable +5 damage buff on her offensive skills. Taking that self-inflicted damage drives her below 60 HP, triggering Resurrección, which upgrades two skills (AoE Cascada + Piercing/Affliction DoT Hirviendo), grants +10 permanent DR, and auto-grants another Aspect stack — turning a tank loop into a self-fueling damage ramp.

abilities.name: Ola Blast
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 flat if ANY ally currently protected by Aspect of Sacrifice; +5 per permanent Aspect stack on Halibel
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable 0-CD 1-Blue nuke. Base 25 Energy, 30 while an ally is shielded, plus 5 per accumulated Aspect stack. Pure damage filler that benefits from the ramp.

abilities.name: Ola Azul
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per permanent Aspect stack; Shatter rider gated on Halibel being below max HP
abilities.effects_summary: 30 Piercing (skips flat+%DR). If Halibel is below max HP, also applies Shatter/def_negate(2) = negate enemy ability for 1 turn (soft-cc). Replaced by Cascada/Hirviendo on Resurreccion.

abilities.name: Aspect of Sacrifice
abilities.conditional_scaling: Generates the permanent +5 stack engine (first hit on protected ally = +1 stack, unbounded)
abilities.effects_summary: Core piece. For dur 6 (3 turns) target ally has 50% of incoming damage redirected to Halibel plus a watcher; first time that ally is attacked Halibel gains a PERMANENT stackable +5 damage mod on Ola Azul/Cascada/Ola Blast/Hirviendo, then watcher consumed. Protection + ramp engine + self-damage to fuel Resurreccion.

abilities.name: Tiburon Block
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Halibel becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Cheap (1 random) panic button / mitigation; lets her survive redirect tanking and time Resurreccion.

abilities.name: Resurreccion: Tiburon
abilities.conditional_scaling: One-time trigger when HP first falls below 60 (threshold 59); auto-grants +1 Aspect stack
abilities.effects_summary: Passive transformation. First time HP<60: swaps two visible skills into Cascada (AoE) + Hirviendo (Piercing/Affliction DoT), grants +10 PERMANENT damage reduction, +1 permanent Aspect stack, and portrait change. Self-redirect damage naturally triggers it.

abilities.name: Cascada
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 flat if any ally protected by Aspect; +5 per permanent Aspect stack (applies per enemy)
abilities.effects_summary: Post-Resurreccion AoE replacement. 20 Energy to ALL enemies, 25 if an ally is shielded, +5 per Aspect stack to each target. Primary scaling AoE win-con after release.

abilities.name: Hirviendo
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Aspect stack on direct hit; DoT duration 2->3 turns while Halibel below max HP (almost always post-Resurreccion)
abilities.effects_summary: Post-Resurreccion replacement. 25 Piercing direct (skips flat+%DR) + Affliction DoT 5/turn for dur 4 (2 turns), or dur 6 (3 turns) while wounded. Affliction bypasses barriers/shields/DR. Single-target burst+DoT scaling with stacks.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded via Aspect of Sacrifice stacks (+5 per stack on all offensive skills, applied per-target on AoE). Pre-ramp single-target peak ~35 (Ola Azul 30 +5 from one Resurreccion stack). With 3-4 stacks Cascada hits ~35-40 to each of 3 enemies (~105-120 board-wide/turn). Realistic ramp ceiling 3-6 stacks per match; theoretically unlimited since stacks are permanent and each ally protect-hit grants one.
damage_profile.notes: Piercing (Ola Azul/Hirviendo) skips flat+%DR; Affliction DoT (Hirviendo) bypasses barriers/shields/DR entirely, making effective damage higher than raw numbers vs defensive comps. Output is modest in isolation but compounds with permanent stacks; damage is back-loaded behind the tank/ramp loop and Resurreccion. AoE (Cascada) and DoT (Hirviendo) only unlock after the one-time HP<60 transformation.

economy.color_dependency: Heavily mono-Blue. 3 of 5 visible pips are specifically Blue (Ola Blast, Ola Azul, Aspect); Tiburon Block and one Ola Azul pip are Random. Post-Resurreccion Cascada/Hirviendo are also Blue-anchored. Strong Blue dependency, no off-color requirement.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast/low. Ola Blast 0 CD (spammable filler), Ola Azul 1 CD, Tiburon Block 1 CD, Aspect of Sacrifice 3 CD (the only real gate / ramp pacer). Acts meaningfully every turn. Post-res Cascada 1 CD, Hirviendo 2 CD.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Baseline damage is mediocre; full power requires repeatedly protecting allies who then get hit to bank permanent +5 stacks, plus reaching Resurreccion (<60 HP) to unlock AoE/DoT, +10 DR, and a free stack. Slow-burn payoff curve.

soft_cc: Shatter / def_negate on Ola Azul (conditional on Halibel being wounded) — negates enemy ability for 1 turn
invuln_or_counter: Tiburon Block: 1-turn self Invulnerability
Aspect of Sacrifice: 50% damage redirect from protected ally to self (mitigation, not a shield)
Resurreccion: +10 permanent flat damage reduction (self)

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, mechanically coherent protect-tank/ramp hybrid. Strengths: extremely cheap mono-Blue kit with fast cooldowns, a 0-CD spammable nuke, a self-Invuln panic button, Piercing + Affliction damage that bypasses defensive layers, and a clever closed-loop ramp — protecting allies banks permanent +5 stacks AND drives her toward Resurreccion, which upgrades her into a stacking AoE + DoT threat with +10 DR. Unbounded permanent scaling on all offensive skills (multiplied across Cascada's AoE) gives a high late-game ceiling. Weaknesses keep her from top tier: damage is low and back-loaded early, the ramp is slow and contingent on the team taking redirected damage (and an ally actually being attacked to bank stacks), she has zero healing/cleanse/hard-CC/energy-denial, and redirect tanking endangers her own HP with no self-sustain — she can be focused down before Resurreccion pays off, or have her transformation rushed before she can capitalize. Solidly above-average and value-positive in protect comps, but reliant on setup and team context rather than independently dominant.
outlier_flags: Unbounded permanent +5/stack scaling applied to an AoE (Cascada) — multiplies per enemy, a possible balance outlier if matches run long
Self-damaging tank with NO self-heal/sustain — survivability outlier on the fragile side pre-Resurreccion
Resurreccion is HP-gated and one-time; pairing self-redirect with the <60 HP threshold makes the transformation reliable but potentially player-rushable

Self-Invulnerability panic button (Tiburon Block) for 1 random pip
Ally protection via 50% damage redirect that doubles as a ramp engine

Self-redirect damage naturally drives her toward her own transformation

No healing, no cleanse, no self-sustain — actively endangers her own HP while tanking
Ramp is slow and contingent: needs allies protected AND actually attacked to bank stacks
No hard CC and no energy denial; only conditional soft Shatter and self-Invuln

Shatter rider and Hirviendo's extended DoT both require being wounded, coupling offense to taking damage

Trigger Resurreccion for +10 DR, AoE Cascada, and Hirviendo DoT, then snowball stacked AoE across the enemy team
Act as a protect-tank that converts redirected ally damage into permanent personal power while keeping carries alive

Aspect of Sacrifice <-> Resurreccion: redirected self-damage pushes HP below 60 to trigger transformation, which itself grants another stack
Resurreccion <-> all offensive skills: +5/stack mod array covers Ola Azul/Cascada/Ola Blast/Hirviendo, so stacks amplify every form
Being wounded (from redirect tanking) enables Ola Azul's Shatter and extends Hirviendo's DoT to 3 turns — tanking fuels offense
+10 DR from Resurreccion stacks with Tiburon Block Invuln and the redirect to keep her alive while stacks compound

role: Delay-stacking AoE controller / team-support bruiser who converts pending skills into sustained piercing damage + shields
signature_mechanic: Self-delaying his own offensive skills, then the Great Thriving Forest passive pays out 5 team Shield + 5 Piercing AoE per currently-delayed skill at the end of every turn; Deep Forest Creation enhances + further delays Pollen/Strangle so they keep ticking each turn they remain delayed, and can be reactivated to extend all delays for a snowballing engine.

abilities.name: Deep Forest Bloom: Pollen
abilities.conditional_scaling: While enhanced (Deep Forest Creation active) and held in delay, the passive ticks an extra 5 team-heal + 5 Affliction AoE each turn it remains delayed; stacks with the +1 delay from Creation to keep ticking 2-4+ turns
abilities.effects_summary: Heals Hashirama's whole team for 20 HP and deals 20 Affliction (barrier/shield-bypassing) AoE to all enemies. Always self-delayed 1 turn before it resolves; while enhanced, applies a recurring 5-heal/5-Affliction-AoE tick each delayed turn.

abilities.name: Deep Forest Bloom: Strangle
abilities.conditional_scaling: While enhanced and held in delay, the passive additionally stuns a random enemy's Physical AND Energy skills (energy/action denial) each turn it remains delayed
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal damage to one enemy and stuns them for 1 turn (full stun). Always delayed 1 turn before resolving; while enhanced, each delayed turn also locks a random enemy's Physical+Energy skills for 1 turn (recurring soft energy-denial/CC).

abilities.name: Deep Forest Creation
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enables the enhanced ticking on Pollen/Strangle; reactivation extends EVERY active delay effect (his and others') by +1 turn, multiplying passive payout duration
abilities.effects_summary: Self-mark for 3 self-turns that enhances Pollen and Strangle and adds +1 turn to their delay (so they sit delayed longer and feed the passive). While active, reactivating extends all active delayed-skill and delay-marker durations by +1 turn. No cooldown, so it can be spammed energy-permitting to keep the delay engine running.

abilities.name: Wood Clone
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible 1-turn counter on Hashirama or one ally: the first Harmful skill that targets them is delayed by 2 turns (negating it for that window / pushing it back). Defensive disruption / soft protect on a 4-turn cooldown; also adds a delayed skill the passive can count.

abilities.name: Great Thriving Forest
abilities.conditional_scaling: Scales linearly with the number of skills Hashirama currently has delayed (Pollen, Strangle, Wood Clone, plus any held longer via Creation). 1 delay = 5 shield/5 pierce; realistically 2-3 delays = 10-15 shield + 10-15 Piercing AoE per turn; also drives the enhanced Pollen heal/AoE and Strangle Physical+Energy stun ticks.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive: at the end of each of Hashirama's turns, his whole team gains 5 Shield AND all enemies take 5 Piercing (flat/%DR-bypassing) AoE, PER skill he currently has delayed. While Creation is up, also resolves the per-delay Pollen heal/Affliction ticks and Strangle Physical+Energy stun ticks. Self-applies a baseline delay marker.

damage_profile.notes: Numbers are low per instance but recurring. A 'resolve turn' with Strangle (20 Normal single) landing plus passive ticks is the single-target window; ~35 = Strangle 20 + ~15 Piercing from ~3 delayed skills. AoE peak ~35 = Pollen 20 Affliction AoE + ~15 Piercing AoE. Skills are delayed so they don't land the turn cast. Affliction bypasses shields/barriers; Piercing skips flat and %DR, so effective damage punches above the raw numbers. He is a slow attrition/sustain engine, not a burst threat.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Passive payout scales with delayed-skill count; with Pollen, Strangle, Wood Clone and Creation extensions stacking, 3-4 delays = ~15-20 Piercing AoE + ~15-20 team Shield every turn, plus recurring 5 Affliction AoE / 5 team-heal (enhanced Pollen) and a recurring random Physical+Energy stun (enhanced Strangle). Effectively unbounded ramp since Creation has no cooldown and can re-extend delays.

economy.color_dependency: Mono-Red. 3 of 5 visible kit pips are specifically Red (Pollen, Strangle, Creation each need Red:1); Pollen and Wood Clone each add one Random. Heavy single-color dependency means he wants a Red-leaning team and stalls if Red is scarce.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Extremely low/no cooldowns on the core loop — Pollen, Strangle and Creation are all CD 0, so the only gate is Red energy. Only Wood Clone (defensive counter) is gated at CD 4. Tempo is energy-limited, not cooldown-limited.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Power is back-loaded: skills are delayed before they resolve and the passive only pays meaningfully once 2-3 skills are simultaneously delayed and Creation is active. Weak turn 1-2, strong from turn 3+ once the delay engine is primed.

hard_cc: 1-turn full stun on Strangle target
soft_cc: recurring random-enemy Physical+Energy skill stun while enhanced Strangle is delayed
invuln_or_counter: Wood Clone: invisible counter that delays the first Harmful skill targeting an ally/self by 2 turns (soft protect, not true invuln)

win_conditions: Prime the delay engine (Creation up + Pollen/Strangle held delayed) so the passive grinds out per-turn Piercing AoE chip + team Shield, winning slow attrition / outlasting fights
Stack team-wide sustain (Pollen heals + passive shields) to make his team unkillable while enemies are slowly bled by Affliction + Piercing that bypass mitigation
Lock down enemy offense with the enhanced Strangle recurring Physical+Energy stun while the team outvalues
Use no-cooldown Creation re-extensions to keep delays alive indefinitely, snowballing passive payout
internal_synergies: Deep Forest Creation is the linchpin: it enhances Pollen/Strangle AND extends their delay, which directly multiplies how many turns the passive sees them as 'delayed' (more passive Piercing+Shield ticks)
Great Thriving Forest passive turns the self-delay drawback into the win condition — every delayed skill is +5 Shield/+5 Piercing AoE per turn

Enhanced Pollen's per-turn 5 heal/5 Affliction AoE and enhanced Strangle's per-turn Physical+Energy stun are both routed through the passive, so Creation effectively powers three recurring effects at once
Wood Clone adds another delayed skill into the count, marginally feeding the passive while defending an ally
Creation's no-cooldown reactivation extends all delays (+1 turn), keeping the whole engine and its passive payout alive
strengths: Strong, repeatable mitigation-bypassing output: Affliction (Pollen) ignores shields/barriers and Piercing (passive) skips flat/%DR — low raw numbers translate to high effective damage
Whole-team sustain stack: team heals (Pollen) + team shields (passive) every turn make his side extremely durable in long fights
AoE pressure plus team-wide shielding makes him a strong support in multi-enemy / attrition formats
Energy-efficient loop with no cooldowns on the core trio — only gated by Red energy
Layered control: a guaranteed 1-turn stun (Strangle) plus recurring random Physical+Energy denial, plus Wood Clone delaying enemy burst
Indefinite ramp via no-cooldown Creation re-extensions
weaknesses: Everything is delayed — near-zero immediate impact; very weak in the first 1-2 turns and loses to fast burst before the engine spins up
Heavy mono-Red color dependency (3 specific Red pips) constrains team-building and stalls if Red is scarce
Low per-hit numbers; against a single tanky target the 5-per-delay Piercing is slow and Pollen AoE is unimpressive without sustained setup
Passive payout collapses if his delayed skills are forced to resolve early, cleansed, or if he's stunned/isolated (passive checks not-isolated/not-banished)
No cleanse, no hard escape, no true invuln — Wood Clone only postpones one harmful skill and is on a 4-turn cooldown
Reliant on staying alive long enough to ramp; bursty assassins (especially with their own Affliction/Piercing) undercut his whole plan

power_assessment.reasoning: Hashirama is a well-designed engine character whose strength is multiplicative rather than raw. Once primed (Creation + 2-3 delayed skills) the passive alone delivers ~15-20 team Shield AND ~15-20 mitigation-bypassing Piercing AoE every turn, on top of recurring team heals, Affliction AoE, and recurring Physical+Energy stun lockdown — all on a near-cooldown-free, energy-only loop. That is a very high sustained value floor for an attrition/support archetype, and the mix of shield-bypassing Affliction + DR-bypassing Piercing makes effective damage punch above the small printed numbers. He is held back from top tier by a genuinely weak early game (everything delayed, near-zero turn-1 impact), heavy mono-Red dependency, and fragility to burst/cleanse/stun that can dismantle the engine before it pays off. Rated in isolation as a strong but ramp-gated controller/support.
outlier_flags: JSON metadata damage/heal numbers (10) are STALE — .gd ground truth is 20 for Pollen heal/damage and Strangle damage
No-cooldown Creation with unlimited delay re-extension could enable an unbounded ramp loop — potential balance outlier if Red energy is plentiful
Passive scales with delayed-skill count with no stated cap — payout could spike high in long games

abilities.name: Feather Strike
abilities.effects_summary: 15 dmg + increases target cooldowns by 1 for 1 turn; Hawkmon gains 1 Digivolve stack; if target is Silenced, applies a 15-dmg DoT (1 turn) and a ticking trigger that grants another Digivolve stack next turn (ramp accelerator vs silenced targets)
