abilities.name: Pecking Beak
abilities.effects_summary: 10 dmg; Hawkmon gains 1 Digivolve stack; if target is Stunned, fires twice (20 total dmg + 2 Digivolve stacks) — fast ramp vs stunned targets
abilities.conditional_scaling: on-stunned: doubles to 20 dmg + 2 stacks

abilities.name: Hawkmon Digivolve
abilities.effects_summary: Transformation. Permanent form change based on Digivolve stacks: 1 stack -> Aquilamon (swaps slots to hawkmon5-8), 2 stacks -> Silphymon (swaps to hawkmon9-12 + portrait change + sets a permanent mark enabling Silphymon's allied-effect tracking). Requires >=1 stack to use. Consumes the Digivolve mark.
abilities.conditional_scaling: branches at 1 vs 2 stacks (Aquilamon vs stronger Silphymon)

abilities.name: Wind Guard
abilities.effects_summary: Self invuln for 1 turn (panic button); shares cooldown with Wind Breath (hawkmon8) and Air Field (hawkmon12) so the defensive cooldown carries across forms
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Blast Wings
abilities.effects_summary: Aquilamon AoE: 5 Piercing to all enemies now + 5 Piercing DoT for 3 more turns (4 turns total, ~20 over time per enemy). Sets up triggers: next Grand Horn OR next Blast Wings use makes Aquilamon invuln 1 turn (once each per trigger). Piercing bypasses flat+%DR.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat DoT)

abilities.name: Grand Horn
abilities.effects_summary: Aquilamon single-target nuke: 30 dmg; also hits ALL Blinded/Stunned/Taunted enemies for 30 (conditional cleave). Can consume the Blast Wings trigger to grant self invuln.
abilities.conditional_scaling: becomes multi-target vs CC'd enemies (30 each)

abilities.name: Storm Bomber
abilities.effects_summary: Aquilamon AoE nuke: 30 dmg to all enemies. Action class (channel). Long 6-turn cooldown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Wind Breath
abilities.effects_summary: Aquilamon self invuln 1 turn (panic button), part of the cross-form shared defensive cooldown with Wind Guard and Air Field.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Top Gun
abilities.effects_summary: Silphymon single-target: 25 dmg; applies Stun + Silence + Taunt for 1 turn each — but ONLY the types an ally has NOT applied in the last 3 turns (Silphymon avoids redundant CC, fills gaps). Strong team-coordinated lockdown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: effect set shrinks if allies already applied that CC type recently

abilities.name: Static Force
abilities.effects_summary: Silphymon AoE: 10 Piercing now + 10 Piercing DoT 1 more turn (2 turns, ~20 per enemy). Applies Shatter(def-negate) + Isolate + Blind for ~2 turns to all enemies, again only the debuff types allies haven't applied recently. Piercing bypasses DR.
abilities.conditional_scaling: debuff set shrinks based on allied-applied effects

abilities.name: Dual Sonic
abilities.effects_summary: Silphymon single-target: 30 dmg; for EACH CC/debuff type an ally applied in last 3 turns (stun/silence/shatter/isolate/taunt/blind) re-applies that effect for 2 turns. Massive payoff lockdown if the team has been CC-stacking — can chain many 2-turn debuffs at once.
abilities.conditional_scaling: per allied-applied effect type witnessed (up to 6 simultaneous 2-turn CC/debuffs)

abilities.name: Air Field
abilities.effects_summary: Silphymon self invuln 1 turn; also resets Silphymon's tracking of allied-applied effects (clears the EMPTY witness marks). Panic button + bookkeeping reset.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: As Silphymon, Dual Sonic (30 dmg) re-applies up to 6 different 2-turn CC/debuffs at once if the team CC-stacked beforehand — the kit's ceiling is lockdown breadth, not raw damage. Aquilamon Grand Horn can cleave 30 to every CC'd enemy. Base Pecking Beak ramps to 20 dmg + 2 stacks vs a stunned target.
damage_profile.notes: Single-target peak ~60 in one turn would require Aquilamon Grand Horn (30) catching a CC'd target plus stacked Blast Wings DoT priming; realistic per-turn nuke is ~30-40. AoE peak is Storm Bomber 30 to all (6cd). Piercing DoTs (Blast Wings 5/turn x4, Static Force 10/turn x2) bypass barriers/shields/%DR, raising effective value. Sustained DoT is modest (5-10/turn/enemy). Overall a low-to-moderate damage, control/utility-leaning kit.

economy.color_dependency: Base form is cheap and flexible (Feather Strike Red:1, three Random:1 skills) — only 1 hard color pip (Red). Evolved forms lean Blue+Red: Aquilamon (Blast Wings Blue, Grand Horn Red, Storm Bomber Blue+Red) and Silphymon (Top Gun Red, Static Force Blue, Dual Sonic Blue+Red). character_colors = [Blue, Red].
economy.cooldown_tempo: Base form is near-zero-cooldown (slots 1-3 all cd 0) enabling fast Digivolve ramp; defensive skill cd 4 shared across forms. Aquilamon/Silphymon offensive skills sit at cd 1-2 (good tempo) except Storm Bomber cd 6. Generally high uptime.
economy.ramp_dependency: HIGH — the whole payoff is gated behind accumulating Digivolve stacks (1 for Aquilamon, 2 for Silphymon) via Feather Strike/Pecking Beak. Silphymon's best abilities (Dual Sonic / Top Gun gap-filling) further depend on ALLIES applying CC in the prior 3 turns, so it ramps on team coordination too.

internal_synergies: Feather Strike + enemy Silence -> bonus DoT and an extra Digivolve stack next turn (accelerates evolution)
Pecking Beak + enemy Stun -> double-cast for 20 dmg and 2 stacks, can reach Silphymon in a single turn against a stunned target
Hawkmon Digivolve consumes stacks: 1 stack -> Aquilamon, 2 stacks -> Silphymon (rewards patient ramp)
Aquilamon Blast Wings primes a trigger so the next Grand Horn or Blast Wings grants self-invuln (offense buys defense)
Aquilamon Grand Horn cleaves all Blinded/Stunned/Taunted enemies for 30 — synergizes with team CC and Silphymon-style debuffs
Silphymon Top Gun/Static Force apply only the CC/debuff types allies HAVEN'T used recently (non-redundant gap-filling control)
Silphymon Dual Sonic re-applies every CC/debuff type allies applied in the last 3 turns — payoff for a CC-heavy team comp
Air Field resets Silphymon's allied-effect tracking, letting the gap-filling logic re-trigger cleanly

power_assessment.reasoning: A team-dependent transformation/control character with deliberately modest standalone numbers. In a vacuum it's middling: base form does only 10-15 dmg while ramping, and the strongest payoff (Silphymon Dual Sonic / Top Gun / Static Force) is entirely conditional on ALLIES having applied CC/debuffs in the prior 3 turns — solo, much of that text does nothing. Strengths: very cheap and flexible base economy, fast cooldowns for ramp, three layers of self-invuln (Wind Guard/Wind Breath/Air Field) for survivability, Piercing DoT that bypasses DR, and a high control ceiling when coordinated (up to 6 simultaneous 2-turn debuffs, conditional 30-cleave). Weaknesses: heavy double-ramp (stacks + team setup), low raw damage, payoff abilities are dead weight on an uncoordinated team, and it must spend turns transforming before it's online. Rated 5.5 as a coordination-reliant control/support enabler — likely a strong B-tier piece in a CC comp and a weak pick in solo/aggro contexts.
outlier_flags: Dual Sonic can stack up to 6 distinct 2-turn CC/debuffs in one cast given prior team CC — potential lockdown outlier in coordinated play
Grand Horn conditionally hits every Blinded/Stunned/Taunted enemy for 30 (uncapped multi-target nuke vs CC'd boards)
Triple cross-form self-invuln gives strong, repeatable defensive uptime
Most evolved-form value is conditional on allies — power swings hard between solo and team contexts

role: Ramping transformation control/support enabler — evolves Hawkmon -> Aquilamon -> Silphymon to deliver team-coordinated CC, debuff gap-filling, and Piercing AoE/DoT
signature_mechanic: Digivolve stacking: landing Feather Strike/Pecking Beak builds Digivolve stacks (accelerated when the target is Silenced/Stunned); spending 1 stack evolves to Aquilamon, 2 stacks to Silphymon. Silphymon then tracks which CC/debuff types allies have applied and either fills the gaps (Top Gun/Static Force apply only the missing types) or amplifies them (Dual Sonic re-applies every type the team used).
strengths: Cheap, color-flexible base economy (mostly Random:1) and near-zero cooldowns enable quick ramp
Three layers of self-invuln across forms (Wind Guard / Wind Breath / Air Field) for high defensive uptime
High control ceiling: Silphymon can apply or re-apply up to 6 distinct CC/debuff types in coordinated play
Piercing AoE DoTs (Blast Wings, Static Force) bypass barriers/shields/%DR for reliable chip
Conditional cleave (Grand Horn) and gap-filling CC reward synergy with a CC-heavy team
Built-in survivability lets it stall while ramping

hard_cc: Stun (Top Gun, Dual Sonic, Grand Horn cleave trigger)
Silence (Top Gun, Dual Sonic)
Taunt (Top Gun, Dual Sonic)
Isolate (Static Force, Dual Sonic)
invuln_or_counter: Self invuln 1 turn (Wind Guard / Wind Breath / Air Field)
Trigger-granted self invuln after Blast Wings -> Grand Horn/Blast Wings (Aquilamon)
soft_cc: Cooldown increase +1 (Feather Strike)
Blind (Static Force, Dual Sonic)
Shatter / DEF_NEGATE (Static Force, Dual Sonic)

weaknesses: Heavy double-ramp: must spend turns building stacks and transforming before reaching peak; weak and low-damage in the opening
Best abilities (Silphymon Top Gun/Static Force/Dual Sonic) are conditional on allies applying CC — large chunks of the kit are dead weight on an uncoordinated team
Low raw single-target/AoE damage compared to dedicated nukers (mostly 25-30 per hit)
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no energy denial — purely offense/control/self-defense
Evolved forms demand consistent Blue+Red energy, raising color dependency post-transform
Permanent form changes are one-way commitments; misjudging the stack count (1 vs 2) locks in the weaker Aquilamon
win_conditions: Reach Silphymon on a CC-stacking team and use Dual Sonic / Top Gun to lock down key enemies with stacked 2-turn debuffs
Use Aquilamon Grand Horn to cleave a CC'd enemy board for 30 each while Blast Wings DoT chips through DR
Stall with layered self-invuln while allies set up, then convert their CC into Silphymon's amplified lockdown
Grind enemies down with Piercing AoE DoT (Static Force / Blast Wings) that ignores shields and DR

abilities.name: Cloud Tonfa
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat 20). Becomes free / no-cooldown spam while Porcospino Nuvola (hibari3) is active, raising effective throughput
abilities.effects_summary: Pure single-target nuke, 20 Normal damage. No riders. Cheap 1-pip filler that turns into a free repeatable hit under hibari3.

abilities.name: Alaudi's Handcuffs
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal damage plus Stun (dur 2 = 1 turn) and Isolate (dur 2 = 1 turn) on one target. Hard lockdown: target cannot act and cannot give/receive allied help for the turn.

abilities.name: Porcospino Nuvola
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reactive punish: any enemy that uses a Harmful skill during the 3 turns takes +10 Piercing (HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER, dur 6). Scales with enemy team size and how often enemies attack.
abilities.effects_summary: Applies a 3-turn 5 Piercing/turn AoE DoT to all enemies (with an immediate 5-Piercing tick on cast), plus a HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER that deals 10 Piercing to any enemy who uses a Harmful skill, and grants Hibari a Cloud Tonfa cooldown-removal buff (cooldown_mod -1) so Cloud Tonfa can be spammed. Piercing bypasses flat/% DR.

abilities.name: Hibari Block
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerability for 1 turn (invuln dur 2). Panic-button / damage-dodge on a long 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Cloud Flames
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent, stacking: each enemy Invisible-skill use adds a fresh 5 Affliction permanent stack (per_stack, dur -1). Unbounded ramp vs stealth-heavy enemies.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive counter to stealth: whenever an enemy uses an Invisible skill, that enemy takes a permanent, stacking 5 Affliction damage tick. Affliction bypasses barriers/shields. Pure anti-stealth tech, does nothing vs non-Invisible kits.

role: Single-target lockdown bruiser with reactive AoE Piercing punish/control
signature_mechanic: Porcospino Nuvola: a 3-turn field that DoTs the whole enemy team for Piercing, punishes any enemy who uses a Harmful skill for +10 Piercing, AND removes Cloud Tonfa's cooldown so Hibari can spam a free 20-damage nuke for the duration. Pairs a "tax on aggression" zone with personal damage acceleration.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Porcospino is the engine: across its 3 turns vs a 3-enemy team it deals 3 ticks x5 x3 enemies = 45 base DoT, plus up to 10 per Harmful use per enemy (potentially +90 if all 3 enemies attack each of 3 turns), while Hibari free-spams Cloud Tonfa for 20/turn. Cloud Flames passive can ramp unboundedly (5 Affliction/stack) but only vs Invisible-using enemies. No internal stat scaling otherwise.
damage_profile.notes: All listed damage is base from the .gd. Single-target peak ~45 assumes hibari2 (25) plus a free Cloud Tonfa (20) enabled by an active Porcospino. AoE peak ~45 in one turn = immediate 5 Piercing on 3 enemies (15) + 10 punish on each of 3 enemies who attack (30). Piercing skips flat+%DR; Cloud Flames Affliction skips barriers/shields. Raw numbers are modest; value is in control + tax pressure, not nuke ceiling.

economy.color_dependency: Light Red dependency: only 2 specific Red pips total (1 on hibari2, 1 on hibari3); the rest are Random. Mono-Red identity (character_colors=[3]) but very flexible to splash.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mixed: Cloud Tonfa cd1 (spammable, near-free under hibari3), Handcuffs cd2, Porcospino cd3, Block cd4. Wants to land Porcospino on cd to keep the punish field and free-Tonfa loop up; tempo dips when Porcospino is down.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. No stack-based self-buffs except the anti-stealth passive. Power spikes are windowed around Porcospino uptime rather than a continuous ramp; Cloud Flames provides slow unbounded ramp only vs stealth comps.

hard_cc: Stun (hibari2, 1 turn)
Isolate (hibari2, 1 turn)
soft_cc: Aggression tax / Harmful-use punish (hibari3) acts as a soft deterrent on enemy attacks
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerability (hibari4, self, 1 turn)
Reactive punish counter on Harmful use (hibari3)

win_conditions: Lock down a key threat each cycle with Handcuffs (stun+isolate) to deny their turn and break enemy combos
Keep Porcospino Nuvola active to tax every enemy attack for Piercing while free-spamming Cloud Tonfa, grinding the whole team down
Use Hibari Block to survive predictable burst turns and stretch the game into his DoT/tax attrition plan
Hard-counter stealth/Invisible-reliant comps via Cloud Flames stacking Affliction
internal_synergies: Porcospino Nuvola removes Cloud Tonfa's cooldown, turning the 1-pip nuke into a repeatable free 20 damage while the field is up
Porcospino's Harmful-use punish + Handcuffs' isolate/stun discourage and deny enemy aggression simultaneously, layering passive tax with hard lockdown
Piercing (Porcospino) and Affliction (Cloud Flames) both bypass mitigation, so Hibari's chip damage stays effective vs tanks/shields
Hibari Block protects Hibari during the window he's committed to keeping Porcospino up
strengths: Strong single-target lockdown: Handcuffs stun+isolate fully neutralizes a target for a turn at only 2 pips
Excellent mitigation-bypass profile: Piercing AoE + Affliction passive ignore DR/shields/barriers
Reactive punish field taxes enemy aggression team-wide and rewards good prediction
Built-in survivability (1-turn invuln) plus a self-enabling combo (free Cloud Tonfa under Porcospino)
Very low color commitment (only 2 Red pips, rest Random) — easy to slot into many energy banks
Hard answer to stealth comps via permanent stacking Affliction
weaknesses: Low raw numbers: peak single-target ~45 and base AoE DoT only 5/turn — relies on opponents cooperating (attacking into the punish) to ramp damage
No healing, shields, cleanse, or energy denial — purely offensive/control with thin defensive depth (one 4-cd invuln)
Porcospino's punish does nothing against passive/defensive enemy turns; damage output craters vs patient opponents
Cloud Flames is a dead passive against any comp without Invisible skills
Hibari Block's long 4-turn cooldown leaves big windows where he is fragile
Single-target focused control — can only hard-lock one enemy per Handcuffs cycle (cd2), limited team-fight CC throughput

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded control bruiser whose value is in lockdown and mitigation-bypassing tax rather than burst. Handcuffs is an efficient 2-pip stun+isolate, Porcospino is a genuinely good team-wide aggression tax that also accelerates his own damage, and he has self-invuln plus an anti-stealth tool. But raw damage is low and much of his output is conditional on enemies attacking into the punish field, so he underperforms against passive or defensively-stacked teams and brings no healing/shields/cleanse/energy-denial. Solid, flexible, low-color-cost mid-tier pick; strong in attrition/control comps, mediocre as a standalone carry. Rated in isolation.
outlier_flags: Cloud Flames (hibari5) is a fully conditional dead passive vs non-Invisible comps — high variance / matchup-dependent value
Porcospino's effective damage is highly dependent on enemy behavior (Harmful-use punish), making his power swingy across matchups
Cloud Tonfa cooldown removal under Porcospino creates a free-action loop whose real value depends on action-economy rules (potential under-the-radar power spike)

abilities.name: Gentle Fist Taijutsu
abilities.conditional_scaling: Re-use mode deals fixed 5 Piercing; DoT is fixed 10/turn — no scaling, just a stance toggle.
abilities.effects_summary: First use: 10 Normal on-hit + applies a 10 Normal damage-over-time effect (dur 7 = ~3 turns of 10/turn) to the target. Sets a self-stance mark that makes this skill free to re-use and grants -1 Random cost to Eight Trigrams: Air Palm. While the stance mark is active, re-use deals 5 Piercing to the original target (advances a mission if target is the My-Turn-To-Protect taunt target).

abilities.name: Protective Eight Trigrams: 64 Palms
abilities.conditional_scaling: Thorns are fixed 5 Piercing per enemy Harmful action — scales with how many times enemies attack the team (reactive, multi-target potential). Shield stacks indefinitely across re-uses.
abilities.effects_summary: First use: whole team gains 5 Damage Reduction (dur 8 = 4 turns) and a counter-trigger that deals 5 Piercing to any enemy who uses a NEW Harmful skill on that ally (team-wide reactive thorns). Sets a self-stance mark making this skill free to re-use, re-targets it to SINGLE, and grants -1 Random cost to Eight Trigrams: Air Palm. While marked, free re-use gives one ally a stacking permanent 10 Shield.

abilities.name: Eight Trigrams: Air Palm
abilities.cost_breakdown: Random:2 (-1 per active stance, can reach 0)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cost (not damage) scales down with active stances: 2 -> 1 -> 0 pips. Damage fixed 20.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal damage and stuns the target's Harmful skills for 1 turn (dur 2). Costs 1 less Random while Gentle Fist stance is active and 1 less while 64 Palms stance is active — with both stances up it becomes FREE (and advances a mission when cast at 0 cost).

abilities.name: My Turn To Protect
abilities.conditional_scaling: none — binary trigger gate that unlocks the offensive transformation.
abilities.effects_summary: One-time use. Applies permanent invisible stun-received and damage-received triggers to a chosen ally. If an enemy stuns that ally OR drops them below 30 HP, Hinata permanently (dur -1) TAUNTS that enemy and this skill is permanently swapped to the hidden Gentle Step: Twin Lions Fist (slot 5). No direct damage.

abilities.name: Gentle Step: Twin Lions Fist
abilities.conditional_scaling: Bonus 10-on-damage trigger multiplies all of Hinata's other damaging actions while active (synergizes with Air Palm 20->30, Gentle Fist DoT, etc.). Stanced re-use double-procs it for ~50 single-target.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt unlocked by My Turn To Protect's taunt trigger. First use: self DAMAGE_DEALT_TRIGGER (dur 7 = ~3 turns) adding 10 Normal bonus to ANY enemy Hinata damages (excludes its own re-use effect) + a self-stance mark. While marked, re-use deals 15 Normal twice to one enemy; each 15 separately procs the +10 dealt-trigger, so a stanced re-use = 15+15 base +10+10 bonus = 50 Normal single-target in one turn.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Modest. Bursts cap around 50 single-target (Twin Lions stanced re-use: 15+15 base + 10+10 from the dealt-trigger). With both base stances + Twin Lions active, normal Air Palm reads 20->30. Reactive thorns (5 Piercing per enemy Harmful action) can add unbounded chip if enemies keep attacking, but per-hit it's tiny. No multiplicative ramp; ceiling is fixed-number stacking.
damage_profile.notes: Twin Lions is a hidden transformation gated behind My Turn To Protect's trigger actually firing (ally stunned or dropped <30 HP), so the 50 burst is conditional and late. Pre-transformation Hinata is almost pure defense/control with a 10/turn DoT and a 20+stun nuke.

economy.color_dependency: Light Green/Blue (her identity colors [0,1]). Only 2 specific pips across the 4 visible skills (Green:1 hinata1, Blue:1 hinata2); the two stances are 1 pip each and become free to re-use once active, so realized cost trends toward Random-only. Twin Lions (hidden) adds Green:1+Blue:1.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast. hinata1/hinata2/hinata4 are cd 0; only Air Palm (hinata3) has cd 1. Both stances make their re-uses free and drop Air Palm's cost, so once set up she spends almost no energy per turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate setup, low energy ramp. Power comes online by toggling stances (free re-use, -cost on Air Palm, team DR/thorns) and unlocking Twin Lions via My Turn To Protect — a conditional, opponent-dependent trigger rather than a guaranteed ramp.

hard_cc: Air Palm: 1-turn Harmful-only stun (hinata3)
My Turn To Protect: permanent taunt on a triggering enemy (hinata4)
soft_cc: Team-wide reactive thorns punish Harmful actions (hinata2)
invuln_or_counter: 64 Palms: team 5 Damage Reduction for 4 turns
64 Palms: 5 Piercing counter-thorns to any enemy using a new Harmful skill on the team
Stacking 10 Shield to an ally via free 64 Palms re-use

role: Defensive support / protect-control with a conditional offensive transformation
signature_mechanic: Two free-to-re-use stances (Gentle Fist DoT + 64 Palms team DR/thorns) that also discount Air Palm, plus 'My Turn To Protect' — a guardian mark that permanently taunts whoever stuns or nearly kills the protected ally and transforms her bar into the offensive Twin Lions Fist.
internal_synergies: Both stances active drop Eight Trigrams: Air Palm from Random:2 to FREE (and advance a mission), giving a free 20+stun every other turn (cd 1).
Each stance's re-use is cost-free once marked: Gentle Fist re-use = free 5 Piercing chip, 64 Palms re-use = free stacking 10 Shield.
Twin Lions Fist's 10-on-damage dealt-trigger boosts every other damaging action (Air Palm 20->30, Gentle Fist DoT, Twin Lions own 15s), and its own re-use double-procs it for the 50 burst.
My Turn To Protect's taunt target lines up with Gentle Fist / Twin Lions mission-advance checks (manually_advance_mission on the taunt target).
64 Palms thorns + team DR + ally shields layer with the My Turn To Protect taunt to wall off a focused-down ally.
win_conditions: Outlast: stack team Damage Reduction, reactive thorns, and ally shields so the enemy grinds down on the protected core while Hinata chips with DoT and free Air Palm stuns.
Punish focus-fire: bait enemies into stunning/bursting the My-Turn-To-Protect ally, locking that threat in a permanent taunt and unlocking Twin Lions Fist for 50-burst closeout.
Energy advantage: free re-uses and discounted Air Palm let her contribute control every turn while the team banks energy.
strengths: Extremely energy-efficient once set up — stance re-uses are free and Air Palm can hit 0 cost.
Strong layered protection: team-wide 5 DR (4 turns), 5 Piercing counter-thorns on any Harmful action, stacking ally shields.
Reliable single-target control: 1-turn Harmful stun on a low cd, plus a permanent sticky taunt that neutralizes an enemy assassin/bruiser.
Light color commitment (only 2 specific pips) and fast cd 0 tempo make her flexible on most teams.
Punishes the enemy game plan: thorns + taunt specifically tax stunning and focus-fire compositions.
weaknesses: Low proactive damage before transformation: 10/turn DoT, 20+stun nuke, and 5 Piercing chip — easily out-DPS'd by dedicated carries.
The Twin Lions transformation is OPPONENT-DEPENDENT: it only unlocks if an enemy stuns or sub-30s the marked ally; vs a patient or burst-light enemy it may never fire, leaving her offense capped.
No healing and no cleanse — she mitigates and shields but cannot restore HP or remove debuffs.
Thorns/DR values are small (5) and flat — Piercing thorns are nice but easily outpaced by high single-hit damage.
Stun is Harmful-only (doesn't lock non-Harmful utility) and the taunt requires the trigger condition; control is conditional rather than on-demand AoE.
Air Palm's free cost relies on maintaining BOTH stances; if either lapses or she's stunned (mark pauses), her tempo and discounts degrade.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded defensive support with excellent energy economy (free re-uses, 0-cost Air Palm), solid layered team protection (DR + reactive thorns + stacking shields), and two flavors of hard control (Harmful stun + sticky permanent taunt). She is sticky and annoying to play against and asks very little of a team's color budget. The ceiling is held back by genuinely low proactive damage and by her best payoff (Twin Lions Fist, ~50 burst + the +10 dealt-trigger that lifts her whole damage profile) being gated behind an opponent-dependent trigger that a careful enemy can simply avoid. No healing/cleanse limits her as a primary support. Strong, reliable, but not oppressive — a solid mid-tier protector with upside.
outlier_flags: Air Palm reaching 0 cost with both stances active is a strong efficiency outlier — a free repeatable 20 damage + 1-turn stun.
Twin Lions re-use double-procs its own +10 dealt-trigger for 50 single-target burst, notably above the rest of her kit's damage band.
Transformation availability is conditional on enemy behavior, an unusual design that makes her offensive ceiling matchup-dependent rather than guaranteed.

role: Ramping single-target Piercing assassin with execute payoff and a counter/invuln defensive layer
signature_mechanic: Card Throw stacks: each cast adds a stack and fires 5 Piercing per current stack at random enemies, ramping damage every turn until 5 stacks unlock Flamboyant Execution (instant-kill the lowest-HP enemy). Backed by Bungee Gum: a 1-turn ignore-all-Harmful invuln that captures incoming skills and reflects them back via Reflect.

abilities.name: Card Throw
abilities.conditional_scaling: Per Card Throw stack: deals 5 Piercing to the target, then an additional 5 Piercing to a random living enemy for EACH current stack (before adding this cast's stack). +1 stack per cast. Turn-by-turn from zero: 5/10/15/20/25 across turns 1-5. At 5 stacks this skill is replaced by Flamboyant Execution for 1 turn.
abilities.effects_summary: Primary 5 Piercing to chosen target + 5 Piercing per existing stack scattered to random enemies; grants a stacking displayed 'Card Throw' mark; at 5 stacks applies an ability_swap to Flamboyant Execution (hisoka6). Piercing bypasses flat and % DR. Cooldown 0 = spammable engine of the kit.

abilities.name: Bungee Gum - Attract
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Normal damage + Taunt for 1 turn (taunt_effect dur 2 = 1 enemy turn). Forces a target onto Hisoka/allies; soft setup for redirecting threats. Normal damage is reduced by DR/shields.

abilities.name: Texture Surprise
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Applies an invisible health-freeze mark for 3 turns: the opponent cannot see HP changes on the marked character (works on ally or enemy). Pure information warfare / bluff tool, no damage. On expiry restores HP visibility. Synergizes with hidden burst and execute by masking how close a target is to death.

abilities.name: Bungee Gum - Catch
abilities.conditional_scaling: Captures every Harmful skill enemies use on Hisoka during the protected window (stored in the Catch mark's class_targets) for later reflection.
abilities.effects_summary: For 1 turn ignores ALL Harmful skills used on Hisoka (ignore_damage + ignore_non_damage = full Harmful invuln) and records each captured skill. Swaps slot 4 to Bungee Gum - Reflect next turn. Strong panic-button / bait that also arms a counter. Self-targeted; tags all enemies with a HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER to log skills used on him.

abilities.name: Bungee Gum - Reflect
abilities.conditional_scaling: Damage/effects equal the sum of all Harmful skills captured by Catch on the previous turn; scales with how much the enemy threw at Hisoka.
abilities.effects_summary: Re-executes every skill captured by Bungee Gum - Catch onto the target enemy (turns enemy aggression into reflected damage/effects). Hidden alt that occupies slot 4 after Catch is used. Counter payoff; does nothing if no skills were captured.

abilities.name: Flamboyant Execution
abilities.conditional_scaling: Unconditional kill but restricted: can only target the living enemy with the lowest current HP.
abilities.effects_summary: Instantly kills the targeted enemy (instant_kill bypasses HP/shields/DR entirely). Targeting is hard-locked to the lowest-current-HP living enemy. Unlocked by reaching 5 stacks of Card Throw; hidden alt that temporarily replaces Card Throw in slot 1 for 1 turn.

damage_profile.notes: Card Throw at 4 pre-existing stacks deals 5 (target) + 4x5 (random scatter) = 25 Piercing in one turn, but the 20 scatter is randomly distributed across living enemies, so it is only true single-target focus when one enemy remains (otherwise it splits as pseudo-AoE). Bungee Gum - Attract adds a flat 15 Normal. The real peak is Flamboyant Execution, which removes one full enemy regardless of HP/shields/DR (effectively infinite single-target value, gated to the lowest-HP target and 5-stack ramp). Reflect's burst depends on what the enemy spent on Hisoka and is unbounded in theory but situational. No DoT in kit.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Card Throw ramps +5 effective damage/turn until 5 stacks (turn 5 = 25 dmg cast that also unlocks Flamboyant Execution = guaranteed kill on lowest-HP enemy). Ceiling is an unconditional execute each cycle plus a reflect that scales with enemy aggression; Piercing ignores DR so the ramp is hard to mitigate defensively.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate: 2x White (Attract, Catch) + 1x Red (Texture Surprise); the core ramp engine (Card Throw) and the alt skills (Reflect, Execution) are all generic Random pips, so the spammable damage loop is color-flexible. White is the most-used specific color.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent on the core loop: Card Throw and the alts (Reflect, Execution) are cooldown 0 and cheap, so Hisoka can ramp/scatter every turn. Utility is gated: Attract cd 1, Texture Surprise cd 3, Catch cd 4 (the long defensive cooldown is the main tempo limiter).
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Damage and the win condition are tied to accumulating 5 Card Throw stacks; first 1-2 turns are weak (5-10 dmg). Stacks live on a mark that can presumably be cleansed, and the scatter is random, so the ramp is somewhat fragile and luck-dependent.

hard_cc: Taunt (1 turn, Bungee Gum - Attract)
invuln_or_counter: Bungee Gum - Catch: 1-turn ignore of ALL Harmful skills (full Harmful invuln)
Bungee Gum - Reflect: counter that re-executes captured enemy skills back at a target

win_conditions: Ramp Card Throw to 5 stacks and use Flamboyant Execution to delete an enemy outright, regardless of their HP or defenses
Grind enemies down with cooldown-0 Piercing scatter that ignores DR, lowering someone into execute range
Bait enemy nukes with Bungee Gum - Catch (full Harmful invuln) and reflect them back for tempo/burst via Reflect
Use Texture Surprise to hide an ally's or his own true HP, baiting the opponent into mis-targeting / wasting an execute or burst
internal_synergies: Card Throw scatter + Flamboyant Execution: scatter chips the lowest-HP enemy, and the same skill at 5 stacks unlocks the execute that finishes that enemy
Texture Surprise + Flamboyant Execution: hiding HP changes prevents the opponent from realizing a unit is in execute range, and conceals Hisoka's own chip damage
Bungee Gum - Catch + Reflect: invuln window captures harmful skills, Reflect turns the enemy's own offense into Hisoka's burst (two-card combo, gated by Catch's cd 4)
Attract Taunt + Catch: taunt forces an enemy to attack Hisoka, who can then Catch the forced Harmful skill and Reflect it
Piercing on Card Throw bypasses DR/shields, so the ramp keeps progressing even against defensive comps that blunt the 15 Normal of Attract
strengths: Unconditional execute (Flamboyant Execution) ignores HP totals, shields, and DR — a hard answer to tanks and high-HP threats
Cooldown-0, 1-pip, color-flexible core loop (Card Throw) that ramps every turn and Pierces through damage reduction
Strong defensive/counter layer: a full 1-turn Harmful invuln that also reflects captured skills back
Cheap overall kit (5 pips visible) with low color commitment on its damage engine
Unique information-warfare tool (Texture Surprise HP hiding) that creates mind-games and bait potential
Built-in Taunt for control / forcing favorable trades
weaknesses: Slow start: first 1-2 turns deal only 5-10 damage; needs to survive and ramp before the kit comes online
Win condition is gated behind 5 Card Throw stacks living on a mark — vulnerable to cleanse/stack removal and to losing tempo
Random scatter targeting means burst is not reliably focusable; damage can be wasted on the wrong enemy
Flamboyant Execution is hard-locked to the lowest-HP enemy — can't pick its target, and is counterable by enemy invuln on that unit
No healing, no shields, no sustain — purely offensive plus defensive cooldowns; fragile when his invuln is on cooldown (Catch cd 4)
Reflect does nothing if the enemy throws no Harmful skills at Hisoka during the Catch window — a savvy opponent simply ignores him that turn
Attract is his only reliable raw damage (15 Normal) and is fully mitigable by DR/shields

power_assessment.reasoning: Hisoka is a well-rounded scaling assassin with a genuine win condition: a DR-ignoring Piercing ramp that culminates in an unconditional execute, plus a flexible 1-turn full-Harmful invuln and a reflect counter. The cooldown-0, color-flexible core loop and cheap 5-pip kit give him strong economy and tempo, and the execute is a premium answer to tanks. He is held back from top tier by a slow ramp, fragile stack-dependent payoff, random/non-focusable scatter, and the execute's lowest-HP targeting lock plus reflect's reliance on enemy cooperation. Solid, flexible, high-skill-ceiling rather than oppressive — a 7. Rated in isolation; cross-roster recalibration may shift this depending on how common cleanse/invuln are and how strong other execute units are.
outlier_flags: Unconditional instant_kill execute (bypasses all defenses) — potential balance outlier vs high-HP/tank archetypes; gated by 5-stack ramp and lowest-HP lock
Reflect can re-execute arbitrary captured enemy skills — theoretically unbounded burst depending on what is thrown at him
Cooldown-0 + 1 random pip core damage skill that Pierces DR is unusually efficient for a spammable engine
Texture Surprise HP-hiding is a rare information-warfare mechanic that is hard to value numerically

abilities.name: Kororo Snowboard
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Stance/transformation: for 4 turns swaps visible slots 1/2/3 (Nipopo Punch/Gauntlets/Impeccable Power) to alt skills Impeccable Power/Icicle Sword/Frost (ability_swap dur 9). Installs a STUN_RECEIVED trigger (dur 8): while active, if Horohoro is stunned by a source, that source's stuns are erased and he heals 20 HP (stun-immunity + self-heal panic button).

abilities.name: Nipopo Punch
abilities.conditional_scaling: +15 damage (to 40) if target already Stunned; consumes/ends all stuns on stunned target
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal damage. If target was stunned: +15 (40 total) and all stuns on them are erased (stun-eater/follow-up). If not stunned: applies Stun (dur 2 = until end of Horohoro's next turn). 1-turn cooldown spammable stun engine.

abilities.name: Nipopo Gauntlets
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT duration extended +1 turn each time target receives a new stun (self-extending while Horohoro stun-locks)
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal on hit + 20 Normal/turn DoT (damage_effect dur 3 ~1 turn base). Attaches STUN_RECEIVED trigger on target that extends both the DoT and this skill by +1 turn whenever the target gets a new stun. Cannot recast while the DoT is active on any enemy.

abilities.name: Impeccable Power
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (binary invuln-on-stun)
abilities.effects_summary: For 4 turns: whenever Horohoro stuns an enemy, he gains Invulnerable for 1 turn (invuln_effect dur 2) and the watcher's duration resets to 8 (self-sustaining as long as he keeps stunning). Alt-form slot-1 skill; strong defensive engine layered on his stun spam.

abilities.name: Icicle Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: enables stun on subsequent Harmful hits vs marked target
abilities.effects_summary: 35 Normal damage + applies Frostbite mark (ACTION_RECEIVE trigger dur 5): Horohoro's other Harmful skills auto-Stun this enemy for 1 turn (if not already stunned). 0 cooldown — repeatable single-target nuke + mark setter. Alt-form slot-2 skill.

abilities.name: Frost That Rouses The Sleeping
abilities.conditional_scaling: 15 dmg per marked enemy that uses a Harmful skill (punish-tax, scales with enemy aggression)
abilities.effects_summary: Marks ALL enemies with Frostbite (dur 5): Horohoro's other Harmful skills auto-Stun marked enemies for 1 turn. Also attaches ACTION_USE trigger (dur 4): any marked enemy that uses a Harmful skill takes 15 Normal damage. AoE stun-setup + offense-deterrent. Alt-form slot-3 skill.

abilities.name: All-Swallowing Avalanche
abilities.conditional_scaling: hits only currently-stunned enemies this turn, then 40 to all that were NOT hit next turn — total board coverage = up to 40 to every enemy across 2 turns
abilities.effects_summary: 40 Normal AoE to all currently STUNNED enemies (marks them exempt). Installs a TICKING follow-up (dur 3): next turn deals 40 (Bypassing — skips barriers/shields) to all enemies not initially damaged. 0 cooldown finisher that converts his stun-lock into guaranteed board-wide damage. Always-visible slot-4.

role: Stun-lock control bruiser who converts hard CC into AoE burst
signature_mechanic: Stun economy: nearly every skill applies, consumes, or pays off Stun. Mark (Frostbite) makes his Harmful hits auto-stun; Nipopo Punch double-dips stunned targets (+15 and eats the stun); Impeccable Power turns each stun into self-Invuln; Avalanche detonates all stunned enemies for 40 AoE then mops up the rest next turn. Kororo Snowboard is a stance swap (slots 1-3 → Impeccable Power / Icicle Sword / Frost) plus stun-immunity + 20 self-heal."

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Avalanche covers the entire enemy team for 40 each over 2 turns (e.g. 120 across a full 3-enemy board, Bypassing on the follow-up). Single-target practical ceiling ~75 in a turn = Icicle Sword 35 (marks→will-stun) + Nipopo Punch 40 on the now-stunned target; or Gauntlets 20+20 DoT + Nipopo Punch 40 on a stunned target = 80. No per-stack snowball beyond filling/clearing the stun board, so damage is bounded but very reliable.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Normal except Avalanche's follow-up tick which is Bypassing (skips shields/barriers). DoT base ~20/turn and self-extends as long as he keeps re-stunning the target. His burst is gated entirely on having enemies stunned/marked, which his own kit guarantees.

economy.color_dependency: Heavy mono-Blue dependency: 6 of 8 visible pips are Blue (only Nipopo Punch and Icicle Sword take 1 random). Wants a Blue-heavy energy pool; gets starved if Blue is scarce.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent — two 0-cooldown skills (Icicle Sword, Avalanche) plus a 1-cd stun engine (Nipopo Punch). Setup skills are short (Frost 3, Snowboard 4) and Impeccable Power (6) self-refreshes. Can act every turn with high uptime.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate: no resource ramp, but his payoff (Avalanche, +15 punch, auto-stuns) requires 1-2 turns of mark/stun setup. Kororo Snowboard stance is the gate to his best alt skills (Icicle/Frost/Impeccable).

hard_cc: Stun (Nipopo Punch on unstunned target, dur 2)
Auto-Stun via Frostbite mark on any Harmful hit (Icicle Sword / Frost setup)
Stun-immunity for self while Kororo Snowboard active
soft_cc: AoE Frostbite mark (enables team-wide stun setup)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerable 1 turn on each stun applied (Impeccable Power, self-refreshing)
15-damage retaliation tax on marked enemies that use Harmful skills (Frost)

internal_synergies: Icicle Sword / Frost apply Frostbite mark → his other Harmful skills auto-Stun marked enemies → those stuns feed Nipopo Punch (+15, stun-eat), Impeccable Power (self-Invuln), and Avalanche (40 AoE detonation).
Nipopo Punch on a non-stunned target stuns it; on a stunned target it both bonus-damages AND clears the stun, letting him re-apply for repeated Impeccable Power invuln procs.
Nipopo Gauntlets self-extends its DoT every time the target receives a new stun — synergizes with his constant re-stunning to prolong DoT.
Frost marks the whole board → next-turn Avalanche becomes a guaranteed two-wave AoE finisher (stunned now, everyone else next turn, Bypassing).
Impeccable Power converts his offensive stun spam into near-permanent self-Invulnerability, making him very hard to punish while he locks the enemy down.
Kororo Snowboard gates the alt kit (Icicle/Frost/Impeccable) and simultaneously grants stun-immunity + 20 heal, a defensive pivot.
win_conditions: Establish stun-lock: mark the board with Frost, auto-stun via Harmful hits, then detonate with Avalanche for board-wide 40s.
Chain Impeccable Power invuln procs off repeated stuns to become untargetable/unpunishable while grinding the enemy team down.
Single-target lockdown of a key enemy: Icicle Sword mark → auto-stun → Nipopo Punch +15/stun-eat loop, denying that enemy turns indefinitely.
strengths: Dense, reliable hard CC — can stun on demand and chain-stun a target or the whole board.
Strong defensive layer for an offensive character: self-Invuln on every stun, stun-immunity + 20 heal in stance, retaliation tax on aggressive enemies.
Excellent tempo: two 0-cd skills and a 1-cd stun engine; acts meaningfully every turn.
Avalanche guarantees board-wide AoE (40 to all over 2 turns) once his stun setup lands, with a Bypassing follow-up that ignores shields.
Self-sustaining loops (Impeccable Power refreshes, Gauntlets DoT extends, marks refresh) reward correct sequencing.
weaknesses: Heavy mono-Blue color dependency (6/8 pips Blue) — vulnerable to Blue energy starvation/denial.
All meaningful burst is gated on setup: needs a stun/mark already present, so a clean opening turn is low-impact and he can be outraced by faster nukers.
Best skills live behind the Kororo Snowboard stance (4-turn window, 4 cd) — if forced out of stance or it lapses, his kit degrades to the weaker base trio.
No shields/barriers, no cleanse, no energy denial; raw damage numbers are modest (mostly 20-40 Normal) and don't snowball.
Counterable by stun-immune / unstunnable enemies — his entire payoff engine (Avalanche, +15 punch, invuln) collapses if targets can't be stunned.
Self-stun-immunity only applies while Snowboard is up and only erases stuns from that source; CC outside that window still locks him.

power_assessment.reasoning: A cohesive, well-designed control bruiser. Every skill interlocks around a single stun/mark economy with a clear setup-then-payoff loop, and he layers an unusually strong defensive package (self-Invuln on stun, stun-immunity + heal, retaliation tax) onto an offensive CC engine — making him sticky and hard to punish. Tempo is excellent (two 0-cd skills, 1-cd stun engine) and Avalanche gives guaranteed board-wide AoE. Held back from top tier by modest raw numbers (mostly Normal 20-40, no real snowball), heavy mono-Blue color dependency, hard reliance on landing stuns (dead vs stun-immune foes), and dependence on the Snowboard stance for his best tools. Strong, reliable, but ceiling-capped.
outlier_flags: mono-Blue color dependency unusually high (6/8 pips)
two 0-cooldown skills (Icicle Sword, Avalanche) — high action density
self-Invuln-on-stun (Impeccable Power) can become near-permanent invulnerability with sustained stunning — potential durability outlier
horohoro7 (Avalanche) not included in the Kororo Snowboard swap code (dev TODO note in horohoro1.gd) — it occupies the always-visible 4th slot rather than swapping

role: Single-target control/lockdown + ramp execute specialist (anti-carry assassin)
signature_mechanic: Ink Splatter stacking: every ink application marks an enemy AND stacks ink on Ichibe, each self-stack granting +5 permanent Shield. Self-stacks ramp toward two thresholds — 4 stacks on an enemy enables a permanent lockdown (Silence + Strategic-stun + 10 damage cap), and 10 self-stacks unlocks Futen Taisatsuryo, an uncounterable cleanse-then-execute that ignores Immortality.

abilities.name: Ichimonji
abilities.conditional_scaling: Each cast adds 1 Ink stack to Ichibe, permanently growing his Shield (+5/stack) and ramping both thresholds; damage itself is flat 20.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Affliction (bypasses barriers/shields/DR) to one enemy; applies 1 Ink Splatter stack to the enemy and 1 to Ichibe; Ichibe gains +5 permanent Shield per self-stack. Spammable (CD 0). Triggers Futen unlock check at 10 self-stacks.

abilities.name: Ink Splatter
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-stacks gained scale with number of living enemies inked (up to +N stacks and +5N Shield per cast in a full enemy team), accelerating the ramp to 10.
abilities.effects_summary: No damage. Applies 1 Ink stack to every living enemy; Ichibe gains 1 self-stack per enemy inked plus +5 permanent Shield per self-stack. Spammable (CD 0). At 10 self-stacks, permanently swaps slot 1 to Futen Taisatsuryo (ichibe5).

abilities.name: Shirafude Ichimonji
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gated by 4+ Ink stacks on the target; effect is permanent ('rest of the game') rather than numerically scaling.
abilities.effects_summary: Hard single-target lockdown: permanent Silence, permanent Stun on Strategic skills, and outgoing damage capped at 10 per hit. Requires target to have >=4 Ink stacks. All effects removed if Ichibe dies. Effectively neutralizes an enemy carry for the match.

abilities.name: Ink Manipulation: Conceal
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend). Panic button / protect the ramp; CD 4.

abilities.name: Futen Taisatsuryo
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gated behind 10 self Ink stacks; an instant-kill, so effectively infinite effective damage against a single target.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt that swaps into slot 1 once Ichibe reaches 10 self Ink stacks. Cleanses all helpful effects from the target, removes Immortality, then outright kills it (die()). Cannot be countered, ignores Immortality. Requires 10 self stacks. AI weights it as 200 burst.

abilities.name: Named Reconstitution
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Passive one-time self-revive. On first death, a random living ally is marked; when that ally next uses a skill, Ichibe revives with HP equal to that ally's current HP, but generates no energy for the rest of the match thereafter. Conditional, not guaranteed (needs a living ally who acts).

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Direct damage is trivially low (flat 20 Affliction from Ichimonji, no AoE damage), but Futen Taisatsuryo is an unconditional single-target execute once unlocked (10 self stacks), so effective single-target 'damage' is lethal/infinite. The real ceiling is control: a permanent Silence + Strategic-stun + 10 damage cap on one enemy, plus the execute that strips immortality and cannot be countered. peak_single_target value (9999) represents the execute kill, not a damage number.
damage_profile.notes: Only repeatable real damage is the 20 Affliction tick from Ichimonji (bypasses shields/barriers/DR). No AoE damage at all. Win damage comes from the execute and from caps that gut enemy output.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate White dependency: Ichimonji (W1) and Shirafude (W2) need White specifically; Ink Splatter and Conceal take any color. Visible kit = 3 White + 2 Random across 4 skills. Futen costs Random:3 (no color dependency once unlocked).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two spammable 0-CD engine skills (Ichimonji, Ink Splatter) let him ink every turn; the lockdown (CD4), self-invuln (CD4), and execute (CD6) are the slower payoff buttons. Very low per-turn cost for a relentless ramp.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. The whole kit is built around accumulating self Ink stacks: 4 to enable the permanent lockdown, 10 to unlock the execute and convert to a transformed slot-1. Early game he is a low-damage staller; power spikes hard at the stack thresholds.

hard_cc: permanent Silence (Shirafude)
permanent Strategic-skill Stun (Shirafude)
soft_cc: outgoing damage cap of 10 (Shirafude)
instant-death execute (Futen)
invuln_or_counter: self Invulnerable 1 turn (Conceal)
Futen is Uncounterable

internal_synergies: Ichimonji and Ink Splatter both feed the same self-stack counter, so every turn of inking simultaneously builds permanent Shield, pushes a target toward the 4-stack lockdown gate, and pushes Ichibe toward the 10-stack Futen unlock.

Ink Splatter against a full enemy team stacks self-ink far faster (1 per enemy) than single-target inking, accelerating Futen unlock; single-target Ichimonji is better for concentrating 4+ stacks on one priority target for Shirafude.
+5 permanent Shield per self-stack means the same ramp that arms his control also turns him into a near-unkillable wall (10 stacks = ~50 Shield, and it keeps growing), protecting the slow ramp.
Conceal (invuln) and Named Reconstitution (revive) protect the ramp/keep him alive long enough to hit thresholds.
Shirafude's damage cap + Silence neuters an enemy carry while Ichibe ramps; Futen then deletes whatever survived, even immortal/buffed targets, uncounterably.
win_conditions: Ramp to 10 self Ink stacks, unlock Futen Taisatsuryo, and execute the enemy carry/win-condition (ignoring immortality, uncounterable), repeating on CD6 to dismantle the enemy team.
Lock down the enemy's primary damage dealer with Shirafude (permanent Silence + Strategic-stun + 10 damage cap) so the rest of his team out-paces a crippled enemy roster.
Out-sustain via stacking permanent Shield and the one-time revive, winning a long attrition game the enemy cannot close out.
strengths: Unconditional single-target execute (Futen) that ignores Immortality and cannot be countered — a hard answer to immortals, revivers, and buff-stacked carries.
Best-in-class single-target soft+hard lockdown: permanent Silence, Strategic-skill stun, and a 10 outgoing-damage cap effectively remove an enemy from the game for the match.
Extremely cheap, 0-cooldown ramp engine (both ink skills spammable) that simultaneously builds a large, permanent, growing Shield wall — high effective bulk.
Affliction tick bypasses shields/barriers/DR, so his chip damage is reliable.
Self-invulnerability and a one-time self-revive give strong staying power to reach his power spikes.
Low specific-color demand on the alt/execute (all-random), easy to fuel.
weaknesses: Very weak raw damage before thresholds — flat 20 Affliction and no AoE damage; he does almost nothing offensively in the early game.
Heavily ramp-dependent: needs to survive to 4 stacks (lockdown) and 10 stacks (execute); if rushed down or denied targets he never comes online.

Shirafude's permanent lockdown and Futen both depend on Ichibe living (Shirafude effects removed on his death), and the revive is conditional (needs a living ally who then acts) and disables his energy generation afterward, crippling his post-revive kit.
No team support, no healing, no cleanse for allies — purely self-focused control/tank.
Single-target focus means he struggles to swing wide multi-threat enemy comps before his execute is online.
Against single fast bursty enemies he can be killed before reaching 10 stacks.

power_assessment.reasoning: An unconditional, uncounterable, immortality-ignoring single-target execute plus a permanent full lockdown (Silence + Strategic-stun + 10 damage cap) are both top-tier disruption tools, and his ramp simultaneously builds an enormous growing permanent Shield wall off two 0-CD, near-free skills. That combination — hard counter to immortals/carries, self-sustain, and self-invuln/revive — is very strong and warps matchups. Held back from 9-10 by a slow, ramp-gated start with near-zero early damage and no AoE/team utility, plus fragility windows before thresholds and the lockdown/revive being conditional on his survival. High floor of impact once online, lower-variance ceiling than pure burst carries.

role: single-target ramping bruiser/duelist with self-invuln sustain
signature_mechanic: Permanent stacking damage ramp: Zangetsu Slash adds a permanent +5 damage-mod stack to itself on every use, and Bankai (ichigo3) further enhances his harmful skills (cost reduction, Getsuga bypass + AoE conversion of the basic) — the longer the fight runs, the harder his cheap attacks hit.

abilities.name: Zangetsu Slash
abilities.target_type: SINGLE (becomes ALL enemies while enhanced by Bankai mark)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent stacking +5 damage to this skill each time it affects an enemy (Effect.damage_mod_effect(5, -1) with stackable/per_stack=true). 0 cooldown means it can be spammed every turn, compounding the ramp. While Bankai mark is active it hits all enemies (each hit applies its own stack).
abilities.effects_summary: Cheap, cooldown-free single-target normal-damage filler that permanently buffs its own damage on every use; converts to AoE under Bankai. No CC/debuff.

abilities.name: Getsuga Tenshou
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:1, Random:1 (reduced to 1 Random by Bankai for one turn)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 35 PIERCING in the .gd (skips flat+%DR). When marked by Bankai (ichigo3) it gains bypass-invulnerability targeting and per the mark text deals +10 (~45 effective). JSON's 45 base and its self-invuln/energy-gain/'+5 per Hollow Slayer use' text are STALE; execute() does none of that.
abilities.effects_summary: High single-target piercing nuke on a short 1-turn cooldown; under Bankai becomes an invuln-bypassing ~45 piercing hit. Pure damage, no rider effects in current code.

abilities.name: Bankai: Tensa Zangetsu
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self cooldown increments by +1 on every use (2 -> 3 -> 4...), so repeated transforms get progressively slower. Enhancement window is short (durations of 2-3 ticks).
abilities.effects_summary: Self setup/transformation engine: 1-turn invuln (dur 2); -1 Random cost to Zangetsu Slash & Getsuga Tenshou next turn (dur 3); target-change Zangetsu Slash to ALL enemies (dur 3); marks self so Getsuga Tenshou bypasses invuln and deals +10 (dur 3); portrait change. JSON's '5-skill passive Bankai swap' description is STALE.

abilities.name: Ichigo Block
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Panic-button full invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend) on a 4-turn cooldown. Pure defensive cooldown, no offense.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded over a long match: Zangetsu Slash gains a permanent +5 stack every use with 0 cooldown, so a basic starting at 20 grows to 25/30/35/... indefinitely (~50-60+ by mid-game). A turn of Bankai-enhanced Getsuga (45 piercing) plus a heavily-stacked Slash can exceed 80-100 single-target late. AoE ceiling also climbs because the stacked Slash hits all enemies under Bankai.
damage_profile.notes: Peak ST one turn early is Getsuga 35 piercing (45 under Bankai); with a stacked Zangetsu Slash also fired it is higher, but Slash damage is Normal (DR-reducible) while Getsuga pierces. No DoT/affliction. Real strength is the compounding ramp, not turn-1 burst.

economy.color_dependency: Low. Only 2 specific pips across the visible kit (1 Blue on Getsuga, 1 Red on Slash); the other 4 pips are Random. Dual Blue/Red identity but very light demands, splashes into almost any team. Bankai temporarily drops Slash/Getsuga to 1 Random each.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/aggressive. Slash is cooldown-free (spammable every turn), Getsuga 1-turn cd, so he can attack every turn. Bankai cd 2 (self-escalating +1/use), Block cd 4.
economy.ramp_dependency: High - kit is built around ramping. Turn-1 output is mediocre (20 normal / 35 piercing); value compounds with every Zangetsu Slash stack and is amplified by Bankai windows. Punished by short games and burst that kills him before he ramps.

invuln_or_counter: Ichigo Block: full 1-turn invuln, cd 4
Bankai: Tensa Zangetsu: 1-turn invuln bundled with offensive enhancement, cd 2 (escalating)

internal_synergies: Bankai (ichigo3) is the hub: it cuts Slash/Getsuga cost to 1 Random, converts Zangetsu Slash to hit ALL enemies, and marks Getsuga to bypass invuln + deal +10 - turning the basic into AoE and the nuke into an invuln-piercing finisher in the same window.
Zangetsu Slash's 0-cooldown + permanent per-use stacking means every Bankai-enabled AoE turn also adds stacks to a now-multi-target attack, so AoE damage ramps alongside single-target.
Bankai's cost reduction lets him fire both Slash (1 Random) and Getsuga (1 Random) cheaply in the enhancement turn, maximizing the burst+stack window.
Two independent invuln sources (Block cd4, Bankai cd2) give strong defensive-turn uptime while Bankai turns still advance the ramp.
strengths: Excellent energy economy: only 2 specific pips total, mostly Random, fits any team.
Relentless tempo - can attack every single turn (Slash 0 cd, Getsuga 1 cd).
Piercing main nuke (Getsuga) ignores all DR and, under Bankai, ignores invulnerability - strong vs tanks and defensive comps.
Unbounded permanent damage ramp on a free-to-cast basic; snowballs in longer fights.
Self-sufficient survivability with two invuln cooldowns, no ally reliance.
Bankai flexibly pivots him into an AoE threat without needing extra cards.
weaknesses: Weak early/burst-light: turn-1 ceiling is just ~35 piercing; needs several stacking turns to become threatening.
Hard-countered by burst/assassins that kill him before the ramp matures, and by energy denial that starves his attacks.
Zero team utility - no CC, healing, shields, cleanse, or energy denial; purely a solo damage dealer.
Main basic damage is Normal type, fully reducible by DR/shields/barriers (only Getsuga pierces).
Bankai's self-incrementing cooldown makes repeated transforms slower, and its enhancements are short one-turn windows.
No hard CC means he can't stop a dangerous enemy from acting; defenses are reactive invuln only (no sustain/healing).
win_conditions: Survive the early game (Block/Bankai invuln) long enough to stack Zangetsu Slash into a large permanent damage mod, then win on compounding tempo.
Use Bankai windows to spike: invuln-bypassing ~45 piercing Getsuga to delete a defensive key target, or AoE Slash to spread the ramp.
Out-attrition opponents - every-turn cheap attacks plus DR-ignoring piercing grind through tanks and shields.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, focused solo carry: superb energy economy (2 specific pips), every-turn tempo, a piercing/invuln-bypassing nuke, and an unbounded permanent ramp give him a strong late-game and good matchups into tanks/defensive comps. But he is one-dimensional - no CC, healing, shields, cleanse, or energy denial, so he brings nothing to teammates and offers no answer to threats other than killing them. His early game is soft (turn-1 ceiling ~35) and he is exploitable by burst that ends the game before his ramp matters. Solid B-tier duelist: above average in a vacuum, capped by lack of utility and ramp dependence. role: Red-energy bruiser/burst damage dealer with a randomized awaken/wane power-cycle and offensive buff-strip
signature_mechanic: Hanyo Cycle: every 2 turns a 1d2 roll randomly toggles Inuyasha between Awakened (+50% Harmful damage, +1 Random cost) and Waned (-50% damage, -1 Red cost) for 2 turns, swinging all his offense with no player control.

abilities.name: Wind Scar
abilities.conditional_scaling: Hanyo Cycle mark mag: normal 20, Awakened (mag1) 30, Waned (mag2) 10
abilities.effects_summary: AoE Normal damage to all enemies; no rider effects. Damage modulated by Hanyo Cycle state.

abilities.name: Blades of Blood
abilities.conditional_scaling: Repeats once per damage instance Inuyasha took since last cast (counter capped at 2 extra = max 3 hits), then resets. Per-hit by cycle: normal 10, Awakened 15, Waned 5. Peak: normal 30, Awakened 45, Waned 15.
abilities.effects_summary: Single-target Affliction (bypasses barriers/shields/DR), multi-hit scaling off the Hanyo Cycle damage-received counter; consumes/resets the counter on use.

abilities.name: Iron Reaver Soul Stealer
abilities.conditional_scaling: Hanyo Cycle mark mag: normal 30, Awakened 45, Waned 15
abilities.effects_summary: Cleanses ALL beneficial effects from the target (offensive buff/invuln/shield strip), then deals Piercing damage (skips flat + % DR). Strongest single-hit nuke. Tagged Physical class but resolves as Piercing in code.

abilities.name: Tessaiga Barrier
abilities.cost_breakdown: Random:1 (Strategic, not Harmful, so unaffected by Hanyo Cycle cost mods)
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Grants Invulnerability for 1 turn (dur 2) to a target ally AND to Inuyasha himself. Defensive/protect tool on a 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Hanyo Cycle
abilities.conditional_scaling: Drives all scaling. Ticking counter starts at 2; on reaching 0 rolls 1d2: roll 1 = Awakened (mark mag1, +50% Harmful dmg, +1 Random cost on Wind Scar/Iron Reaver/Blades), roll 2 = Waned (mark mag2, -50% dmg, -1 Red cost). State lasts 2 turns.
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent passive applied at battle start. Sets up (a) the random awaken/wane ticking cycle with portrait swaps + cost mods, and (b) the Blades of Blood damage-received counter (increments up to 2 per hit taken). No direct damage.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Awakened band is the ceiling: Iron Reaver 45 Piercing (post-cleanse) or fully-stacked Blades 45 Affliction (3x15, needs 2+ damage instances taken since last Blades cast). All three offensive skills are cooldown 0 but only one skill resolves per turn; no multi-skill stacking. Waned floor is roughly one-third of these values.
damage_profile.notes: Affliction (Blades) bypasses barriers/shields/DR; Iron Reaver Piercing skips flat + % DR after stripping all buffs, so its 45 is near-unmitigable effective damage. Wind Scar is plain Normal and fully mitigable. Blades is instant multi-hit, not a true DoT, so sustained DoT/turn is 0.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate mono-Red dependency (character_colors=[3]): 3 of 4 visible skills cost Red:1 + Random:1 in normal state; Tessaiga Barrier is Random:1 only. Waned removes the Red requirement (-1 Red), Awakened adds +1 Random (3 pips each).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Three offensive skills are all cooldown 0 (spammable); only Tessaiga Barrier has a 4-turn cooldown. Very high offensive tempo, limited defensive uptime.
economy.ramp_dependency: Soft ramp: Blades ramps to its 3x peak only after taking damage; the Awakened window must be rolled into and is uncontrollable. No hard gate - baseline damage available turn 1.

invuln_or_counter: Tessaiga Barrier: 1-turn Invulnerability for self + target ally (4-turn cooldown)

win_conditions: Land big hits during the Awakened window: Iron Reaver 45 Piercing (after stripping all enemy buffs) or 30 AoE Wind Scar to close out low-HP teams.
Use Iron Reaver's all-buff cleanse to neutralize a defensively-stacked threat (invuln/shields/regen) then follow with near-unmitigable Piercing/Affliction.
Tank a hit or two to charge Blades of Blood to 3 stacks for a 45 Affliction burst that ignores barriers/shields.
Protect a key ally (and self) through a lethal turn with Tessaiga Barrier invuln to outlast the enemy team.
internal_synergies: Hanyo Cycle's Awakened mark boosts all three offensive skills 50% at once - any one benefits from the window.
Hanyo Cycle also feeds Blades of Blood's damage-received counter, so one passive drives two separate scaling systems.
Iron Reaver's pre-damage all-buff cleanse pairs with its own Piercing and with Blades' Affliction to bypass the defenses it just stripped.
Taking damage is doubly rewarded: it charges Blades, and Tessaiga Barrier can self-protect on the turn that exposure would otherwise be lethal.
Waned state's -1 Red cost keeps him casting when energy-starved, partly offsetting the damage penalty as a tempo play.
strengths: Strong unmitigable damage types: Iron Reaver Piercing (after a full buff strip) and Blades Affliction both bypass most defenses.
Built-in offensive buff/invuln/shield strip on Iron Reaver - rare and very valuable utility.
All three offensive skills are cooldown 0, giving flexible AoE + two single-target pressure every turn.
Self+ally invulnerability on a reasonable 4-turn cooldown provides a clutch defensive button.
Awakened window gives high burst (45 single-target / 30 AoE) for a 2-pip skill.
Cheap, mono-Red, mostly-Random costs are easy to pay on almost any team.
weaknesses: Hanyo Cycle is RANDOM (1d2) and uncontrollable - he can be locked into Waned (half damage) at the worst moment, and Awakened also taxes energy (+1 Random).
Roughly half his uptime is at baseline or actively penalized; damage consistency is poor.
No hard CC, no healing, no energy denial, no shields, no stealth - purely damage + buff-strip + invuln.
Blades' ramp requires taking damage, which is risky and outside his control; without it Blades is just 10/hit.
Wind Scar is plain Normal damage and fully mitigable by DR/shields.
A single passive carries the kit's identity; in a bad state he is a vanilla low-cost striker.
Iron Reaver's cleanse + Piercing is single-target only; limited answer to multiple defensive enemies.

power_assessment.reasoning: A solid, flexible mono-Red striker with two excellent traits: an offensive all-buff cleanse on Iron Reaver paired with unmitigable Piercing damage, and an Affliction multi-hit that bypasses shields. Cooldown-0 offense plus a self+ally invuln gives real tempo and a safety button. The ceiling (45 effective single-target after a buff strip, 30 AoE) is good but not elite for a 2-pip cost. The big limiter is the random Hanyo Cycle: he cannot reliably schedule his Awakened burst, and ~half his time is at baseline or Waned (-50%), capping consistency. No CC/heal/energy-denial keeps him one-dimensional. Lands as a good-but-swingy mid-tier damage/utility hybrid.
outlier_flags: Randomized damage band (1d2) with no player agency - high variance is a design outlier vs deterministic kits.
Iron Reaver double-strips: removes ALL enemy buffs AND deals Piercing on a 2-pip, cooldown-0 skill - strong anti-defense package and a potential balance hotspot.
Class tag mismatch: Iron Reaver is classed Physical but resolves as Piercing damage in code.

abilities.name: Invincible Punch
abilities.conditional_scaling: +15 for 1 turn if Heroic Rush is used on self; further boosted permanently by the A Reason To Fight passive (+5 per ally-damage instance) and by Face Smash's stacking damage-taken debuff on the target
abilities.effects_summary: Single-target spammable nuke (0 cd, 1 Random pip). Base 15 Normal damage; the primary payoff target for all of Invincible's ramp (self-buff window, passive stacks, Face Smash amp).

abilities.name: Heroic Rush
abilities.conditional_scaling: If cast on self, grants +15 damage to Invincible Punch for 1 turn (a one-turn 30-damage burst window)
abilities.effects_summary: Targeted invulnerability: makes self OR one ally invulnerable for 1 turn (cd 1). Doubles as a self-empower button for a 30-damage Punch turn. Flexible protect/setup tool.

abilities.name: Desperate Bite
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (fixed 10 True); part of the Bite<->Face Smash swap loop
abilities.effects_summary: Cheap 10 True damage (bypasses DR/barriers). On use, swaps slot to Face Smash. Entry point of the True-damage execute/anti-tank loop.

abilities.name: Viltrumite Flight
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn on a long 4-turn cooldown. Pure defensive panic/survival button, color-flexible (Random pip).

abilities.name: Face Smash
abilities.conditional_scaling: Applies a PERMANENT, stacking +5 non-Affliction damage-taken debuff on the target — every subsequent hit (Punch, Bite, ally damage) is amplified per stack
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap (from Desperate Bite). 15 True damage PLUS a permanent stacking vulnerability debuff (+5 damage taken, non-Affliction). Swaps back to Desperate Bite. Core ramp/anti-tank engine; chained Bite->Smash loops stack vulnerability indefinitely.

abilities.name: A Reason To Fight
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent +5 to all of Invincible's outgoing damage each time ANY ally takes new damage (unbounded stacks)
abilities.effects_summary: Passive snowball: every instance of ally damage permanently raises Invincible's damage by 5. Rewards being attacked / having allies dive in; pairs with his invuln tools (protect a baited ally, stack damage). Unbounded scaling ceiling.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded. Two independent permanent stacking engines compound: A Reason To Fight (+5 outgoing per ally-damage instance) and Face Smash (+5 stacking damage-taken on the target). Late game a single Invincible Punch can hit for 50+ as stacks accumulate; the Bite<->Face Smash loop layers True damage that ignores DR while building target vulnerability.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is single-target; zero AoE and zero DoT. Base burst is modest (15 Normal Punch, 10/15 True from Bite/Smash). The 30 peak comes from Heroic Rush self-buff (+15) on Punch in one turn. Real power is in ramp over a long match, not turn-1 burst.

economy.color_dependency: Light Green dependency: 2 of 4 visible pips are Green (Heroic Rush, Desperate Bite); the two damage/defense staples (Invincible Punch, Viltrumite Flight) use Random pips, so the kit is flexible. Note: .tscn mastery label reads 'Invincible (Blue)' but actual ability costs are Green/Random, not Blue.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Both main damage tools (Invincible Punch, Desperate Bite/Face Smash) are 0-cooldown spammable; Heroic Rush is cd1. Only the self-invuln Viltrumite Flight is gated (cd4). Can attack every turn while ramping. Low-cost, low-cooldown sustained pressure profile.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Early kit is below-curve in raw numbers; the character is balanced around scaling. Needs a longer game and ideally an ally taking damage (passive) plus repeated Face Smash applications to reach its damage ceiling.

invuln_or_counter: Heroic Rush: 1-turn invulnerability on self or one ally (cd1)
Viltrumite Flight: 1-turn self invulnerability (cd4)

internal_synergies: Desperate Bite -> Face Smash swap loop: each Face Smash adds permanent +5 damage-taken to the target, so re-looping Bite/Smash steadily amplifies every future Punch and Bite into that enemy (anti-tank).
Heroic Rush (self) + Invincible Punch: one-turn +15 Punch makes a 30-damage spike, and the same button can instead bunker an ally.

A Reason To Fight passive + Heroic Rush/Viltrumite Flight: bait or protect an ally so they take damage safely while the passive permanently ramps Invincible's damage; invuln lets him soak hits that feed allies into taking damage too.
Face Smash vulnerability + passive ramp stack on the same target: an amped target takes (15 base + passive stacks) further increased by +5 per Face Smash stack.
role: Single-target scaling bruiser/DPS with self-and-ally invulnerability support; ramps via a True-damage anti-tank loop and an ally-damage snowball passive
signature_mechanic: Dual permanent stacking ramp: the A Reason To Fight passive (+5 outgoing damage per ally-damage instance) plus the Desperate Bite<->Face Smash swap loop that layers permanent +5 stacking vulnerability and True damage on a target, snowballing single-target damage with no upper bound.
strengths: Two unbounded permanent ramp engines (passive + Face Smash amp) give a very high late-game single-target ceiling.
True damage (Desperate Bite 10, Face Smash 15) bypasses DR/barriers/shields — strong anti-tank and against mitigation stackers.
Excellent tempo/economy: 0-cooldown spammable damage, mostly 1-pip costs, two Random pips keep it color-flexible.
Two separate invulnerability tools, one of which can fully protect an ally — rare protective utility on a damage dealer.
Heroic Rush is dual-purpose (protect OR self-empower for a burst turn), giving flexible decision-making.
Passive turns enemy aggression on allies into permanent power, so the kit gets stronger the longer/messier the fight.
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero DoT — purely single-target, easily walled by multi-target comps.
Low front-loaded damage; weak in short games and behind-the-curve before ramp comes online.
Ramp is reactive/conditional: the passive only fires when an ally actually takes damage, so a fully-protected or solo-carry team starves it.
No hard CC, no energy denial, no healing, no shields, no cleanse — narrow utility outside invuln.
Invulnerability is short (1 turn) and the only reliable self-defense (Viltrumite Flight) is on a long cd4; vulnerable to burst on off-turns.
Face Smash amp lives on the enemy and passive stacks reward a long fight — losing the marked target or a quick game wastes accumulated value.
All actives are stunnable (accurate:false) — enemy CC and dodge/invuln disrupt both the damage and the ramp loop.
win_conditions: Grind a long game and snowball the passive + Face Smash stacks until a single Invincible Punch one-shots key targets.
Lock onto an enemy tank/mitigation-stacker and dismantle it with True damage + escalating vulnerability while teammates clean up.
Use invulnerability to keep himself or a key ally alive through the ramp window, then convert accumulated stacks into a decisive single-target spike.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded scaling single-target DPS with unusually strong defensive utility for a damage dealer (two invuln tools, one ally-targetable). Economy and tempo are excellent — 0-cd spammable True damage that ignores mitigation, mostly 1-pip flexible costs. The two permanent stacking ramp engines give a genuinely high, unbounded ceiling, making him a strong anti-tank and late-game threat. Held back from top tier by: no AoE/DoT (single-target only), low front-loaded damage (a 30 peak in one turn needs the Heroic Rush self-buff; otherwise ~15-25 early), and reactive ramp that depends on allies eating damage. Strong in long, attrition-heavy fights; mediocre in fast burst metas. Rated in isolation; the unbounded scaling could push higher if matches routinely go long.
outlier_flags: UNBOUNDED_SCALING: two permanent stacking damage engines with no cap (passive + Face Smash) — potential late-game outlier if games run long.

role: single-target control/counter assassin with a mid-fight Susanoo transformation into a piercing burst executioner
signature_mechanic: Two-phase kit. Pre-Susanoo: lay invisible marks (Crow Clone counter-trigger, Kotoamatsukami counter) that, if triggered, let Tsukuyomi banish instead of stun, while Crow Clone generates Random/White cost discounts. Susanoo (a once-per-game self setup) auto-activates the first time Itachi's HP drops below 50, granting a 35 Shield + permanent immunity to non-damage effects and PERMANENTLY swapping abilities 1/2/3 into Totsuka Blade / Yata Mirror / Yasaka Magatama — converting him into an uncounterable Piercing burst dealer with a skill-seal -> bonus-damage combo.

abilities.name: Crow Clone
abilities.conditional_scaling: Conditional/trigger-based: deals 10 Piercing on trigger; doubles to 20 Piercing if the enemy's triggering skill targeted Itachi. No trigger = 0 damage.
abilities.effects_summary: Marks target enemy 1 turn (invisible) and Itachi gains 10 invisible Shield. If the marked enemy uses a new skill: Itachi's skills cost 1 less Random next turn (and also 1 less White if that skill targeted Itachi), enemy takes 10 Piercing (x2 if it targeted Itachi), and a hidden 'damaged by Crow Clone' breadcrumb is dropped enabling Tsukuyomi's banish.

abilities.name: Tsukuyomi
abilities.conditional_scaling: Effect upgrade (not damage): if target carries a Crow Clone or Kotoamatsukami breadcrumb from last turn, the stun is replaced by a 1-turn banish (mark is consumed).
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal damage + 1-turn stun. Hard upgrade to 1-turn BANISH if the target was damaged by Crow Clone or countered by Kotoamatsukami last turn (respects banish shrug-off).

abilities.name: Kotoamatsukami
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible 1-turn counter. On an ally: counters the next Harmful skill used on them (COUNTER_RECEIVE). On an enemy: counters the next Harmful skill they use (COUNTER_USE). When the counter fires it drops a hidden breadcrumb on the offending enemy that enables Tsukuyomi's banish next turn.

abilities.name: Susanoo
abilities.conditional_scaling: Transformation gate: arms a one-time HP-below-50 trigger (fires immediately if already below 50).
abilities.effects_summary: Once-per-game setup. When Itachi's HP first drops below 50: gain 35 Shield (permanent duration), permanently ignore non-damage effects (CC immunity), portrait change, and PERMANENTLY swap abilities 1/2/3 -> Totsuka Blade / Yata Mirror / Yasaka Magatama. NOTE: .gd grants 35 Shield with no downside; the JSON's '50 Shield + 10 Affliction/turn self-damage' is STALE — code has no Affliction tick.

abilities.name: Totsuka Blade
abilities.target_type: SINGLE enemy (ignores invuln/targeting via uncounterable hostile)
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (enables Yasaka's +20 via the seal mark)
abilities.effects_summary: Post-Susanoo replacement of Crow Clone. 30 Piercing damage (Uncounterable) + 1-turn SKILL SEAL (target cannot use skills; explicitly not a stun, so it bypasses stun-immunity). Seal mark lingers one extra turn so Yasaka Magatama can read it.

abilities.name: Yata Mirror
abilities.conditional_scaling: Resource ramp: +1 Red energy per Harmful skill received while shielded.
abilities.effects_summary: Post-Susanoo replacement of Kotoamatsukami. Gives Itachi or an ally 30 invisible Shield for 1 turn; each Harmful skill the shielded target receives during that window generates 1 Red energy for Itachi (fuels his Red-heavy Susanoo kit).

abilities.name: Yasaka Magatama
