kid2.gd custom_behavior uses '==' instead of '+=' (variations == behavior_single_target_damage(...)), a no-op bug in AI hint generation (does not affect player execute path)

role: Single-target piercing assassin with mark-detonation execute
signature_mechanic: Decapitation stacks: killua1 and killua2 each apply a stackable Decapitation mark; killua3 detonates all stacks on one enemy for 15 Affliction per stack and attempts an execute if the target drops to 20 HP or below. Self-buff from killua1 adds +10 to his piercing attacks for 2 turns, enabling a ramp-then-detonate-then-execute pattern.

abilities.name: Claws Assassination
abilities.conditional_scaling: Applies a self damage_mod_effect of +10 to Claws Assassination and Heart Ripper for 2 turns (dur 5 self-facing). With the buff active, this skill deals 25 piercing; the buff is flat +10 (one instance, refreshed on recast).
abilities.effects_summary: 15 piercing damage; applies 1 stackable Decapitation mark (infinite duration, displays stacks); grants self +10 damage buff to killua1/killua2 for 2 turns. Cooldown 0 = spammable mark-builder and core ramp engine.

abilities.name: Heart Ripper
abilities.conditional_scaling: Benefits from Claws Assassination's +10 buff: deals 30 piercing while buff is active.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 piercing damage; stun for 1 turn (stun_effect dur 2 = 1 enemy turn); applies 1 stackable Decapitation mark. Hard single-target lock plus a mark stack.

abilities.name: Decapitation
abilities.conditional_scaling: Damage = 15 * Decapitation stack_count on the target. Scales linearly with marks applied by killua1 (CD0) and killua2. Affliction bypasses barriers/shields/DR. Only usable while a Decapitation mark exists.
abilities.effects_summary: Detonates ALL Decapitation stacks on one marked enemy for 15 Affliction per stack; then execute_attempt: instant-kills if target HP <= 20. Pure burst-detonation + execute finisher; consumes the mark stacks.

abilities.name: Killua Hide
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). Panic-button defensive cooldown to dodge a kill turn; long 4-turn cooldown.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: killua3 = 15 x Decapitation stacks. Stacks build at ~1-2/turn (killua1 CD0 + killua2 CD1). A realistic ramp of ~3-4 stacks over a couple turns yields a single 45-60 Affliction detonation (barrier/shield/DR-bypassing); higher with longer setup. Plus the killua1 buff makes piercing hits 25/30. True ceiling is unbounded in stacks but practically bounded by turns spent ramping and the 20-HP execute making large detonations unnecessary against low targets.
damage_profile.notes: All direct damage is Piercing (killua1 15, killua2 20) which skips flat+%DR, and the detonation is Affliction which bypasses barriers/shields entirely - so effective damage is very high against defensive targets. Single-turn peak of 30 is one buffed Heart Ripper; the real damage comes from a detonation turn (45-60+ Affliction at 3-4 stacks) and is best measured as front-loaded burst, not sustained DoT (the mark itself deals no per-turn damage, only on detonation). killua3 execute removes any target at <=20 HP regardless of stacks.

economy.color_dependency: Heavy Green dependency: killua1, killua2, and killua3 each require Green:1 (3 Green pips across the kit). Mono-Green identity (character_colors=[0]). killua2 also wants 1 random; killua4 is fully flexible (1 random). Green-starved turns shut down the entire offensive loop.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast offense: killua1 CD0 (spammable), killua2 CD1, killua3 CD1. He can mark and detonate almost every turn. Only killua4 (CD4) is slow. Tempo favors a quick mark-mark-detonate cadence.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Detonation damage and the +10 piercing buff both require a setup turn or two, but killua1's 0 cooldown means ramp is cheap and fast. He is functional turn 1 (15 pierce + mark) but peaks after 1-2 stacking turns.

hard_cc: killua2 stun (1 turn)
invuln_or_counter: killua4 self-invulnerability (1 turn, CD4)

win_conditions: Ramp Decapitation stacks on a priority target with killua1 (CD0) + killua2, then detonate with killua3 for a barrier/shield-ignoring Affliction burst.
Use killua3's execute (HP <= 20) to guarantee-kill softened or low-HP targets regardless of remaining defenses.
Chip a single target down with DR-ignoring Piercing (buffed to 25/30) while the stun from killua2 denies a key enemy turn.
internal_synergies: killua1's +10 self damage_mod buffs both killua1 (25) and killua2 (30) for 2 turns - cast it first each ramp window.
killua1 (CD0) and killua2 both apply Decapitation stacks that feed killua3's per-stack detonation - the whole offense is one closed loop.
Piercing direct damage (killua1/killua2) drops a target toward the 20-HP threshold so killua3's detonation + execute_attempt finishes them even on a low stack count.
killua4 invuln lets him survive to complete a ramp/detonation cycle against burst threats.
strengths: Excellent defensive-stat penetration: all offense is Piercing (skips flat+%DR) or Affliction detonation (bypasses barriers/shields/DR), so tanks and shield-stackers are weak against him.
Built-in execute (HP <= 20) gives reliable closing power and snowball potential.
Very fast cooldowns (killua1 CD0, killua2/killua3 CD1) for a near-every-turn mark-and-detonate cadence.
Cheap kit (5 total pips) with a single 0-cooldown mark engine.
Self-invulnerability panic button for survivability.
Hard single-target stun for tempo denial.
weaknesses: Strictly single-target; zero AoE and no team utility (no heal/shield/cleanse/support).
Heavy mono-Green color dependency - 3 Green pips needed; Green-screwed turns cripple him.
Detonation burst requires setup turns to ramp stacks; against burst/cleanse he can be raced or have his payoff window denied.
Marks deal no passive per-turn damage - all value is back-loaded onto the detonation cast, so a mistimed/interrupted detonation wastes the ramp.
killua4 is his only defensive tool on a long 4-turn cooldown.
No energy denial, no transformation, no counter beyond the single invuln.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, focused single-target assassin with strong defensive-stat bypass (Piercing + Affliction), a fast 0-cooldown mark engine, hard stun, a real execute, and a panic-button invuln - all for a cheap 5-pip kit. That makes him a reliable tank-buster and finisher. He is held back from top tier by being purely single-target with no AoE or team support, his back-loaded detonation requiring ramp turns, and a punishing mono-Green color dependency. Solid, well-rounded duelist; effective but not oppressive in isolation.
outlier_flags: uncapped detonation scaling (15 x unlimited stacks) bounded mainly by ramp turns
killua1 0-cooldown free mark application could over-enable detonation cadence
Affliction detonation fully ignores all defensive layers

abilities.name: Chastifold: Sunflower
abilities.conditional_scaling: 35 damage instead of 15 when Empowered (King marked by True Spirit Spear Chastifold). Only targets enemies NOT currently affected by Disaster.
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable single-target nuke (cd0, 1 Red pip). 15 base / 35 Empowered. Each hit triggers Disaster passive -> +10 Bleed next turn on the target if damage lands.

abilities.name: Chastifold: Increase
abilities.conditional_scaling: When Empowered: 10 Piercing per turn instead of 5 Normal. Applies a 3-turn ticking damage effect to all enemies (instant hit + DoT).
abilities.effects_summary: AoE DoT: 5 dmg/turn (Normal) for 3 turns to all enemies; Empowered -> 10 Piercing/turn for 3 turns. Each non-Bleed tick also feeds Disaster -> +10 Bleed follow-up when active.

abilities.name: True Spirit Spear Chastifold
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (enables Empowered state which scales king1/king2/king4)
abilities.effects_summary: Transformation/setup: 4 turns, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill is hit with a trigger dealing 10 Bleed next turn (Disaster counter). Empowers King's whole kit (mark dur 7). Swaps slot 3 -> king5 Pollen Garden. Functions as a counter/punish + panic button (custom_behavior panic_button 140).

abilities.name: Chastifold: Guardian
abilities.conditional_scaling: When Empowered: grants a 1-turn invisible Reflect (returns next Harmful skill) instead of the shield.
abilities.effects_summary: Single-ally protection: 20 Shield for 1 turn (dur 2). Empowered -> invisible Reflect effect that bounces the next Harmful skill received (1 turn).

abilities.name: Chastifold: Pollen Garden
abilities.conditional_scaling: Re-triggers a second time if the ally does not act on the following turn (free extra invuln + 15 heal).
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap target (post-True Spirit Spear). Heals all allies 15 HP + Invulnerable for 1 turn; ticking trigger repeats the 15 heal + invuln if that ally stays idle next turn. Strong team-wide stall/protect.

abilities.name: Disaster
abilities.conditional_scaling: Triggers on every non-Bleed damage instance King deals; does NOT trigger if the damage is absorbed/prevented (shield/invuln/DR fully blocks).
abilities.effects_summary: Passive: any enemy taking non-Bleed damage from King takes 10 Bleed next turn. Converts every King hit into +10 Bleed; pairs with king2 AoE DoT for stacked Bleed across the enemy team. Bleed bypasses shields/barriers.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Empowered king1 (35) + Disaster follow-up (10 Bleed) = 45 to one target across the turn/next-turn window. AoE: Empowered king2 puts 10 Piercing/turn x 3 turns on all enemies, each Piercing tick also adds 10 Bleed via Disaster -> ~20/turn per enemy sustained on the whole team. No infinite/stack-based scaling; ceiling is fixed by Empowered numbers.
damage_profile.notes: Single-turn raw is modest. Real output is the DoT engine: king2 (3-turn ticking) x Disaster (10 Bleed per non-Bleed hit) x AoE = team-wide ~20 effective dmg/turn/enemy while Empowered, and Bleed bypasses shields. Peak single-target counts the 35 Empowered Sunflower plus its 10 Bleed rider.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate. Visible kit (king1-4) costs Red:1 + Blue:1 + (Blue:1,Red:1) + Random:1 = 2 Blue, 2 Red, 2 Random. Genuinely two-color (Blue/Red) dependent; no White/Green. After transforming, slot 3 becomes Pollen Garden (Blue:1), shifting demand slightly Blue.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Low-cost spammable opener (king1 cd0), two cd2 utility/AoE skills, and one big cd6 setup (True Spirit Spear). Tempo is comfortable: King can attack every turn while rotating shields/AoE; the cd6 transform is the only long cooldown.
economy.ramp_dependency: Medium. Kit is functional from turn 1 but roughly doubles in value once True Spirit Spear is up (Empowered 35 nuke, 10 Piercing AoE, Reflect, Disaster counter, Pollen Garden swap). Wants to land Empowered window to peak.

invuln_or_counter: Pollen Garden: AoE Invulnerable + heal (re-triggers on idle)
True Spirit Spear: Disaster counter (10 Bleed on any enemy that uses a Harmful skill, 4 turns)
Guardian (Empowered): invisible Reflect of next Harmful skill

internal_synergies: Disaster passive converts EVERY non-Bleed hit into +10 Bleed next turn; king2 AoE DoT therefore plants Bleed on the whole enemy team each tick.
True Spirit Spear simultaneously Empowers (35 nuke / 10 Piercing AoE), arms the Disaster harmful-use counter, and unlocks Pollen Garden — a single button that flips offense and defense.
Empowered king2 becomes Piercing, so its ticks bypass flat/%DR and still feed Disaster Bleed (which bypasses shields) — very hard to mitigate combined chip.
Pollen Garden's idle-retrigger rewards a defensive/stall turn with a second invuln+heal, synergizing with King's low need to act (king1 is cd0 but optional).
Guardian Reflect + Disaster counter both punish enemies for using Harmful skills, creating a deterrence/anti-aggro shell around the team.
role: AoE Bleed/DoT controller and defensive team-support with a counter/transformation window
signature_mechanic: Disaster: King's hits inflict delayed Bleed (10/turn, bypasses shields), and True Spirit Spear weaponizes it into a team-wide counter while Empowering the rest of the kit and unlocking AoE invuln/heal (Pollen Garden).
strengths: Persistent, mitigation-resistant team-wide damage: AoE DoT + Disaster Bleed stack on every enemy and bypass shields/barriers (Bleed) and DR (Empowered Piercing).
Excellent defensive toolkit for a damage dealer: 20 shield, AoE invuln+heal with idle-retrigger, invisible Reflect, and a 4-turn harmful-use counter.
Cheap, flexible economy (6 total pips, 2 random) with a cd0 spammable attack — strong tempo and low energy strain.
Self-sufficient transformation (no external setup) that upgrades the whole kit and adds proactive enemy punishment.
Good vs aggressive/burst comps — Pollen Garden invuln + Guardian Reflect + Disaster counter heavily tax opponents for attacking.
weaknesses: Low burst: highest single-turn single-target is ~45 incl. Bleed rider; cannot quickly delete a threat or close out before DoTs tick.
No hard CC (no stun/lock) — purely damage-over-time and protection; struggles to stop a committed enemy nuke turn.
Disaster Bleed is suppressed entirely if the initiating damage is absorbed/prevented, so enemy shields/invuln/DR can shut off his main scaling.
Power is heavily back-loaded behind a cd6 transform; pre-Empowered numbers (15 nuke, 5/turn AoE) are weak.
Two-color (Blue+Red) requirement and reliance on DoTs make him slow vs heavy-sustain/healing or cleanse comps that wipe Bleed.
win_conditions: Out-attrition the enemy team with stacked AoE DoT + Disaster Bleed while keeping allies alive via Pollen Garden and shields.
Land the True Spirit Spear Empowered window to threaten Piercing AoE + Bleed that ignores most mitigation, then stall to victory.
Punish an aggressive enemy into a stalemate they can't break (Reflect + invuln + harmful-use counter) while chip damage grinds them down.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded attrition/support hybrid with an unusually deep defensive kit for a damage dealer. The Disaster + AoE DoT engine produces relentless, hard-to-mitigate team-wide damage (Bleed bypasses shields; Empowered ticks are Piercing), and the defensive layer (AoE invuln+heal, 20 shield, invisible Reflect, harmful-use counter) makes him very durable and team-friendly. Held back from top tier by low burst, zero hard CC, back-loaded power behind a cd6 transform, and the fact that his Bleed scaling is fully negated when the initial hit is absorbed/prevented. Strong in grindy/defensive metas, mediocre against burst-it-down or heavy-cleanse comps. Rated in isolation.
outlier_flags: Disaster passive double-dips on AoE: a single king2 cast can plant Bleed on the entire enemy team via the damage-dealt trigger — potentially strong vs wide enemy teams and worth a balance look.
king2 execute applies BOTH an instant hit and a 3-turn ticking damage_effect each cast; verify it isn't unintentionally double-counting the first tick.
Empowered window grants Piercing AoE + invisible Reflect + AoE invuln simultaneously, which is a lot of value loaded onto one cd6 button.

abilities.name: Slicing Water Waves
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat 15 on hit + permanent 15/turn Piercing DoT while channel holds)
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Piercing on cast, then applies a permanent (dur -1) channeled Piercing DoT dealing 15/turn. Channel cancels if Katara uses another skill or is stunned. Piercing bypasses flat and % DR (not barriers).

abilities.name: Ice Deflection
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self reflect-receive buff for 1 turn (dur 2): single-target Harmful skills aimed at Katara are redirected back at their caster (erases her from targets, appends attacker). Invisible buff, counter-timeout wrapup. Does NOT interrupt active Channeling, so it can be cast while kitara1 ticks.

abilities.name: Soothing Water
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Heals target ally for 35 HP and cleanses all hostile Affliction effects from them (Affliction-only cleanse, not all debuffs).

abilities.name: Ice Barrier
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: self Invulnerable for 1 turn (invuln_effect dur 2). Total damage immunity panic button on a 4-turn cooldown.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Flat and non-scaling. No stacking — recasting Slicing Water Waves refreshes one DoT rather than stacking. Real damage ceiling is the permanent 15/turn Piercing tick (ignores flat+%DR), but the channel breaks the moment she does anything else, so sustained DoT competes with using her support/defensive kit.
damage_profile.notes: Turn 1 cast = 15 immediate Piercing + 15 DoT scheduled = ~30 effective single-target that turn. Thereafter 15 Piercing/turn for as long as she channels and is not stunned. No AoE anywhere in the kit. All offense is Piercing (skips flat+%DR, not barriers).

economy.color_dependency: Light Blue dependency: 3 of 6 visible pips are Blue (kitara1, kitara2, kitara3 each need 1 Blue). kitara4 is fully flexible (1 Random). Single-color identity (character_colors=[1], Blue).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast on offense (kitara1 cd 1, effectively always available), medium on utility (kitara2 and kitara3 cd 2), slow on the invuln panic button (kitara4 cd 4). Cheap kit overall (1-2 pips each).
economy.ramp_dependency: Low. No stacks or transformation to build. The only 'ramp' is letting the channel DoT sit, which is passive and free but locks her out of acting.

invuln_or_counter: Ice Barrier: self Invulnerable 1 turn (cd 4)
Ice Deflection: reflects single-target Harmful skills back at caster for 1 turn (cd 2)

role: Single-target support/sustainer with a channeled Piercing DoT and strong self-protection (reflect + invuln)
signature_mechanic: Permanent channeled Piercing DoT (Slicing Water Waves) that ticks 15/turn forever and ignores flat/%DR — but breaks if she does anything else or is stunned — paired with a reflect buff explicitly designed to keep channeling while she defends.
internal_synergies: Ice Deflection (kitara2) is hard-wired to NOT interrupt Channeling, so she can keep the Slicing Water Waves DoT running while reflecting incoming single-target attacks — the kit's one deliberate combo.

Slicing Water Waves channel provides free passive pressure while she spends her actual turns supporting, letting one character contribute damage + support simultaneously — but only kitara2 preserves the channel; kitara3 and kitara4 break it.
Reflect (kitara2) plus Invuln (kitara4) give her two staggered defensive cooldowns to survive focus while the DoT does the work.
win_conditions: Establish the permanent Slicing Water Waves DoT early and protect the channel with Ice Deflection so it ticks 15 Piercing/turn over a long game.
Out-sustain the enemy: keep a key ally alive with 35 HP heals + Affliction cleanse while the passive DoT grinds a target down.
Survive burst windows with Ice Barrier (invuln) and bounce single-target assassins back onto themselves with Ice Deflection.
strengths: Permanent Piercing DoT bypasses flat and % damage reduction, providing reliable un-mitigated chip every turn for zero ongoing cost.
Extremely cheap, low-cooldown kit (kitara1 cd 1, all abilities 1-2 pips) — easy to slot energy-wise with only a Blue commitment.
Two distinct survival tools: a single-target reflect (turns assassins' burst against them) and a full 1-turn invulnerability.
Real healing + dedicated Affliction cleanse make her a genuine support, not just a damage stick.
Ice Deflection's channel-preserving design lets her defend and deal DoT damage in the same turn.
weaknesses: Zero AoE — all output and reflect are strictly single-target; useless for clearing wide threats or area DoT teams.
Fragile damage identity: the channel DoT cancels the instant she heals, defends (kitara4), or is stunned, so her sustained damage and her support/defense compete for the same turns.
Highly stun-vulnerable — a single stun both wastes her turn and kills her permanent DoT.
Low burst (peak ~30 one-turn) and no scaling/ramp/transformation — damage never grows, so she loses damage races against scaling carries.
Reflect only catches SINGLE-target Harmful skills; AoE attacks and non-targeted effects punch straight through.
Heal is modest (35), single-target, with no shields/barriers, so against heavy AoE pressure her support throughput is limited.
No energy denial, no hard CC, no offensive control — she cannot proactively shut anyone down.

power_assessment.reasoning: A solid, well-rounded but unspectacular support/sustainer. Her permanent Piercing DoT (15/turn, ignores flat+%DR) is mechanically strong as free passive chip, and the kit is cheap with great cooldowns. Two layered defensive tools (single-target reflect + 1-turn invuln) plus a 35 heal with Affliction cleanse make her durable and team-useful. But she is held back by hard tension in her own design: the channel breaks whenever she heals, defends with Ice Barrier, or is stunned, so her DoT and her support/defense can't both run except via the one Ice-Deflection combo. No AoE, no scaling, low burst (~30 peak), and severe stun vulnerability cap her ceiling. She is a flexible role-player that struggles to ever be the best answer to anything — middle of the pack.
outlier_flags: Permanent (dur -1) DoT that ignores flat+%DR is unusually persistent value for a 1-pip, cd-1 skill, but is gated by the fragile channel.
Self-tension outlier: three of her four abilities (heal, invuln, and stun-vulnerability) cancel her own primary damage source; only kitara2 is channel-safe.

role: Team-support / protection enabler with a 0-cooldown single-target poke that converts into bypassing AoE
signature_mechanic: Rotating field-wide class-invulnerability (Hard Lessons) layered with Pitch Black to turn the spammable 0-cooldown Impossible Speed poke into a bypassing multi-mark AoE nuke, while the Class Is In Session passive shields/heals allies who play defensively.

abilities.name: Hard Lessons
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: For 4 turns (ticking trigger dur 7), EVERY living/un-banished character on the field (allies AND enemies) gains Invulnerability to one random skill class for 1 turn (invuln dur 3). The class (Physical/Mental/Energy/Affliction) rotates each turn through the not-yet-chosen classes. Also enables Impossible Speed's bonus Class Is In Session proc. Because it protects enemies too, it is a field-wide defensive/denial coin-flip rather than pure ally protection.

abilities.name: Impossible Speed
abilities.target_type: SINGLE (AoE on all Pitch Black marks while Pitch Black active)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Under Pitch Black: also fires at every Pitch Black-marked enemy (scales with number of marks) and bypasses invuln. During Hard Lessons: adds a random Class Is In Session proc (heal 10 or 10 shield) to a random ally each cast.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal damage to one enemy, cooldown 0 so castable every turn. During Hard Lessons, a random ally gets a random Class Is In Session effect (50% heal 10 HP / 50% 10 Shield for 1 turn). During Pitch Black, marks the target with a Pitch Black mark and also hits all currently Pitch Black-marked enemies (becomes repeating AoE), bypassing/ignoring class invulnerability.

abilities.name: Protective Molting
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Places a 1-turn (HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER dur 2) reactive shield on another ally: if they receive a new Harmful skill, cleanse ALL enemy effects from them and heal 25 HP. After it triggers, Koro gets a cost-change effect making Pitch Black free next turn. Strong counter-burst/cleanse protection plus ramp into Pitch Black.

abilities.name: Pitch Black
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enables Impossible Speed's bypass + mark + AoE-on-marks behavior; damage scales with how many marks accumulate.
abilities.effects_summary: For 4 turns (mark dur 9 on self), Impossible Speed bypasses invuln and marks its targets for the rest of Pitch Black; while active, each Impossible Speed also re-hits every marked target, snowballing 20-dmg hits across multiple enemies. Pure setup/transformation of the basic attack into bypassing AoE.

abilities.name: Class Is In Session!
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent passive (dur -1) on every ally: an ally who ends their turn without using a new skill gains 10 Shield for 1 turn; whenever an ally is stunned, they heal 10 HP. Rewards passive/defensive play and partially offsets enemy stun pressure. Also the source of the random heal/shield proc fired by Impossible Speed during Hard Lessons.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Impossible Speed is only 20 Normal/turn single-target, but under Pitch Black it re-hits every accumulated mark each cast. With N Pitch-Black-marked enemies it deals 20*N per turn (bypassing invuln). Practically capped by enemy count (3 enemies -> ~60/turn) and the 4-turn Pitch Black window; no per-stack damage growth beyond mark count.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Normal (subject to DR/shields) EXCEPT while Pitch Black is up, when Impossible Speed bypasses invuln. Peak single-target is just 20/turn (one cast). Peak AoE shown as 40 = a single Impossible Speed hitting 2 marked enemies; scales to ~60 vs 3 marks. No Affliction/Bleed/True/Piercing damage in the kit.

economy.color_dependency: Heavily Green-dependent: 3 of 4 visible skills are Green-only (1+1+2 Green pips); only Protective Molting uses 2 random. Strong single-color (Green) commitment.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Low-cost, fast tempo. Impossible Speed has cooldown 0 (spammable every turn); Pitch Black cd3, Hard Lessons cd4, Protective Molting cd4. Core poke is always available; setup skills gate on cooldown.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Real value requires sequencing Pitch Black (for AoE/bypass) and Hard Lessons (for invuln + ally procs). Protective Molting ramps Pitch Black to free, smoothing the loop, but the kit functions at a basic level without ramp.

invuln_or_counter: Hard Lessons: rotating per-class invulnerability field-wide for 4 turns
Protective Molting: reactive cleanse + 25 heal on next harmful hit (counter-style protection)

win_conditions: Stall and out-sustain with field-wide rotating invuln + passive shields/heals while chipping with the free 20-dmg poke
Set up Pitch Black, mark multiple enemies, then spam Impossible Speed as a bypassing AoE to grind the whole enemy team
Protect a key carry with Protective Molting (cleanse + heal) and let allies snowball
internal_synergies: Pitch Black -> Impossible Speed: converts the 0-cd poke into a bypassing, multi-mark AoE
Hard Lessons -> Impossible Speed: each cast adds a random ally heal/shield via Class Is In Session
Protective Molting trigger -> free Pitch Black next turn (ramp into AoE window)
Class Is In Session passive rewards allies for passing/defensive play, synergizing with Hard Lessons' invuln turtle plan
Class Is In Session stun-heal partly counters enemy stun pressure that would otherwise lock the team
strengths: Extremely cheap kit (6 pips total) with a free, always-available 20-dmg attack
Strong layered defense: rotating field invuln, reactive cleanse+heal, passive shields and stun-heals
Cleanse is rare and valuable; Protective Molting also fully strips enemy effects
Pitch Black gives bypass + scalable AoE, addressing both invuln walls and multi-target pressure
Good ramp loop (Molting -> free Pitch Black) and low cooldowns keep tempo high
weaknesses: Hard Lessons protects ENEMIES too and the protected class is random — can backfire by shielding the enemy from your team's damage type that turn
Low raw damage: 20 Normal/turn baseline, AoE only after multi-turn Pitch Black setup and requires multiple marked enemies
No hard CC, no energy denial, no stealth — purely reactive/defensive
Self-targeted, low-impact if forced to act under pressure without setup; value is back-loaded behind sequencing
Random effects (invuln class, heal-vs-shield proc) add variance and reduce reliability
All non-Pitch-Black damage is plain Normal, fully blocked by enemy shields/DR/invuln

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, cheap support/control character with excellent defensive layering (rotating invuln, cleanse, reactive heal, passive shields/stun-heal) and a flexible free poke that scales into bypassing AoE via Pitch Black. However, raw damage is low and back-loaded behind multi-turn setup, it has no hard CC or energy denial, and Hard Lessons notably also protects enemies and is random, capping its ceiling and reliability. Solid team-fight glue and a strong stall/grind enabler rather than a standalone carry — middle-of-the-pack power pending roster recalibration.
outlier_flags: Hard Lessons applies invulnerability to ALL characters including enemies (potential design footgun / can shield enemy team)
Impossible Speed cooldown 0 + Pitch Black makes it a repeating bypassing AoE — efficient-damage outlier if many enemies are marked
Class Is In Session passive applies permanently (dur -1) to every ally, a strong always-on team buff for nearly free

role: Adaptive four-element controller/counter-toolbox with stance-swap attacks and a once-per-game Avatar transformation
signature_mechanic: Four invisible 1-pip elemental "Control" counter stances (slots 1-4), each countering one damage/skill class and swapping itself into a matching elemental attack (Fire Fist / Air Wave / Earth Area Attack / Water Arm Stun). Using 5 skills of one element triggers a once-per-game 4-turn Avatar State (element-dependent buff) that further upgrades Earth/Water Control slots into Energybending and Gate Open.

abilities.name: Fire Control
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (AI weights by enemy Affliction-skill count x45)
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible counter: counters the first Affliction-class skill the target enemy uses (dur 2 = 1 enemy turn). Self-swaps slot 1 to 'Fire Fist'. Counts toward Fire element tally for Avatar State.

abilities.name: Air Control
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible counter: counters the first Mental-class skill the target enemy uses (dur 2). Self-swaps slot 2 to 'Air Wave'. Counts toward Air element tally.

abilities.name: Earth Control
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible counter: counters the first Physical-class skill the target enemy uses (dur 2). Self-swaps slot 3 to 'Earth Area Attack'. Counts toward Earth tally. In Avatar State this slot is replaced by Energybending.

abilities.name: Water Control
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible counter: counters the first Energy-class skill the target enemy uses (dur 2). Self-swaps slot 4 to 'Water Arm Stun'. Counts toward Water tally. In Avatar State this slot is replaced by Gate Open.

abilities.name: Fire Fist
abilities.conditional_scaling: Applies Affliction vulnerability +10, so a follow-up Affliction hit effectively +10. Bypasses shields/barriers/DR (Affliction).
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Affliction damage (ignores barriers/shields/DR) + Affliction vulnerability +10 for 1 turn on target. Swapped form of Fire Control; counts as Fire.

abilities.name: Air Wave
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies (skips flat+%DR) + each enemy's skills cost +1 random energy for 1 turn (dur 2). Soft energy denial. Swapped form of Air Control; counts as Air.

abilities.name: Earth Area Attack
abilities.conditional_scaling: Destroys ALL enemy shields before damage, so effective damage vs shielded teams is far higher than face value.
abilities.effects_summary: Shatters all enemy shields, then 40 Normal to main target + 20 Normal to all other enemies. Swapped form of Earth Control; counts as Earth.

abilities.name: Water Arm Stun
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT stacks: 15 on cast + 15/turn for 2 turns = up to 45 total over the window.
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Normal on cast + 15 Normal/turn DoT for 2 turns + stuns all non-Mental skills for 2 turns (stun dur 4). Self lock: cannot be recast while a target is affected. Swapped form of Water Control; counts as Water.

abilities.name: Energybending
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: On enemy: permanent, uncleansable Silence. On ally: permanent, uncleansable ignore-enemy-non-damage-effects buff. Cannot re-target an affected character. Avatar-State upgrade replacing Earth Control slot; also a base hidden alt.

abilities.name: Gate Open
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 40 Piercing to entire enemy team (skips flat+%DR) + for 2 turns the next skill each enemy uses is delayed 8 turns (heavy tempo denial). Avatar-State upgrade replacing Water Control slot. Needs one pip of all four colors.

abilities.name: Korra Avatar State
abilities.conditional_scaling: Ramp: tallies same-element uses (Control + its swapped attack both count). At 5 of one element, fires once per game.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive tracker. 5 uses of one element -> 4-turn (dur 8) Avatar State: Fire = reflect 10 Affliction to any enemy who uses a new skill on Korra; Earth = +40 permanent Shield; Water = +20 Damage Reduction; Air = ignore all non-damage Harmful effects. On activation, swaps Earth Control->Energybending and Water Control->Gate Open and changes portrait. Once per game only.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Modest. Single-target peak ~45 (Fire Fist 25 Affliction with its +10 Affliction vuln realized on a same-turn second Affliction hit, or Earth 40 to main target). AoE peak 60 (Earth Area Attack 40 main + 20 splash). Gate Open (Avatar-only) is 40 Piercing to the whole team = 120+ across a 3-enemy team but gated behind transformation, 4 colors, and an 8-turn cooldown. No per-stack/per-kill multiplicative scaling; damage is flat. Real ceiling is control/denial value, not raw damage.
damage_profile.notes: Affliction (Fire Fist) and Piercing (Air Wave, Gate Open) damage is effective vs tanky/shielded teams; Earth Area Attack actively shatters shields first. Water Arm Stun adds a 15/turn DoT (Normal, mitigable). Damage is intentionally low because the kit pays in control, counters, energy denial, and a transformation. Earth main-target hit is 40 Normal (after shield-shatter).

economy.color_dependency: Visible attack forms each lean on a single specific color: Fire Fist=Red, Air Wave=White, Earth Area Attack=Green:2, Water Arm Stun=Blue. The Control stances (slots 1-4) are pure 1 Random each, so the opening rotation is color-agnostic and very cheap. Color demand only appears once stances swap into attacks; Earth needs 2 Green (heaviest single-color demand). Gate Open (Avatar) is the only ability needing all four colors at once.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Control stances are 2-cd but swap to 0-cd attacks, enabling a Control->attack->Control rhythm. Attack forms are 0-cooldown so can be repeated freely once unlocked, gated only by re-arming the stance and energy. Energybending 1-cd, Gate Open 8-cd. Overall fast/flexible tempo with one long-cd nuke.
economy.ramp_dependency: Two layers: (1) per-target you must spend a 1-pip Control stance before the matching attack is available (1-turn ramp per element); (2) Avatar State requires 5 same-element uses, a once-per-game ramp rewarding element commitment. The strongest tools (Energybending, Gate Open as slot upgrades) are gated behind that transformation, though Energybending is also a base hidden alt.

hard_cc: Water Arm Stun: stun non-Mental skills 2 turns
Energybending: permanent uncleansable Silence (enemy)
Gate Open: delays next enemy skill 8 turns (Avatar-only)
soft_cc: Air Wave: +1 random energy to all enemy skill costs for 1 turn (tempo tax)
invuln_or_counter: Fire/Air/Earth/Water Control: class-specific counter stances
Air Avatar State: ignore all non-damage Harmful effects 4 turns
Fire Avatar State: reflect 10 Affliction to attackers 4 turns
Energybending (ally): permanent ignore enemy non-damage effects

power_assessment.reasoning: Korra is an exceptionally deep, flexible toolbox: four 1-pip invisible counter stances cover every damage/skill class, each unlocking a 0-cd attack with a relevant rider (Affliction vuln, energy tax + Piercing AoE, shield-shatter splash, stun + DoT). Damage numbers are modest, but the value is in adaptive control, Piercing/Affliction that ignore mitigation, shield destruction, and strong denial (permanent uncleansable Silence via Energybending; team-wide 8-turn delay via Gate Open). The once-per-game Avatar State gives a meaningful power spike and upgrades two slots into premium tools. Cheap, color-light opening and 0-cd attacks make her tempo-positive. She rates high for versatility and matchup coverage; held back from elite because raw damage is low, the best payoffs are ramp/transformation-gated, attacks require pre-spending a stance, and the counters are single-class/single-enemy and only last 1 turn.
outlier_flags: permanent_uncleansable_silence (Energybending) is a rare hard-lock effect
shield_shatter_aoe (Earth Area Attack) hard-counters shield/barrier teams
11_abilities_with_stance_swaps makes effective kit much wider than the 4 visible slots
8-turn_skill_delay (Gate Open) is extreme tempo-denial, though Avatar-gated and 8-cd
two_independent_piercing/affliction_sources bypass most defensive stats

strengths: Universal matchup coverage: a counter stance for every damage/skill class (Affliction/Mental/Physical/Energy)
Very cheap, color-agnostic opening (four 1-Random stances) keeps her tempo-positive and easy to fuel
Multiple mitigation-bypassing sources: Affliction (Fire Fist), Piercing AoE (Air Wave, Gate Open), and explicit shield-shatter (Earth Area Attack)
Strong denial suite: permanent uncleansable Silence, non-Mental stun + DoT, energy-cost tax, and an 8-turn skill delay
Once-per-game Avatar State gives a defensive/offensive spike AND upgrades two slots to premium tools (Energybending, Gate Open)
0-cooldown attack forms allow repeated pressure once a stance is armed
Self-sustain options without a healer: +40 permanent shield (Earth) or +20 DR (Water) from Avatar State
weaknesses: Low raw damage ceiling (single-target ~25-45, AoE ~60) outside the Avatar nuke
Two-step tempo cost vs a fresh target: must spend a 1-pip Control stance before its attack is usable, so first damage is a turn slower
Counters are narrow: single target, single class, only last 1 enemy turn, and whiff entirely if the enemy doesn't use that class that turn
Best tools (Gate Open, slot-upgraded Energybending) are gated behind a once-per-game 5-stack ramp; a forced wrong element may give a suboptimal Avatar buff
Gate Open demands all four energy colors simultaneously plus an 8-turn cooldown
No healing and no cleanse for allies
Element commitment for Avatar State conflicts with using the best stance reactively each turn (ramp vs flexibility tension)
win_conditions: Out-tempo and out-flex the opponent: counter their key class each turn while chipping with the matching attack form
Stack one element to 5 to trigger Avatar State, then leverage Energybending (permanent silence on a key threat) and Gate Open (team-wide 8-turn delay + 40 Piercing) to lock the enemy out
Hard-counter shield/barrier or tank comps via Earth Area Attack (shield shatter) plus Piercing/Affliction damage that ignores mitigation
Permanently Silence the enemy's most dangerous caster early with Energybending and grind out the disabled opponent
internal_synergies: Each Control stance directly enables its attack form (Fire Control->Fire Fist, etc.) — the core swap loop
Both a Control use AND its swapped attack count toward the same element tally, accelerating Avatar State if you commit to one element
Fire Fist's Affliction vulnerability +10 amplifies a repeat Fire Fist / Fire Avatar reflect chip
Avatar State swaps Earth/Water Control slots into Energybending and Gate Open, so the ramp both buffs Korra and upgrades her action bar
Air Wave's energy tax + broad counter coverage compound enemy tempo loss; Gate Open's delay layers on top for full lockout
Earth Area Attack shatters shields right before Korra's Piercing/Affliction tools land, maximizing effective damage against defensive teams

role: single-target lockdown assassin / energy-denial controller
signature_mechanic: Chain Jail (mark + non-Mental stun) sets up Judgement Chain, a permanent unremovable death sentence: the marked enemy is hunted until Kurapika dies; if it uses 3 new skills it is instantly killed, and every turn it does NOT use a new skill it takes 10 Affliction damage and loses 1 energy — a lose-lose lock that punishes both acting and stalling.

abilities.name: Bokken Smash
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 damage (40 total) while Scarlet Eyes is active via a damage_mod_effect targeting 'Bokken Smash'
abilities.effects_summary: Shatters ALL of one enemy's Shield (shatter_shields) then deals 30 Normal damage (40 with Scarlet Eyes up). No cooldown spammable anti-shield basic attack.

abilities.name: Chain Jail
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Normal damage; applies a stun on all non-Mental skills + the Judgement Chain mark (stun_effect dur 3 = 1 turn). Swaps user's slot 1 to Judgement Chain for 1 turn (ability_swap_effect dur 3). The setup half of the combo; the swap window is the only time Judgement Chain is castable.

abilities.name: Holy Chain
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Targets self or an ally: cleanse_all_enemy_effects (full cleanse of all enemy harmful effects) AND heals 35 HP. Strong single-target cleanse+heal support tool.

abilities.name: Scarlet Eyes
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enables the +10 Bokken Smash damage buff while active
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff: ignore_damage_effect(-1, ability_only, full_remove_once_triggered) so Kurapika ignores the next instance of new enemy damage. abilities.name: Judgement Chain
abilities.conditional_scaling: Instant-kill if the marked target uses 3 new skills (counter decrements per ACTION_USE_TRIGGER); 10 Affliction + 1 energy drain each turn the target does NOT act
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt unlocked by Chain Jail's swap. On the Chain-Jail-marked enemy: applies two permanent (dur -1, until Kurapika dies) unremovable triggers. ACTION_USE_TRIGGER counts new skills (mag 3) -> instant_kill on the 3rd. END_OF_TURN_TRIGGER: if the target did NOT act, deal 10 Affliction (bypasses shields/barriers/DR) and lose_energy (1 pip). Lose-lose lockdown + execute. Cannot be recast while active; unremovable.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Direct numbers are tiny (Bokken Smash 40 cap with Scarlet Eyes, Chain Jail 15, Judgement tick 10). The real ceiling is binary: Judgement Chain instant-kills any HP-pool target if it uses 3 new skills, or whittles ~10 Affliction/turn while energy-starving it. Effective DPS is execution-based, not number-based.
damage_profile.notes: No AoE in the entire kit; every offensive ability is single-target. Judgement Chain's 10 dmg is Affliction so it bypasses shields/barriers/DR. Energy drain (1 pip/turn the target idles) is a soft form of damage that cripples enemy tempo. Peak burst is just 40 from a buffed Bokken Smash.

economy.color_dependency: Spread across Green/White/Red (all three of its colors) plus Random, but only 1 specific pip per color at a time — low single-color dependency, flexible. Red is only needed for the hidden Judgement Chain. Visible kit specific pips: 1 Green (Chain Jail) + 1 White (Holy Chain); the rest Random.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Cheap and fast: Bokken Smash 0 CD spammable, Chain Jail 2 CD, Holy Chain 2 CD, Scarlet Eyes 3 CD. Combo cadence is gated by Chain Jail's 2-turn cooldown and the 1-turn swap window to fire Judgement Chain.
economy.ramp_dependency: Combo-gated rather than ramp-gated: must land Chain Jail to unlock/cast Judgement Chain, then Kurapika must survive (the chain lasts 'until Kurapika dies'). Payoff scales over many turns as the target either feeds the 3-skill execute or bleeds Affliction + energy.

power_assessment.reasoning: A specialist single-target lockdown/assassin with an unusually punishing signature: Judgement Chain is permanent, unremovable, and creates a true lose-lose — the marked enemy is instant-killed after 3 new skills or bleeds 10 Affliction (shield/DR-ignoring) plus 1 energy per idle turn. That is a hard answer to high-value combo/setup carries and a strong energy-denial vector. The kit is also self-sufficient: a 0-CD anti-shield basic (Bokken Smash, 30->40), a full cleanse+35 heal (Holy Chain), and a one-shot damage-ignore + stealth self-save (Scarlet Eyes). Costs are cheap (6 visible pips) and color-flexible. Ceilings on raw damage are very low and there is zero AoE, so it is weak into wide boards and races. Biggest fragilities: the entire payoff hinges on landing Chain Jail (1 Green, 2 CD) into the right target and then KEEPING Kurapika alive, since Judgement Chain ends if he dies and he has no self-shield/heal-on-self beyond one cleanse and one damage-ignore. Against a smart opponent the chain can be partly neutralized by simply not using 3 new skills (eating the 10/turn) or by bursting Kurapika down. Strong, high-skill-cap control piece rather than a raw stat outlier.

abilities.name: Tactical Teleport
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true scaling. Damage is fixed: Teleporting Strike caps at 35 Normal (with Judgement Throw mark), Needle Pin caps at 20 Piercing (with Teleporting Strike mark), Judgement Throw flat 20 Normal. Across a multi-turn combo loop she lands roughly 20-35 per turn plus heavy control; no per-stack/per-kill growth.
damage_profile.notes: Entirely single-target, no AoE anywhere in the kit. One-turn peak is 35 Normal from a Judgement-Throw-marked Teleporting Strike. Real value is the rotation: turn 1 Judgement Throw (20+Silence) -> turn 2 Teleporting Strike (35+self-invuln) -> turn 3 Needle Pin (Shatter+20 Piercing bypass+Isolate). Needle Pin->Teleporting Strike gives a free (cooldown-0) recast for an extra 20-35 in a turn. Damage is modest; control/denial is the point.

economy.ramp_dependency: None (no stacks/ramp). She has a sequencing dependency instead: each skill self-applies a 1-turn mark that buffs the OTHER two next turn, so optimal output requires planning a 2-3 turn order, but there is no long-term ramp to build.

power_assessment.reasoning: A low-cost, fast, evasive single-target harasser with an unusually deep control/denial toolkit for a 1-pip kit: Silence, conditional Stun, Shatter (anti-shield), Isolate (anti-heal/support), and energy drain, plus two sources of self-invulnerability (one of them every other turn via cd1 Teleporting Strike). She's cheap (4 total pips, only 2 specific colors), funds easily, and runs her full rotation nearly every turn. The catch is damage: peak is only 35 single-target in a turn, no AoE, no DoT, no scaling, and her best effects are all gated behind self-marks that require setting up the prior turn, so a disrupted sequence (her own stun/silence target dying, or being CC'd) drops her output. Strong as a disruptor/anti-support pick (Shatter+Isolate+Silence+energy drain shut down healers, shielders, and combo enablers) and very hard to burst down thanks to near-constant self-invuln, but she lacks the raw kill pressure or AoE to close games alone and contributes nothing to allies. Solid utility role-player, not a carry.

role: Affliction DoT controller / attrition support with self-preserving immortality
signature_mechanic: Stacking permanent Affliction DoTs plus a rotating "Drug" slot (Flesh-Healing / Superhuman / Postcognition swap each turn) that culminates in a 5-skill-use Bankai release granting +5 Affliction vulnerability to all enemies, a non-Mental riposte, and swapping single-target poison for AoE Deadly Gas.

abilities.name: Ashisogi Jizo
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT becomes permanent at 3 stacks (re-cast refreshes duration); per-turn damage stays flat at 5 — stacks only pin duration to -1. Amplified +5 per Affliction instance while Bankai vulnerability is active.
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Affliction immediate damage (bypasses barriers/shields/DR), applies a 5/turn Affliction DoT for 2 turns; recasts refresh and at 3+ stacks the DoT becomes permanent. Replaced by Deadly Gas during Bankai.

abilities.name: Data Collection
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enables Empowered mode on all three Drug skills for 3 turns and ramps energy (1 Random/turn).
abilities.effects_summary: Self mark for 3 turns: reveals invisible enemy effects, Empowers Drug skills (Flesh-Healing front-loads 30 HP instant heal; Superhuman delay 2/2; Postcognition 3x cooldown bumps), and grants +1 Random energy each turn (immediate gain on cast + ticks). Pure utility/ramp; no damage.

abilities.name: Flesh-Healing Drug
abilities.conditional_scaling: While Empowered (Data Collection up): full 30 HP healed instantly instead of 10 now + 10/turn.
abilities.effects_summary: Target ally: 10 Damage Reduction for 3 turns + heals (10 now and 10/turn for 2 more turns = 30 total; Empowered front-loads all 30 instantly). Rotating Drug slot (swaps to a random other Drug at end of each turn). Healing + DR support.

abilities.name: Nikushibuki
abilities.conditional_scaling: One-time death-trap; after consumed the same skill retools into a 1-turn Invuln push.
abilities.effects_summary: First cast: permanent Immortality death-trap — next lethal hit banishes Mayuri 2 turns and returns him at 30 HP (once only). After it triggers, this skill grants 1 turn of Invulnerability instead. Self-preservation / panic button.

abilities.name: Bankai - Konjiki Ashisogi Jizo
abilities.conditional_scaling: Triggers after 5 skill uses; recharges (counter resets) so it can recur. While active for 4 turns, all enemy Affliction damage taken +5.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive ramp: after 5 skill uses releases Bankai for 4 turns — +5 Affliction vulnerability on every enemy, a HARMFUL_RECEIVE riposte (any non-Mental harmful skill targeting Mayuri inflicts 5 Affliction/turn for 2 turns on the attacker), and swaps Ashisogi Jizo -> Deadly Gas. Also installs the Drug-cycling trigger. Massively amplifies all DoT output.

abilities.name: Deadly Gas
abilities.conditional_scaling: Each tick amplified +5 by Bankai vulnerability (Deadly Gas is only available during Bankai), so effectively 10/tick while gas is active.
abilities.effects_summary: All enemies: 5 Affliction immediate + 5 Affliction/turn for 4 turns, and they ignore healing and cleansing while gas is active. AoE attrition lock — unhealable, uncleansable poison. Bankai-only replacement for Ashisogi Jizo.

abilities.name: Superhuman Drug
abilities.conditional_scaling: Empowered (Data Collection up): delay amount and duration both become 2 instead of 1.
abilities.effects_summary: Target enemy's skills Delayed by 1 turn (for 1 turn); Empowered = delay 2 / duration 2. Soft tempo denial. Rotating Drug (slot 6 alt that occupies the slot-3 Drug position via swap).

abilities.name: Postcognition Drug
abilities.conditional_scaling: Empowered (Data Collection up): the random cooldown bump rolls 3 times instead of 1.
abilities.effects_summary: Increases one random enemy skill's active cooldown by 1 (3x while Empowered) AND Paralyzes target for 2 turns (their cooldowns stop ticking). Hard CC + cooldown denial. Rotating Drug.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Pre-Bankai single-target poison: Ashisogi Jizo 15 immediate + 5 first DoT tick = ~20 in the landing turn, then a permanent 5/turn that bypasses barriers/shields/DR. Post-Bankai the kit pivots to AoE: Deadly Gas at 5 immediate + 5/turn, each tick amplified +5 by Bankai vulnerability = ~10 immediate + ~10/turn per enemy. With a 3-enemy board: ~20 in the cast turn per enemy plus stacked permanent Ashisogi DoTs (also +5 amplified) = roughly 25-30 sustained Affliction/turn team-wide, all of it unhealable/uncleansable during gas and bypassing all defenses.
damage_profile.notes: Almost all output is Affliction (bypasses barriers/shields/DR/HP-percent walls) and delivered as DoT rather than burst, so true effective damage is high despite low printed numbers. No conventional Normal/Energy/Physical/Piercing/True damage; zero one-shot burst. Damage ceiling is gated behind the 5-use Bankai ramp and the +5 vulnerability multiplier.

economy.color_dependency: Tri-color Blue/White/Red but very light — visible kit needs Red:1 (Ashisogi), White:1 (Data Collection), Blue:1 (Flesh-Healing), with the rest Random. Cheap and flexible; no double-pip color demands until Bankai-only Deadly Gas (Red:1+Random:2). Data Collection self-feeds +1 Random/turn, easing the Random demand.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Spammable core (Ashisogi Jizo CD 0, Superhuman Drug CD 0) supports rapid Bankai charging; mid CDs on Data Collection (3), Flesh-Healing (2), Postcognition (2); long CDs on Nikushibuki (4) and Deadly Gas (4). Generally fast tempo with 1-pip costs.
economy.ramp_dependency: Heavily ramp-dependent. Two ramp engines: (1) 5-skill-use counter to release Bankai (the +5 Affliction amplifier and AoE pivot), recharging for repeat releases; (2) Data Collection's 3-turn Empowered window that upgrades all Drugs and feeds energy. Early game output is modest until both come online.

power_assessment.reasoning: A deep, mechanically rich attrition/control kit that is hard to interact with: nearly all damage is Affliction DoT that ignores barriers, shields, and damage reduction, and the post-Bankai Deadly Gas locks the whole enemy team out of healing and cleansing while it ticks. He brings hard CC (2-turn Paralyze), tempo denial (delay + cooldown bumps), allied healing + 10 DR support, and a strong personal survival package (permanent death-trap revive at 30 HP, then repeatable 1-turn Invuln, plus a non-Mental riposte during Bankai). The 5-use Bankai both amplifies all Affliction by +5 and converts single-target poison into AoE, giving real late-game scaling. Held back from top tier by: low raw per-turn numbers (no burst, slow kills against teams that can race him), reliance on two separate ramp engines before he peaks, no shields/cleanse for his own team, and complete dependence on Affliction immunity / banish / DoT-removal being rare on the enemy side. Excellent in long games, weak under fast aggression.

role: Attrition / punish-tank: Affliction DoT spreader who taxes attackers via a permanent stacking poison and protects herself with invuln
signature_mechanic: Lady's Poison: a permanent, infinitely-stacking Affliction DoT (5 dmg/turn per stack, bypasses barriers/shields/DR). Enemies who hit her with any Harmful skill automatically gain a stack for the rest of the game, and Darkness Spear can seed 2 stacks proactively. Damage ramps the longer she survives and the more she is attacked.

abilities.name: Black Wing
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Pure single-target Affliction nuke (20, bypasses barriers/shields/DR). .gd damage is 20, JSON says 25 (stale).

abilities.name: Devil Slap
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Normal damage + Taunt for 1 turn (dur 2). Forces target to attack her, baiting Harmful hits that feed Lady's Poison stacks.

abilities.name: Darkness Spear
abilities.conditional_scaling: On first cast vs a target without Lady's Poison deals 5+5=10 immediate Affliction (skipped if poison already present); ongoing DoT scales with the 2 stacks applied (+10/turn).
abilities.effects_summary: Applies 2 stacks of Lady's Poison (+10 Affliction/turn). Applies a -10 non-Affliction damage debuff for 1 turn (dur 2). Grants the target a 10-point barrier labeled 'Nullify' (permanent, -1 dur) — note: this barrier is placed on the ENEMY, a likely quirk/intended damage-cap mechanic. Deals 10 immediate Affliction only the first time (no existing poison).

abilities.name: Darkness Wave
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerable for 1 turn (dur 2). Panic button / survival tool that lets her outlast burst while poison ticks; does not stop the Harmful-receive trigger from already-landed hits but blanks the incoming turn.

abilities.name: Lady's Poison
abilities.conditional_scaling: Per-stack: each stack = 5 Affliction/turn, stacks unlimited and permanent (-1 dur). Total DoT grows every time an enemy uses a Harmful skill on her.
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent HARMFUL_RECEIVE trigger: any enemy that targets LadyDevimon with a Harmful skill gains one permanent, stacking Lady's Poison stack (5 Affliction/turn each, bypasses barriers/shields/DR). Core ramp engine. Hidden/non-castable.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded in theory: Lady's Poison stacks are permanent and uncapped (5 Affliction/turn each). Realistically a single attacker accrues 1 stack per Harmful turn it spends on her, so by mid-game an enemy may sit at 3-6 stacks (15-30 Affliction/turn). Darkness Spear adds 2 stacks/cast (+10/turn) on demand. Late-game an attacker focusing her can hit 40+ Affliction/turn of pure unmitigated DoT.
damage_profile.notes: Burst is weak: max one-turn output is ~45 (Black Wing 20 Aff + Darkness Spear's 10 immediate + 2 starting poison stacks worth nothing turn-1, plus Devil Slap 25 if she could double-tap — but she casts one skill/turn, so realistic single-turn direct damage is 20-25). The 45 figure assumes the rare Darkness Spear first-hit 10 + a poison tick already running. No AoE in kit at all. Win comes from cumulative DoT over many turns, not spikes. All her damage except Devil Slap is Affliction (unmitigable).

economy.color_dependency: Light: 1 Blue (Darkness Spear) + 1 Red (Devil Slap) fixed, 2 Random (Black Wing, Darkness Wave). Two-color Blue/Red identity but only 1 pip each, very splashable.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Three of four skills are 1-cooldown (effectively spammable every turn); only Darkness Wave invuln is on a 4-turn cd. She can poison/nuke every single turn while holding her panic button in reserve.
economy.ramp_dependency: High value-over-time. Each visible skill costs only 1 pip and she has no expensive payoff, so she ramps the BATTLE state (enemy poison stacks) rather than her own energy. The longer the game, the stronger she gets — strongly favors long fights.

invuln_or_counter: Self Invulnerable 1 turn (Darkness Wave, 4cd)
Passive Lady's Poison punish-counter: attackers gain permanent stacking Affliction DoT for hitting her

power_assessment.reasoning: A focused single-role attrition tank. Strengths: extremely cheap (4 total pips, three 1-cd skills), a permanent uncapped Affliction DoT engine that bypasses all mitigation, a Taunt to force feeding stacks, and a 1-turn invuln panic button. Against slow control/durable comps she snowballs and is hard to ignore. But she is one-dimensional: near-zero burst (single hits of 20-25), NO AoE, no healing/cleanse/energy-denial/hard CC, and her core damage is back-loaded over many turns. Fast comps that race her or simply don't attack her (she has no way to force damage onto herself beyond a single-target Taunt) starve the passive entirely. The 'Nullify' barrier being applied to the ENEMY in ladydevimon3 looks like a bug or an unusual cap-mechanic and is worth flagging. Average-to-slightly-weak in isolation: high ceiling in attrition matchups, low floor versus tempo/burst.
outlier_flags: ladydevimon3 applies a barrier_effect (labeled 'Nullify') to the ENEMY target rather than self — likely a bug or non-standard mechanic worth dev review
Black Wing .gd deals 20 but JSON/metadata says 25 (stale description)
Lady's Poison stacks are permanent and uncapped (-1 duration, stackable, per_stack) — unbounded scaling potential in very long games
All non-Affliction damage in kit is a single 25 hit; ~95% of her damage bypasses all barriers/shields/DR

strengths: Permanent, uncapped Affliction DoT that bypasses barriers/shields/DR (Lady's Poison)
Auto-punishes anyone who attacks her — strong vs focus-fire/burst comps that must commit Harmful skills
Very cheap: 4 total pips with three 1-cooldown spammable skills
Taunt to force a target to feed poison stacks and bait Harmful hits
1-turn Invulnerability panic button to survive burst windows while DoT ticks
Splashable two-color identity (1 Blue + 1 Red + 2 random)
weaknesses: Almost no burst — peak direct damage is ~20-25 per turn
Zero AoE; entirely single-target, poor into wide boards
No healing, no cleanse, no energy denial, no hard CC
Damage is heavily back-loaded; loses fast races and short games
Passive is reactive — if enemies simply don't attack her (and she can only Taunt one target/turn) the core engine is throttled
Affliction-heavy: hard-countered by Affliction-immunity / DoT-cleanse effects
Self-protection is a single 1-turn invuln on a 4-turn cooldown
win_conditions: Drag the game long and let stacked Lady's Poison out-tick the enemy team's sustain
Bait/force attackers onto herself (Taunt + being a sticky threat) so each Harmful hit permanently raises their DoT
Use Darkness Wave invuln to survive lethal turns and convert tempo into more poison ticks
Front-load stacks with Darkness Spear on a priority target, then keep it alive long enough for poison to do the work
internal_synergies: Devil Slap Taunt forces the target to use a Harmful skill on her -> triggers Lady's Poison passive -> free permanent stack
Darkness Spear proactively seeds 2 stacks (+10/turn) AND debuffs the target's non-Affliction damage by 10, softening incoming hits
Darkness Wave invuln buys turns for the permanent DoT to accumulate without risk
All Affliction sources stack into the same Lady's Poison pool, compounding sustained damage
Black Wing provides the only repeatable direct unmitigable pressure to finish poisoned, low-HP targets

role: Weapon-form support/enabler: attaches to an ally to grant energy discounts, on-hit chip damage, and self-sustain
signature_mechanic: "Wielding" transformation: Transform (slots 1/2) marks an ally as wielding Liz or Patty for 3 turns, granting the Sisters 10 DR, converting that ally's Green (Liz) or Blue (Patty) costs to Random, and adding a trigger that deals 10 Normal damage to the ally's primary target whenever the ally uses a harmful skill. While wielded, the Transform slot is replaced by a Wavelength Compression attack (slots 5/6: 15 Piercing + self shield/heal). Sisters alternate active form (Brooklyn Devils passive); Death the Kid can dual-wield both sisters at once.

abilities.name: Transform: Liz
abilities.conditional_scaling: Trigger deals flat 10 Normal per harmful skill the wielding ally uses; no stacking. Death the Kid target (path 'kid') gets BOTH sisters' packages (dual-wield), doubling DR (10+10) and triggers.
abilities.effects_summary: Marks target ally as wielding Liz for 3 turns (color_change Green->Random, dur 7). Sisters gain 10 Damage Reduction (dur 6 = 3 turns). Adds HARMFUL_USE trigger: when wielding ally uses a harmful skill, deals 10 Normal to that ally's primary target. Swaps slot 1 -> Wavelength Compression: Liz for the duration. Kid synergy applies a second sister's full package.

abilities.name: Transform: Patty
abilities.conditional_scaling: Same 10 Normal harmful-use trigger; flat, no stacking. Kid target gets both sisters' packages.
abilities.effects_summary: Marks target ally as wielding Patty for 3 turns (color_change Blue->Random, dur 7). Sisters gain 10 Damage Reduction (dur 6 = 3 turns). Adds HARMFUL_USE trigger dealing 10 Normal to the ally's primary target per harmful skill use. Swaps slot 2 -> Wavelength Compression: Patty. Kid dual-wield synergy.

abilities.name: Thompson Sisters Soul Resonance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Patty branch grants +15 non-Affliction damage to the ally's next damaging skill (one-shot, consumed on next damage dealt). Liz branch grants a 10 HP/turn HoT for 2 turns. Kid treats both branches as active.
abilities.effects_summary: Until end of turn, installs an ACTION_USE trigger on target ally (dur 1). If ally uses a Strategic skill -> ally becomes Immortal 2 turns. If wielding Liz + uses a Helpful skill -> that skill's targets get 10 HP/turn HoT for 2 turns. If wielding Patty + uses a Harmful skill -> +15 non-Affliction damage on next damaging hit (consumed). Conditional immortality/heal/damage-amp enabler.

abilities.name: Coordinated Evasion
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: the Thompson Sisters become Invulnerable for 1 turn (ignore all harmful effects). Panic-button self-protection. (Flavor: flips active sister to Patty afterward.)

abilities.name: Wavelength Compression: Liz
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (only usable while Liz is being wielded, mark mag 0 or 2)
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) to one enemy and gives the Liz-wielding ally a 10 Shield (permanent until consumed). Replaces the Transform: Liz slot while Liz is wielded; 0 cooldown.

abilities.name: Wavelength Compression: Patty
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (only usable while Patty is being wielded, mark mag 1 or 2)
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Piercing to one enemy and heals the Patty-wielding ally for 10 HP. Replaces the Transform: Patty slot while Patty is wielded; 0 cooldown.

abilities.name: Brooklyn Devils
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Passive state machine: tracks active sister via a mark mag (0=Liz, 1=Patty). When an ally begins wielding a sister, the OTHER becomes active. Liz starts active. When Patty is active, installs slot 2/3 ability swaps (alt forms) + portrait change. Manages Death the Kid dual-wield swap refresh. No combat output.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Very low. Direct damage caps at one Wavelength Compression (15 Piercing) per turn. The harmful-use trigger adds 10 Normal per ally-harmful-skill (tied to the wielding ally's actions, not the Sisters' own turn). Soul Resonance can add +15 non-Affliction to one ally hit. Realistic Sisters-only burst in one turn ~25 (15 Piercing WC + 10 trigger); team contribution is dominated by enabling the wielder, not raw numbers.
damage_profile.notes: No AoE anywhere in the kit and no DoT. 15 Piercing bypasses flat + % DR. The 10 trigger damage is Normal (mitigable). All damage is single-target. Not a damage dealer; damage is incidental chip on top of a support package.

economy.color_dependency: Effectively colorless to operate the 4 visible skills (all 1 Random each). Energy IDENTITY is Blue+Green, but that only manifests in the hidden Wavelength Compression attacks (1 Green for Liz WC, 1 Blue for Patty WC). The Sisters' own activation cost is trivial; Blue/Green dependency is pushed onto firing the WC follow-ups.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Cheap and spammable. Transforms on 2 CD, Soul Resonance on 3 CD, Coordinated Evasion on 4 CD, and the Wavelength Compression skills have 0 CD. Every visible skill costs only 1 Random, so the Sisters can act nearly every turn with minimal energy investment.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate setup: must spend a turn applying Transform to a chosen ally before the discount/trigger/WC value comes online. No stacking ramp; value is binary (wielded vs not). Death the Kid unlocks dual-wield (both sisters at once) as the payoff.

invuln_or_counter: Coordinated Evasion: 1-turn invulnerability (ignore all harmful effects)
Conditional Immortality (2 turns) granted to ally via Soul Resonance when ally uses a Strategic skill

internal_synergies: Transform installs both the color discount AND the harmful-use trigger on the same ally, so a high-frequency attacker wielding a sister both saves energy and tacks 10 chip damage onto every harmful action.

Brooklyn Devils alternates the active sister each time someone begins wielding, letting you cycle between the Liz package (Green discount, shield WC, HoT resonance) and the Patty package (Blue discount, heal WC, +15 damage resonance).
While wielded, the Transform slot becomes a 0-cooldown Wavelength Compression (15 Piercing + self-sustain), a cheap repeatable attack that also keeps the wielder topped up.

Soul Resonance's branches key off the active sister: Liz->team HoT on Helpful use, Patty->+15 damage amp on Harmful use, plus universal Immortality on Strategic use, adapting to the wielder's playstyle.

Death the Kid (kid) is the dedicated synergy partner: Transforming Kid grants BOTH sisters' packages (double 10 DR, both triggers, both color discounts, both WC skills available, both resonance branches active via mark mag==2 dual-wield).
strengths: Extremely cheap and spammable: all visible skills are 1 Random with low/zero cooldowns, generating value almost every turn for negligible energy.
Strong ally energy-fixing: converts an ally's Green or Blue costs to Random, smoothing a teammate's color requirements (rare, valuable economy support).
Layered protection: 10 self DR while wielded, a 1-turn full invulnerability panic button, ally shields, ally heals/HoT, and conditional Immortality keep a carry alive.
Piercing damage on Wavelength Compression ignores flat and % DR for reliable chip into tanks.
On-hit trigger damage (10 Normal per ally harmful skill) scales passively with the wielder's action frequency at no extra cost.
Death the Kid dual-wield turns the whole kit into a double-value package.
weaknesses: Almost no independent damage output: peak Sisters-only burst is ~25 single-target with zero AoE and zero DoT; cannot close games on their own.
Hard dependency on a worthwhile wield target: most of the kit (discount, trigger, WC attacks, resonance branches) does nothing until an ally is transformed and is itself an active attacker.
Setup tax: must spend a turn applying Transform before value comes online, and value is binary (wielded or not) with no stacking ramp.
No hard or soft CC and no energy denial: cannot pressure enemy tempo, only support their own side.
No cleanse, so allies stay vulnerable to debuffs/affliction the Sisters can't strip.
Best-case payoff is gated behind a specific partner (Death the Kid); without him the kit is a single-target enabler at half throughput.
Single shared body with only modest 10 DR; if focused while not invulnerable, they fold and the support package collapses.
win_conditions: Attach a sister to a high-tempo carry, fixing that carry's color costs and stacking 10 chip per harmful action while the Sisters add 15 Piercing WC and keep the carry shielded/healed.
Outlast the opponent: stack DR + invulnerability + ally shields/heals/Immortality to make a protected core impossible to kill while the wielder grinds the enemy down.
Run the Death the Kid dual-wield package to double every layer of value (discounts, triggers, WC, resonance) and snowball Kid into a hyper-efficient carry.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed pure support/enabler with excellent economy: 1-Random colorless activation and low cooldowns deliver DR, energy discounts, shields, heals, on-hit chip, invulnerability, and conditional immortality at almost no cost. The Green/Blue->Random cost conversion is a rare and genuinely powerful teammate-enabling tool, and the protection suite (10 DR + 1-turn invuln + Immortality grant) makes a chosen carry very durable. Rated in isolation as middling rather than top-tier because it has essentially no standalone offense (no AoE, no DoT, ~25 single-target ceiling), no CC, no cleanse, and no enemy-tempo interaction; its ceiling is entirely a function of how good the wielding ally is, and its true payoff is gated behind a specific partner (Death the Kid). A strong glue piece that elevates a good carry but does nothing meaningful alone, landing slightly above average.
outlier_flags: Colorless 1-Random costs across all 4 visible skills make activation economy an outlier on the cheap end (Blue/Green identity only appears in hidden alt skills).
Ally color-cost conversion (Green/Blue -> Random) is a rare economy-support mechanic; flag for cross-roster comparison of energy enablers.
Hidden ability_swap design: slots 1/2 transform into Wavelength Compression attacks while wielded, so the live action bar differs from static metadata; peak-damage/tempo reads must account for this.
Hard-coded Death the Kid (kid) dual-wield synergy roughly doubles output; power level is partner-dependent.

role: AoE caster / ramping DoT controller with a self-buff transformation window (Gemini)
signature_mechanic: Gemini (lucy2): self-mark for 3 turns that (a) extends every Lucy skill's effect by 1 extra turn and (b) converts her damage skills into recurring DoTs / extended buffs, while swapping her Gemini slot for the Urano Metria nuke. It is a ramp/burst-window enabler rather than a stat transformation.

abilities.name: Aquarius
abilities.conditional_scaling: During Gemini: team DR extends from 1 turn (dur 2) to 3 turns (dur 4), AND the 15 dmg is re-applied as a recurring NORMAL DoT to all enemies for the duration
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 NORMAL to all enemies; grants whole allied team 10 flat damage reduction for 1 turn (3 turns under Gemini). Under Gemini also lays a 15/turn NORMAL DoT on all enemies. Dual hostile+helpful AoE.

abilities.name: Gemini
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enabler: marks self for 3 turns (mark dur 7) so all other Lucy skills last 1 extra turn / gain their Gemini-conditional bonus; swaps slot 2 for Urano Metria for the duration
abilities.effects_summary: Self-mark 'Gemini' for 3 turns (self-facing dur 7). While active, Lucy's skills stay active one more turn and unlock their Gemini-enhanced DoT/duration modes. Replaces this slot with Urano Metria (ability_swap, dur 7). No cooldown, 1 Blue pip - a cheap, spammable setup/ramp button.

abilities.name: Capricorn
abilities.conditional_scaling: During Gemini: in addition to the 25 immediate hit, applies a recurring 25/turn NORMAL DoT to the target for the duration
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 25 NORMAL to one enemy. Under Gemini also attaches a 25/turn NORMAL DoT - turns the cheap 1-pip nuke into a ramping single-target damage source.

abilities.name: Leo
abilities.conditional_scaling: During Gemini: invulnerability extends from 1 turn (dur 2) to 3 turns (dur 4)
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn (3 turns under Gemini). Panic-button / damage-dodge on a 4-turn cooldown, 1 flexible pip.

abilities.name: Urano Metria
abilities.conditional_scaling: Always applies a 25/turn NORMAL DoT to all enemies on top of the 25 immediate hit (the hidden finisher unlocked by Gemini swap)
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 25 NORMAL to all enemies immediately AND lays a 25/turn NORMAL AoE DoT for the duration. Only available while Gemini's ability_swap is active. 4-turn cooldown, 1 Blue + 1 White.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: All damage is NORMAL (fully mitigated by barriers/shields/DR - no bypass). One action per turn caps immediate output at 25. Real ceiling is DoT stacking under Gemini: Urano Metria (25/turn AoE) + Aquarius (15/turn AoE) + Capricorn (25/turn single) layered across the 3-turn window, reaching roughly 40-65 damage/turn to a focused target and ~40/turn field-wide, plus immediate hits. Ramp, not burst.
damage_profile.notes: Damage is modest and NORMAL-typed, so it is soft against shields/DR teams. Strength is breadth (AoE) and persistence (stacked DoTs) during the Gemini window rather than single-turn spikes. DoT durations of 3 (dur=3) are short, so the ceiling requires re-casting each turn to keep stacks fresh.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate Blue/White dependency. Gemini setup needs Blue; Capricorn and Aquarius need White; Urano Metria needs both Blue+White. Two-color (Blue/White) reliant but cheap per ability.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast core loop: Gemini (cd 0) and Capricorn (cd 0) are spammable, Aquarius is cd 1. Cooldowns gate only the protective Leo (cd 4) and the Urano Metria finisher (cd 4). Low energy cost per cast lets her act every turn cheaply.
economy.ramp_dependency: High - the kit's payoff is conditional on Gemini being up. Without Gemini she is a cheap but low-output AoE poke (15 AoE / 25 single). Power comes from maintaining the Gemini window and stacking DoTs.

invuln_or_counter: Leo: self-invulnerability 1 turn (3 turns during Gemini, cd 4)

win_conditions: Establish and maintain the Gemini window, then layer Urano Metria + Aquarius + Capricorn DoTs to grind the enemy team down over the 3 turns
Win attrition/AoE races against multi-target enemy comps while the team rides Aquarius damage reduction
Use Leo invuln (extended to 3 turns under Gemini) to no-sell a key enemy burst turn while DoTs continue ticking
internal_synergies: Gemini is the hub: it simultaneously upgrades Aquarius (longer DR + AoE DoT), Capricorn (single-target DoT), Leo (3-turn invuln), and unlocks Urano Metria - every other ability keys off it
Gemini has 0 cooldown and costs only 1 Blue, so the window can be refreshed before it lapses, keeping enhanced modes online continuously
Aquarius pairs offense (AoE damage) with team defense (DR) in one button, supporting a DoT-stall game plan
Leo's extended invuln under Gemini lets Lucy survive while her DoTs do the work
strengths: Extremely cheap kit (5 total pips, two 0-cd and one 1-cd skills) - acts meaningfully every turn
Strong AoE breadth: hits the whole enemy team with immediate damage + stackable DoTs under Gemini
Provides team utility (10 team-wide damage reduction) on top of damage
Self-protection via Leo invuln, extended to 3 turns inside the Gemini window - good survivability for a caster
Flexible, self-sufficient ramp that needs no allies to come online
weaknesses: All damage is NORMAL type - fully blocked by barriers, shields, and damage reduction; no Piercing/Affliction/True to punish defensive comps
Low immediate numbers (15 AoE / 25 single / 25 AoE) - no real burst; she is slow to close out
Power is gated behind Gemini; the turn spent setting up Gemini and the recurring re-casts to keep DoTs fresh cost tempo
DoT durations are short (dur 3), so leaving Gemini or skipping re-casts collapses her output quickly
No hard CC, no energy denial, no healing - limited disruptive ceiling; can be raced or out-tempoed
Two-color (Blue+White) dependency on Urano Metria can be awkward in energy-starved turns

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, low-cost AoE/DoT caster with a clean self-contained ramp loop (Gemini), team-wide damage reduction, and a 3-turn self-invuln for survivability. The economy is excellent - she acts every turn cheaply and refreshes her own buff window for free. But her damage is entirely NORMAL-typed and numerically modest, so she has no burst and folds against shield/DR-heavy defenses. She wins slow attrition and multi-target races but lacks the disruption (no hard CC, no energy denial, no cleanse) to swing tempo. Solidly mid-tier: reliable and flexible, with a meaningful but bounded ceiling that depends on keeping Gemini stacks alive. Marked 'beginner' in the char def, consistent with a forgiving but unspectacular kit.
outlier_flags: all-NORMAL-damage (no bypass type anywhere in kit)
0-cooldown free-refresh transformation enabler (Gemini cd 0, 1 pip) - unusually low gate for a window buff
very low total kit cost (5 pips) relative to output breadth

role: Mono-red physical bruiser / anti-invulnerability single-target striker with self-shielding sustain
signature_mechanic: Every offensive skill is Bypassing (ignores Invulnerability) and gains a bonus rider specifically when the target IS Invulnerable (extra damage + red refund, a lingering DoT, or a full stun). Passive Rubber Body converts dealing damage into flat 15 self-shield each turn.

abilities.name: Gomu Gomu No Pistol
