abilities.name: Withdraw
abilities.effects_summary: Free defensive stance. Ends any active skill Squirtle has on the enemy team and IGNORES damaging effects for 2 turns (effectively damage-effect immunity while up). While active, Skull Bash -> Rapid Spin and Bubblebeam -> Hydro Pump become available as alternates (the upgraded AoE mode). Water Gun cannot be used during Withdraw.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (Skull Bash reduces its effective cooldown; pairs with the 0-cost spammable to keep this near-permanently available).

abilities.name: Rapid Spin
abilities.effects_summary: Withdraw-mode alternate of Skull Bash. Deals 25 physical damage to ALL enemies and ignores enemy stun effects for 1 turn (anti-stun, can act through CC). For 1 turn, makes Hydro Pump cost 1 less random energy and deal 5 less damage (combo discount with a damage tradeoff).
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 from Thug Life when consecutive (peak 30 AoE). Synergy: discounts the paired Hydro Pump.

abilities.name: Hydro Pump
abilities.effects_summary: Withdraw-mode alternate of Bubblebeam. Deals 15 piercing AoE damage to all enemies each turn for 2 turns (DR-bypassing sustained AoE). For 1 turn, makes Rapid Spin cost 1 less random energy and deal 5 less damage (mutual combo discount).
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per hit from Thug Life when consecutive (peak 20/turn AoE piercing); -5 if discounted by Rapid Spin in the same turn it was cheapened.

abilities.name: Thug Life
abilities.effects_summary: Passive: all of Squirtle's skills deal +5 damage as long as he consecutively casts a NEW skill on an enemy each turn (must keep applying new offense, no repeats/Withdraw breaks the chain). The +5 only applies to the skill cast that turn. Rewards an uninterrupted aggression chain.
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 flat per damaging instance while the consecutive-new-skill condition holds; lost the moment he goes defensive (Withdraw) or repeats a skill / skips offense.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true multiplicative scaling. Per-turn ceiling against a full enemy team that all act: Bubblebeam 10 piercing + Hydro Pump 15 piercing per acting target if both ongoing, plus the +5 Thug Life. Realistic per-target sustained AoE ~15-20 piercing/turn during Withdraw windows. Single-turn AoE burst caps at Rapid Spin 30 (25 + Thug Life). Single-target caps ~25 (Water Gun/Skull Bash + Thug Life). Output is wide (AoE) rather than tall; ceiling is low but DR-immune (piercing), which raises EFFECTIVE damage vs tanky comps.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is small flat numbers (5/15/20/25) with only a flat +5 passive; no multiplicative, on-mark, or execute scaling. Strength is the Piercing AoE (Bubblebeam, Hydro Pump) that bypasses DR/shields, plus Water Gun's hard DR/invuln denial. No source of huge numbers; this is a grind/attrition + anti-defensive kit. Sustained DoT figure (25) reflects best-case overlap of two piercing AoE ticks on an acting target; realistic single-tick sustained is 15/turn AoE (Hydro Pump) or 5-10/turn AoE (Bubblebeam). Peak AoE 30 = Rapid Spin 25 + Thug Life 5 to all enemies in one activation. NOTE: numbers sourced from abilities_data.json descriptions, not from .gd ground truth (no source files exist).

economy.color_dependency: Green + Blue split, very light. Visible kit: Skull Bash Green:1, Water Gun Blue:1, Bubblebeam Random:1, Withdraw free = only 1 Green + 1 Blue + 1 Random hard-required across the whole visible bar. Withdraw-mode alts add a second Green (Rapid Spin) and second Blue (Hydro Pump) but each only need 1 specific + 1 random. Low, flexible color demand; easy to fit into most teams. (Counting alts instead of base forms, the bar costs 5 pips total.)
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very high tempo. Two 0-cost/0-cooldown spammable basics (Skull Bash, Water Gun) plus a free 0-cooldown Withdraw whose availability Skull Bash improves further. Bubblebeam is the only long cooldown (3) but is an ongoing 3-turn effect so it self-justifies. Withdraw-mode AoE alts are CD1. Squirtle can act meaningfully and cheaply every single turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Two ramp engines: (1) Thug Life passive requires an UNBROKEN chain of new-skill casts to keep +5; going defensive (Withdraw) or repeating breaks it, so the damage bonus and the best defensive tool are in tension. (2) Water Gun's stacking debuff-duration ramp rewards locking the same target turn after turn. Neither is required to function, but both reward disciplined sequencing.

internal_synergies: Skull Bash reduces Withdraw's cooldown -> can keep the damage-effect-immunity stance up far more often, a defensive tempo loop driven by a free 0-cost basic.
Withdraw transforms Skull Bash -> Rapid Spin and Bubblebeam -> Hydro Pump, turning the single-target/weak-AoE bar into a strong piercing-AoE bar; the defensive button IS the offensive power spike.
Rapid Spin <-> Hydro Pump mutual discount: each cheapens the other by 1 random energy (at the cost of -5 damage) for a turn, enabling a cheap alternating AoE loop while in Withdraw.

Bubblebeam / Hydro Pump punish enemies that use a new skill -> synergizes with Water Gun's DR/invuln denial: enemies can't turtle to avoid the piercing ticks, and acting to fight back triggers extra piercing.
Thug Life +5 rewards an uninterrupted offensive chain across all skills, but is broken by Withdraw, creating a deliberate aggression-vs-defense decision tree.
Water Gun's stacking duration on the same target makes long DR/invuln lockdown of a key enemy tank possible if you commit consecutive turns.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, low-budget anti-defensive AoE attrition controller with a strong identity but a low raw-damage ceiling. Standout strengths: (1) Water Gun is a cheap, spammable hard counter to damage-reduction and invulnerability stacking, premium utility against tank/defensive comps; (2) Bubblebeam and Hydro Pump deal PIERCING AoE that bypasses flat and % DR, so effective damage stays high vs the exact comps that wall other attackers; (3) Withdraw gives free, frequently-available damage-effect immunity that doubles as a transformation into the better AoE bar; (4) extremely cheap and color-light (3 visible pips, only 1 Green + 1 Blue hard-required), so it slots into nearly any team and acts every turn. Limiting factors: numbers are tiny (5/15/20/25) with only a flat +5 passive and no multiplicative or execute scaling, so it cannot close games quickly or threaten burst; the Thug Life chain and the Withdraw defensive stance are mutually exclusive (defending drops your damage bonus); single-target pressure is mediocre (~25 cap); and it has no healing, no shields, and no hard CC to protect itself or peel for allies. Verdict: a solid mid-tier specialist/support-flex that overperforms into defensive/stall metas and underperforms into glass-cannon races.

Water Gun's stacking debuff-duration ramp is potentially abusable (uncapped duration growth on a single target) - flag for balance review if the live .gd matches the description.
Likely an unfinished / not-yet-implemented or data-only character (Pokemon set: squirtle/charmander/bulbasaur .tscn exist but their scripts are absent).

role: Cheap anti-defensive AoE DoT controller — piercing-damage attrition with DR/invuln denial and a defensive transformation stance
signature_mechanic: Withdraw stance: a free, frequently-refreshed window that grants damage-effect immunity AND transforms the single-target bar (Skull Bash, Bubblebeam) into a piercing-AoE bar (Rapid Spin, Hydro Pump), paired with Water Gun's stacking shutdown of enemy damage-reduction and invulnerability.
strengths: Piercing AoE (Bubblebeam, Hydro Pump) bypasses flat and % DR and shields/barriers, keeping effective damage high against tanky/defensive comps.
Water Gun hard-denies enemy damage reduction and invulnerability cheaply and repeatedly, with stacking duration on a committed target - a premium counter to defensive stacking.
Withdraw is free, near-permanently available (Skull Bash shortens its cooldown), grants damage-effect immunity, and upgrades the whole offensive bar - defense and a power spike in one button.
Extremely cheap and color-light (3 visible pips; only 1 Green + 1 Blue hard-required), so it slots into any team and acts every turn.
Punishes enemy aggression: Bubblebeam/Hydro Pump deal bonus piercing to enemies who act, squeezing opponents whether they attack or turtle.
Can ignore enemy stun effects (Rapid Spin) - acts through CC during its AoE mode.
weaknesses: Low raw damage ceiling: tiny flat numbers (5/15/20/25) and only a +5 passive; no multiplicative, on-mark, execute, or transformation-power scaling. Cannot burst or close games fast.
Mediocre single-target pressure (~25/turn peak) - struggles to focus down a priority threat quickly.
Tension between offense and defense: Thug Life's +5 chain breaks the moment he uses Withdraw, so going defensive costs damage and vice versa.
No healing, no shields/barriers, no cleanse, and no hard CC (stuns) to protect itself or peel for allies - purely selfish defense (Withdraw only protects Squirtle).
Relies on ongoing/ramping effects (Bubblebeam 3-turn, Hydro Pump 2-turn, Water Gun stacking) to reach real output - bursty enemies can kill it before attrition pays off.
Hydro Pump/Rapid Spin AoE power is gated behind being in Withdraw mode, coupling its best damage to a defensive cooldown rather than letting it freely pick offense.

invuln_or_counter: Withdraw: ignores damaging effects for 2 turns (damage-effect immunity / self-protection, not a reflect counter)
Rapid Spin: ignores enemy stun effects for 1 turn (anti-CC self-immunity)
soft_cc: Water Gun: denies target the ability to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn, stacking duration on consecutive same-target casts (anti-DR / anti-invuln lockdown)

win_conditions: Grind down defensive/tank comps with piercing AoE (Bubblebeam + Hydro Pump) that ignores their DR and shields while Water Gun strips their invulnerability/DR escape.
Out-tempo opponents with a cheap, every-turn cycle: spam basics to keep Withdraw up, alternate into the discounted Rapid Spin/Hydro Pump AoE loop, and win the attrition race.
Lock down a key enemy tank/defensive pivot with stacking Water Gun denial so allies (or the piercing ticks) can kill it.
Survive aggression with Withdraw's damage-effect immunity and stun-ignore, then punish enemies for acting via the Bubblebeam/Hydro Pump on-action bonus piercing.

role: Delayed board-wide execute finisher / AoE-DoT controller that activates only after a setup condition (Sealed King transfer or Demonic Pact)
signature_mechanic: Sealed King + Malevolent Shrine: Sukuna is permanently stunned and untargetable and marks a random ally (+5 non-Affliction dmg). When that ally crosses HP thresholds (below 70 then below 30), or via Demonic Pact, Sukuna activates Malevolent Shrine: a game-long rising execute (kills any other character at <=5 HP, threshold +5 every turn and whenever an enemy hits Sukuna) that unlocks his Fire Arrow HP-setter and Cleave-and-Dismantle AoE/Piercing DoT.

abilities.name: Malevolent Shrine
abilities.conditional_scaling: Execute threshold starts at 5 HP and rises +5 every turn AND +5 whenever a selected enemy uses a skill on Sukuna; over time the threshold climbs until it kills the entire enemy team. Also makes Cleave and Dismantle hit 2 extra random targets per cast.
abilities.effects_summary: Applies a permanent ticking execute trigger: at end of each turn, instantly kills any other character (loop iterates all_characters) whose HP <= current threshold (starts 5, +5/turn, +5 on enemy skilling Sukuna). Removes Sukuna's untargetable Sealed King mark, marks himself 'Malevolent Shrine' to unlock Fire Arrow and Cleave. Uncounterable, Affliction-class (bypasses barriers/shields). One-time activation.

abilities.name: Fire Arrow
abilities.conditional_scaling: HP-set by bracket: HP>60 -> set to 60; HP 31-60 -> set to 30; HP<=30 -> execute. Effective single-target value scales with how high the target's HP is (erases up to 40 HP, or kills below 30).
abilities.effects_summary: Pure HP manipulation/execute. Sets a healthy target's HP to 60 or 30 (untracked, bypasses DR/shields/barriers) or instantly kills if <=30. Feeds Malevolent Shrine's rising execute threshold and Cleave ticks. Requires Malevolent Shrine. 1-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Cleave and Dismantle
abilities.conditional_scaling: Each cast self-applies a +5 stacking damage mod to Cleave (stackable, stack_mag) ramping future casts; Malevolent Shrine adds 2 extra random-target hits per cast. Recurring Piercing tick is flat 5/turn per enemy.
abilities.effects_summary: AoE: 5 Normal damage to all targets, then applies a permanent recurring Piercing 5/turn DoT tick to each enemy. Self-applies a one-turn lockout tick and a +5 stacking damage mod for future Cleaves. Uncounterable. Piercing tick bypasses flat and % DR. Requires Malevolent Shrine; cannot recast while lockout active.

abilities.name: Demonic Pact
abilities.conditional_scaling: Branching: if Sealed-King-marked ally HP<=40 -> execute that ally and immediately activate Malevolent Shrine (rising board execute begins). Otherwise applies a buff. JSON's '10 Affliction damage' is not in current .gd.
abilities.effects_summary: Setup/payoff converter targeting the Sealed-King-marked ally. If ally HP<=40: executes the ally (sacrifice) and triggers Malevolent Shrine personally, jump-starting the rising execute. Else: grants ally +5 Affliction damage mod (1 turn) and ignore-non-damage-effects (anti-CC). Free, no cooldown. Requires Sealed King mark.

abilities.name: Sealed King
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (binary state machine)
abilities.effects_summary: Passive identity engine. Sukuna is permanently stunned AND untargetable, and at game start marks a random ally granting +5 non-Affliction damage. First time the marked ally's HP crosses below 70 then below 30, Sealed King transfers (off Sukuna, onto ally for 3 turns). If the marked ally dies, Sealed King is permanently disabled. Untargetability ends if both teammates die or Sukuna uses Malevolent Shrine. Both protects Sukuna and gates when his offense comes online.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Effectively the entire enemy team. Malevolent Shrine's execute threshold rises +5/turn (and +5 per enemy skill on Sukuna) with no cap, so given enough turns it executes everyone regardless of HP. Fire Arrow caps healthy enemies at 60/30 to feed that threshold, and Cleave's Piercing ticks (5/turn, board-wide, DR-immune) plus its +5 stacking dmg mod push everyone into execute range. Practical ceiling = full board wipe over several turns once Malevolent Shrine is active.
damage_profile.notes: Almost no conventional burst. peak_single_target ~40 is Fire Arrow erasing a 100-HP target to 60 (HP-set, untracked, bypasses DR/shields). peak_aoe ~25 is a ramped Cleave (base 5 + several +5 stacks) plus the 2 extra Shrine hits; base AoE is just 5 Normal. The real kill power is the rising EXECUTE threshold and board-wide Piercing/Affliction DoT, not raw numbers. Affliction (Shrine, Fire Arrow) and Piercing (Cleave tick) bypass shields/barriers/DR, so what lands is highly reliable.

economy.color_dependency: Light Red dependency: only 2 specific Red pips across the visible kit (1 on Malevolent Shrine, 1 on Fire Arrow); Cleave is 2 Random and Demonic Pact is free. Very flexible to fund.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mostly cooldown-free (Shrine, Cleave, Demonic Pact all 0 CD; Fire Arrow 1 CD). Tempo is bottlenecked by GATING not cooldowns: Fire Arrow and Cleave are locked until Malevolent Shrine is active, and Shrine needs either Demonic Pact (marked ally <=40 HP) or the natural Sealed King HP-cross. Cleave also self-locks for a turn after each cast.
economy.ramp_dependency: Very high. Sukuna does nothing on his own turns until setup is met (permanently stunned). His payoff (rising execute + DoT board state) ramps over multiple turns. The archetype is a slow-burn that snowballs once online and is dead weight before then.

hard_cc: board-wide rising execute (Malevolent Shrine) - removes characters
Demonic Pact ally execute/sacrifice
soft_cc: Fire Arrow HP-set (caps target HP at 60/30)
invuln_or_counter: Sukuna permanently untargetable via Sealed King (until Malevolent Shrine used or both teammates die)
Uncounterable on Malevolent Shrine and Cleave and Dismantle
Demonic Pact grants marked ally ignore-non-damage-effects (anti-CC for ~1 turn)

win_conditions: Survive long enough for the marked ally to take damage and transfer Sealed King / drop the ally to <=40 HP for Demonic Pact, then fire Malevolent Shrine and let the rising execute threshold + Piercing/Affliction DoTs wipe the enemy board.
Use Fire Arrow to crater high-HP threats to 60/30 so the climbing execute threshold and Cleave ticks finish them.
Sacrifice the marked ally via Demonic Pact (ally <=40 HP) to instantly activate Malevolent Shrine ahead of schedule, trading a teammate for the board-wide execute engine.
internal_synergies: Sealed King (untargetable + ally HP-cross trigger) is the gate that, once met, transfers the mark and lets Demonic Pact / Malevolent Shrine come online.
Demonic Pact executes a low-HP marked ally to immediately activate Malevolent Shrine, bypassing the natural HP-cross wait.
Malevolent Shrine unlocks Fire Arrow and Cleave and adds 2 extra Cleave hits, tying the whole offensive kit together.
Fire Arrow sets enemies to 60/30, dovetailing with Shrine's +5/turn rising execute threshold and Cleave's 5/turn Piercing ticks to convert HP-set targets into kills.
Cleave's +5 stacking self damage-mod plus permanent Piercing ticks erode the whole board into execute range over time.
Permanent untargetability keeps Sukuna hard to remove during the slow ramp, protecting the setup.
strengths: Eventual board-wide, DR/shield-ignoring EXECUTE that scales to kill the entire enemy team regardless of HP (uncapped rising threshold).
Extremely cheap and flexible to fund (only 2 specific Red pips; lots of Random; Demonic Pact free).
Damage is largely Affliction (Shrine, Fire Arrow) and Piercing (Cleave ticks), bypassing barriers, shields, and DR.
Permanent untargetability + Uncounterable abilities make Sukuna and his payoff very hard to disrupt directly.
Fire Arrow is a reliable HP-cap/anti-tank tool that ignores defenses entirely.
Self-protecting setup: he can't be focused while ramping.
weaknesses: Permanently stunned and does NOTHING until a setup condition is met; effectively a 2-character team early and total dead weight if the ramp never triggers.
Entire kit is gated behind Malevolent Shrine, which itself needs the marked ally to take heavy damage (cross below 70/30) or a self-sacrifice via Demonic Pact.
If the marked ally dies before transferring Sealed King, the passive is permanently disabled and the win path can collapse.
Sacrificing the marked ally (Demonic Pact execute) costs a teammate to go online early.
Very low immediate/burst output: base AoE is 5, single-target is HP-set with no tracked damage; slow to close games if enemies heal or race him.
Board-wide execute loops iterate all_characters and can clip his own allies in threshold range.
No healing, shields, cleanse, or energy denial - purely a slow offensive payoff with self-protection.

power_assessment.reasoning: A high-variance, high-skill snowball payoff character rather than a statline. In isolation his ceiling is enormous: an uncapped, DR/shield-ignoring, board-wide rising execute (Malevolent Shrine) plus board-wide Piercing/Affliction DoT and a defense-ignoring HP-set tool, all on a permanently untargetable, hard-to-disrupt body, funded by just 2 specific Red pips. If a game goes long he reliably wipes the enemy team. His floor is very low: he is permanently stunned and contributes nothing until a setup condition (Sealed King HP-cross or Demonic Pact ally-sacrifice) is met, so against fast aggro or if his marked ally dies early he can be near-useless and the win path collapses. That conditional, ramp-heavy, all-or-nothing profile keeps him off the top tier despite a game-ending ceiling. Net: a strong but swingy 6.5.
outlier_flags: UNCAPPED EXECUTE THRESHOLD - Malevolent Shrine's kill threshold rises +5/turn with no ceiling, eventually executing full-HP characters; potential balance outlier in long games.
PERMANENT STUN/UNTARGETABLE on the character himself - unusual self-disabling identity that makes him a delayed 3rd member.
INDISCRIMINATE BOARD EXECUTE - execute loops iterate over all_characters and can clip own allies in threshold range.

JSON/.gd DRIFT - Demonic Pact JSON says 'deal 10 Affliction damage'; current .gd instead executes the ally at <=40 HP and activates Malevolent Shrine, or grants a +5 Affliction dmg-mod buff. Fire Arrow JSON omits the 100-61->60 bracket present in code.
DEFENSE-BYPASS STACKING - nearly all of his real damage is Affliction or Piercing, bypassing shields/barriers/DR, making mitigation-based counters ineffective.

abilities.name: Nekomata Blaze
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 affliction damage per damage-over-time effect on the target (per-stack DoTs count each stack). Self-synergizes with its own permanent 5-affliction DoT stacks and tamaki2/tamaki5 stacks. JSON says base 15 but .gd is base 10.
abilities.effects_summary: Affliction nuke that bypasses barriers/shields. Applies a permanent (-1 dur), stacking, per-stack 5 affliction DoT that does not remove on death. Bypasses invulnerability if target is marked by Nekomata Cage.

abilities.name: Nekomata Cage
abilities.conditional_scaling: none directly; enables the +5/DoT scaling on tamaki1/tamaki5 by seeding permanent DoTs, and arms invuln-bypass via its mark
abilities.effects_summary: Applies a mark (Nekomata Cage, dur 5 ~3 turns) enabling invuln-bypass for Blaze/Fireball. Also a HARMFUL_USE_TRIGGER (dur 6 ~3 turns): if the target uses a NEW harmful skill during the window they gain a permanent (-1), stacking, per-stack 5 affliction DoT for the rest of the game. Pure control/setup, no upfront damage.

abilities.name: Ignition: Nekomata
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self transformation/setup. 15 permanent shield (-1 dur). For 3 turns (dur 7): ignore enemy non-damage effects (effective CC/debuff immunity), and Nekomata Cage targets ALL enemies. Swaps slot 4 -> tamaki5 (Nekomata Fireball) for the duration. Swaps out Fearless Defender, not the slot-1 nuke.

abilities.name: Fearless Defender
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Ally protection/redirect. Self gains 10 flat damage reduction for 1 turn (dur 2, invisible). Targets one ally with an invisible reflect (dur 2 ~1 turn) that redirects all Harmful skills used on that ally back onto Tamaki herself. Bodyguard/peel.

abilities.name: Nekomata Fireball
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 affliction damage per damage-over-time effect on target (per-stack DoTs counted per stack). Big payoff once Cage and Blaze DoTs have ramped.
abilities.effects_summary: Upgraded affliction nuke (active only during Ignition). 30 base affliction, +5 per DoT, bypasses barriers/shields. Bypasses invulnerability if target is Cage-marked. Applies THREE separate permanent (-1), stacking, per-stack 5 affliction DoTs.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded over a long game. Every Blaze (+1 stack) and Fireball (+3 stacks), plus every triggered Cage stack, permanently adds 5/turn affliction AND raises the +5/DoT bonus on future Blaze/Fireball. By turn 6-8 a target can carry 6-10+ permanent 5-affliction stacks (30-50+ unavoidable affliction/turn) while Fireball hits 30 + 5*stacks = 60-80+. Affliction bypasses all mitigation, so it is a guaranteed, accelerating kill clock.
damage_profile.notes: Peak single-target ~80 in one turn assumes a Fireball (30 base) into a target carrying ~10 DoT stacks (+50). Direct AoE is 0 (no AoE damage skill); Cage's all-target retarget via Ignition only seeds DoTs, it does not deal direct AoE. The 35/turn sustained DoT figure assumes a mid-game target with ~7 permanent 5-affliction stacks; early game is only 5-15/turn and ramps relentlessly. JSON tamaki1 base 15 vs .gd base 10 mismatch; .gd used.

economy.color_dependency: Mono-Blue (character_colors=[1]). Visible kit: tamaki2 and tamaki3 cost Blue:1 (2 specific Blue pips); tamaki1 and tamaki4 cost Random:1 each. Light single-color dependency; active-form Fireball adds another Blue:1+Random:1.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Blaze and Fireball both cd 1 (spammable); Cage cd 2; the two cd-4 buttons (Ignition, Fearless Defender) are situational. Low cost + low cd lets her act/setup nearly every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Damage is back-loaded: turn-1 Blaze is only 10. Real output comes from accumulated permanent DoT stacks, the +5/DoT multiplier, and committing Ignition to unlock Fireball. Wants long games and early Cage.

invuln_or_counter: Fearless Defender: redirects/reflects all Harmful skills targeting one ally onto Tamaki (peel/bodyguard) + 10 flat DR on self for 1 turn
Ignition: Nekomata: ignore enemy non-damage effects for 3 turns (effective CC/debuff immunity) + 15 permanent shield
Anti-invuln: Blaze/Fireball bypass invulnerability vs Cage-marked targets

win_conditions: Survive into mid/late game and let permanent, mitigation-ignoring affliction DoT stacks out-clock the enemy team
Land Nekomata Cage early (or on all enemies via Ignition) so the +5/DoT scaling and new-harmful-skill DoT trigger snowball
Use Ignition to unlock Fireball (30 + scaling, 3 DoT stacks per cast) and pressure-spam it at cd 1 while immune to non-damage effects
Punish invulnerability/dodge-reliant enemies via Cage-mark invuln bypass on Blaze/Fireball
internal_synergies: Cage -> Blaze/Fireball: the mark grants invuln-bypass and Cage's triggered DoTs feed the +5/DoT multiplier
Blaze/Fireball self-seed permanent per-stack DoTs that then raise their OWN future damage (compounding loop)
Ignition makes Cage hit ALL enemies, turning single-target setup into team-wide DoT seeding, and unlocks the stronger Fireball
Ignition's 'ignore enemy non-damage effects' protects the ramp from CC/debuffs while she pressures
All damage is Affliction, so DoT stacks bypass enemy barriers/shields/DR — her clock is near un-mitigable
Fearless Defender lets her tank reflected harm behind 15 permanent shield + 10 DR, keeping the engine alive
strengths: Mitigation-proof damage: all output is Affliction, bypassing shields, barriers, and DR entirely
Unbounded permanent scaling: DoT stacks never expire (-1 dur, remove_on_death=false on Blaze/Fireball) and compound the +5/DoT bonus
Very cheap and low-cooldown: 4 visible skills total only 4 pips; main damage on cd 1
Strong self-sustain for a DoT carry: 15 permanent shield, 1-turn 10 DR, 3-turn non-damage-effect immunity
Flexible peel/support: Fearless Defender redirects harm off a fragile ally onto her protected self
Hard counter to invulnerability/dodge via Cage-marked invuln bypass
Energy-light (mono-Blue, 2 random pips), easy to slot into any team
weaknesses: Very weak early game: turn-1 nuke is only 10; needs several turns of stacking to threaten kills
No burst, no direct AoE damage, no hard CC, no healing, no energy denial — a slow attrition clock
Heavily reliant on Cage landing/sticking; if the target dies or swaps out, mid-window setup is lost
Single-target damage routing (AoE only via Cage DoT seeding); cleave comps can outpace her clock
Fireball (real damage) is gated behind committing Ignition (cd 4) and only available 3 turns at a time
Enemy cleanse/DoT-removal directly attacks her win condition by stripping permanent stacks
Fast burst comps can kill her or her allies before the clock matures
signature_mechanic: "Permanent, compounding affliction DoT ramp: Nekomata Cage seeds un-expiring 5-affliction stacks and an invuln-bypass mark; Blaze/Fireball deal affliction scaled by +5 per DoT on the target while themselves stacking more permanent DoTs, creating a self-reinforcing, mitigation-ignoring kill clock that only accelerates over a long game."
role: "Affliction DoT ramp carry / anti-invuln attrition controller with peel support"

power_assessment.reasoning: Strong, well-designed scaling carry with a clear identity. Her ceiling is very high because all damage is Affliction (ignores every form of mitigation) and her DoT stacks are permanent, un-expiring, and compound their own +5/DoT multiplier. Combined with near-free costs (4-pip visible kit, mono-Blue) and cd-1 spam, she builds a relentless, nearly un-mitigable kill clock and even punishes invulnerability comps via Cage's bypass. She also has unusually good survivability and peel for a DoT carry (15 permanent shield, non-damage-effect immunity, a harmful-skill redirect). Held below 8 by a genuinely weak early game (turn-1 nuke of 10, no burst/AoE/CC), heavy reliance on Cage sticking and on committing Ignition to unlock real damage, and clean counterplay from cleanse/DoT-removal and from fast burst comps that end the game before her ramp matures. In a slow attrition meta closer to 8; against fast comps closer to 6.
outlier_flags: UNBOUNDED_SCALING: permanent, non-expiring, compounding affliction stacks with a +5/DoT self-multiplier have no practical cap over a long game
MITIGATION_BYPASS: 100% of her damage is Affliction, fully ignoring shields/barriers/DR
JSON_GD_MISMATCH: tamaki1 metadata says base 15 but .gd is base 10 (used .gd as ground truth)
ANTI_INVULN: hard-counters invulnerability via Cage-marked invuln bypass on Blaze/Fireball
COST_EFFICIENCY: 4 total pips for a full 4-skill visible kit with cd-1 main damage is extremely cheap

abilities.name: Fourth Form: Striking Tide

abilities.effects_summary: Spammable 20 Piercing single-target nuke (skips flat+%DR). 0 cooldown, 1 Blue pip. Swaps with Tenth Form via passive.

abilities.conditional_scaling: On successful counter, marks the attacker with +5 vulnerability specifically to Eighth Form (and converts that hit to Piercing)

Countered enemy gets a vulnerability mark (+5 dmg, turns Eighth Form into Piercing vs them). Invisible. Defensive/counter setup feeding the alt-form Eighth Form. Swaps with Eighth Form.

abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.conditional_scaling: +20 damage per DEAD enemy (counts dead non-team characters); 30 base, 50 vs 1 dead, 70 vs 2 dead, 90 vs 3 dead

abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Alt form of slot 2. For 2 turns: 10 Normal AoE to enemies (immediate + 3-dur ticking) AND grants the whole team invulnerability vs Energy skills (dur 4). Anti-Energy-comp team protection + chip. control_cancel locks while active.

abilities.name: Enhanced Smell
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Tenth Form scales +20 per dead enemy: 30/50/70/90 against 0/1/2/3 dead. Late-game with 2-3 dead enemies it becomes a 70-90 AoE nuke. Third Form duration is unbounded if Tanjiro keeps acting (extends +1 turn per action), but only 10 dmg/tick. damage_profile.notes: Per-hit numbers are modest; the only big number is Tenth Form's dead-enemy scaling, a snowball/finisher rather than opening burst. Striking Tide (20 Piercing) and Eighth Form (Piercing-on-mark) give reliable shield-bypass damage. peak_single_target of 70 reflects Tenth Form hitting a lone surviving enemy after 2 deaths.

economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate but RNG-gated: power comes from the passive rolling alt forms onto the bar and from enemies dying to fuel Tenth Form. Third Form rewards multi-action turns. No guaranteed ramp — depends on coin-flips each turn.

signature_mechanic: Enhanced Smell passive: at the end of every turn each of Tanjiro's first three skill slots independently coin-flips between its base form and a stronger alternate form, making his action bar a randomized loadout that trades consistency for a deep toolbox (single-target Piercing, scaling AoE, low-CD AoE, channels, counters).
role: Flexible bruiser/AoE-skirmisher: an RNG-swapped multi-tool with a scaling AoE finisher and layered self/team defense, light on raw burst.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, hard-to-counter generalist with three defensive layers (self invuln, anti-Energy team invuln, team counter), guaranteed Piercing access, cheap flexible costs, and a genuine late-game finisher in Tenth Form (+20/dead, up to 70-90 AoE). That breadth plus survivability makes him reliably useful and annoying to remove. He is held back from top tier by low raw numbers (mostly 10-30 per hit), no hard CC / healing / energy denial, back-loaded burst that needs kills to come online, and above all the passive RNG: he cannot guarantee the right form is on the bar, so his strongest lines (Seventh->Eighth counter chain, on-demand Tenth Form) are inconsistent. Solid mid-tier: high floor from defenses and versatility, capped ceiling from RNG and modest damage.
outlier_flags: METADATA MISMATCH: abilities_data.json lists Eighth Form (tanjiro7) at 30 damage but .gd base_damage is 25 (ground truth 25).
RNG LOADOUT: passive randomly swaps slots 1-3 each turn; effective kit consistency is engine-RNG-dependent and hard to evaluate deterministically.

UNBOUNDED CHANNEL: Third Form duration extends +1 turn per action with no visible cap (code adds +2 dur units per trigger); could persist indefinitely if Tanjiro keeps acting, though only 10 dmg/tick + 10 DR.
Tenth Form scaling is uncapped per dead enemy (potential 90+ AoE in 3v3 endgame).

role: Stun-lock control/setup duelist with team-wide invuln defense
signature_mechanic: Chain-stun engine: lands partial/full stuns, then extends and capitalizes on them. Psychokinetic Bind tags two enemies with "Nullify" and slams them together for a positional combo (middle enemy hit for combined Nullify + 2-turn full stun, bypassing invuln), Extreme Psychic Twisting extends all stuns by 1 turn and swaps in Spear of Green Light for a 75-damage execute on any stunned target.

abilities.name: Psychic Shear
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Piercing damage (skips flat+% DR). Applies a partial stun that disables only the target's Harmful-class skills until end of Tatsumaki's next turn (~1 turn). Cheap, near-spammable (CD 1) soft-lock that sets up Spear of Green Light and feeds the stun-extension chain.

abilities.name: Psychokinetic Bind
abilities.conditional_scaling: Combo damage = total accumulated Nullify (20 per application). Two applications = 40; the slam needs Nullify on two different enemies.
abilities.effects_summary: Applies a 20 'Nullify' barrier-tracker (no cooldown, repeatable). When two different enemies hold this Nullify, slams them together: if they sit at positions 0 and 2 with a LIVING enemy between (pos 1), that middle enemy takes Normal damage equal to combined Nullify (40) and is fully stunned 2 turns; otherwise the two tagged enemies split the Nullify as damage (20 each) and each is stunned 1 turn. Removes all Nullify and BYPASSES INVULNERABILITY. Primary hard-CC and combo enabler; CD 0 lets her stack Nullify across turns.

abilities.name: Extreme Psychic Twisting
abilities.conditional_scaling: Value scales with how many enemies are already stunned (each stunned enemy gets +1 turn on all its stuns).
abilities.effects_summary: 30 Normal AoE to all enemies. Every already-stunned enemy has the duration of ALL its stun effects increased by 1 turn (stun-lock amplifier). Swaps Tatsumaki's slot 3 to Spear of Green Light for 3 turns, enabling the 75-damage execute window. CD 3.

abilities.name: Tatsumaki Barrier
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend panic button). Swaps slot 4 to City-Wide Barrier for 4 turns, unlocking the 2-turn team-wide invuln. CD 4.

abilities.name: Spear of Green Light
abilities.conditional_scaling: Targeting is conditional: can only target a currently STUNNED enemy. No damage scaling.
abilities.effects_summary: Execute/payoff: 75 Normal damage to a currently stunned enemy. Hidden alt that replaces slot 3 for 3 turns after Extreme Psychic Twisting. Highest single-hit in the kit; entirely dependent on her own stun setup. CD 5.

abilities.name: City-Wide Barrier
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Team-wide invulnerability for 2 turns. Hidden alt that replaces slot 4 for 4 turns after Tatsumaki Barrier. Major defensive cooldown that can hard-block an entire enemy turn for the whole team. CD 5.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Largely fixed numbers. Spear of Green Light (75) is the single-hit ceiling but requires the target to already be stunned (her own setup). Psychokinetic Bind combo caps at 40 (two 20-Nullify applications). AoE caps at 30 each / 90 total. No per-stack or per-kill damage growth; her 'scaling' is tempo (stun-lock duration), not damage.
damage_profile.notes: No damage-over-time anywhere. Peak single-target 75 is Spear of Green Light, only usable against a stunned target and only during the 3-turn swap window after Twisting; outside that, single-target peak is 40 (Bind combo) or 20 Piercing (Shear). Damage is low/moderate and gated behind CC setup; her value is control + the 75 execute payoff and a team invuln, not raw DPS. Piercing on Shear and the invuln-bypassing Bind combo give reliable chip into defensive enemies.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate-to-high mono-Green dependency (character_colors=[0]). Visible kit: Green x3 (Shear, Bind, Twisting) + Random x3. Both hidden alts are Green-heavy (Spear 2 Green; City-Wide Barrier 2 Green + 1 Random), so every payoff wants Green and she is energy-screen-prone.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Front-loaded cheap controllers: Bind CD 0 (repeatable) and Shear CD 1 give constant pressure. Mid CDs on Twisting (3) and Barrier (4); the strong alts (Spear, City-Wide Barrier) are CD 5. Good early/mid tempo, throttled payoff.
economy.ramp_dependency: Setup-dependent, not resource-ramp. Needs to land/stack stuns and (for the combo) manipulate enemy positioning before payoffs come online; Spear requires casting Twisting to swap it in AND a stunned target.

hard_cc: Full stun 2 turns (Psychokinetic Bind combo, middle enemy)
Full stun 1 turn x2 (Psychokinetic Bind split)
Stun-duration extension +1 turn to all enemy stuns (Extreme Psychic Twisting)
soft_cc: Partial stun disabling only Harmful-class skills ~1 turn (Psychic Shear)
invuln_or_counter: Self invuln 1 turn (Tatsumaki Barrier)
Team-wide invuln 2 turns (City-Wide Barrier)

win_conditions: Establish a stun-lock: repeatedly apply Psychic Shear / Psychokinetic Bind, extend with Extreme Psychic Twisting, and convert with Spear of Green Light (75) on a perma-stunned key target.
Position-combo a clustered enemy team so Psychokinetic Bind slams the middle enemy for 40 + a 2-turn full stun, ignoring invuln.
Stall to her cooldowns and use City-Wide Barrier (2-turn team invuln) to negate enemy burst windows while allies do work.
internal_synergies: Psychic Shear / Psychokinetic Bind apply stuns that Spear of Green Light needs (it can only target a stunned enemy).
Extreme Psychic Twisting both extends existing stuns (+1 turn) AND swaps in Spear of Green Light for 3 turns, so the AoE turn directly sets up the execute.
Psychokinetic Bind's CD 0 lets her pre-stack Nullify on two enemies across turns before triggering the slam.
Tatsumaki Barrier (self invuln) buys a turn and swaps in City-Wide Barrier, chaining her two defensive layers.
The combo's invuln-bypass on Bind means stuns can land even on defensively-positioned/invuln targets, keeping the lock going.
strengths: Premier hard-CC: layered stuns, a 2-turn full stun, and a global stun-duration extender enable near-perpetual stun-locks.
Very cheap, high-uptime controllers (Bind CD 0, Shear CD 1) for constant pressure and energy efficiency.
Strong defensive ceiling for a control unit: self invuln plus a 2-turn TEAM invuln (rare team-wide protection).
Bypasses invulnerability on her signature combo and deals Piercing on Psychic Shear, so defensive enemies don't fully shut her down.
75-damage execute (Spear) gives her real kill pressure once the lock is set.
weaknesses: Low raw damage and zero DoT; almost all damage is gated behind landing CC first.
Spear of Green Light is doubly conditional: requires casting Twisting to swap it in AND a stunned target; whiffs if the lock is broken or cleansed.
The full-power Bind slam (40 + 2-turn stun) needs a specific enemy layout (positions 0 and 2 with a living enemy at position 1), often unavailable.
Heavily reliant on stuns sticking: enemy stun-immunity, cleanse, or invuln-on-stun counters gut her plan (Spear/Twisting payoffs evaporate).
Mono-Green color dependency makes her energy-screen-prone; long CDs (5) on her best alts limit repeat payoff.
No healing, no sustain, no energy denial; purely tempo/control with a fragile setup chain.

power_assessment.reasoning: An efficient, well-rounded control specialist. Cheap repeatable stuns (Bind CD 0, Shear CD 1), a stun-duration amplifier, an invuln-bypassing combo, a 75 execute on stunned targets, plus BOTH a self invuln and a 2-turn team-wide invuln give her strong control + defense in one kit at only 6 total visible cost. She is genuinely oppressive against single high-value threats and provides team utility most controllers lack. Held back from S-tier by low raw/AoE damage, no DoT or sustain, mono-Green dependency, and a payoff chain (Spear) that is conditional and breaks down against stun-immunity/cleanse or unfavorable enemy positioning. Strong but counterable.
outlier_flags: Psychokinetic Bind has cooldown 0 AND bypasses invulnerability AND applies up to a 2-turn full stun — unusually strong, repeatable hard-CC for a 1-Green cost; potential balance outlier.
Provides a 2-turn TEAM-WIDE invulnerability (City-Wide Barrier), a rare and high-impact defensive effect for a control character.
Stun-duration extension (Extreme Psychic Twisting) plus cheap repeatable stuns enables potentially permanent single-target stun-lock, which can be degenerate against low-cleanse comps.

abilities.name: Killing Strike
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 if target is stunned, +5 if target HP <= 50 (both stack, max 35). Becomes PIERCING while Tatsumi is under Incursio's mark.
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable single-target nuke (cd 0). Synergizes with Neuntote's false-stun mark (always +5) and execute threshold (<=50 HP +5). Converts to Piercing during Incursio, ignoring flat+%DR.

abilities.name: Incursio
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: 3-turn self transformation/empowerment: +10 Damage Reduction, end-of-turn Invuln if he used no new skill that turn (passive evasion when idle), unlocks Neuntote, makes Killing Strike Piercing, and makes all his skills Bypass invuln while he is Invulnerable. Core enabler of the whole kit.

abilities.name: Neuntote
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat 40 Piercing)
abilities.effects_summary: 40 Piercing damage (ignores flat+%DR) and applies a PERMANENT false-stun mark (duration -1): the target is treated as stunned by all skills/effects forever, permanently fueling Killing Strike's +5 and any stun-conditional synergy. Gated behind Incursio being active. Cooldown 0.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self-targeted 1-turn Invulnerability (duration 2). Gated: only usable while Tatsumi is already Invulnerable through Incursio's end-of-turn effect, extending/guaranteeing an invuln window. Panic button / survivability layer.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Hard-capped per turn. During Incursio vs a Neuntote-marked + <=50 HP target: Killing Strike 35 + Neuntote 40 = 75 Piercing single-target in one turn (both cd 0). Sustained loop after the mark is set: Killing Strike alone = 25 base +5 (mark counts as stun) +5 if execute range = 35 Piercing/turn for 1 Green pip. No AoE, no DoT, no per-stack growth — ceiling is fixed, not ramping.
damage_profile.notes: All burst is Piercing during Incursio, so it ignores flat and % Damage Reduction (but NOT invuln/shields the way Affliction/Bleed would — Piercing still respects invuln). The Incursio 'Bypass while Invulnerable' clause additionally lets his skills hit through enemy invuln when he himself is invuln. 75 one-turn piercing for a 3-pip outlay is strong but conditional on setup turns.

economy.color_dependency: Light Green dependency (mono-Green identity, character_colors=[0]). Only 2 of 5 visible pips are hard Green (Killing Strike, half of Neuntote); the other 3 are Random, so very splashable into any team.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent for offense: both damage skills (Killing Strike, Neuntote) are cooldown 0 and can be fired every turn. The two utility/defense skills (Incursio, Invisibility) are cd 3. Tempo is gated by Incursio's 3-turn buff window and re-up cadence, not by attack cooldowns.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate setup ramp: needs Incursio active (turn 1) to unlock Neuntote, then one Neuntote cast to plant the permanent stun-mark. After ~1-2 setup turns the kit runs at full power with no further ramp; no per-stack accumulation.

invuln_or_counter: Incursio end-of-turn Invulnerability when no new skill is used
Invisibility: 1-turn self-Invuln (gated on Incursio invuln)
+10 flat Damage Reduction during Incursio
skills Bypass enemy invuln while self is invuln

internal_synergies: Incursio is the linchpin: unlocks Neuntote, converts Killing Strike to Piercing, grants the Bypass-while-invuln clause, and gates Invisibility.
Neuntote's permanent false-stun mark feeds Killing Strike's +5 stun bonus every turn for the rest of the match (and any external stun-conditional teammates).
Killing Strike's two +5 conditions (stunned + <50 HP) both fire on a marked, low-HP target -> 35 piercing/turn as a closer; flagging a mission advance when both trigger.
Incursio's end-of-turn invuln triggers only on turns he uses no NEW skill, so Invisibility/idle turns make him untargetable while still holding +10 DR.
Bypass-while-invuln lets his cd-0 attacks punch through enemy invuln during his own invuln windows, turning defense into offense.
strengths: High, reliable single-target Piercing burst (up to 75 in one turn) that ignores flat and % DR.
Cooldown-0 damage skills allow sustained 35 piercing/turn pressure for a single Green pip.
Strong, multi-layered survivability: +10 DR, conditional end-of-turn invuln, and a gated on-demand invuln (Invisibility).
Permanent stun-mark from Neuntote is durable, un-cleansable-by-duration setup that also enables ally stun-payoffs.
Cheap and splashable (3 of 5 pips Random), low color commitment.
Can attack through enemy invuln while invuln himself (Bypass clause).
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero DoT — single-target only, poor into wide boards or swarms.
No team support: no healing, shields, cleanse, or energy denial; purely selfish.
Entirely dependent on Incursio uptime — Neuntote and Invisibility are hard-locked behind it, and Incursio is cd 3, so a window of vulnerability exists every cycle.
No hard CC of his own; the 'stun' is only a tag for damage conditions, it doesn't actually disable the enemy.
Burst is front-loaded and capped — no per-stack/scaling growth, so he can be out-scaled by ramp characters in long games.
Invuln-stalling turns deal no damage, creating a tempo cost; cannot both maximize evasion and pressure simultaneously every turn.
win_conditions: Open with Incursio, plant Neuntote's permanent mark, then grind a single priority target down with cd-0 piercing attacks (Killing Strike +5 from mark, +5 in execute range).
Use the invuln layers (idle end-of-turn invuln + Invisibility) to survive enemy burst turns and re-up Incursio, out-tempoing a single bruiser/carry.
Snowball by isolating and executing low-HP targets (<=50) for the +5, then moving to the next.
signature_mechanic: "Incursio transformation window that (a) makes his damage Piercing and invuln-bypassing, (b) unlocks Neuntote's permanent 'treated-as-stunned' false-stun mark, and (c) grants stacking invulnerability when he idles — turning him into a self-sufficient single-target executioner."
role: "Single-target piercing burst assassin / self-sufficient executioner with strong personal survivability"

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, well-defined assassin with reliable Piercing burst (75 single-target/turn peak, 35/turn sustained) that ignores DR, plus a robust multi-layer invuln/DR survivability package — all for a cheap, splashable cost (5 pips, 3 Random). The permanent stun-mark and cd-0 attackers give him strong, low-variance single-target pressure and durability. Held back from higher by being entirely single-target (no AoE/DoT), entirely selfish (no support/CC/energy denial), hard-dependent on the cd-3 Incursio window, and a fixed (non-ramping) damage ceiling that gets out-scaled late. He is a solid, focused 1v1 duelist rather than a team-warping threat.
outlier_flags: cooldown-0 on both damage skills enables every-turn piercing pressure for 1 pip — efficient relative to typical attackers
permanent (-1 duration) un-expiring stun-mark from Neuntote is a strong durable-setup outlier
multiple invuln sources (idle end-of-turn invuln + gated Invisibility + 'bypass enemy invuln while self invuln') make him unusually slippery for a damage dealer

abilities.name: Heaven-Piercing Ice Wall
abilities.conditional_scaling: Debuff duration scales: lasts 2+2*cold engine-duration (1 turn + 1 extra turn per Half-Cold stack). Damage itself is fixed at 20.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal damage; applies a damage-mod debuff lowering target's non-Affliction damage by 5 for 1 turn (+1 turn per Half-Cold stack). Cold builder: +1 Half-Cold, -1 Half-Hot.

abilities.name: Jet Burn
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 Affliction damage per Half-Hot stack on Todoroki (damage = 20 + 10*hot). Bypasses barriers/shields/DR.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 (+10/Half-Hot) Affliction damage, bypasses shields/barriers/DR. Hot builder: +1 Half-Hot, -1 Half-Cold.

abilities.name: Glacial Prison
abilities.conditional_scaling: Both stun and DoT last 2+2*cold engine-duration (1 turn base, +1 turn per Half-Cold stack). 15 Normal damage per turn over that duration.
abilities.effects_summary: Hard CC: stun for 1 turn (+1/Half-Cold) plus 15 Normal DoT per turn over the same duration. Cold builder: +1 Half-Cold, -1 Half-Hot.

abilities.name: Fire Wall
abilities.conditional_scaling: AoE damage = 0 + 10*hot Affliction (0 with no Half-Hot, scales 10 per stack). JSON says 0 base; only worthwhile after stacking Hot.
abilities.effects_summary: AoE Affliction to all enemies (0 + 10/Half-Hot) plus self Invulnerable for 1 turn (panic button). Hot builder: +1 Half-Hot, -1 Half-Cold.

abilities.name: Half-Hot Half-Cold
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-damage 10 Affliction per Half-Hot stack above 1 at end of turn; cost penalty +1 Random energy per Half-Cold stack above 1.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive resource engine. Tracks Half-Hot / Half-Cold marks. Overheating (>1 Hot) burns 10 Affliction self-damage per excess stack at end of turn; overfreezing (>1 Cold) inflates all skill costs by +1 Random per excess stack.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Hot-side: Jet Burn = 20 + 10*hot (Affliction, bypasses shields/DR). Hot stacks are self-limited because >1 Hot burns 10 Affliction/excess stack at end of turn, so practical Hot is ~2-3 before self-damage dominates, giving Jet Burn ~40-50, Fire Wall AoE ~20-30 across all enemies. Cold-side: Glacial Prison stun+DoT duration grows by 1 turn per Cold stack, but >1 Cold inflates costs by +1 Random/excess stack, capping practical Cold ramp too. Realistic peak single-target ~40-50 Affliction (Jet Burn at 2-3 Hot); theoretical higher but throttled by passive backlash.
damage_profile.notes: Damage is modest and deliberately throttled by the passive's two-sided punishment. Affliction on Jet Burn and Fire Wall bypasses barriers/shields/DR, making effective damage higher than face value vs defensive targets. Glacial Prison provides a 15/turn Normal DoT plus stun lock that can extend multiple turns if Cold is stacked. Peak ~60 figures assume favorable stacking ignoring the self-burn drag.

economy.color_dependency: Two-color (Blue + Red) identity matching his ice/fire theme. Blue:1 (todoroki1), Red:1 (todoroki2), Blue:1+Random:1 (todoroki3), Random:1 (todoroki4). Needs both Blue and Red consistently; moderate color dependency. Costs can inflate dynamically: Half-Cold above 1 stack adds +1 Random energy per excess stack to every skill (self-imposed tax for over-freezing).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two spammable 0-CD builders (Ice Wall, Jet Burn) for turn-by-turn ramping. Glacial Prison CD 2 (control on a leash). Fire Wall CD 4 (defensive/AoE finisher, long cooldown). Tempo is steady spam of builders punctuated by periodic control/defensive plays.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. The kit is built around alternating Hot/Cold stacking. Jet Burn and Fire Wall reward Hot stacks; Ice Wall and Glacial Prison reward Cold stacks. But each stack type punishes overcommitment (Hot = self-burn, Cold = cost inflation), so it is a balanced see-saw ramp rather than runaway scaling — you must oscillate, not stack one side.

internal_synergies: Hot/Cold see-saw: Jet Burn (+Hot) feeds its own +10/Hot Affliction scaling AND Fire Wall's AoE scaling; Ice Wall/Glacial Prison (+Cold) feed Glacial Prison's stun+DoT duration extension.

Each builder removes the opposite stack, so the passive forces oscillation — you spend a turn building Hot for a big Jet Burn, then must dump back to Cold via Ice Wall/Glacial Prison to avoid self-burn.
Glacial Prison duration scales with Cold; chaining Cold-builders before it maximizes stun-lock and total DoT.
Fire Wall converts accumulated Hot into AoE burst AND grants Invuln, letting Todoroki cash out Hot stacks defensively before they cause self-burn backlash.
Ice Wall's non-Affliction damage debuff stacks duration with Cold, providing soft mitigation that complements Glacial Prison's lockdown.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, self-balancing dual-resource ramp character. Strengths: cheap 0-CD builders, Affliction damage that bypasses shields/DR, a hard stun with extendable duration, a 15/turn DoT, a soft damage debuff, and a strong Invuln panic button on Fire Wall. However, raw output is modest (base 20s) and both scaling axes are deliberately self-throttled — Hot stacking self-damages (10 Affliction/excess), Cold stacking inflates energy costs (+1 Random/excess). This caps the realistic ceiling around 40-50 single-target and makes runaway snowballing impossible. He has no healing, no team support, no cleanse, no energy denial, and no stealth, so he's a self-contained solo skirmisher reliant on careful stack management. Fire Wall dealing 0 base damage without Hot stacks is a notable dead-on-arrival button early. Net: a solid, tactically interesting mid-tier duelist whose power is intentionally fenced in by his own passive.
outlier_flags: Fire Wall base damage is 0 (JSON description literally reads 'Deals 0 Affliction damage') — useless as an AoE until Hot is stacked; effectively an Invuln button with conditional damage.
Passive self-damage (Hot) and self cost-inflation (Cold) are unusual self-punishing mechanics that cap scaling — anti-snowball design, rare in the roster.
todoroki1's damage-mod debuff excludes Affliction (lowers only non-Affliction damage by 5), a narrow/situational soft debuff.

role: Dual-resource ramp skirmisher: a single-target Affliction/control duelist who oscillates fire (burst) and ice (stun+DoT) while self-balancing two punishing resource stacks.
signature_mechanic: Half-Hot Half-Cold see-saw: every skill adds one stack type and removes the other. Hot skills scale damage (+10/stack) but over-stacking Hot self-burns 10 Affliction/excess at end of turn; Cold skills extend stun/DoT/debuff durations but over-stacking Cold adds +1 Random energy to every skill. Forces constant oscillation rather than one-sided ramp.
strengths: Two 0-cooldown, 1-cost builders enable flexible turn-by-turn play and ramping.
Jet Burn and Fire Wall deal Affliction that bypasses barriers, shields, and DR — high effective damage vs defensive/tanky targets.
Hard stun (Glacial Prison) with duration that scales up via Cold stacks, plus a 15/turn DoT on the same target.
Fire Wall grants 1-turn Invulnerability — a strong panic button / defensive cooldown.
Ice Wall applies a damage-reduction debuff with Cold-scaling duration for soft mitigation.
Low total kit cost (5 pips) and a thematically coherent self-contained kit.
weaknesses: Damage is intentionally throttled — both scaling axes punish overcommitment, capping realistic single-target around 40-50 and AoE low.
Fire Wall deals 0 damage without prior Hot stacking; dead button early game.
No healing, no shields/barriers for allies, no cleanse, no energy denial — purely selfish, no team utility.
Cold over-stacking inflates his own energy costs, and Hot over-stacking damages himself; mismanagement is self-punishing.
Two-color (Blue + Red) requirement plus dynamic Random cost inflation can strain energy economy.
Glacial Prison (CD 2) and Fire Wall (CD 4) gate his control and defense — limited burst windows.
Relies on ramp/oscillation; weak immediate impact from a cold start.

hard_cc: stun (Glacial Prison, 1 turn base, +1/Half-Cold stack)
soft_cc: non-Affliction damage reduction -5 (Ice Wall, 1 turn +1/Half-Cold)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerable 1 turn (Fire Wall)

win_conditions: Lock down a key single target with Glacial Prison stun + DoT while chipping with cheap builders.
Oscillate to a 2-3 Hot Jet Burn for a shield-piercing Affliction spike, then dump back to Cold to avoid self-burn.
Outlast aggressive opponents using Fire Wall Invuln to survive burst turns, winning attrition with Affliction DoT/chip.
Grind down defensive/tank targets whose shields and DR are bypassed by his Affliction damage.

role: Single-target piercing assassin with a Twisted Love ramp engine and a stealth-opener disguise
signature_mechanic: Twisted Love stacks: nearly every action grants stacks (skills, syringe ticks, and +1/turn while disguised). The self-buff Twisted Love reads current stacks and grants tiered rewards for 4 turns — 3+ stacks: Killing Spree +15 dmg; 4+ stacks: all skills cost 1 less Random energy; 5+ stacks: the Twisted Love slot is swapped to the AoE nuke Drop Dead.

abilities.name: Thirsting Knife
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (flat 15); grants +1 Twisted Love stack
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Piercing damage (skips flat+%DR), gains 1 Twisted Love stack. Uniquely does NOT break Quirk: Transform disguise, so it is the stealth-opener spammable while staying hidden. CD 0 = spammable stack generator and chip.

abilities.name: Vacuum Syringe
abilities.conditional_scaling: none per-hit; applies a TICKING_TRIGGER (dur 5) that re-fires ~3 times -> 10 Bleed/tick + 1 stack/tick
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Bleed on cast + a ticking trigger (dur 5) dealing 10 Bleed and granting 1 Twisted Love stack each of ~3 following turns. Total ~40 Bleed over the window and ~4 stacks. Bleed bypasses barriers/shields. Primary stack-generation and sustained DoT tool.

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities.conditional_scaling: +15 damage (->45) while Twisted Love buff is active with 3+ stacks (via damage_mod_effect)
abilities.effects_summary: 30 Piercing (45 when buffed by Twisted Love at 3+ stacks) AND Toga becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (invuln dur 2). Burst nuke + same-turn defensive tempo. Piercing skips flat+%DR.

abilities.name: Twisted Love
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reads current Twisted Love mark stacks; tiered 4-turn rewards at 3+/4+/5+ stacks. NOTE: .gd thresholds (3/4/5) differ from stale JSON (2/4/6).
abilities.effects_summary: Self buff for 4 turns: 3+ stacks -> Killing Spree +15 dmg; 4+ stacks -> all skills cost 1 less Random energy (cost_mod); 5+ stacks -> ability-swap the Twisted Love slot into Drop Dead for the duration. The payoff/ramp converter that turns accumulated stacks into damage, economy, and an AoE finisher.

abilities.name: Quirk: Transform
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Passive opener: Toga starts the match disguised as a chosen character (shows their portrait). Disguise breaks on taking damage OR using any skill except Thirsting Knife. While disguised she gains +1 Twisted Love stack each turn (free pre-ramp). Pure information/mindgame + free stack ramp; no combat stats.

abilities.name: Drop Dead
abilities.conditional_scaling: none; unlocked only by replacing the Twisted Love slot at 5+ stacks
abilities.effects_summary: AoE: stuns ALL enemies for 1 turn (stun dur 2) and applies a delayed 25 Normal damage effect (dur 3) that detonates the following turn. Team-wide hard CC + delayed nuke; only accessible after ramping to 5+ Twisted Love stacks and casting Twisted Love.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Single-target ceiling ~45 (Killing Spree buffed at 3+ stacks). Realistic per-turn output stacks Thirsting Knife (15 Pierce) + a Syringe Bleed tick (10) on top once DoT is rolling, ~25-55/turn single target. Drop Dead adds 25 Normal to ALL enemies (delayed one turn) once the 5+ stack swap is online, plus the team-wide stun. No further per-stack damage scaling beyond the 3+ threshold flip, so the ceiling is fixed rather than runaway.
damage_profile.notes: Damage is heavily Piercing (toga1/toga3) and Bleed (toga2) -- both bypass DR/shields, so 'effective' damage is higher than raw vs tanky/shielded targets. Drop Dead is Normal (mitigable) and delayed. Burst is front-loaded into Killing Spree (45 = buffed at 3+ stacks); everything else is chip/DoT. Stacks gate DAMAGE only at the 3+ tier (binary +15), not a continuous scaler.

economy.color_dependency: None -- character_colors=[] and every visible ability costs only Random energy. Maximally splashable; fits any team's energy pool with zero color tax.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Aggressive/flexible: Thirsting Knife CD 0 (spammable), Killing Spree CD 1, Syringe CD 2, Twisted Love CD 3, Drop Dead CD 3. The CD-0 stack generator means Toga always has an action; main throttles are the 3-CD buff/AoE.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high. Real power lives behind Twisted Love stacks: +15 dmg at 3, -1 Random cost (self-sustaining economy loop) at 4, AoE Drop Dead at 5. Disguise (+1/turn) and Syringe ticks (+1/turn) feed ramp passively, so she reaches thresholds without spending tempo, but turn-1 she is just a 15-dmg piercer.

hard_cc: Drop Dead: stun ALL enemies for 1 turn (alt-slot, requires 5+ stacks)
invuln_or_counter: Killing Spree: self Invulnerable for 1 turn on cast

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, low-friction assassin. Strengths: zero color dependency (7 Random pips total) makes her universally splashable; CD-0 Thirsting Knife guarantees an action and free ramp; heavy Piercing+Bleed means her damage largely ignores DR/shields/barriers (high effective damage vs tanks); Killing Spree pairs 30-45 burst with a 1-turn invuln (offense+defense in one button); the Twisted Love engine self-funds its own economy (-1 cost at 4 stacks) and unlocks a team-wide stun + 25 AoE finisher (Drop Dead) at 5. Disguise is a strong information/mindgame opener with free passive ramp. Weaknesses: raw numbers are modest (single-target ceiling fixed at 45, AoE only 25 and delayed); no healing/shields/cleanse/energy-denial; front-loaded burst with no continuous scaler beyond the binary 3+ threshold; ramp-dependent (turn-1 she's a 15-dmg poke); disguise breaks the moment she does anything but Thirsting Knife or eats damage, so the stealth value is fragile; the Drop Dead payoff requires reaching 5 stacks AND spending a turn on Twisted Love. Solid mid-tier: efficient, flexible, and tanky-shred-relevant, but not a damage outlier.
outlier_flags: JSON-vs-gd threshold mismatch: metadata/JSON says Twisted Love triggers at 2/4/6 stacks and Killing Spree needs 2+, but toga4.gd uses 3/4/5 -- code is ground truth at 3/4/5.
Thirsting Knife not breaking disguise is the linchpin of the stealth opener and is easy to overlook.
Pervasive Piercing/Bleed damage typing makes effective damage notably higher than raw vs DR/shield comps.

strengths: Zero color dependency -- 7 Random pips across the visible kit, splashable into any team
Piercing (toga1/toga3) + Bleed (toga2) bypass DR/shields/barriers, giving high effective damage vs tanks
Killing Spree = 30-45 burst PLUS a 1-turn self-invuln in a single action
CD-0 Thirsting Knife: always has an action, free stack ramp, and uniquely keeps disguise active
Twisted Love engine self-funds economy (-1 Random cost at 4 stacks) and unlocks a team-wide stun + AoE nuke
Multiple passive stack sources (disguise +1/turn, Syringe ticks +1/turn) reach thresholds without spending tempo
Disguise opener provides real information/mindgame value and free pre-combat ramp
weaknesses: No healing, shields, cleanse, or energy denial -- purely offensive toolkit
Modest raw numbers: single-target ceiling fixed at 45, AoE only 25 and delayed a turn
Ramp-dependent: turn-1 she is just a 15-damage piercer; payoffs gate at 3/4/5 stacks
Disguise is fragile -- breaks on any damage taken or any skill other than Thirsting Knife
Drop Dead requires both reaching 5 stacks AND spending a turn casting Twisted Love to unlock
Burst is binary, not a continuous scaler -- no runaway ceiling, easy to plan around
Self-invuln is her only defensive layer; if focused before ramping she has little staying power
win_conditions: Open disguised, poke with Thirsting Knife to accrue free stacks, then convert with Twisted Love into the -1 cost economy loop and the +15 Killing Spree
Stack to 5, cast Twisted Love to swap in Drop Dead, and team-wide stun + AoE-detonate to swing a teamfight
Grind down tanky/shielded comps with unmitigable Piercing + Bleed where conventional DR comps fall off
Use Killing Spree's invuln to trade favorably and survive focus while the ramp comes online
internal_synergies: Thirsting Knife feeds Twisted Love stacks at CD 0 without breaking disguise -- the core ramp loop
Disguise (toga5) grants +1 stack/turn for free, accelerating every Twisted Love threshold pre-combat
Vacuum Syringe ticks grant +1 stack/turn over ~3 turns AND sustained Bleed simultaneously
Twisted Love (toga4) is the keystone: its 3+/4+/5+ tiers buff Killing Spree, cut all skill costs, and unlock Drop Dead
4+ stack cost reduction (-1 Random) makes the expensive 3-pip skills (Killing Spree, Drop Dead) far more castable
Killing Spree's self-invuln lets her safely commit the burst turn while building toward the AoE payoff

abilities.name: Dark Shadow Rampage
abilities.cost_breakdown: Random:4 (cost reduced by 1 Random per Black Abyss stack, 4->1 at 3 stacks)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cost drops by 1 Random energy per Black Abyss stack (4 -> 1 at 3 stacks); damage itself does not scale
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 10 Normal damage to all enemies immediately, then applies a 10 Normal damage-per-turn DoT (duration 7 = 3 further ticks) for 4 total instances of 10 (=40 total per enemy over 4 turns). Pure AoE damage, no control.

abilities.name: Sabbath
abilities.target_type: SINGLE (becomes ALL at 3 stacks via target_change)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stun class-scope and target count scale with Black Abyss stacks: 0=Strategic-stun, 1=+Mental, 2=full stun, 3=full stun applied to ALL enemies (AoE). At 3 stacks cooldown raised to 2 by Dark Aura/Black Abyss.
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Normal damage to primary target (only first target takes damage even when AoE), plus a 1-turn stun (dur 2). Stun scope widens with stacks: Strategic-only -> Strategic+Mental -> all skills; at 3 stacks the stun hits all enemies. Cheap repeatable lockdown.

abilities.name: Covert Black-Ops Arms
abilities.conditional_scaling: Counter scope scales with stacks: 0=first Strategic skill, 1=+Mental, 2/3=first any skill. At 3 stacks applies to all enemies. Invisible counter, 1-turn window (dur 2).
abilities.effects_summary: Applies an invisible counter to target for 1 turn: if the target uses a skill of the covered class, it is countered (negated). Scope widens with stacks; at 3 stacks counters the first skill from every enemy. Anti-cast / tempo-denial tool, no damage.

abilities.name: Dark Aura
abilities.conditional_scaling: Invuln scope scales with stacks: 0=Strategic, 1=+Mental, 2/3=all skills. At 3 stacks can be cast on an ally (targets allied), extending protection coverage to teammates.
abilities.effects_summary: Grants Tokoyami (self) invulnerability to a class of skills for 1 turn (self dur 2). Scope widens with stacks to full invuln; at 3 stacks retargets to allies. Defensive panic button / ally protection.

abilities.name: Black Abyss
abilities.conditional_scaling: Core ramp engine: +1 stack each turn (max 3). Loses a stack if Stunned/Silenced/Blinded and gains none that turn. At 3 stacks: Sabbath/Covert/Dark Aura gain ALL-target capability and Sabbath cooldown +1.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive stacking mark (Black Abyss, max 3) that drives all conditional scaling on abilities 1-4. Ramps automatically; interrupted by hard CC (stun/silence/blind), which also strips a stack. Defines Tokoyami's entire power curve.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Damage is FLAT and low — Black Abyss does not scale damage numbers, only cost, control scope, and target count. Peak single-target burst in one turn is ~25 (Sabbath 15 + first DoT tick 10 from Rampage). Peak realistic AoE in one turn is ~25 per enemy (Rampage immediate 10 + first tick 10; Sabbath's 15 only hits one target even at 3 stacks). Rampage delivers ~40 total per enemy across its 4-turn DoT but spread over time. Tokoyami's 'scaling' is utility/lockdown breadth, not damage.
damage_profile.notes: Lowest-tier raw damage character; identity is control + protection that broadens as stacks build, not a damage ramp. The custom_behavior AI hints (25/40) overstate effective damage versus the actual .gd numbers (10/15).

economy.color_dependency: Light single-color (Red) dependency: only Sabbath and Covert Black-Ops Arms require Red (1 each); Rampage is 4 Random, Dark Aura is 1 Random. Energy identity is Red. Rampage's Random cost is discounted by Black Abyss stacks (4 -> 1 at full ramp), so effective kit cost can drop to ~4 pips once ramped.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent low-end tempo: Sabbath is a 1-cd 1-Red repeatable stun, Covert is 2-cd, Dark Aura 3-cd, Rampage 4-cd. Can stun nearly every turn; at 3 stacks Sabbath cd rises to 2 (self-imposed throttle on the AoE stun).
economy.ramp_dependency: HIGH. The entire kit is balanced around Black Abyss stack count (0->3). At 0 stacks abilities are narrow single-target / Strategic-only; at 3 stacks they become full-class, all-target effects. Ramp is automatic (+1/turn) but fragile: any stun/silence/blind on Tokoyami strips a stack and blanks that turn's gain, so the opponent can reset his power.

hard_cc: stun (Sabbath, 1 turn; scope/target widening with stacks; full-class and AoE at 3 stacks)
invuln_or_counter: invulnerability to a skill class for self/allies (Dark Aura; scope widens to full invuln, ally-targetable at 3 stacks)
skill counter / negation (Covert Black-Ops Arms; scope widens to any-skill, AoE first-skill counter at 3 stacks)

role: Ramping control/lockdown disruptor with light AoE DoT — denies enemy actions (stun/counter) and protects allies (invuln), scaling breadth with Black Abyss stacks rather than damage.
signature_mechanic: Black Abyss: a passive that gains 1 stack/turn (max 3) and is stripped by stun/silence/blind on Tokoyami. Every active ability's reach scales with the stack count — at 0 stacks effects are narrow (single-target, Strategic-class only); at 1 add Mental, at 2 add all classes, and at 3 every active becomes ALL-target (team stun, team counter, ally-wide invuln) at the cost of +1 Sabbath cooldown. Also discounts Dark Shadow Rampage's Random cost by 1 per stack.
internal_synergies: Black Abyss (passive) is the linchpin: it simultaneously upgrades the class-scope AND target-count of Sabbath, Covert Black-Ops Arms, and Dark Aura, and cheapens Rampage.
Sabbath's stun and Covert's counter both deny enemy actions — and since CC on Tokoyami strips his stacks, his own lockdown protects his ramp by keeping enemies from stunning him back.
Dark Aura (invuln) lets Tokoyami survive while ramping; at 3 stacks it converts into a team-protection tool, pivoting him from solo disruptor to support.
At 3 stacks the kit becomes an AoE control package: team stun (Sabbath ALL) + team counter (Covert ALL) + team invuln (Dark Aura allied) layered on top of Rampage's AoE DoT.
win_conditions: Reach 3 Black Abyss stacks uninterrupted and pivot into AoE lockdown (team-wide stun + team-wide counter) to stall the enemy team while Rampage's DoT grinds them down.
Use cheap, repeatable single-target Sabbath stuns + Covert counters early to deny key enemy casters and protect the ramp.
Out-tempo opponents on energy: once ramped the kit costs almost nothing (Sabbath 1 Red, Rampage discounted), letting Tokoyami chain control every turn while teammates close kills.
strengths: Very cheap, high-frequency control: a 1-cooldown, 1-Red repeatable stun is rare tempo value.
Broad, scaling disruption — at 3 stacks delivers simultaneous AoE stun, AoE counter, and team invuln, an excellent anti-offense package.
Strong defensive/protective options (self and ally invuln, skill counters) that ignore HP and negate abilities outright.
Energy-light: only 2 Red pips of color dependency; Rampage self-discounts as it ramps, freeing energy for the rest of the kit.
Self-reinforcing loop: his own CC stops enemies from stripping his stacks.
weaknesses: Very low raw damage — flat 10/15 numbers that never scale; he cannot close games quickly and leans on the DoT and teammates for kills.
Fragile ramp: a single stun/silence/blind both wipes that turn's stack gain and removes a stack, so dedicated CC or energy-denial enemies can keep him perpetually weak.
Front-loaded weakness: at 0-1 stacks his control is narrow (Strategic/Mental-only, single target) and easy to play around.
No healing, no HP shields, and modest survivability outside the situational 1-turn invuln — sustained pressure or burst can drop him before he ramps.
Counters/invuln are class-conditional at low stacks, so opponents can bait or sidestep them with off-class skills.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed scaling control specialist. The standout is tempo: a 1-cooldown / 1-Red repeatable stun plus a cheap counter is strong action-denial, and at 3 stacks the kit blossoms into a layered AoE lockdown (team stun + team counter + team invuln) that can hard-stall an enemy team while a 40-over-4-turns AoE DoT chips them down. That control ceiling is genuinely high. It is held back from top tier by (a) near-zero scaling damage — he almost never closes a kill himself, and (b) a fragile ramp that any stun/silence/blind resets, giving CC-heavy or energy-denial opponents a clean counter. In isolation he is a solid, high-utility support/disruptor whose value depends heavily on a team that can convert his lockdown into kills.
outlier_flags: custom_behavior AI hints (25 single / 40 AoE) significantly exceed the real .gd damage (10 immediate + 10/tick; 15 on Sabbath) — AI may over-value his offense
Sabbath only damages the first/primary target even when it becomes AoE at 3 stacks (only target == targets[0] takes the 15), so its 3-stack upgrade is control-only, not damage AoE
Ramp-strip vulnerability to stun/silence/blind is a hard, exploitable counter that swings his power heavily by matchup
Dark Shadow Rampage cost-discount can drive effective kit cost to ~4 pips, a cheap-side economy outlier once ramped

role: Defensive control/support — Physical-attacker lockdown, energy denial, and team protection
signature_mechanic: Earthen Shackles locks down an enemy's Physical skills with a self-refreshing stun + DoT and marks them so the spammable, free-cooldown Stone Pillar repeatedly strips 1 random energy — a single-target soft-lock + energy-denial loop, backed by team-wide invulnerability and shields.

abilities.name: Stone Pillar
abilities.conditional_scaling: If target is marked by Earthen Shackles: also drains 1 random energy (no extra damage). No damage scaling otherwise.
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal single-target damage; cooldown-free spam. If target carries the Earthen Shackles mark, removes 1 random energy from them (energy denial). Advances a mission counter on the energy-drain proc.

abilities.name: Earthen Shackles
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-refreshing: a ticking trigger (dur 3) re-applies the Physical-skill stun + Stone Pillar mark each turn while active; paused if Toph is stunned. No damage scaling.
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Normal upfront damage + 10 Normal DoT/turn (damage_effect dur 3). Stuns the target's Physical skills (stun_effect dur 2 = 1 turn) and re-stuns each turn via the ticking trigger. Applies a mark (dur 3) enabling Stone Pillar's energy drain. Self-mark notes the channel pauses if Toph is stunned.

abilities.name: Metal Armor
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Grants target ally a 30 Shield (dur -1, persistent; re-cast refreshes magnitude to 30). Ally is Blinded for as long as the shield persists — a drawback unless paired with a Blind-immune target (e.g. Toph via Seismic Sense).

abilities.name: Earth Wall
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Makes ALL allied characters Invulnerable for 1 turn (invuln_effect dur 2). Team-wide hard defensive save / tempo button on a 5-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Seismic Sense
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Passive (auto-applied). Toph ignores Blind effects (ignore_effect_effect on BLIND, dur -1) and can see invisible enemy Physical effects (mark, dur -1). Counters stealth/invisibility and removes the downside of self-targeting Metal Armor.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Flat — no damage scaling. Per-turn ceiling while Shackles is active: 20 (Stone Pillar) + 10 (Shackles DoT tick) = 30 Normal/turn, all of it barrier/DR-affected (Normal type). The kit kills via attrition + energy denial, not burst.
damage_profile.notes: Low, all-Normal damage that is fully stopped by shields/DR. Casting Shackles deals 10 upfront + 10 DoT = 20 that turn; thereafter spamming Stone Pillar on a shackled target sustains 30/turn (20 hit + 10 tick). Real output value is the energy denial (1 random energy stripped per Stone Pillar on a shackled foe) plus permanent Physical-skill stun-lock, not raw HP loss.

economy.color_dependency: Light Green dependency. 3 of 6 visible pips are Green (toph1, toph2, toph3 each need 1 Green); the other 3 are Random. Mono-color identity [Green] but cheap and easy to fund alongside other Green/flex characters.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mixed. Stone Pillar is cooldown-free (spammable energy-denial/damage every turn). Metal Armor cd 2, Earthen Shackles cd 3, Earth Wall cd 5 (long). The free Stone Pillar gives constant pressure while the strong defensives are gated by long cooldowns.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low ramp, high setup. No stacking/transformation ramp, but the kit's value is gated on first landing Earthen Shackles to enable the Stone Pillar energy-drain loop and Physical lockdown. Once the mark is up, value is immediate and repeatable.

hard_cc: Physical-skill stun via Earthen Shackles (self-refreshing while active, effectively permanent)
soft_cc: Blind inflicted on shielded ally via Metal Armor (drawback/utility)
invuln_or_counter: Team-wide Invulnerability for 1 turn (Earth Wall, AoE, cd 5)
