Seismic Sense passive: Blind immunity + reveals invisible enemy Physical effects (anti-stealth/anti-invisibility)

win_conditions: Lock down a key Physical-damage enemy with Earthen Shackles (permanent Physical-skill stun) and grind them with the Stone Pillar mark loop, starving them of energy.
Out-sustain the enemy: use Earth Wall team invuln and Metal Armor shields to absorb burst windows while chip damage and energy denial accumulate.
Counter stealth/invisibility and Blind-reliant comps via Seismic Sense, neutralizing their core mechanic.
internal_synergies: Earthen Shackles -> Stone Pillar: the Shackles mark turns the free Stone Pillar into repeatable single-target energy denial each turn.
Metal Armor + Seismic Sense: Toph is immune to Blind, so she can shield herself with Metal Armor with no Blind downside; allies suffer the Blind unless they too ignore it.
Earthen Shackles stun-lock pairs with its DoT to keep a Physical attacker permanently disabled while it bleeds out.
Earth Wall + Metal Armor give a layered defensive package: invuln for the burst turn, shields for the follow-up.
strengths: Excellent, cheap energy denial — repeatable 1-energy strip per turn on a shackled target via a cooldown-free skill.
Hard, self-refreshing lockdown of an enemy's Physical skills (effectively permanent disable of Physical attackers).
Strong team protection: AoE 1-turn invulnerability plus a refreshing 30 shield.
Very low color commitment (mono-Green, half the pips Random) — easy to slot into many comps.
Built-in anti-stealth/anti-Blind counter (Seismic Sense) that hard-counters invisibility comps.
weaknesses: Very low, all-Normal damage that is fully blunted by shields, barriers, and DR — almost no kill pressure on her own.
No healing, no cleanse; sustain is purely mitigation (shields/invuln), so accumulated damage is hard to undo.
Lockdown only hits Physical-class skills — Energy/Affliction/non-Physical attackers walk through Earthen Shackles' stun.
Key defensives are on long cooldowns (Earth Wall cd 5), and Metal Armor blinds non-immune allies, a real downside.
Value is heavily front-loaded on landing Earthen Shackles; if she is stunned, the channel pauses and the loop stalls.
Single-target control — limited answer to wide AoE/swarm pressure beyond the one Earth Wall save.

power_assessment.reasoning: A specialist defensive controller. Her power lies in repeatable energy denial + a permanent Physical-skill stun-lock on a single target, plus genuinely strong team protection (AoE invuln + refreshing shield) at a trivial mono-Green cost. The Stone Pillar/Earthen Shackles loop is efficient and oppressive against Physical-damage dealers and energy-reliant enemies. However, her own damage is negligible and entirely Normal (shield/DR-stoppable), she has no healing or cleanse, and her control is narrow (Physical-only + single-target). She is a high-impact pick into the right matchups (Physical bruisers, stealth/invisibility, energy-hungry kits) and a low-impact, no-kill-pressure liability into Energy/Affliction or wide-AoE comps. Balanced, matchup-dependent support; not a standalone carry.
outlier_flags: Stone Pillar is a cost-1, cooldown-0 ability that both deals 20 damage AND strips 1 random energy on a marked target — a very strong repeatable energy-denial rate for its cost.
Earthen Shackles' ticking trigger re-applies the Physical stun every turn, making the Physical-skill disable effectively permanent (near-perma-stun on Physical attackers).

Metal Armor grants a persistent (dur -1) shield refreshable on a 2-turn recast, with the unusual cost of Blinding the shielded ally — a drawback that synergizes specifically with Toph's own Seismic Sense immunity.

role: Evasive single-target counter-duelist / tempo-denial assassin
signature_mechanic: Draw Stance is a counter-stance: activating it sets up a counter (next harmful skill on Touka is negated, attacker takes 15, and the stance ends) AND swaps her bar to Raikiri, a 45 Piercing, Uncounterable nuke. The whole kit is built around baiting an enemy attack with the stance/dodge tools, then drawing for a guaranteed high-pierce strike, all while Nukiashi keeps her actions invisible.

abilities.name: Draw Stance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Counter damage (15 Normal) only triggers if an enemy uses a new harmful skill on Touka while the stance is active
abilities.effects_summary: Swaps Draw Stance->Raikiri for 1 turn (ability_swap dur 3, self-facing). Adds a COUNTER_RECEIVE counter: the next Harmful skill used on Touka is countered, its user takes 15 Normal damage, and the stance/swap ends immediately. Counter-bait that unlocks the Raikiri nuke. If Nukiashi mark is active, all of these effects are invisible.

abilities.name: Nukiashi
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: For ~2 turns (mark dur 5 / stealth dur 5, self-facing): applies a Stealth effect AND a 'Nukiashi' mark that renders Touka's subsequently-cast effects Invisible to the opponent. Pure information-denial / stealth enabler; the mark is read by toudou1/3/4 to hide their effects. No damage, no offense.

abilities.name: Raiou
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal damage to a single enemy and applies cooldown_mod(2,2): increases the cooldown of that target's skills by 2 for 1 turn. Tempo/soft energy-denial poke. Effect becomes invisible under Nukiashi.

abilities.name: Graceful Dodge
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: ignore_damage_effect(2): Touka ignores ALL damage for 1 turn (full damage invulnerability). Long CD4 panic/bait button. Effect invisible under Nukiashi.

abilities.name: Raikiri
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden alt slot, only available while Draw Stance's 1-turn swap is active. Deals 45 Piercing damage to a single enemy (skips flat + percent DR), Uncounterable. The kit's payoff nuke. CD 0 so it can be fired the instant the swap window opens.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No stacking/ramp scaling. Hard ceiling per turn is ~65 to one target (45 Piercing Raikiri + 20 Normal Raiou if both fired the same turn), plus 15 reactive counter damage if an enemy walks into Draw Stance. No per-stack/per-kill/transformation multiplier, so damage is fixed.
damage_profile.notes: Raikiri's 45 is Piercing (ignores flat and % DR) and Uncounterable, making it reliably effective against tanky/DR-stacked targets. Raiou's 20 is plain Normal (mitigable). Realistic single-turn burst is 45 (Raikiri the turn after Draw Stance) since the player typically spends one turn entering stance; 65 requires both Green-costed offensive skills the same turn while the swap is up. Counter pings 15 Normal reactively, off-turn.

economy.color_dependency: Very light. Across the 4 visible skills only Raiou needs a specific pip (1 Green); Draw Stance and Graceful Dodge each take 1 Random and Nukiashi is free. Raikiri (alt) costs 1 Green + 1 Random. Total Green demand is low (1 in the visible bar, 2 if Raikiri also fires).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent / spammy. Three of four visible skills are CD1 and Raikiri is CD0; only Graceful Dodge is on a long CD4. She can run the stance/draw loop nearly every turn; the long-CD invuln is the only real tempo limiter.
economy.ramp_dependency: None. No build-up, stacks, or transformation gating beyond the 1-turn Draw Stance->Raikiri swap window. Fully online from turn 1.

soft_cc: Raiou: +2 cooldown to target's skills for 1 turn (action/tempo denial)
invuln_or_counter: Graceful Dodge: ignore ALL damage for 1 turn (full invuln, CD4)
Draw Stance: counters the next Harmful skill used on Touka, deals 15 to attacker, and ends the stance

win_conditions: Out-tempo a single priority target: chip with Raiou (and its cooldown lock) while baiting an attack into Draw Stance, then draw Raikiri for 45 unmitigable Piercing to close.
Survive-and-counter: cycle Draw Stance / Graceful Dodge to neutralize the enemy's biggest harmful skill, punishing with the 15 counter, then convert the stance into Raikiri.
Information war: keep Nukiashi up so the opponent cannot see Touka's stance/dodge/counter setups and misplays into the counter or wastes burst into invuln.
internal_synergies: Draw Stance -> Raikiri is the core combo: the stance is the only way to access the 45 Piercing Uncounterable nuke; the counter half also punishes anyone who tries to interrupt the draw.

Nukiashi (free, CD1) hides the effects of Draw Stance, Raiou's cooldown-lock, and Graceful Dodge's invuln, so the opponent can't tell whether she is in counter-stance, dodging, or just poking, maximizing bait value.
Graceful Dodge (full invuln) and Draw Stance (counter) overlap as bait tools: both reward the enemy committing a harmful skill, giving Touka multiple ways to invalidate enemy turns before drawing.
Raiou's +2 cooldown lock buys the extra turn she needs to set Draw Stance and resolve Raikiri before the target can retaliate.
strengths: Reliable, mitigation-proof finisher: Raikiri is 45 Piercing AND Uncounterable, beating DR-stackers, shields-as-DR, and counter characters.
Strong defensive suite for a damage dealer: full-damage invuln (Graceful Dodge) plus a counter-stance, letting her trade turns very favorably.
Excellent tempo/economy: nearly all skills CD1 or CD0, low total cost (3 pips visible), minimal color dependency, fully online turn 1.
Built-in soft control + information denial (Raiou cooldown lock + Nukiashi stealth/invisible effects) that disrupts enemy sequencing.
Free Nukiashi makes her setups extremely hard to read, amplifying the value of every bait.
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero sustain: purely single-target, useless at spreading pressure or against wide boards; no healing/shields/cleanse to support a team.
Damage ceiling is hard-capped (~65/turn, realistically 45) with no scaling, so she falls off versus high-HP/regenerating comps or in long games.
Burst is gated behind a 1-turn Draw Stance setup; the swap window can be wasted if the player can't connect Raikiri or is forced to use the stance defensively.
Counter and dodge are reactive: a patient opponent who simply doesn't attack into them, or who uses Affliction/Bleed/non-harmful pressure, neutralizes her defensive identity.
No hard CC and no true energy denial; Raiou only delays cooldowns, it doesn't strip resources or lock a target down.
Squishy frame: outside the long-CD4 invuln and single-use counter she has no mitigation, so unbaited burst or DoT can punish her.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, self-sufficient single-target duelist. Her standout is a 45 Piercing + Uncounterable nuke that bypasses the game's main mitigation levers, backed by an unusually deep defensive/evasion package (full-damage invuln, a counter-stance, stealth, and effect invisibility) on very cheap, low-cooldown costs. That combination of reliable burst + strong self-protection + tempo disruption (Raiou cooldown lock) makes her a frustrating, high-floor pick that can repeatedly invalidate enemy turns. She is held back from top tier by a hard, non-scaling damage ceiling, complete lack of AoE and team support, and the fact that her counter/dodge identity is reactive and can be played around by patient or DoT-based opponents. Strong but not oppressive in isolation.
outlier_flags: Uncounterable + Piercing on the same 45-damage skill is a notable mitigation-bypass combo worth roster-wide comparison.
Nukiashi is free (0 cost) and CD1 and grants stealth + effect-invisibility, giving near-permanent information-denial uptime that raw stat checks may undervalue.
Three CD1 skills plus a CD0 nuke give near-every-turn pressure with almost no downtime, flag for tempo balance.

role: AoE energy-denial controller who ramps into single-target burst + hard stun via a self-empower
signature_mechanic: Crystallized Ukaku (touka3) is a self-empower toggle that flips Touka from a low-damage AoE harasser into a single-target nuke: it converts Ukaku Slam and Crystallized Shards to single-target, adds +20 / +15 damage to them respectively, grants a 20 shield, and lays a 2-turn 5-piercing AoE DoT. Under Ukaku, Ukaku Slam becomes a 45-damage hit that fully stuns for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Ukaku Slam
abilities.target_type: ALL enemies (single-target while Crystallized Ukaku is active)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base hit is a flat 25 (code computes mod_damage = base_boost 5 + base_damage 20 unconditionally). During 'Crystallized Ukaku' a damage_mod from touka3 adds +20 -> 45 single-target, plus a full stun for 1 turn. NOTE: the 'Crystallized Shards' +5 boost shown in the description is non-functional - the 'boost' variable is computed but never added to mod_damage (dead code / bug).
abilities.effects_summary: 0-cooldown spammable AoE Normal damage (25, blocked by shields/DR). Under Crystallized Ukaku: becomes single-target 45 damage and applies a full Stun for 1 turn (stun dur 2). The advertised +5 vs Crystallized-Shards-marked targets does not actually apply (dead code).

abilities.name: Crystallized Shards
abilities.target_type: ALL enemies (single-target while Crystallized Ukaku is active)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 5 Piercing. During 'Crystallized Ukaku' a damage_mod from touka3 adds +15 -> 20 Piercing (single-target).
abilities.effects_summary: AoE 5 Piercing (skips flat+%DR) + increases all enemy cooldowns by 1 for 2 turns (cooldown_mod dur 4) - a soft tempo/energy-denial lock. Also applies the 'Crystallized Shards' MARK (dur 3) intended to enable the +5 on Ukaku Slam, but that bonus is currently dead code. Advances mission counter 8.

abilities.name: Crystallized Ukaku
abilities.conditional_scaling: This is the empower enabler, not a scaler itself. It grants damage_mod +20 to Ukaku Slam and +15 to Crystallized Shards for 3 (dur), and target_change to SINGLE for both abilities.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-empower 'transformation' (no model swap, an effect bundle for ~1 turn): gain 20 Shield (dur 4); convert Ukaku Slam and Crystallized Shards to single-target; +20 damage to Ukaku Slam, +15 to Crystallized Shards; immediate 5 Piercing AoE to all enemies plus a 5 Piercing AoE DoT (damage_effect dur 5) ticking each turn. 4-turn cooldown gates the burst window.

abilities.name: Touka Observation
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Panic button: Touka becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend -> invuln_effect dur 2) and gains +5 damage for 1 turn. Pure defensive/utility; no damage.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true scaling - damage is bounded by the fixed Crystallized Ukaku empower. Peak single-target in one turn under Ukaku: Ukaku Slam 45 (Normal) + Crystallized Shards 20 (Piercing) = 65 to one target, plus the 5 Piercing DoT tick = ~70, while also full-stunning that target for 1 turn. Outside Ukaku the kit caps around 25 single / 30 AoE.
damage_profile.notes: Non-Ukaku AoE peak ~30 in one turn (Ukaku Slam 25 Normal to all + Crystallized Shards 5 Piercing to all). Once Crystallized Ukaku is up, abilities go single-target so AoE output drops to just the 5 Piercing DoT tick. Touka must choose between spreading (no Ukaku) and bursting one target (Ukaku). The full stun on a 45-damage Ukaku Slam is the standout - both burst and hard CC on the same button.

economy.color_dependency: Light. 3 specific pips: Red x2 (Ukaku Slam, Crystallized Shards) + Blue x1 (Crystallized Ukaku). Identity colors are Blue+Red. The remaining 2 pips are Random/flexible. Very cheap kit overall.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Ukaku Slam is 0-cooldown and spammable every turn; Crystallized Shards is 2; the two strong buttons (Crystallized Ukaku empower, Touka Observation invuln) are both 4. Low energy + spammable main makes her energy-efficient.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. She functions immediately as a cheap AoE harasser/cooldown-locker, but her burst identity is gated behind Crystallized Ukaku (4 cd, ~1-turn window). Real damage requires lining up the empower with Ukaku Slam/Shards inside the window.

hard_cc: Full stun for 1 turn (Ukaku Slam during Crystallized Ukaku)
soft_cc: Enemy cooldown increase +1 for 2 turns, all enemies (Crystallized Shards)
invuln_or_counter: Invulnerability for 1 turn (Touka Observation)

win_conditions: Pressure the whole enemy team early with 0-cost spammable AoE + cooldown-lock to deny their key abilities, then convert to a single-target kill window with Crystallized Ukaku.
Use the Crystallized Ukaku window to land a 45-damage full-stun Ukaku Slam on a priority target, denying them a turn while bursting them down.
Out-tempo the opponent: cheap costs + 0-cd main + 20 shield + 1-turn invuln let her trade efficiently and survive while chipping with Piercing DoT.
internal_synergies: Crystallized Ukaku (touka3) is the hub: it empowers BOTH Ukaku Slam (+20, +full stun) and Crystallized Shards (+15) and makes them single-target, turning two cheap AoE buttons into a focused burst + hard-CC combo.
Crystallized Shards' cooldown lock pairs with the Ukaku stun to chain control - increase enemy cooldowns, then stun the most dangerous target for an extra turn of denial.
Touka Observation's invuln + the 20 shield from Crystallized Ukaku give her two defensive layers to survive the cooldown gaps between burst windows.
The 5 Piercing AoE DoT from Crystallized Ukaku keeps chip damage on the rest of the team while she focuses one target single-target.
strengths: Very cheap, energy-efficient kit (5 total pips, only 3 color-specific) with a 0-cooldown spammable AoE main.
Strong control package: team-wide cooldown increase (soft energy/tempo denial) plus an on-demand full stun for 1 turn.
Flexible identity - can play AoE harasser/denier or pivot to single-target burst via Crystallized Ukaku.
Self-sufficient survivability: 20 shield + 1-turn invulnerability + Piercing damage that bypasses enemy DR/shields.
Burst + hard CC on the same button (45-damage stunning Ukaku Slam) is high-value tempo.
weaknesses: Low ceiling - all damage is flat and fixed; ~65 single-target in the empower window is the hard cap with no scaling.
Burst is gated behind a 4-cd empower with only a ~1-turn window, so her strong turns are infrequent.
Mutually exclusive modes: turning on Crystallized Ukaku makes her abilities single-target, sacrificing all AoE pressure to burst one target.
No healing, no cleanse, no counter - purely shields/invuln for defense.
BUG: the 'Crystallized Shards' +5 bonus on Ukaku Slam is dead code (the boost is computed but never added), so a core advertised synergy does nothing.
Main-mode AoE damage (25 Normal / 5 Piercing) is low and the Normal portion is fully blocked by shields/barriers.

power_assessment.reasoning: A solidly designed, cheap tempo/control character with a clear ramp-into-burst identity. Her economy is excellent (0-cd spammable main, only 5 pips, 3 color-specific) and her control package - team-wide cooldown increase plus an on-demand full stun on a 45-damage hit - is genuinely strong utility. Survivability (20 shield + 1-turn invuln + Piercing that ignores DR) keeps her healthy between windows. But her damage ceiling is low and entirely fixed with no scaling, her burst is infrequent (4-cd, 1-turn window), and the AoE-vs-single-target mode tradeoff means she can never do both at once. Without healing, cleanse, or a counter she is a capable mid-tier controller rather than a carry. Rated 5.5 in isolation: above-average utility and economy, below-average raw output.
outlier_flags: BUG: touka1 'Crystallized Shards' +5 boost is dead code - 'boost' variable is set but never used; mod_damage is always base_boost(5)+base_damage(20)=25, so the mark-conditional bonus never applies.
touka1 base damage is effectively 25, not the 20 stated in its description (the 5 from base_boost is always added).
Cheap 0-cooldown spammable AoE main (Ukaku Slam) is an economy outlier - most AoE damage abilities carry a cooldown.

role: Weapon-support enabler / partner buffer (wields an ally for DR, color-fixing, invuln-bypass, shields, and counter protection)
signature_mechanic: "Wielding" mechanic: Tsubaki attaches herself to an ally (auto-onto Black Star at game start via the passive). The wielded ally gains White->Random color flexibility and invuln-bypass, can have its next skill replaced by the hidden Uncanny Sword (cleanse+40 dmg), and receives shields/counters routed through Tsubaki. Most of the kit only functions through a wielded partner.

abilities.name: Tsubaki Mode: Kusarigama
abilities.target_type: SINGLE (ally; locks to Black Star if alive)
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Marks target ally as wielding Tsubaki for 3 turns (dur 6). While wielded: ally's White costs become Random (color_change White->Random) and ally's effects Bypass Invulnerability. Tsubaki herself gains 10% Damage Reduction for 3 turns. Targets Black Star automatically if alive (per passive).

abilities.name: Tsubaki Mode: Smoke Bomb
abilities.conditional_scaling: Triggers Black Star's S4 (Tsubaki Smoke Bomb) if used while Black Star is stunned (synergy combo, per passive)
abilities.effects_summary: Immediate 5 Affliction to all enemies plus a 5 Affliction/turn DoT (damage_effect dur 7, ~3 ticks). Blinds Strategic skills on all enemies for 4 turns (blind dur 8). Affliction bypasses barriers/shields/DR.

abilities.name: Tsubaki Soul Resonance
abilities.conditional_scaling: +15 Shield to Tsubaki if target is Black Star; unlocks Uncanny Sword skill-swap only if target is wielding Tsubaki
abilities.effects_summary: Grants target ally 20 Shield (dur 2). If that ally is wielding Tsubaki (marked Kusarigama), adds a 1-turn action-use trigger: their next new skill is replaced by Tsubaki Mode: Uncanny Sword (the hidden slot-6 attack). If target is Black Star, Tsubaki also gains 15 Shield. Very low 1-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Dummy Star
abilities.target_type: SINGLE ally (default target is the Kusarigama-wielding ally)
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: For 1 turn (dur 2), counters the first Harmful skill used on the wielding ally (invisible counter). During that window Tsubaki gains 10 Shield (invisible). Pure defensive protection for the partner.

abilities.name: Partner: Black Star
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Passive. If Black Star is alive on the team, auto-casts Kusarigama onto him at game start (sets its cooldown to 3-4) and locks Kusarigama to only target him. Also enables the Smoke Bomb -> Black Star S4 combo when Black Star is stunned. Defines the partner-synergy identity.

abilities.name: Tsubaki Mode: Uncanny Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden skill accessible only via Soul Resonance's replacement trigger (used by the wielding ally, not Tsubaki directly). Removes all cleansable helpful effects from target enemy, then deals 40 Normal damage. Also cleanses all harmful effects off the user (the wielder). Uncounterable.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Low and flat. Tsubaki's own offense is just the 5 Affliction AoE + 5/turn DoT. The 40 Normal Uncanny Sword is delivered through the wielded ally (replacing their skill), not by Tsubaki, and is uncounterable + strips enemy buffs. No per-stack/per-kill scaling. Real damage ceiling lives in the partner (Black Star), whom this kit empowers.
damage_profile.notes: Tsubaki is near-zero personal burst. AoE is a token 5 Affliction (barrier-piercing) with a 4-turn Strategic-skill Blind for control. The only sizable number (40) is conditional, routed, and consumes the wielder's action.

economy.color_dependency: Light-moderate Red dependency: 2 of 4 visible skills cost Red:1 (Smoke Bomb, Soul Resonance); the other two are Random:1. Hidden Uncanny Sword costs Red:2 but is paid by the wielder, not Tsubaki. Single-color (Red) mono-energy identity.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/spammy. Soul Resonance CD1 (near-every-turn shields + Uncanny Sword enabler), Kusarigama CD2, Smoke Bomb CD3, Dummy Star CD4. Very cheap actions overall, all 1-pip.
economy.ramp_dependency: No ramp. Front-loads instantly: passive auto-wields Black Star turn 1. Power is conditional on having Black Star (or any ally) alive to wield, not on stacking over time.

soft_cc: Blind (Strategic skills) for 4 turns on all enemies via Smoke Bomb
invuln_or_counter: Dummy Star: counters first Harmful skill on the wielded ally (1 turn)
Kusarigama: wielded ally bypasses enemy Invulnerability
Uncanny Sword: Uncounterable

win_conditions: Enable a strong carry partner (especially Black Star) by wielding them: grant color flexibility (White->Random), invuln-bypass, repeated shields, counter protection, and on-demand Uncanny Sword buff-strip burst
Outlast via cheap, spammy shields (Soul Resonance CD1) and self DR/counters while the partner does the killing
Chip + lock down enemies with the barrier-piercing Affliction DoT and the 4-turn Strategic Blind, neutralizing enemy setup/utility skills
internal_synergies: Passive auto-wields Black Star turn 1, making Kusarigama's color-fix + invuln-bypass + Tsubaki's DR active from the start with zero action cost
Soul Resonance only grants the Uncanny Sword skill-swap if the target is wielding Tsubaki (Kusarigama mark) -> Kusarigama gates Soul Resonance's offensive upgrade
Soul Resonance + Black Star double-dips shields (20 on him + 15 on Tsubaki)
Smoke Bomb triggers Black Star's S4 if he is stunned -> combo payoff with the partner
Dummy Star defaults to the Kusarigama-wielding ally, layering counter protection onto the same partner the rest of the kit buffs
strengths: Extremely cheap, spammable support (all visible skills 1 pip; Soul Resonance CD1)
Strong, repeatable shielding and self-survivability (shields + 10% DR + invisible counters)
Grants partner invulnerability-bypass and color flexibility — high-value enabling for a carry
Barrier-piercing Affliction DoT plus a long 4-turn Strategic-skill Blind for enemy utility denial
Uncanny Sword provides uncounterable burst that also strips enemy buffs and self-cleanses the wielder
Cleanse access (offensive + defensive) is rare and valuable
weaknesses: Near-zero independent damage; offense is borrowed from / routed through the partner
Heavily reliant on having an ally (ideally Black Star) to wield — much of the kit (counter, invuln-bypass, color-fix value, Uncanny Sword enabler) is dead weight on a lone or partner-less comp
Uncanny Sword consumes the wielder's action and only fires through Soul Resonance's trigger — conditional, telegraphed, and not Tsubaki's own tempo
No hard CC, no healing (only shields), no energy denial
Blind only stops Strategic-class skills, not all damage; control is narrow
If the wielded partner dies, much of her value evaporates

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, very cheap support/enabler whose ceiling is tied to a partner. In isolation she is a solid but unspectacular kit: cheap spammy shields, self DR + counters for durability, a barrier-piercing AoE DoT, a long Strategic Blind for utility denial, and dual-direction cleanse. The standout pieces — invuln-bypass for the wielder, White->Random color-fix, and the uncounterable 40-dmg buff-stripping Uncanny Sword — are strong but all conditional on a wielded ally and (best case) Black Star. Personal damage is negligible, so she cannot carry a game herself. Pairs into a clear A-team with Black Star where she meaningfully amplifies a real carry, but as a generic support she sits around average. Rated mid; would rise in a dedicated Black Star comp and fall in random/solo evaluation.
outlier_flags: partner-dependent power (designed-around Black Star synergy)
key burst (Uncanny Sword) is action-routed through the ally, not the character
very low standalone damage output
CD1 1-pip shield is a spammy-efficiency outlier worth watching

role: Single-target burst + light AoE caster with mark/counter combo and self-protect tools
signature_mechanic: X-Burner combo engine: Burning Axle marks a target so X-Burner consumes the mark for +10 damage and a 1-turn stun; Zero Point Breakthrough counters/stuns the first Energy/Affliction attacker and, on a successful counter, gives X-Burner +10 damage to all targets for 2 turns.

abilities.name: X-Burner
abilities.conditional_scaling: Hits main target for 25, all other enemies for 10. Gains +10 to all targets for 2 turns if Zero Point Breakthrough successfully counters. If main target carries a Burning Axle mark, the mark triggers an extra 10 damage + 1-turn stun on consume.
abilities.effects_summary: Cleave nuke: 25 to primary enemy, 10 splash to each other enemy. Synergy hub for the Axle mark (extra 10 + stun) and the Zero Point counter buff (+10 all). 1-turn cooldown = spammable, the kit's main damage tap.

abilities.name: Zero Point Breakthrough
abilities.conditional_scaling: Conditional counter: only fires vs the first enemy Energy or Affliction skill aimed at Tsuna within the 1-turn window. On success grants X-Burner +10 dmg to all for 2 turns.
abilities.effects_summary: Counter_receive effect (invisible) gated to Energy/Affliction skills. On trigger: stuns the attacker 1 turn and nullifies the countered ability, then grants a 2-turn damage_mod buffing X-Burner by +10 to all targets. Conditional anti-caster peel + offensive ramp enabler.

abilities.name: Burning Axle
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mark is permanent (dur -1) until consumed by X-Burner; consume adds 10 damage + 1-turn stun. No stacking scaling beyond the single mark.
abilities.effects_summary: 30 Normal damage single-target + applies a permanent DAMAGE_RECEIVE_TRIGGER mark. When that enemy is next damaged by X-Burner, they take +10 and are stunned 1 turn, and the mark is consumed. Sets up the burst/stun combo.

abilities.name: Flare Burst
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Tsuna becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Pure self-peel / panic button on a 4-turn cooldown.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true scaling. Hard ceiling is one X-Burner cast: ~45 on a single marked + counter-buffed target (25 base +10 counter buff +10 mark trigger, plus a 1-turn stun), or 35 main / 20 per-other in AoE while the +10 counter buff is up. Burning Axle is 30 single-target on its own turn. All numbers are fixed; no per-stack/per-kill/transformation growth.
damage_profile.notes: Setup-dependent burst. Realistic non-buffed line: turn 1 Burning Axle (30 + mark), turn 2 X-Burner on marked main (25 + 10 mark = 35 + stun) plus 10 splash to others. The +10 counter buff requires the enemy to throw an Energy/Affliction skill at Tsuna, so the 45 single / 35-main AoE peaks are situational. All damage is Normal, so it is fully reduced by barriers/shields/DR.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Only 2 specific pips, both Blue (X-Burner Blue:1, Burning Axle Blue:1); the other 3 pips are Random. Mono-Blue identity but cheap and flexible.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Bimodal: X-Burner is a 1-cd spammable main tap and Burning Axle is a 2-cd setup; the two utility self-buttons (Zero Point, Flare Burst) are both 4-cd, so peel/counter is infrequent.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low. No resource/stack ramp. Only sequencing dependency: Axle must precede X-Burner to land the combo, and the +10 buff depends on a successful counter.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun via Burning Axle mark consume (on X-Burner hit)
1-turn stun on Zero Point Breakthrough successful counter
invuln_or_counter: Flare Burst: 1-turn invulnerability (self)
Zero Point Breakthrough: conditional counter + nullify vs first Energy/Affliction skill aimed at Tsuna

win_conditions: Land Burning Axle then X-Burner on the same target to chain ~35+ burst with a 1-turn stun, repeating the X-Burner tap to grind a priority target down.
Bait an enemy Energy/Affliction skill into Zero Point Breakthrough to stun+nullify it and turn on the permanent-feeling +10 X-Burner buff, then cleave the team.
Use Flare Burst / Zero Point as survivability windows to outlast and keep tapping X-Burner each turn.
internal_synergies: Burning Axle mark is consumed only by X-Burner damage -> tight 2-card combo for +10 and a stun.
Zero Point Breakthrough's successful counter buffs X-Burner (+10 all, 2 turns), so its anti-caster peel directly amplifies the kit's only damage source.
X-Burner's 1-turn cooldown lets it both consume the Axle mark and benefit from the Zero Point buff window every turn it is up.
Both self-utility skills share a 4-cd, so the AoE damage tap (X-Burner) is the only thing happening on most turns, keeping the combo loop centered on it.
strengths: Very cheap kit (5 total pips, only 2 specific Blue) -> easy to fund and flexible energy-wise.
X-Burner is a 1-cooldown AoE-cleave that doubles as the combo trigger; reliable repeatable pressure.
Two separate 1-turn stuns (Axle consume + Zero Point counter) give real tempo/control for a low-cost character.
Strong defensive package for a damage dealer: hard 1-turn invuln plus a conditional counter that both stuns and nullifies an enemy caster's skill.
Anti-caster tech (counters Energy/Affliction) is a hard wall against many burst/DoT openers.
weaknesses: All damage is Normal type -> fully stopped by shields/barriers and reduced by flat and % DR; no Piercing/True/Affliction to punish defensive comps.
No scaling whatsoever; damage is hard-capped around 45 single / 35-main AoE even with full setup.
The big payoffs are conditional: the +10 buff needs the enemy to attack Tsuna with Energy/Affliction, and the combo needs Axle landed first.
Zero Point counter is narrow (only Energy/Affliction, only the first such skill, only on Tsuna) and whiffs entirely vs Physical/strategic teams.
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no energy denial, no team utility -> purely selfish damage + self-peel.
Both utility/peel tools sit on 4-turn cooldowns, leaving long windows of low defensive options.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, cheap, well-rounded single-target/light-AoE damage dealer with a self-contained 2-card combo (Axle -> X-Burner for +10 and stun) and two strong defensive buttons (1-turn invuln + conditional anti-caster counter/nullify). The 1-cooldown X-Burner gives reliable turn-by-turn pressure for only 5 total pips. However, output is modest and entirely Normal-typed (hard-countered by shields/DR), there is zero scaling, and the standout payoffs (the +10 buff, the counter) are conditional on enemy behavior. Solid, fair, slightly above-average baseline character without being an outlier in either direction.

role: single-target defensive/utility support (protector + soft controller)
signature_mechanic: "Tongue Lash" mark gating Great Leap: marking an enemy unlocks a 15-damage stun, while marking an ally unlocks a full-invulnerability grant the next turn. Dual-mode skills (harmful/helpful) let every targeted ability bend toward offense or protection.

abilities.name: Tongue Lash
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (dual-mode: enemy = damage, ally = DR)
abilities.effects_summary: Enemy mode: 15 Normal instant damage + 15 Normal DoT tick on the following turn (damage_effect dur 3 = 1 turn) + applies 'Tongue Lash' mark (enables Great Leap stun combo). Ally mode: grants 15 Damage Reduction for 2 turns (dur 4) + the 'Tsuyu will leap' mark (enables Great Leap ally-invuln). JSON description for ally mode is stale (says ignore non-damage effects); .gd grants DR. Total enemy damage over life = 30.

abilities.name: Great Leap
abilities.target_type: SELF (with mark-gated reach across all marked characters)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Mark-gated: only triggers on characters affected by Tongue Lash. Scales with how many Tongue-Lash-marked targets exist, but Tongue Lash is single-target so usually one.
abilities.effects_summary: Self: Invulnerable to non-Strategic skills for 1 turn (dur 2). For each Tongue-Lash-marked enemy: 15 Normal damage + 1-turn stun (dur 2). For each Tongue-Lash-marked ally: that ally becomes fully Invulnerable for 1 turn (dur 2). Strong defensive panic button plus conditional hard CC.

abilities.name: Frog Mucus
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Enemy mode: damage_mod -10 — target deals 10 less non-Affliction damage for 2 turns (dur 4), a damage de-fang. Ally mode: ignore_non_damage_effect for 2 turns (dur 4) — ally ignores all non-damage effects (CC/debuff immunity, soft cleanse-by-prevention). Pure utility, no damage.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Tsuyu becomes fully Invulnerable for 1 turn. Long 4-turn cooldown panic button. No mark interaction, no damage.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Very low and fixed. No scaling mechanic. Max realistic single-target output is the Tongue Lash combo: 15 instant + 15 DoT (30 over two turns), plus Great Leap's 15+stun on the marked enemy. No AoE, no execute, no per-stack growth.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Normal type (fully mitigated by DR/barriers). Damage is a secondary win path; the kit is built around denial and protection, not killing.

economy.color_dependency: Light mono-Green. Only Tongue Lash and Great Leap require Green (2 Green pips total); Frog Mucus and Camouflage take any color. Trivial to fit on any Green-leaning team and splashable.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast and spammable. Tongue Lash (CD1) and Frog Mucus (CD1) are near-every-turn; Great Leap (CD2) is the combo/defensive piece; only Camouflage is slow (CD4). Low cost + low cooldown = high uptime utility.
economy.ramp_dependency: None. No ramp, no stacking, no transformation. Effective from turn 1; performance is flat across a match.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun (Great Leap, requires Tongue Lash mark on enemy)
soft_cc: -10 damage dealt debuff for 2 turns (Frog Mucus enemy mode)
invuln_or_counter: Self invuln vs non-Strategic skills 1 turn (Great Leap)
Self full invuln 1 turn (Camouflage, CD4)
Ally full invuln 1 turn (Great Leap, requires Tongue Lash mark on ally)

win_conditions: Out-sustain by denying enemy damage: stack Frog Mucus damage-mod debuffs and ally Damage Reduction to let teammates out-trade.
Protect a key carry through a lethal turn using ally-targeted Tongue Lash mark + Great Leap invuln, or Camouflage on self.
Lock down a priority threat with the Tongue Lash -> Great Leap stun combo to deny their turn while chipping with the DoT.
internal_synergies: Tongue Lash mark is the keystone: it gates Great Leap entirely. Mark enemy -> Great Leap = 15 + stun; mark ally -> Great Leap = full invuln. Every Great Leap value path runs through Tongue Lash first.
Dual-mode design (Tongue Lash + Frog Mucus each helpful/harmful) lets Tsuyu pivot between protecting an ally and de-fanging an enemy turn to turn without changing her energy needs.
Self-protection stack: Great Leap (partial invuln) and Camouflage (full invuln) give two staggered defensive turns, making her hard to focus.
strengths: Extremely cheap (4 total pips, only 2 fixed Green) and fast cooldowns = very high utility uptime.
Flexible: every targeted skill is dual-mode (offense or protection), adapting to board state.
Strong personal survivability (two invuln buttons) plus the ability to hand an ally full invuln or 15 DR.
Provides a 1-turn hard stun and an enemy damage debuff for control without heavy energy investment.
Zero ramp/setup; online from turn 1.
weaknesses: Very low damage ceiling (all Normal type, ~30 single-target over two turns, no AoE, no scaling). Cannot threaten kills on her own.
Great Leap's offense and ally-invuln are mark-gated: a wasted/cleansed Tongue Lash neuters her best turn, and Tongue Lash is single-target so the combo only hits one target.
No healing, no real shields, no true cleanse, no energy denial — purely mitigation/prevention, so she leaks value against burst that outpaces DR.
Normal damage and DR-based protection are both bypassed by Affliction/Bleed/Piercing/True effective-damage types.
Low impact in isolation; her value is entirely contingent on having a carry to protect — weak as a standalone threat.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, cheap utility/defensive support with good flexibility (dual-mode skills), reliable personal survivability, a conditional hard stun, an ally full-invuln, ally DR, and an enemy damage debuff — all for a trivial light-mono-Green cost and fast cooldowns. However the damage is near-negligible (15-30 Normal, single-target, no AoE, no scaling), so she cannot close games herself and depends fully on a carry. Her best offense/protection turns are gated behind the single-target Tongue Lash mark, which adds setup fragility. Solid role-player and team enabler, not a carry; sits around average due to efficiency and flexibility but capped by lack of damage and proactive impact.
outlier_flags: JSON-vs-gd mismatch: Tongue Lash ally mode grants 15 Damage Reduction in the .gd, not 'ignore non-damage effects' as the JSON description claims.
Unusually low total kit cost (4 pips for 4 abilities) with high cooldown uptime — efficiency outlier on the cheap end.
Tongue Lash applies an instant hit plus a same-value DoT tick plus a mark in one CD1 ability — value-dense for the cost.

abilities.name: BindBenihime (Bind, Benihime)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Enables the urahara5 combo: marks the target as 'affected by Bind, Benihime' so Fire-Play deals 40 affliction next turn
abilities.effects_summary: Full stun (1 turn) + anti-invulnerability (target cannot become invulnerable 1 turn) + heal-block (target ignores healing effects 1 turn). This ability then swaps itself to urahara5 'Fire-Play, Benihime' for the following turn (combo enabler). NOTE: execute() body is an unimplemented stub (pass); mechanics taken from describe/split_desc which match JSON.

abilities.name: Seal Slaying Penance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stacks: each cast adds another -10 damage debuff and another 20-damage punish; invisible. Punish only fires when the enemy uses a new non-strategic skill.
abilities.effects_summary: Debuff: lowers target's non-affliction damage by 10 until they use a new non-strategic skill. Punish: next time the target uses a new non-strategic skill, they take 20 damage. Both effects stack and are invisible. 0 cooldown = spammable each turn to ramp stacks. Soft energy-denial / activity tax that discourages the enemy from attacking.

abilities.name: Suspended Seal Destruction
abilities.conditional_scaling: Execute/low-HP scaling: if target HP <= 50, stun becomes 2 turns and removes 2 random energies instead of 1.
abilities.effects_summary: Full stun 1 turn + strip 1 random energy pip + remove all helpful/buff effects from target. At <=50 HP: 2-turn stun + strip 2 random energy pips. Hard CC plus buff-strip plus energy denial in one card.

abilities.name: Negation Block
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn. Defensive cooldown to dodge a burst or a key enemy skill; 4 cooldown.

abilities.name: Fire-Play, Benihime
abilities.conditional_scaling: Requires target to be marked by urahara1 Bind, Benihime; only deals damage to that enemy.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 40 Affliction damage (bypasses barriers/shields/DR) to the enemy stunned by Bind, Benihime. Hidden swap-in: this replaces urahara1 in the action bar the turn after Bind is used, forming a 2-turn lock+burst combo.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true DoT. Effective per-turn pressure is low: 40 affliction every other turn from the Bind->Fire-Play combo (~20/turn averaged), plus the urahara2 punish (20 per stacked trigger) which is conditional on the enemy acting. With many stacked urahara2 casts an enemy could eat 20*N on a single attack, but each stack costs a full turn to apply, so realistic ceiling is modest (~40-60 conditional). This is a controller, not a damage dealer.
damage_profile.notes: All 'damage' is low and mostly conditional. urahara5's 40 is Affliction so it ignores shields/barriers/DR, making it reliable but it requires a 2-turn setup (Bind on T1, Fire-Play on T2). urahara2 deals 20 only when the enemy chooses to use a new non-strategic skill, so it is a tax rather than guaranteed damage.

economy.color_dependency: Light Blue-leaning. 2 of 4 visible skills cost Blue (urahara2, urahara3); urahara1 and urahara4 are Random; the hidden urahara5 burst costs Red. So core control is Blue-dependent, the burst payoff needs 1 Red. Low overall color strain (only ever 1 specific pip per cast).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Cheap and fast. All visible skills cost 1 pip. urahara2 is 0-cooldown (spammable), urahara1 is 2 (gated by the Bind/Fire-Play swap cycle), urahara3 is 3, urahara4 is 4. Good turn-to-turn tempo; the control engine (urahara2 + urahara3) is almost always available.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low-to-moderate. urahara2 stacks reward repeated casting but each instance is independently useful; no transformation gate beyond the urahara1->urahara5 swap. Burst payoff requires a 2-turn combo setup.

hard_cc: Full stun 1 turn (urahara1)
Full stun 1 turn / 2 turns at <=50 HP (urahara3)
soft_cc: Damage debuff -10 non-affliction until enemy acts (urahara2)
Heal-block 1 turn (urahara1)
Anti-invulnerability 1 turn (urahara1)
invuln_or_counter: Self invulnerability 1 turn (urahara4)

internal_synergies: urahara1 (Bind, Benihime) -> urahara5 (Fire-Play, Benihime): Bind stuns and marks the target, then the action slot swaps to Fire-Play which deals 40 affliction to that exact marked enemy the next turn. Core combo and only real damage.

urahara1's heal-block + anti-invuln pairs with urahara3's buff-strip to fully neutralize a healer/defensive enemy: they cannot heal, cannot go invulnerable, lose their buffs, and are stunned and energy-starved.
urahara3's energy strip + urahara2's damage debuff together strangle an enemy's offense (less energy to act, less damage when they do).

urahara2's 'take 20 when you use a new non-strategic skill' synergizes with the stuns: while the enemy is stunned by urahara1/urahara3 they cannot trigger the punish, but the debuff portion persists; against unstunned turns the punish discourages action.
urahara4 self-invuln lets Urahara survive while running the slow control combo against burst enemies.

power_assessment.reasoning: Strong single-target lockdown/disruption specialist. Two independent full stuns (one with execute-range upgrade to 2-turn + double energy strip), buff removal, energy denial, anti-invulnerability, heal-denial, a stacking damage-reduction tax, a 40 affliction combo payoff that bypasses shields, and a self-invuln panic button -- all at 1 pip each with light color requirements. As a solo controller that hard-locks and de-buffs one threat, it is excellent (could hard-counter healers, invuln/defensive carries, and ramp characters). Held back from higher because: damage output is very low and almost entirely single-target (no AoE, no sustained DoT), the burst needs a 2-turn setup, urahara2's payoff is conditional on enemy behavior, and it brings nothing for teammates (no heals/shields/cleanse). In a 3v3 it is a premier disruptor but not a win condition by itself.
outlier_flags: UNIMPLEMENTED: all five ability execute() bodies are empty stubs (pass) -- mechanics are read from describe()/split_desc() text only and are not actually coded, so in-engine the character currently does nothing. Numbers reported are design-intent, not verified runtime behavior.
Stacking + invisible urahara2 effect could be a balance landmine if implemented (unbounded -10 damage / +20 punish stacks at 0 cooldown).
urahara3 double-CC (2-turn stun) + double energy strip at <=50 HP is a strong execute-window denial that could feel oppressive.
No character_colors array in character/urahara.gd; energy identity inferred from cost dicts (Blue/Red).

role: Single-target lockdown controller / disruptor (anti-heal, anti-invuln, energy denial) with a small affliction burst combo
signature_mechanic: Bind, Benihime -> Fire-Play, Benihime action-slot swap: urahara1 stuns and marks one enemy and disables their healing and invulnerability, then transforms the slot into urahara5 which delivers 40 shield-piercing affliction damage to that marked target the next turn.
strengths: Two full stuns plus a stacking damage debuff = dominant single-target lockdown.
Hard counter to defensive/sustain enemies: removes buffs, blocks healing, blocks invulnerability, and strips energy.
urahara5 deals 40 Affliction, ignoring barriers/shields/DR -- reliable payoff against tanky targets.
Very cheap (all 1-pip) with low color strain and a 0-cooldown spammable control skill (urahara2).
Energy denial (urahara3 strips 1-2 pips) disrupts enemy tempo and combo characters.
Self-invulnerability (urahara4) gives a survivability button for a low-defense controller.
Execute scaling on urahara3 (2-turn stun + double strip at <=50 HP) closes out weakened threats.
weaknesses: Very low damage output; essentially no kill pressure outside the 40-affliction combo.
No AoE and no sustained DoT -- single-target only, weak into wide boards.
The burst requires a 2-turn setup (Bind then Fire-Play) and can be disrupted.
Provides zero team support: no healing, shields, or cleanse for allies.
urahara2's punish is conditional on the enemy choosing to act, so it can be played around.
Squishy/utility-only frame relying on stuns and one 4-cooldown invuln to stay alive.
CRITICAL: ability execute() functions are unimplemented stubs, so as shipped the character has no working mechanics.
win_conditions: Pick the enemy's most dangerous single target (healer, invuln carry, or ramp threat) and keep it perma-locked with alternating urahara1/urahara3 stuns while energy-starving and de-buffing it.
Run the Bind -> Fire-Play combo repeatedly to chip a key target down with shield-piercing affliction, then use urahara3's <=50 HP upgrade to close.
Stall and disrupt long enough for damage-dealing teammates to clean up while Urahara neutralizes the enemy's defensive/sustain pieces.
Tax an aggressive enemy into inaction via stacked urahara2 (damage debuff + punish) so they cannot profitably attack.

role: Anchor-protect support: single-ally damage-amplifier and bodyguard built around the Lip Rod-marked teammate
signature_mechanic: Uranus Lip Rod passive permanently marks the ally directly below her (granting that ally +10 DR), and every other ability keys off that mark: cheaper/stronger shielding, a counter with reduced cooldown, an invuln target, and (per JSON) a damage-amp on enemies — making one chosen ally the focal point of the whole kit.

abilities.name: Space Sword Blaster
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (execute deals flat 20; the 35 in custom_behavior is only an AI weighting heuristic, not applied damage)
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Energy damage to one enemy; grants 10 Shield (duration 3 = self/ally-facing 1 turn) to the Lip Rod-marked ally if present and alive. No-cooldown spammable poke + repeatable shield on the anchor.

abilities.name: Intercepting Strike
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cooldown 3 -> 1 when cast on the Lip Rod ally; the 25 reactive damage only triggers if an enemy actually uses a Harmful skill on the protected ally
abilities.effects_summary: Applies an invisible COUNTER_RECEIVE on the target ally (duration 2 = 1 turn) scoped to Harmful skills: the next Harmful skill on them is fully countered (cancelled) and the attacker takes 25 Normal damage. Cooldown drops to 1 turn if the target is the Lip Rod ally, making it a near-permanent bodyguard on the anchor.

abilities.name: World Shaking
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT: 10 immediate + damage_effect(10, dur 5 = enemy-facing, ticks 2 more turns) = 30 total per enemy over 3 turns. The JSON-promised +5 damage from the Lip Rod ally is NOT implemented in code (only a 'World Shaking' mark is applied; the +5 boost wiring is explicitly left out).
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Energy AoE on cast to all enemies plus a 3-turn 10/turn Energy DoT (30 per enemy total) and a 'World Shaking' mark. Action-class AoE; the intended +5 amp from the anchor is unwired so currently it is just AoE poke + DoT.

abilities.name: Space Defense
abilities.target_type: SINGLE (self or Lip Rod ally only)
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Grants Invulnerability (duration 2 = 1 turn) to either Uranus herself or the Lip Rod-marked ally. Hard damage-immunity peel on a 4-turn cooldown; targeting is locked to just those two characters.

abilities.name: Uranus Lip Rod
abilities.conditional_scaling: Positional: only marks the ally in the team slot directly below Uranus; no-op if Uranus is last in slot order
abilities.effects_summary: At combat start, permanently marks the ally directly below Uranus with 'Uranus Lip Rod' (visible mark) and grants that ally permanent +10 Damage Reduction. This mark is the dependency hub for uranus1/2/3/4's anchor-specific bonuses.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Low and flat. No stack/transformation scaling. World Shaking is the only multi-turn output: 30 per enemy over 3 turns (10 cast + 10 + 10). The reactive counter can add a one-off 25 if an enemy attacks the protected ally. The advertised +5 anchor amp is not coded, so realized damage is even lower than the JSON implies.
damage_profile.notes: Uranus is a defensive/support character whose damage is intentionally modest: a free spammable 20 poke (uranus1, the only pure single-target nuke; uranus3 adds 10 to each enemy on cast), a 30-over-3-turns AoE DoT, and a conditional 25 counter. The kit's value is protection (shields, invuln, counter, DR), not damage. Counter damage (25) is Normal; World Shaking is Energy DoT (subject to DR but not barrier-bypassing).

economy.color_dependency: Tri-color Blue/White/Red, one specific pip each on slots 1-3 (Blue for Sword Blaster, White for Intercepting Strike, Red for World Shaking) plus 2 random pips (one on World Shaking, one on Space Defense). Spread across three colors makes the kit slightly color-greedy but each ability only needs a single specific pip, so it is castable in most energy states. Never demands doubles.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fast and flexible: Space Sword Blaster has 0 cooldown (spammable every turn), World Shaking 2, Intercepting Strike 3 (but 1 when cast on the anchor, so effectively near-spammable bodyguard), Space Defense 4. Low costs + low cooldowns let her contribute every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: None. No build-up, stacks, or transformation. Full power from turn 1 (passive fires at combat start). Only 'ramp' is positioning the desired ally directly below her in the lineup.

invuln_or_counter: Invulnerability (1 turn) on self or anchor via Space Defense, cd 4
Counter on Harmful skills via Intercepting Strike (cancels the skill + 25 reflect), near-permanent uptime on the anchor due to 1-turn cooldown there

win_conditions: Make the Lip Rod-marked ally an unkillable carry: stack permanent +10 DR + 10 Shield (free, every turn) + 1-turn Invuln + near-permanent counter, letting that ally win the damage race
Out-attrition with Space Sword Blaster's free 20 poke plus World Shaking's AoE DoT chip while the team survives behind her peel
Punish enemy focus-fire on the anchor via Intercepting Strike counters (cancel + 25 reflect) repeated nearly every turn
internal_synergies: Uranus Lip Rod (passive) is the hub — uranus1 shield, uranus2 cooldown reduction, uranus3 (intended) amp, and uranus4 invuln all key off the same marked ally

Intercepting Strike cooldown drops 3->1 on the anchor, so the counter can be re-applied almost every turn, layering with the anchor's permanent DR and Space Sword Blaster shield for extreme single-ally survivability
Space Sword Blaster's 0 cooldown lets her refresh the anchor's shield AND poke an enemy every single turn for no tempo cost
World Shaking marks enemies for a +5 amp from the anchor (per design) — synergy intended but currently unwired in code
strengths: Extremely cheap, low-cooldown, ramp-free kit — full value from turn 1, contributes every turn
Layered single-ally protection (permanent DR + repeatable shield + 1-turn invuln + near-permanent Harmful counter) makes a chosen carry very hard to kill
Hard counter to enemy single-target focus-fire: Intercepting Strike cancels the skill outright and reflects 25
Free 0-cooldown 20 poke gives constant chip damage at no opportunity cost
AoE DoT (30/enemy over 3 turns) adds team-wide attrition pressure
Invulnerability is a true damage-immunity save on a tolerable 4-turn cooldown
weaknesses: All anchor bonuses funnel into ONE ally (and require correct lineup positioning); if that ally dies or Uranus is bottom-slot, half the kit's value evaporates
Cannot protect or buff the rest of the team — no AoE shields, team heals, or cleanse; the off-anchor allies are on their own
Low, flat damage with no scaling ceiling; she cannot close out games on her own and relies on teammates to deal damage
World Shaking's headline +5 amp is not implemented in code, so realized damage/synergy is below the description
No CC, no energy denial, no cleanse — purely reactive/defensive, can be played around by AoE or by ignoring the anchor and bursting other targets
Counter only triggers on Harmful skills aimed at the protected ally; Strategic/Helpful-classed threats and damage to other allies slip through

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-tuned, low-power defensive support. Her ceiling is high in the narrow niche of keeping one carry alive — permanent DR + repeatable free shield + near-permanent counter + invuln is a genuinely oppressive protect package on a single target, and the counter is a real answer to focus-fire comps. But the entire kit hinges on one positionally-determined ally, she provides almost nothing to the rest of the team, has no CC/cleanse/energy-denial, and deals low flat damage with no scaling. She is a strong role-player in the right composition (paired with a fragile high-damage carry slotted directly below her) and mediocre-to-weak in a vacuum or against AoE/spread comps. Net: solidly average, leaning supportive enabler rather than carry.
outlier_flags: World Shaking JSON advertises +5 anchor amp that is explicitly NOT wired in code (mark applied but no boost) — description/implementation mismatch
Space Sword Blaster custom_behavior references 35 damage for AI weighting while execute deals 20 — potential confusion but not a live damage value
Intercepting Strike effective cooldown of 1 on the anchor gives near-permanent counter uptime, unusually strong peel for 1 White pip
Kit value is hard-gated by team slot ordering (ally must be directly below Uranus), an unusual positional dependency

role: Controller / Energy-Denial Debuffer
signature_mechanic: Zero Gravity mark loop: apply invisible "Zero Gravity" marks (each stack = -10 damage to the target's next skill + 1 energy drained when they next act), then swap to "Gravity Plus" to detonate marks for 20 (+5 per ZG stack) damage and a stacking +1 random pip cost tax. The whole kit is a soft energy-attrition engine rather than a damage threat.

abilities.name: Zero Gravity
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stackable mark; each stack independently contributes -10 damage to the marked enemy's next skill and 1 energy drained on trigger. Also fuels uraraka2's +5 damage per stack.
abilities.effects_summary: Marks 1 enemy with invisible, stackable 'Zero Gravity': reduces their NEXT skill's damage by 10 (per stack) and, when they next use a skill, drains 1 random energy and clears the mark. On use, swaps the slot to 'Gravity Plus' for 1 turn. No damage. Also advances a mission counter on trigger.

abilities.name: Gravity Plus
abilities.conditional_scaling: Deals base 20 + 5 per stack of 'Zero Gravity' on the target (e.g. 2 ZG stacks = 30 dmg). The detonator half of the loop.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal damage (+5 per Zero Gravity stack) to target and applies a stacking +1 random-energy cost increase to all their skills until they next use a skill. This is the swap-form of slot 1; the visible card is Zero Gravity until it is cast.

abilities.name: Zero Gravity: Comet Shower
abilities.conditional_scaling: Any enemy already carrying Zero Gravity additionally receives a Gravity Plus cost-tax effect (+1 random pip until they act), so the value scales with how many enemies were pre-marked.
abilities.effects_summary: AoE: grants every enemy a stack of 'Zero Gravity' (-10 next-skill damage + 1 energy drain on trigger each). Enemies already marked also get the +1 random-energy cost tax applied. Swaps slot to 'Gravity Plus' for 2 turns. No direct damage. 5-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Uraraka Float
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reactive: punishes any enemy who attacks Uraraka while active by stamping Zero Gravity on them.
abilities.effects_summary: INTENDED: for 2 turns gain 20 invisible Shield, and any enemy who uses a new skill on her gets 'Zero Gravity' applied (counter-mark); slot swaps to Gravity Plus during this window. WARNING - BUG: in uraraka4.gd execute(), the shield_eff and HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER trigger_eff are constructed but never added via Character.add_self_effect/add_hostile_effect, so as written the ability currently grants NO shield and NO counter-mark (dead effect).

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Single-target only scales via Gravity Plus: 20 + 5 per ZG stack. Realistically 2-3 stacks (30-35 dmg) before detonation; stacking more requires spending multiple turns marking, which is rarely worth it. No DoT, no true AoE damage (Comet Shower deals 0).
damage_profile.notes: Damage is negligible and incidental - this is a control/denial kit, not a damage dealer. Peak single-turn 30 assumes the target carries 2 ZG stacks when Gravity Plus lands; with no stacks it is just 20. Comet Shower, the only AoE, deals zero damage. The entire single-turn output ceiling is one Gravity Plus hit (~20-35).

economy.color_dependency: Very low. Only 2 fixed pips across the visible bar (White x2 on Zero Gravity and Comet Shower, Green x1 implied by swap-form Gravity Plus). Float and Comet Shower are mostly Random. Extremely flexible / splashable energy profile.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two 0-cooldown spammable mark/detonate buttons (slots 1/2 swap-linked) plus a 5-turn AoE setup and a 4-turn self defensive. Core loop is cheap (1 pip per action) and can be run nearly every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: Low ramp; value is in denial-over-time. Needs multiple turns to meaningfully tax the enemy team but every individual action is cheap and immediately usable.

soft_cc: damage reduction on next enemy skill (-10 per ZG stack)
stacking +1 random-pip cost tax on enemy skills (Gravity Plus / Comet Shower)
invuln_or_counter: Uraraka Float reactive counter-mark (INTENDED; currently non-functional due to unapplied-effect bug); 20 invisible self-shield is also intended but currently bugged/non-functional

win_conditions: Grind the enemy team out of energy via repeated Zero Gravity drains + Gravity Plus cost taxes, starving them of actions
Act as a support/disruptor on a team whose real damage dealers capitalize on a resource-starved, action-denied enemy
Use Comet Shower to seed the whole enemy team with marks, then tax/drain them every turn
internal_synergies: Zero Gravity (slot 1) <-> Gravity Plus (slot 2): the swap pair is the core mark-then-detonate loop; each ZG stack adds +5 to Gravity Plus damage
Comet Shower mass-applies Zero Gravity so a single Gravity Plus chain (or its built-in tax) hits multiple pre-marked enemies
Uraraka Float (intended) auto-applies Zero Gravity to attackers, feeding the same mark pool defensively
Energy drain on ZG trigger + cost-increase tax from Gravity Plus stack into a compounding energy-denial engine
strengths: Excellent multi-layered energy denial: drains random energy AND taxes skill costs, both stacking
Extremely cheap, low-color-commitment kit (mostly 1-pip / random) that fits almost any team
Two 0-cooldown spammable actions enable near-every-turn pressure
Invisible marks make her debuffs hard for opponents to play around
Strong soft control versus ramp/energy-hungry enemy comps
weaknesses: Near-zero damage output (peak single-turn ~20-35, AoE damage = 0) - cannot threaten kills herself
Effects are conditional and slow: most marks only matter 'until the enemy uses a skill', so a fast enemy clears them immediately for little payoff
Heavily reliant on a team to convert her denial into wins; useless solo
Uraraka Float, her only defensive/counter tool, appears BUGGED (shield + counter-mark never applied in code) leaving her with no real self-protection
No hard CC, no healing, no cleanse, no stealth - one-dimensional disruptor
Comet Shower is a 3-pip, 5-CD button that deals no damage and only fully pays off against an already-marked enemy team

power_assessment.reasoning: A niche, low-impact control/energy-denial specialist. Her denial layers (energy drain + stacking cost tax + next-skill damage reduction) are genuinely annoying and her economy is wonderfully cheap and splashable, but the payoffs are slow, conditional, and individually small, and she contributes almost no damage (AoE damage is literally 0). She needs a strong carry team to matter and offers nothing on her own. Her single defensive button (Uraraka Float) appears non-functional in the current code (shield and counter-mark effects are constructed but never applied), which further weakens an already fragile, one-dimensional kit. Solid as a situational anti-ramp/anti-energy support, but bottom-half of the roster in raw power.
outlier_flags: BUG: uraraka4.gd execute() builds shield_eff and trigger_eff but never calls Character.add_self_effect/add_hostile_effect on them - Uraraka Float currently grants no shield and no counter-mark
Whole kit deals essentially no damage; Comet Shower (3 pips, 5 CD, AoE) deals 0 damage
Classified as a beginner character (beginner = true) yet relies on a fairly intricate mark/swap/stack loop

abilities.name: Spirit Particle Subjugation
abilities.effects_summary: Grants Uryu 4 Quincy Energy (permanent MARK, dur -1). While he holds any Quincy Energy this skill is swapped out of slot 1 for 'Quincy Final Kojaku Shot'. Deals no damage despite the Affliction class tag; pure resource/setup engine. AI treats it as a high-value panic button (weight 250).
abilities.conditional_scaling: None

abilities.name: Kojaku Shot
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Piercing damage to one enemy, ignoring invulnerability (Bypassing). Self-buff: for 1 turn (dur 3 self-facing) Uryu is invulnerable to enemy non-Strategic skills, and 'Seele Schneider' costs 1 random energy. Spends 1 Quincy Energy. Requires Quincy Energy to use.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Requires >=1 Quincy Energy (extra_usable). Bypassing damage ignores target invulnerability.

abilities.name: Seele Schneider
abilities.effects_summary: 25 Piercing damage to one enemy and drains 1 random energy from them (team-wide energy loss). For 1 turn (dur 3) 'Quincy Final Kojaku Shot' costs Blue:1 + Random:1 (a discount from its base Blue:2). Spends 1 Quincy Energy. Requires Quincy Energy.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Requires >=1 Quincy Energy. Note: NOT Bypassing, so its invuln-pierce only applies to 2/5; energy drain is unconditional.

abilities.name: Uryuu Evasion
abilities.effects_summary: Full invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). Strategic, so it cannot be countered by Harmful/reflect effects. 4-turn cooldown panic button.
abilities.conditional_scaling: None

abilities.name: Quincy Final Kojaku Shot
abilities.cost_breakdown: Blue:2 (reduced to Blue:1+Random:1 for 1 turn after Seele Schneider)
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap that occupies slot 1 while Uryu has Quincy Energy. 35 Piercing damage +5 per current Quincy Energy, ignoring invulnerability (Bypassing). Consumes ALL Quincy Energy on use. 0 cooldown but gated by remaining energy. Max at 4 energy = 55 Piercing.
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 Piercing per Quincy Energy held at cast (base 35, +5/+10/+15/+20 for 1-4 energy). Tension: spending energy on 2/3 lowers this bonus.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: 55 single-target Piercing in one cast (Quincy Final Kojaku Shot with 4 Quincy Energy: 35 + 5*4). All damage is Piercing (skips flat + %DR). uryu2 and uryu5 are Bypassing (also ignore invulnerability). Without the finisher, repeatable output is 25 Piercing per Blue from uryu2/uryu3.
damage_profile.notes: No AoE whatsoever; every damage skill is single-target. Real per-turn ceiling is one action: either ~25 Piercing (cheap, Bypassing on uryu2) or the finisher. The 55 burst is one-shot and self-cannibalizing — to reach it you must NOT have spent energy on 2/3 first, and casting the finisher empties the engine, reverting slot 1 to the free recharge (uryu1, CD2). Energy regen via uryu1 is 4 every 2+ turns, so sustained throughput is modest.

economy.color_dependency: Heavily Blue-dependent: both main damage skills (uryu2, uryu3) and the finisher (uryu5, Blue:2 base) want Blue energy. The visible bar costs Blue:1 + Blue:1 + Random:1 = 3 pips across 3 paying skills (uryu1 is free). Internal discounts ease this: uryu2 makes uryu3 cost 1 random; uryu3 makes uryu5 cost Blue:1+Random:1.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. uryu2/uryu3 are CD1, uryu5 is CD0 (only gated by energy), uryu1 is CD2, uryu4 is CD4. Near-spammable damage with no long cooldowns; tempo is limited by energy pool and Blue availability, not cooldowns.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Must spend a free turn on uryu1 to load 4 Quincy Energy before any damage skill (2/3/5) is usable, and re-cast every time the pool empties. Finisher value ramps with unspent energy.

invuln_or_counter: uryu2: 1-turn invulnerability to enemy non-Strategic skills (self)
uryu4: 1-turn full invulnerability (Strategic, CD4)

win_conditions: Grind out single-target Piercing/Bypassing damage with CD1 uryu2/uryu3 that ignore the enemy's flat/% DR and (on the Bypassing skills) invulnerability, while staying alive behind two invuln windows.
Land the Quincy Final Kojaku Shot finisher at full 4 Quincy Energy (55 Piercing, Bypassing) to delete a low/mid-HP priority target that thinks it is safe behind invuln.
Drag out the game and out-tempo squishy enemies via energy denial (uryu3) plus self-protection, winning the attrition race.
internal_synergies: uryu1 -> uryu5: the energy granted by Spirit Particle Subjugation both unlocks and scales the finisher (+5 each), and the swap mechanic puts the finisher in slot 1 automatically.

uryu3 -> uryu5: Seele Schneider discounts Quincy Final Kojaku Shot to Blue:1+Random:1 for a turn, smoothing the Blue bottleneck — but it spends 1 Quincy Energy, shaving 5 off the finisher's bonus (anti-synergy tension).
uryu2 -> uryu3: Kojaku Shot makes Seele Schneider cost 1 random instead of Blue, easing Blue strain and granting a defensive invuln on the same turn.
uryu2/uryu5 Bypassing + Piercing: damage ignores both DR layers and invulnerability, making Uryu a hard counter to invuln/defensive-stack targets.
uryu4 + uryu2: two staggered invuln layers (Strategic full invuln on CD4, plus the partial non-Strategic invuln from uryu2) give strong turn-to-turn survivability.
strengths: All damage is Piercing (ignores flat and % damage reduction); uryu2 and the finisher are also Bypassing (ignore invulnerability) — a clean counter to tanks and defensive/invuln comps.
Very low cooldowns (CD1 spam, CD0 finisher) make for flexible, repeatable pressure.
Two invulnerability tools (uryu4 full/Strategic, uryu2 partial) give excellent self-preservation for a damage dealer.
Built-in energy denial (uryu3) disrupts enemy economy every time he pokes.
Self-sufficient resource engine: free uryu1 fuels everything with no ally support needed.
weaknesses: Zero AoE — completely single-target, weak into multi-body / swarm comps.
Burst is modest and self-cannibalizing: the 55 finisher requires holding all 4 energy, but the cheap damage skills each spend energy and lower it; you rarely get both the pokes and the max finisher.
Ramp/recharge tax: must spend a free turn on uryu1 whenever the pool empties (and it empties fully on the finisher), and uryu1 is on CD2.
Heavy Blue color dependency; if Blue is starved the kit stalls despite the internal discounts.
No healing, no shields, no hard CC, no cleanse — purely a fragile poke/assassin with evasion, vulnerable on the turns his invuln is on cooldown.
Quincy Energy is stored as a removable MARK effect; effect-wipe/cleanse on Uryu would erase his entire engine.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, focused single-target piercing assassin with strong defensive uptime and built-in counters to DR/invuln, but held back by a modest, self-cannibalizing damage ceiling and zero AoE. Piercing+Bypassing on cheap CD1 skills makes him a reliable answer to tanks and invuln stackers, and two invuln layers plus energy denial give him real staying power and disruption. However his peak burst is only 55 (and getting there means forgoing his cheap pokes), he must repeatedly spend turns recharging via uryu1, and he brings no healing/shields/CC/cleanse and no multi-target presence. Solid, fair, slightly above the floor — a specialist rather than a top-tier carry. Mid-pack.
outlier_flags: Affliction class on uryu1 despite it dealing no damage (likely a vestigial/erroneous tag, not a functional damage source).
Anti-synergy between the cheap energy-spending skills and the energy-scaling finisher — intended tension but easy to misplay.
Quincy Energy implemented as a MARK effect, making the whole kit vulnerable to effect removal/cleanse.

role: Single-Target Piercing Assassin / Anti-Defense Specialist
signature_mechanic: Quincy Energy engine: the free Spirit Particle Subjugation loads 4 stacks of Quincy Energy (stored as a permanent MARK) which gate and fuel his damage skills, and while any energy remains his slot 1 swaps to Quincy Final Kojaku Shot — a Bypassing finisher that consumes ALL energy and gains +5 Piercing per stack (up to 55). The cheap CD1 skills each spend energy and apply temporary cost-reduction chains, creating a push-pull between spamming pokes and saving for the max-scaled finisher.

abilities.name: Smoke Star
abilities.conditional_scaling: Blind durations scale +2 (one enemy turn) per Gunpowder Star mark stack on the target
abilities.effects_summary: Applies Blind to target enemy for duration 6 (3 enemy turns). Also Blinds one random other enemy (not one already Smoke-Star-blinded) for duration 3 (1 turn). Durations extended by Gunpowder Star stacks. Bypassing (skips invuln-type checks for application). This blind is the 'Smoke Star' debuff the rest of the kit keys off.

abilities.name: Impact Dial
abilities.conditional_scaling: Counter's stun rider only fires if the attacking enemy is currently Blinded
abilities.effects_summary: Places an invisible COUNTER_RECEIVE effect on Usopp or an ally for duration 2 (1 turn). Any enemy who uses a NEW skill on the protected ally is countered; if that attacker is Blinded (and can't shrug off Blind) they are additionally Stunned (stun_effect(3), ~1 turn). Strong defensive layer that pairs with the kit's heavy Blind output to convert into hard CC.

abilities.name: Lead Star
abilities.conditional_scaling: Splash: +10 to EVERY Blinded enemy (effectively AoE once Smoke Star is up). Target also takes the +10 if Blinded.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 20 Normal to the primary target, then 10 Normal to all Blinded enemies (respects invuln/shrug-off). 0 cooldown spammable nuke. Against a fully-Smoke-Starred 3-enemy team this becomes 30 to primary + 10 to two others = 50 spread.

abilities.name: Gunpowder Star
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 Normal per remaining turn of Smoke Star on each affected enemy (turns = (blind.duration+1)/2). Smoke Star duration itself ramps via the permanent +1-turn mark this skill stacks, so AoE damage grows over repeated casts.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 10 Normal to all enemies, +5 per remaining Smoke Star turn on each. Consumes/ends Smoke Star on hit, then applies a permanent stacking mark that makes future Smoke Star last +1 turn per stack against each damaged enemy. Detonator + ramp engine for the Blind theme.

abilities.name: Sharpshooter
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent passive: Usopp's attacks cannot Miss or be Dodged, and he himself ignores Blind effects (so enemy blinds/the accuracy-denial theme don't turn on him). Reliability passive, not damage.

role: Blind-stacking AoE controller / debuff-payoff zoner
signature_mechanic: Smoke Star Blind synergy engine

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No true DoT. Lead Star (0 CD) is the sustained nuke: 20 to target +10 to each Blinded enemy (30 on a Blinded primary, 50 total spread on a 3-enemy Smoke-Starred team). Gunpowder Star is the burst/scaling piece: 10 +5 per remaining Smoke Star turn. With base Smoke Star duration 6 => turns=3 => 25 each enemy = 75 AoE on a 3-target team in one turn. The permanent stacking +1-turn mark lets later Smoke Stars run longer (dur 8 => turns=4 => 30 each, etc.), so the AoE ceiling climbs ~+15 team damage per accumulated mark stack as the match drags. Realistic non-stacked AoE turn ~30-75; theoretical ceiling unbounded but slow.
damage_profile.notes: All Normal damage (blocked by barriers/shields/DR). Burst is mediocre in isolation; payoff requires Smoke Star pre-applied. Two-turn setup (Smoke Star CD 2) gates the big Gunpowder/Lead turns.

economy.color_dependency: None — every visible ability costs only Random pips, so Usopp slots into any energy team with zero color requirements (maximum flexibility).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/spammy: Lead Star 0 CD, Gunpowder Star 1 CD, Smoke Star and Impact Dial 2 CD. Can pressure or detonate nearly every turn; only the setup blind and the counter gate at 2.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Floor damage exists immediately (Lead 20, Gunpowder 10) but the character only becomes strong after Smoke Star is established, and scales further the longer the game runs via permanent mark stacks extending Blind duration.

hard_cc: Stun (via Impact Dial counter, only on a Blinded attacker)
soft_cc: Blind (Smoke Star, primary 3 turns + random 1 turn; the core accuracy-denial debuff)
invuln_or_counter: Counter (Impact Dial, 1 turn, allied-targetable, counters next new skill and stuns if attacker Blinded)

win_conditions: Blanket the enemy team in Smoke Star, then farm them with 0-CD Lead Star splash and ramping Gunpowder Star AoE
Grind out a long game: accumulate Gunpowder Star marks so each re-applied Smoke Star runs longer and each detonation hits harder
Use Impact Dial + the team-wide Blind to repeatedly counter-stun the enemy's key attacker, denying tempo while chipping the board
internal_synergies: Smoke Star (usopp1) is the linchpin: it enables Lead Star's +10 splash, Impact Dial's stun rider, and Gunpowder Star's bonus damage
Gunpowder Star (usopp4) consumes Smoke Star but leaves a permanent stacking mark that lengthens FUTURE Smoke Stars — a self-reinforcing ramp loop with usopp1
Impact Dial (usopp2) turns the kit's abundant Blind into hard CC (stun) instead of just accuracy loss
Sharpshooter (usopp5) makes Usopp immune to his own theme's downside (enemy Blind) and guarantees his hits land, so opposing accuracy-denial doesn't shut him off
strengths: Zero color dependency (all Random) — universally splashable into any team comp
Excellent tempo: 0-CD Lead Star and 1-CD Gunpowder Star give near-every-turn AoE pressure
Strong team-wide soft CC (Blind) that doubles as a damage amplifier and a counter-stun enabler
Scales the longer the game goes via permanent mark stacks — good in attrition/late-game
Defensive utility (ally-targetable counter) is rare on a damage-dealer and adds protection + CC
Sharpshooter makes his output reliable and immune to the blind/dodge meta
