weaknesses: All damage is Normal type — fully stopped by shields/barriers/DR; no Affliction/Piercing/True to punch through tanks
Heavily setup-dependent: with no Smoke Star up, Lead Star is just 20 and Gunpowder Star just 10 — weak raw burst
Smoke Star (the enabler) is on a 2-turn cooldown, so the big payoff turns are gated
No healing, no shields, no energy denial, no self-sustain — pure offense/control, fragile if focused
Blind can be cleansed/shrugged off, and any enemy Blind-immunity neuters the entire combo (splash, stun rider, and Gunpowder bonus all check Blind)
Ramp is slow and conditional; in fast games he never reaches his high AoE ceiling

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, cohesive AoE-control character with a clean win-the-long-game loop and zero color cost, which is a real flexibility premium. His tempo (0/1 CD spam) and team-wide Blind+counter-stun give consistent value, and the Gunpowder/Smoke Star ramp gives a genuine scaling ceiling (75+ AoE on a Smoke-Starred 3-target team, climbing with marks). But everything is Normal damage that shields/DR shut off, his burst floor without setup is low, the whole kit single-points-of-failure on Blind being landed and not cleansed, and he has no defensive sustain. Solid mid-tier: strong into squishy/no-cleanse teams, mediocre into tanks and dispel.
outlier_flags: zero-specific-color-cost kit (all Random) — economic outlier on flexibility
entire kit keys off a single debuff (Blind) — high cleanse/immunity vulnerability
0-cooldown damage ability (Lead Star) — tempo outlier
self-reinforcing permanent stacking ramp (Gunpowder->Smoke Star duration) with no hard cap

abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-mark halves output on the immediate follow-up cast (down-scaling, not up-scaling); cd 0 makes it repeatable.

abilities.name: String Performance
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Piercing x3 = 30 to one enemy + grants a counter that nullifies the first Harmful Physical skill used on Uzui for 1 turn. Cost Red:2.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (3 fixed hits)

abilities.name: Uzui Dodge
abilities.effects_summary: Self becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Pure panic button / dodge. Cost Random:1.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: The Score
abilities.effects_summary: Passive counter. Each of Uzui's first 4 skill uses marks a RANDOM enemy with a numbered Score (#1-#4). On the 4th trigger: all cooldowns reset, and skills become FREE and Uncounterable. This empowered window persists only while Uzui attacks Score-marked enemies in ascending numeric order; attacking an unmarked or out-of-order enemy ends it.
abilities.conditional_scaling: Ramp payoff after 4 skill uses: free + uncounterable casting + full cooldown reset, gated by an RNG-influenced ordering puzzle (marks land on random enemies).

role: Single-target Piercing duelist with a ramping free-cast payoff and strong self-defense
signature_mechanic: The Score (passive): first 4 skill uses mark random enemies #1-#4; the 4th trigger resets all cooldowns and makes every skill free + uncounterable, sustained only by attacking marked enemies in ascending order — a ramp-into-value window gated by an RNG-influenced ordering puzzle.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No per-turn multi-cast; one skill per turn caps a single hit at ~30 Piercing. The Score does not raise per-turn damage but enables sustained 0-cost, uncounterable, cooldown-free casting across subsequent turns (~30 Piercing/turn for free with no counter-based counterplay), so the ceiling is uptime/value, not a single big number.
damage_profile.notes: All four damage skills deal Piercing, which skips flat and %DR — so listed numbers are close to effective damage vs most defensive characters. No AoE and no DoT anywhere in the kit.

economy.color_dependency: Heavy Red dependency: uzui1 Red:1, uzui2 Red:1, uzui3 Red:2 — 4 of 6 visible pips are Red. Mono-Red identity (character_colors=[3]). uzui4 is the only purely flexible skill (Random:1).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. uzui2 has cd 0 (spammable), uzui1/uzui3 cd 1, only uzui4 is long (cd 4). The Score's 4th trigger resets ALL cooldowns, so once ramped he has no cooldown constraints.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high payoff ramp via The Score: needs 4 skill uses to unlock the free + uncounterable + cooldown-reset window, then must hit marked enemies in order to sustain it. Early game is plain and Red-hungry; ramped state is very efficient.

invuln_or_counter: uzui4: 1-turn Invulnerability (cd 4)
uzui3: counters the first Harmful Physical skill used on Uzui for 1 turn
uzui5: Uncounterable state after ramping The Score

win_conditions: Grind out a single priority target with cheap, repeatable Piercing that ignores armor/DR
Ramp The Score to the 4th trigger, then exploit free + uncounterable + cooldown-reset casting to out-tempo and out-value the opponent
Survive enemy nukes with invuln (uzui4), self-DR (uzui2), and the uzui3 counter, then win the attrition/efficiency war
Strip key enemy energy with uzui1 to deny their high-cost answers
internal_synergies: uzui2's cd 0 + self-DR lets him stack defensive layers while still dealing damage, and counts toward The Score quickly
Every skill use (including cheap uzui2 spam) advances The Score toward its 4-trigger payoff
Piercing across the whole kit makes his self-DR/invuln/counter defenses asymmetric: he ignores enemy armor while being hard to damage himself
After The Score pops, cooldown reset + free casts turn uzui3/uzui1 into repeatable uncounterable Piercing with no resource cost
uzui1 energy denial + uzui3/uzui4 defenses let him stall opponents while ramping
strengths: Entire damage kit is Piercing — bypasses flat and percentage DR, so effective damage is near nominal vs tanky/armor comps
Strong, layered self-defense for a damage character: 1-turn invuln, repeatable self-DR, and a physical-skill counter
Excellent cooldown tempo (uzui2 cd 0) plus a full cooldown reset from The Score
The Score payoff is very efficient: free, uncounterable, cooldown-free casting once online
Energy denial (uzui1) adds disruptive value beyond raw damage
Cheap, flexible costs (only 6 pips across the visible bar; uzui4 fully random)
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero DoT — purely single-target, weak into wide/swarm comps
Low raw per-turn damage (~30 cap, one skill per turn); no burst spike
Heavy mono-Red color dependency (4/6 pips Red) — vulnerable to Red energy denial/starvation and bad energy rolls

The Score payoff is RNG-gated: marks land on RANDOM enemies and the ordering requirement can be awkward or impossible (e.g. a marked enemy dies or becomes untargetable), prematurely ending the empowered state
No healing, shields, cleanse, or hard CC — limited team utility / no lockdown
Defenses are mostly self-only; brings little to protect allies
Slow start: needs 4 skill uses to ramp, and the empowered window is fragile to disruption breaking the order

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded solo duelist: all-Piercing offense ignores the most common defensive stat (DR/armor), and he packs unusually strong self-protection (invuln + repeatable DR + physical counter) for a damage dealer, with great cooldown tempo. The Score is a flashy, high-ceiling payoff (free, uncounterable, cooldown-free casting). But raw output is low (~30/turn, no AoE, no DoT, no burst), and the marquee mechanic is heavily RNG-dependent (random mark placement + fragile ordering requirement) and slow to come online. He is a solid, self-sufficient 1v1 attrition pick that struggles to close games quickly or impact teamfights — above-average but not oppressive in isolation.
outlier_flags: whole-kit Piercing (effective-damage outlier vs DR/armor)
signature payoff is RNG-gated and can self-terminate (reliability outlier)
mono-color all-Red specific pips (economy outlier)
damage-class character with three distinct self-survival tools (defensive-toolkit outlier)

role: single-target piercing ramp/scaling damage dealer with self-protection
signature_mechanic: Two independent ramp economies: passive "Ki Blast" stacks (+5 dmg/charge gained on any non-Ki-Blast turn, including idle, Energy Charge, or Galick Gun turns; consumed on Ki Blast / Double Ki Blast use), and Galick Gun's permanent +5-per-cast escalation paired with Energy Charge's stacking Red-cost discount.

abilities.name: Ki Blast
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 piercing damage per stored Ki Blast stack (DAMAGE_MOD boosts 'Ki Blast'/'Double Ki Blast'); stacks gained at end of any turn Vegeta did not use a damaging non-Galick/non-EnergyCharge skill; stacks consumed on use
abilities.effects_summary: Single-target piercing nuke that ramps with idle/charge turns. Also applies a non-Affliction damage-reduction debuff to the target of -(5 + 5*stacks) for 1 enemy turn (dur 2), scaling its disable strength with the same stacks; consumes Ki Blast stacks on cast.

abilities.name: Double Ki Blast
abilities.conditional_scaling: Grants +1 Ki Blast stack on use then fires, so damage = 5 + 5*(stacks) piercing to each enemy via the shared Ki Blast DAMAGE_MOD; consumes stacks after
abilities.effects_summary: AoE version of Ki Blast: gains a Ki Blast stack, then hits the whole enemy team for 5 + 5*stacks piercing and applies the scaling non-Affliction damage-reduction debuff (-(5 + 5*(stacks+1)), dur 2 = 1 turn) to each target. Consumes Ki Blast stacks.

abilities.name: Galick Gun
abilities.cost_breakdown: Red:2 (reducible toward 0 via stacked Energy Charge cost-mods)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Permanent +5 piercing damage every time it is cast (self DAMAGE_MOD on 'Galick Gun', stackable/per-stack, never reset); damage = 40 + 5*(prior casts)
abilities.effects_summary: Heavy uncounterable single-target piercing nuke (40 base) that permanently escalates +5 per cast. Consumes any Energy Charge cost-discount stacks on use. No secondary effect beyond uncounterable + ramp.

abilities.name: Energy Charge
abilities.conditional_scaling: Each successful (unharassed) charge stacks a permanent -1 Red cost-mod on Galick Gun until next Galick Gun use
abilities.effects_summary: Self utility: 10 flat damage reduction for 1 turn (dur 2). If Vegeta receives no new Harmful skill during that window, grants a stacking -1 Red cost reduction to Galick Gun (until Galick Gun is next cast). Also counts as a non-damaging turn so it still feeds Ki Blast stacks. Acts as a soft panic button + ramp enabler.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Effectively uncapped on Galick Gun: +5 permanent per cast (40, 45, 50, 55, ... with no reset), all Piercing so it ignores flat and % DR. Ki Blast/Double Ki Blast scale +5 per stored stack with no hard cap on stacks accumulated over idle/charge turns; one big Ki Blast after several charge turns can spike well above base (e.g. 5 charge turns -> 30 single-target). All three offensive skills are Piercing, so effective damage is near-nominal vs armored/DR targets.
damage_profile.notes: Damage numbers in custom_behavior (AI hints: 70 for Galick Gun, 30 AoE for Double Ki Blast, 50 panic for Energy Charge) reflect a few casts of ramp. Base Ki Blast is tiny (5) with 0 cooldown and 1 random pip, designed to be spammed or stockpiled. Real ceiling comes from repeated Galick Gun casts and from cashing in large Ki Blast stack counts; both are linear-per-turn, not single-turn explosive.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate, Red-heavy. Galick Gun needs Red:2 (its main payoff) and Double Ki Blast needs Blue:1; Ki Blast and Energy Charge are 1 random each. Two-color (Blue+Red) identity matching character_colors [1,3]. Energy Charge can drive Galick Gun's Red cost toward 0 over a long game, easing the Red dependency.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast/flexible. Ki Blast has 0 cooldown (spammable filler); Double Ki Blast, Galick Gun, and Energy Charge are all cd 1, so Vegeta alternates big tools every other turn while filling with Ki Blast.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Weak early (5-dmg Ki Blast, 40 Galick Gun); rewards patient play — idle/charge turns build Ki Blast stacks, repeated Galick Gun casts permanently escalate, and Energy Charge stacks discount Galick Gun. Scales hard into the late game with little immediate burst.

soft_cc: Ki Blast / Double Ki Blast apply a scaling non-Affliction damage-reduction debuff to targets (-(5 + 5*stacks) for 1 turn), softening enemy offense
invuln_or_counter: Energy Charge: 10 flat damage reduction for 1 turn (soft mitigation, not invuln/counter)
Galick Gun is Uncounterable (cannot be countered), but grants no counter of its own

win_conditions: Out-scale the opponent: stack repeated Galick Gun casts (+5 each, permanent) and Energy Charge discounts until Galick Gun is a near-free, ever-growing uncounterable piercing nuke.
Stockpile Ki Blast stacks across idle/Energy-Charge turns, then cash in a heavily-boosted Ki Blast or AoE Double Ki Blast.
Grind value: all-piercing damage cleanly bypasses DR/armor comps, letting Vegeta reliably chip and finish tanky targets over a long match.
internal_synergies: Energy Charge feeds two ramps at once: it discounts Galick Gun's Red cost AND counts as a non-damaging turn, so it also grants a Ki Blast stack.
Idle/charge turns convert directly into Ki Blast damage via the end-of-turn stack trigger; the longer Vegeta withholds Ki Blast, the bigger its eventual hit and debuff.
Galick Gun's permanent +5 ramp pairs with Energy Charge's cost discount to make it cheaper and stronger simultaneously over time.
The damage-reduction debuff on Ki Blast/Double Ki Blast scales with the same stacks that boost the damage, so a big cash-in both hits hard and disarms the target.
Galick Gun being Uncounterable protects his main payoff from counter-based defenders.
strengths: Excellent, uncapped late-game scaling on Galick Gun (permanent +5/cast, Piercing, Uncounterable).
All offensive damage is Piercing — ignores flat and % damage reduction, strong vs armor/DR comps.
Cheap, flexible economy: half the kit is random pips, low cooldowns, and Energy Charge can zero out Galick Gun's Red cost.
Self-sustaining ramp with built-in protection (10 DR) and a useful enemy damage-debuff rider.
Has both single-target burst and team-wide AoE through the shared Ki Blast stack system.
weaknesses: Very weak early game; base numbers (5 Ki Blast, 40 Galick Gun) are unimpressive before ramp accrues.
No healing, no real shields/barriers, no hard CC, no cleanse, no energy denial, no transformation — purely a damage/self-buff archetype.
Ramp is fragile to disruption: Energy Charge's discount is denied if hit by any Harmful skill that turn, and Ki Blast stacks require spending turns NOT throwing his big attacks.
Stuns/silences/burst-down comps can kill him before his scaling matters; he wants a long game.
Mitigation is only flat 10 DR for 1 turn — easily overwhelmed by big or piercing/affliction hits.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, well-designed ramp/scaling damage dealer. In isolation he is strong because his payoff (Galick Gun) is uncounterable, all-piercing, and escalates permanently with a self-funded cost discount, while a parallel Ki Blast stack engine gives him spammable single-target and AoE options plus a scaling damage-down debuff. The kit is cheap and tempo-flexible (0-cd filler, 1-cd tools). He is held back from top tier by a soft early game, a single weak layer of mitigation, and zero CC/utility/healing — a fragile body that must survive to the point where ramp dominates. Rated mid-high; could rise if matches run long, fall if burst/lockdown comps prevail.

all-piercing-offense (bypasses DR entirely)
uncounterable-main-nuke
self-cost-reduction can drive a 2-Red skill to 0 cost

universe: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
role: Ramping mono-Red bruiser that idles to heal and stack, then spikes a single-target stun-nuke or a team AoE

At 3+ stacks veldora1 gains a 1-turn stun and veldora3 becomes AoE. Acting (any action) wipes all stacks, so it's a build-then-spend tension between sustain/ramp and tempo.

abilities.name: Imitation Kamehameha
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 damage per Slumbering Dragon stack (Harmful damage_mod). At 3+ stacks also stuns target 1 turn. 30 base, 45 at 3 stacks, scales unbounded with idle turns.
abilities.effects_summary: Single-target Energy nuke; at 3+ Slumbering Dragon stacks adds a 1-turn stun (Effect.stun_effect(2)). Primary stack-spending finisher.

abilities.name: Explosive Aura
abilities.cost_breakdown: Red:1 (becomes Random:1 the turn after use)
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Slumbering Dragon stack (Harmful damage_mod applies since it deals damage). Self-discount: recosts to 1 Random for 1 turn after use.
abilities.effects_summary: AoE 5 Energy to all enemies + damage_mod_effect -5 to their non-Affliction damage for 1 turn (offensive debuff / soft team protection). Grants self a cost_change so Explosive Aura costs 1 Random next turn. Cheap AoE poke + enemy-damage-reduction debuff.

abilities.name: Tempest Fist
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Slumbering Dragon stack. At 3+ stacks gains target_change to ALL enemies (becomes AoE). 20 base, 35 at 3 stacks AoE, scales unbounded.
abilities.effects_summary: Cheap single-target Energy hit (20) that converts to full AoE while at 3+ Slumbering Dragon stacks. The AoE stack-payoff skill.

abilities.name: Tempest Guard
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). Using it counts as acting, wiping all Slumbering Dragon stacks. 4-turn cooldown panic button / hard defensive.

abilities.name: Slumbering Dragon
abilities.conditional_scaling: Generates +5/stack damage_mod and the heal/threshold engine; the scaling source for the whole kit.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive engine (-1 duration). END_OF_TURN_TRIGGER: if Veldora didn't act, heal 5 HP + add a stacking +5 Harmful damage_mod; at 3+ stacks also grants target_change(ALL) for Tempest Fist. ACTION_USE_TRIGGER: acting erases all DAMAGE_MOD + TARGET_CHANGE Slumbering Dragon stacks.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded in theory (+5/stack, +5 HP heal per idle turn). Practical ceiling is low because acting wipes ALL stacks, so you cannot sustain stacked output. Realistic spend window ~3-6 stacks: veldora1 ~45-60 + stun, or veldora3 ~35-50 AoE. No turn-over-turn DoT.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Energy (respects barriers/shields/DR). Numbers shown at the 3-stack threshold (min to unlock stun on v1 and AoE on v3). Every active skill triggers reset_on_action, so the stack bonus applies to the skills resolving that turn, then all stacks are lost and you must re-idle to rebuild. Stacking longer (e.g. 6 idle turns) pushes v1 to ~60 single-target + stun or v3 to ~50 AoE, at the cost of doing nothing those turns.

economy.color_dependency: Mono-Red. 3 of 5 visible pips are Red (v1 Red+Rand, v2 Red, v3 Red); only v4 and one v1 pip are Random. Strong single-color dependency but cheap. Explosive Aura self-discounts to Random the turn after use, easing Red strain on spam.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very low: three of four actives are cooldown 0 and 1-2 pips, so he can act every turn cheaply. Only veldora4 (Invuln) has a 4-turn cooldown. The real tempo constraint is self-imposed: acting resets ramp, so high-value turns require idling first.
economy.ramp_dependency: High and self-conflicting. Payoff (stun on v1, AoE on v3, +damage) keys off Slumbering Dragon stacks built ONLY by NOT acting. Every action including the defensive Tempest Guard wipes stacks, so ramp and tempo directly compete. Heal-while-idle gives passive value even when not spending.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun on veldora1 at 3+ Slumbering Dragon stacks (single target)
soft_cc: non-Affliction damage -5 for 1 turn on all enemies hit by veldora2 (offensive debuff)
invuln_or_counter: Tempest Guard: self Invulnerable 1 turn, 4-turn cooldown

win_conditions: Idle 3+ turns (healing 5/turn) to reach the Slumbering Dragon threshold, then unload a 45+ stunning Imitation Kamehameha to lock down and burst a key target.
At 3+ stacks, swing Tempest Fist as a 35+ AoE to clear or pressure a clustered enemy team.
Grind attrition with cheap mono-Red pokes + 5 HP/turn idle sustain + v2 enemy damage reduction while staying ahead on HP, using Invuln to survive burst windows.
internal_synergies: Slumbering Dragon (v5) is the hub: its +5/stack damage_mod buffs v1/v2/v3 simultaneously and unlocks v1 stun + v3 AoE at 3 stacks.
The idle 5 HP heal makes ramping turns non-wasteful — you gain sustain while building the threshold.

Explosive Aura's self-discount (Red -> Random next turn) lets you weave a near-free AoE poke between ramp turns without straining Red, and its -5 non-Affliction debuff softens incoming damage during slow ramp windows.
Tempest Guard (Invuln) protects the fragile build-up phase, but it shares the act-wipes-stacks rule, so it's an emergency lever, not a free play.
strengths: Cheap, low-cooldown, flexible kit (most skills 1 pip, cd 0) — easy to cast every turn.
Built-in sustain: 5 HP/turn while idling plus an Invuln cooldown make him hard to grind down.
Mode flexibility from one passive: the same stacks turn v1 into a stun-burst or v3 into a team-wide AoE.
Unbounded theoretical scaling (+5/stack) gives a high ceiling if left to ramp.
v2 provides team-useful enemy damage reduction (soft protection) on a 1-pip AoE.
weaknesses: Self-conflicting ramp: every action — even defending — wipes all stacks, so he can't sustain stacked output; payoff is a single spike turn, then back to zero.
Pure Energy damage — fully stopped by barriers/shields/DR, no Affliction/Piercing/True to bypass tanky frontlines.
Idling to ramp surrenders tempo; against fast burst teams he may never reach 3 stacks safely.
No cleanse, no energy denial, no stealth, no shields/barriers; only one single-target stun for hard control.
Mono-Red dependency (3 Red pips) can be color-starved early.
Base output before stacks is mediocre (30 / 20 / 5) — he is weak until ramped.

power_assessment.reasoning: A solid-but-unspectacular ramp bruiser. Floor value is good — cheap spammable skills, passive 5 HP/turn sustain, an Invuln, and a 1-pip AoE debuff make him resilient and flexible. But his identity (stun on v1, AoE on v3, +5/stack damage) is gated behind idling 3+ turns, and acting wipes ALL stacks, so he gets one spike turn rather than escalating pressure. Peak realistic single-target ~45-60 + 1-turn stun and peak AoE ~35-50 are respectable but not elite, and all of it is Energy damage that shields/DR fully absorb. The act-wipes-stacks design caps the theoretically unbounded scaling hard. Balanced and fair rather than oppressive — a mid-tier attrition/setup pick. Rated in isolation; likely lands around average once recalibrated.
outlier_flags: unbounded-in-theory +5/stack scaling that is sharply self-limited by act-wipes-all-stacks
every action including the defensive Invuln resets the ramp engine
v2 self-discount (Red->Random) is an unusual cost-mutation mechanic

role: Taunt-tank / ramping single-target & DoT bruiser that punishes attackers
signature_mechanic: Venus Burning Love: a passive that converts incoming Harmful skills into stacking +5 damage on her next skill (2 stacks if the attacker is Taunted). Her own Taunts force enemies to hit her, and because those attackers are Taunted she banks 2 stacks per hit, ramping a burst nuke (venus2), an AoE (venus1), or a self-scaling DoT (venus3).

abilities.name: Venus Love and Beauty Shock
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Venus Burning Love stack consumed (stack_mag damage_mod adds +5/stack to next damaging skill)
abilities.effects_summary: 5 Normal to all enemies; Blinds each for ~1 turn (dur 3). If a target is already Blinded, Taunts it for ~1 turn instead. Consumes all Burning Love stacks.

abilities.name: Venus Love Me Chain
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per Burning Love stack consumed (e.g. 4 stacks -> 35 single-target)
abilities.effects_summary: 15 Normal single-target + Taunt for ~1 turn (dur 2). Consumes all Burning Love stacks. Primary nuke and Taunt-setter that fuels 2-stack passive triggers.

abilities.name: Crescent Beam Barrage
abilities.conditional_scaling: Per Burning Love stack consumed: DoT magnitude = stacks*5 Normal/turn AND duration = 3 + stacks*2 ticks; both scale with stacks so total DoT output is roughly quadratic in stacks.
abilities.effects_summary: Channeled. 0 hit damage; applies a DoT of (stacks*5) Normal/turn and Taunts the target for total_dur = 3 + stacks*2 ticks; Blinds ALL other enemies for that duration. Consumes all Burning Love stacks. Self channel_cancel (breaks if Venus is stunned or acts again).

abilities.name: Defensive Binding
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend). Panic button to survive focus fire and continue baiting Burning Love stacks. 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Venus Burning Love
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gains 1 stack per Harmful skill received; 2 stacks if the attacker is Taunted. Each stack = +5 to next skill's damage. No stack cap.
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER. Converts being attacked into stacking +5 damage_mod (stack_mag) on her next skill. Synergizes with her own Taunts to bank 2 stacks per hit. Stacks consumed by venus1/2/3 on use.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Theoretically unbounded - no stack cap. venus2 burst = 15 + 5*stacks; venus3 DoT = 5*stacks per turn for 3+2*stacks turns (quadratic total). Stacks come ~2/turn she's attacked, so 4-6 stacks is typical mid-fight: ~35-45 burst or a ~25-30/turn DoT lasting 11-15 ticks.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Normal type (no barrier/DR bypass). Listed peaks assume ~4 banked stacks (a plausible mid-game state): venus2 = 15+20 = 35; venus1 = 5+20 = 25 to all; venus3 DoT = 20/turn for 11 ticks (sustained peak shown at ~6 stacks = 30/turn). Without stacks her raw output is tiny (5 AoE / 15 ST / 0 from venus3).

economy.color_dependency: Light Red dependency - 2 of 4 visible skills (venus2, venus3) each need exactly 1 Red pip; venus1 and venus4 are 1 Random each. Easy to splash, mono-Red identity (character_colors=[3]).
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very fluid - venus1 and venus3 are 0 CD, venus2 is 1 CD, only venus4 (defensive invuln) is on a long 4 CD. She can act and ramp every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: High and unusual: her offense is near-zero without Burning Love stacks, and stacks only accrue when she is attacked. She is reactive - strong vs aggression, weak when ignored or unable to bait hits.

hard_cc: Taunt (venus1 conditional, venus2, venus3)
soft_cc: Blind (venus1 AoE, venus3 all-other-enemies)
invuln_or_counter: Defensive Binding self-Invulnerable 1 turn (venus4, 4 CD)
Burning Love passive is a soft counter - punishes attackers with ramping damage

win_conditions: Bait enemies into attacking her with Taunts, banking 2 Burning Love stacks per hit, then dump a 30-45+ burst (venus2) or a long high-magnitude DoT (venus3) once ramped
Lock down the enemy board with chained Taunts + AoE Blind (venus1/venus3) to neutralize their damage and accuracy while she scales
Use venus3 to apply a snowballing DoT plus full-board control (taunt one, blind the rest) that out-values the channel lockout
internal_synergies: Taunt (venus1/2/3) -> Burning Love: Taunted attackers grant 2 stacks instead of 1, doubling ramp speed
Burning Love stacks -> all three offensive skills: feeds burst (venus2), AoE (venus1), or DoT magnitude+duration (venus3)
Blind (venus1/venus3) reduces enemy accuracy so she survives the attacks she is baiting, sustaining the stack engine
venus3 simultaneously taunts the main target and blinds everyone else, setting the whole enemy board up to feed her passive
Defensive Binding lets her survive a focus-fire turn while still having drawn the attacks that generate stacks
strengths: Extremely cheap, fluid kit (5 total pips, mostly 0-1 CD) - can ramp and control every turn
Heavy, repeatable Taunt access pairs with a passive that rewards being attacked - she turns enemy aggression into her own scaling
Strong board control: AoE Blind + multi-target Taunt cripples enemy offense and accuracy
No hard stack cap means her scaling ceiling (especially venus3's quadratic DoT) is very high in long fights
Self-Invulnerability gives a reliable survival cooldown to protect her ramp
weaknesses: Reactive engine - if enemies refuse to attack her (or kill allies instead), she generates almost no stacks and her raw damage is tiny (5 AoE / 15 ST / 0 DoT)
All damage is Normal type - fully stopped by barriers, shields, invuln, and damage reduction; no bypass anywhere
Stacks are consumed entirely on each use, so a misfire or buff-strip/cleanse on the damage_mod wipes her built-up payload
venus3's channel locks her out (no further actions / cancelled if stunned), and she must commit stacks to it; vulnerable to stun and channel-cancel
Taunt-immune, untargetable, or DoT-immune enemies blank both her control and her win conditions
No healing, no shields, no cleanse, no energy denial - purely a Taunt+ramp specialist with thin defensive depth beyond one invuln

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, internally coherent Taunt-bruiser whose Taunt+Burning Love loop is a genuine engine: cheap, low-cooldown, and self-reinforcing, with a high (uncapped) scaling ceiling on venus3's quadratic DoT and good board control via AoE Blind + Taunt. But she is heavily reactive and all-Normal damage with zero bypass, so disciplined opponents who avoid hitting her, or who run shields/DR/invuln, deflate her output. Floor is low (negligible damage unattacked), ceiling is high; lands as a solid mid-tier specialist rather than a top-tier threat.
outlier_flags: Uncapped damage_mod stacking (no stack ceiling) - potential balance outlier in long or high-aggression matchups
venus3 scales both DoT magnitude AND duration off the same stack count, giving roughly quadratic total DoT
Damage output is almost entirely conditional on being attacked; raw kit numbers (5/15/0) are unusually low for a 4-skill bar

abilities.name: Scoppio d'Ira
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 permanent damage per Scars of Wrath stack (any of 8 trigger conditions adds a per_stack damage_mod); converts to Piercing if 'piercing' triggered; adds 1-turn stun if 'stun' triggered; adds 5 permanent stacking Affliction if 'affliction' triggered
abilities.effects_summary: Primary scaling nuke. Base 20 Normal, single target. Ramps +5/stack of Scars of Wrath. With piercing-trigger becomes Piercing (skips flat+%DR). With stun-trigger applies 1-turn stun (dur 2). With affliction-trigger adds 5 permanent stacking Affliction DoT.

abilities.name: Martello di Fiamma
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cost drops 1 Random per Scars stack (down to Green:1 at 5+ stacks). 'half' trigger changes target_type to ALL (becomes AoE: 35 main + 20 splash to others). 'counter' trigger makes it Uncounterable.
abilities.effects_summary: Heavy single-target hit (35 Normal). Expensive 6 pips initially but Scars ramp reduces Random cost toward Green:1. After Xanxus has been below half HP, becomes AoE (35 main + 20 to each other enemy). Counter-trigger grants uncounterable.

abilities.name: Flames of Wrath
abilities.conditional_scaling: While marked (1 turn), any non-'half' wrath_check re-triggers even on already-triggered conditions, manually advancing the Scars ramp (+5 dmg / -1 cost / -1 CD per re-proc) and re-arming condition marks/bonuses without needing fresh incoming damage
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible 1-turn self-mark (dur 2) letting Scars of Wrath re-trigger as if untriggered. Active ramp accelerator / setup tool; lets Xanxus stack permanent bonuses faster and re-arm conditional riders on his other skills. No direct damage.

abilities.name: Sky Flame Deflection
abilities.conditional_scaling: Cooldown drops 1 per Scars stack (from 8 toward ~0-1 at high stacks). 'affliction' trigger -> heal 15. 'shatter' trigger -> 25 shield. 'isolate' trigger -> full cleanse of all enemy effects
abilities.effects_summary: Defensive panic button: full invulnerability for 1 turn. Base CD 8 but ramps down sharply via Scars (can approach spammable). Conditional riders: +15 heal (after affliction taken), +25 shield (after shatter taken), full cleanse (after isolate taken).

abilities.name: Scars of Wrath
abilities.conditional_scaling: Core ramp engine tracking 8 conditions (normal/piercing/affliction damage, stun, counter, shatter, isolate, below-half-HP). First time each occurs: permanently +5 Scoppio damage, -1 Random cost on Martello, -1 CD on Sky Flame Deflection, and unlocks that condition's conditional bonus across the kit
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden passive storage effect. Converts incoming damage/CC/debuffs into permanent power: each distinct trigger ramps damage, reduces costs, reduces cooldown, and arms conditional riders. 8 possible triggers = strong scaling ceiling. Reactive/punish-based ramp.

role: Reactive scaling bruiser/duelist — single-target nuker who converts incoming damage and CC into permanent ramp, with a strong personal survival package
signature_mechanic: Scars of Wrath: a reactive ramp engine that converts 8 distinct incoming events (Normal/Piercing/Affliction damage, stun, counter, shatter, isolate, dropping below half HP) into permanent power — each first occurrence grants +5 Scoppio damage, -1 Random cost on Martello, -1 CD on Sky Flame Deflection, and arms a condition-specific bonus rider on each ability. Flames of Wrath actively re-triggers the ramp without needing to take damage.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Scoppio d'Ira ramps +5/stack across up to 8 Scars conditions = +40 permanent (20 -> ~60 per cast). Combined with Martello (35) and stacking Affliction DoT, single-target throughput climbs steadily but is gated by how many trigger conditions the enemy actually inflicts. Realistic peak single-target burst ~85-90 in one turn (Scoppio ~55-60 Piercing + Martello 35) at high ramp.
damage_profile.notes: Base damage is modest (20/35); the ceiling is entirely ramp- and condition-dependent. Against a team that never stuns/pierces/afflicts/shatters/isolates him, he ramps only via 'normal' (+5) and 'half' (+5), capping low. Against a high-pressure CC/affliction comp he ramps hard, gains AoE on Martello, Piercing on Scoppio, and a stacking Affliction DoT. Flames of Wrath self-accelerates ~+5 dmg / -1 cost / -1 CD per use to partly bypass the dependency. Affliction DoT (5/stack) bypasses shields/barriers.

economy.color_dependency: Very low / near mono-Green. Only 2 specific Green pips across the 4 visible skills (1 on Scoppio, 1 on Martello); everything else Random. Easily splashable into any team despite Green identity.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Two 1-CD spammable damage skills (Scoppio, Martello) for constant pressure; Flames of Wrath on 3 CD as ramp accelerator; Sky Flame Deflection starts at heavy 8 CD but ramps down toward spammable via Scars. Fine early tempo, excellent late tempo once ramped.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Power and economy both scale off Scars of Wrath: Martello costs 6 initially (Green:1+Random:5) and is the only expensive skill, but every Scars stack shaves a Random pip toward Green:1; Sky Flame Deflection's 8 CD is only reasonable after ramp. Functional but unremarkable at 0 stacks, strong at high stacks.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun on Scoppio d'Ira (only after a stun has triggered Scars of Wrath)
invuln_or_counter: Full invulnerability 1 turn (Sky Flame Deflection, unconditional)
Uncounterable on Martello (after counter triggers Scars)

win_conditions: Out-attrition/duel a single target: survive incoming pressure with invuln + conditional heal/shield/cleanse while Scars ramps Scoppio and cuts costs/cooldowns, then grind them down
Let the enemy 'feed' the ramp — every CC, affliction, pierce, or burst makes Xanxus permanently stronger; punish aggressive comps
Stack Scoppio damage high (+ Piercing conversion to bypass DR) and chain low-CD Scoppio/Martello casts
Use Flames of Wrath to self-accelerate ramp independent of enemy actions, reaching cheap Martello AoE + spammable invuln
internal_synergies: Scars of Wrath (passive) underpins every other ability — ramp gates Scoppio damage, Martello cost, Sky Flame CD, and all conditional riders
Flames of Wrath manually re-triggers Scars conditions (non-'half') to accelerate the permanent +5dmg/-1cost/-1CD stacks without taking damage
Taking damage to enable Sky Flame Deflection's conditional heal/shield/cleanse simultaneously feeds the ramp engine — defensive and offensive scaling share the same triggers
'half' trigger (below 50% HP) simultaneously upgrades Martello into an AoE and adds a permanent ramp stack — being low is a power spike
Affliction trigger gives Scoppio a stacking permanent Affliction DoT AND gives Sky Flame a heal — double payoff for the same enemy debuff type
strengths: Extremely low color dependency (near mono-Green, mostly Random pips) — splashable into any team
Converts enemy pressure (CC, affliction, pierce, burst) into permanent scaling — naturally strong vs aggressive/control comps
Excellent personal survivability: unconditional 1-turn invuln plus conditional heal, shield, and full cleanse
Two 1-CD damage skills for consistent tempo; kit gets cheaper and faster as it ramps
Piercing conversion lets his main nuke bypass flat and % DR; stacking Affliction DoT bypasses shields/barriers
Sky Flame Deflection's CD ramps from 8 toward near-spammable, making him very hard to burst down late
weaknesses: Low floor: at 0 Scars stacks damage is modest (20/35), Martello costs a steep 6 pips, and the defensive is on an 8 CD — weak before ramp
Ramp is largely reactive — against a comp that never stuns/pierces/afflicts/shatters/isolates him, only 'normal' and 'half' trigger, capping scaling hard

Most conditional power (AoE, Piercing, stun, heal, shield, cleanse, uncounterable) requires the ENEMY to first inflict the matching effect; only Flames of Wrath partially self-enables, and not for 'half'
Zero team support — all utility (heal/shield/cleanse/invuln) is self-only; no allied buffs, no energy denial
Hard CC is minimal (one conditional 1-turn stun); self-acceleration via Flames of Wrath is on a 3 CD, so building ramp takes time
Affliction DoT is small (5/stack) and conditional; base sustained damage between nukes is low

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed reactive scaling duelist with a high skill ceiling and excellent splashability (near mono-Green, mostly Random). His personal survival kit (unconditional invuln + ramp-down CD + conditional heal/shield/cleanse) makes him very durable in 1v1 attrition. However his power is heavily matchup- and ramp-dependent: against passive opponents who don't feed Scars of Wrath, his offense stays modest (20/35 base) and Martello stays expensive (6 pips) with a slow 8-CD defensive. Flames of Wrath partially decouples him from enemy behavior but is on a 3 CD and can't trigger 'half'. No team support caps his ceiling in team formats. Lands solidly mid-tier: a reliable bruiser-duelist with strong tools but a real low floor and condition gating on most of his upside.
outlier_flags: Sky Flame Deflection's base cooldown of 8 is unusually high for the roster — mitigated only by ramp, a notable design dependency
Almost entirely Random-cost kit (7 of 9 pips) — extreme splashability outlier
Large power swing between 0-stack and high-stack states; effective rating varies ~2 points by matchup
Most conditional bonuses depend on the enemy inflicting specific effect types — unusually low agency over his own scaling outside Flames of Wrath

role: Ramping single-target striker / transformation duelist with damage-debuff control
signature_mechanic: Asari Ugetsu stacks: every attack feeds a stack counter (mark), then yamamoto3 consumes all stacks to enter a transformation lasting 1+stacks turns, swapping his two attacks for stronger Rondine versions and granting a shield. The kit also layers many small damage-reduction debuffs that the transformed Scontro di Rondine then scales off of.

abilities.name: Shinotsuku Ame
abilities.effects_summary: 20 Normal damage; applies -10 damage debuff (damage_mod, dur 4 = 2 enemy turns, refreshing); Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu. Cheap spammable on-color attack that both ramps stacks and seeds the damage-reducing effects that Scontro scales from.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (fixed 20)

abilities.name: Utsuhi Ame
abilities.effects_summary: Plants an invisible delayed trap (TICKING_TRIGGER dur 3) plus an invisible ACTION_USE_TRIGGER. Next turn the trap deals base 15 + 10*mag Normal damage that BYPASSES INVULNERABILITY, and Yamamoto gains stacks equal to mag. If the target uses a new skill before the trap resolves, mag becomes 1 (so 25 damage and +1 stack instead of 15 and +0). Punishes the target for acting; the bypass makes it a reliable answer to invuln/dodge defenders.
abilities.conditional_scaling: +10 delayed damage and +1 stack if the target uses a skill before resolution (mag increments per skill use)

abilities.name: Asari Ugetsu
abilities.effects_summary: TRANSFORMATION. Consumes all Asari Ugetsu stacks; transformation duration = 3 + stacks*2 (engine units), i.e. ~1 turn + 1 turn per stack. While active swaps slot1 Shinotsuku->Scontro di Rondine (yamamoto5) and slot2 Utsuhi->Beccata di Rondine (yamamoto6), and grants 25 Shield (dur = duration-1). extra_usable gates re-cast while already transformed.
abilities.conditional_scaling: transformation length scales with accumulated stacks (more attacks beforehand = longer empowered window)

abilities.name: Sakamaku Ame
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Yamamoto becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Pure panic button / tempo-stall on a 4-turn cooldown.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none

abilities.name: Scontro di Rondine
abilities.effects_summary: Transformed slot-1 attack. 30 Normal +5 for each enemy-applied damage-reducing (negative damage_mod) effect on the target. CD0 means it can be fired every turn while transformed. Synergizes with his own -damage debuffs (Shinotsuku, Beccata) which inflate its damage.
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 per negative damage_mod (damage-reducing) effect on the target applied by enemies; with his own debuffs stacked this realistically reaches 35-45+

abilities.name: Beccata di Rondine
abilities.effects_summary: Transformed slot-2 attack. 5 Piercing AoE to the enemy team, applies a 5 Piercing DoT (damage_effect dur 5 = ~2 enemy turns) and a -5 damage debuff (damage_mod dur 6 = 3 enemy turns) to all. CD0, repeatable while transformed. Spreads many damage-reducing debuffs across the team, feeding Scontro's scaling and dealing barrier/shield-ignoring chip.
abilities.conditional_scaling: none on the hit itself, but each cast seeds team-wide -damage debuffs that boost Scontro di Rondine

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: While transformed, Scontro di Rondine ~30 base +5 per enemy-applied damage-reduction effect on the target. With his own stacked debuffs (Shinotsuku -10, Beccata -5 across multiple turns) a single Scontro realistically hits ~40-45 against a debuff-laden target, and theoretically higher if many debuffs pile up. Utsuhi adds 25 burst bypassing invuln. Untransformed peak is one Shinotsuku (20) plus a resolving Utsuhi trap (15-25) in the same turn.
damage_profile.notes: Damage is modest and spread out; identity is attrition + debuffs + transformation uptime rather than burst. Beccata's Piercing DoT bypasses barriers/shields; Utsuhi's delayed hit bypasses invulnerability. peak_single_target ~45 (a buffed Scontro). Only one action per turn so sustained raw output is realistically 20-30/turn before debuff scaling.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Mono-Green identity (character_colors=[0], startup gains a Green flame). Only Shinotsuku requires a fixed Green pip; the other three visible skills are Random:1. Transformed Scontro needs Green+Random and Beccata needs Green, so the empowered phase leans slightly more on Green but is still very flexible.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Base bar is low-cost and fast: Shinotsuku CD1 (near-spammable), Utsuhi CD2, Asari CD3, Sakamaku CD4. The transformed Rondine attacks are CD0, so during transformation he can act every turn with no cooldown friction.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate-to-high. Power is gated behind accumulating Asari Ugetsu stacks (1 per Shinotsuku, up to 1 from a triggered Utsuhi) to extend the transformation window; with 0 stacks the transformation is only ~1 turn. Wants 2-3 setup turns before yamamoto3 to get a meaningful empowered phase.

soft_cc: -10 damage debuff (Shinotsuku, refreshing 2 turns)
-5 team damage debuff (Beccata, 3 turns)
invuln_or_counter: Sakamaku Ame: self-invulnerable 1 turn (CD4)

win_conditions: Spend early turns spamming Shinotsuku (and trapping with Utsuhi) to bank Asari Ugetsu stacks, then pop yamamoto3 for a long transformation window.

During transformation, alternate Scontro di Rondine (scaling single-target) and Beccata di Rondine (team-wide Piercing DoT + debuffs) to grind down the enemy team while the Piercing/bypass damage ignores defensive layers.
Use Utsuhi's invuln-bypass and Beccata's barrier-bypass to punish defensive/turtling teams that other strikers struggle against.
Survive burst windows with Sakamaku invuln + the 25 transformation shield, out-attriting the opponent.
internal_synergies: Shinotsuku and Beccata apply enemy-side negative damage_mod effects, which directly inflate Scontro di Rondine (+5 each) — his own debuffs are his own damage amp.
All base attacks feed Asari Ugetsu stacks, which lengthen the transformation that unlocks Scontro/Beccata — attack-to-transform loop.
Utsuhi's stack gain is conditional on the target acting; against active enemies it accelerates the transformation timeline.
Transformed attacks are CD0, so the empowered window has zero cooldown friction and lets debuffs/DoT compound turn over turn.
Beccata's team-wide -damage debuff is both a soft-control tool and fuel for Scontro's per-debuff scaling on any of the debuffed targets.
strengths: Excellent flexible economy: 4 visible skills total only 4 pips (3 of them Random), very easy to fund.
Strong anti-defensive toolkit: Utsuhi bypasses invulnerability, Beccata's Piercing DoT bypasses shields/barriers/DR.
Self-sufficient sustain/defense: 1-turn invuln (CD4) plus a 25 shield from transformation.
Good cooldown tempo — low base CDs and CD0 transformed attacks mean he is rarely idle.
Layered damage-reduction debuffs provide real soft control while simultaneously amplifying his own Scontro damage.
Transformation gives a clean power spike with both single-target scaling and team-wide pressure.
weaknesses: Low raw damage numbers across the board (20/15/30 base) — relies on debuff scaling and time, not burst.
No hard CC, no healing, no cleanse, no energy denial — limited team utility beyond minor damage debuffs.
Ramp-dependent: a transformation popped with few stacks is very short (~1 turn), so a rushed-down Yamamoto never gets his payoff.
Scontro's scaling is conditional on damage-reducing effects existing on the target; against a fresh/unmodified target it is just a vanilla 30.
Asari (CD3) and the transformation window mean his strong phase is intermittent; between transformations he is a weak 20-damage chipper.
Slow to come online; vulnerable to high-burst assassins who kill him before the transformation engine spins up.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, flexible attrition duelist with a genuinely useful niche (anti-invuln via Utsuhi, anti-shield via Beccata's Piercing DoT) and good economy/tempo. But his numbers are low and his strength is gated behind a ramp-then-transform loop, so he is fair rather than oppressive: strong vs defensive/turtle comps, weak vs fast burst. Self-protection (invuln + shield) keeps him from being fragile, but lack of CC/heal/energy denial caps his ceiling. Lands solidly mid-tier.
outlier_flags: JSON/.gd mismatch on Utsuhi: JSON says '15 additional damage', .gd applies +10 (mag*10) — actual triggered hit is ~25 not 30
Utsuhi stack gain in .gd equals mag (so 0 stacks if target never acts), not the flat '1 stack' the JSON implies
Beccata duration encoding: damage DoT dur 5 / debuff dur 6 — DoT lasts ~2 enemy turns, debuff ~3 turns per convention

role: Stance-dancing single-target bruiser/sustain swordsman who modes Halo Blade between burst, control, and lifesteal/tank
signature_mechanic: Three mutually-layering Over Soul stances (Amidamaru / Spirit of Sword / White Swan) reshape the 0-cooldown Halo Blade: Amidamaru doubles its damage + self-heals, Spirit adds a 1-turn stun + non-damage-effect immunity, White Swan adds lifesteal + a 20 damage cap on Yoh. Combining Amidamaru with Spirit swaps Halo Blade into Grand Halo Blade (40 dmg / execute at or below 40), and combining Amidamaru with White Swan swaps it into The Absence of Ignorance (uncounterable, non-damage HP-reduction equal to Yoh's current HP).

abilities.name: Amidamaru Over Soul
abilities.conditional_scaling: Self-heal scales: 10 HP/turn if Yoh took no Harmful skill last turn, else 5 HP/turn (heal_trig dur 10 = 5 turns). Doubles Halo Blade damage (15->30) while active.
abilities.effects_summary: 5-turn self stance (MARK dur 10). Halo Blade deals double damage. Adds ticking self-heal 5 HP/turn (10 HP if untargeted by a Harmful skill last turn, tracked by a HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER watcher). Enables stance combos: +Spirit swaps in Grand Halo Blade, +White Swan swaps in The Absence of Ignorance. Cannot recast while already active. Has self panic-button AI behavior.

abilities.name: Spirit of Sword
abilities.conditional_scaling: none (binary stance enable)
abilities.effects_summary: 4-turn self stance (MARK dur 8). Yoh ignores all Harmful non-damage effects (ignore_non_damage_effect dur 8) — soft anti-CC/anti-debuff. Halo Blade stuns its target for 1 turn (stun dur 2). If Amidamaru also active, Halo Blade is swapped to Grand Halo Blade. Mutually exclusive with White Swan (cannot cast while Swan active, and Swan blocked while this active). Self panic-button AI.

abilities.name: White Swan Over Soul
abilities.conditional_scaling: Damage cap 20 on Yoh (damage_cap_receive 20, dur 6 = 3 turns) — strong vs big hits, weak vs chip; lifesteal capped at 20.
abilities.effects_summary: 3-turn self stance (MARK dur 6). Caps all damage received by Yoh to 20 per instance (anti-burst tank mode). Halo Blade becomes 20 damage and steals up to 20 HP (lifesteal). If Amidamaru also active, Halo Blade is swapped to The Absence of Ignorance. Mutually exclusive with Spirit of Sword. Self panic-button AI.

abilities.name: Halo Blade
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 15 Normal. White Swan active -> 20 dmg + lifesteal up to 20. Amidamaru active -> 30 dmg (double). Spirit active -> adds 1-turn stun on a living target. Combining stances swaps this skill to Grand Halo Blade or The Absence of Ignorance.
abilities.effects_summary: Spammable 0-cooldown 1-Green single-target nuke. 15 base, scales to 20 (Swan, +lifesteal) or 30 (Amidamaru). Spirit adds a 1-turn stun. Core repeatable damage/turn engine that all the stances exist to amplify.

abilities.name: Grand Halo Blade
abilities.conditional_scaling: Execute threshold: instantly kills target at or below 40 current HP (execute_attempt 40); otherwise deals 40 Normal damage.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap that replaces Halo Blade when Amidamaru + Spirit of Sword are both active. 0-cooldown 40-damage single-target hit with a 40-HP execute. As a swap it loses Spirit's stun rider; pure burst/finisher. Strong repeated pressure since cooldown 0.

abilities.name: The Absence of Ignorance
abilities.conditional_scaling: Scales with Yoh's CURRENT HP: next turn reduces target's current HP by Yoh's current HP. Synergizes with Amidamaru/White Swan sustain keeping Yoh's HP high. Not damage -> ignores all DR/barriers/shields/caps; kills if it would drop target to 0.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden swap that replaces Halo Blade when Amidamaru + White Swan are both active. Marks target (MARK dur 3); on the following turn sets target HP = max(0, target HP - Yoh's current HP) and instant-kills if reduced to 0. Non-damage, Uncounterable -> bypasses shields, DR, damage caps, counters, and damage-reduction defenses. Telegraphed 1-turn delay; can be played around by healing/killing Yoh in the interim.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: The Absence of Ignorance scales with Yoh's current HP and is non-damage/uncounterable -> against a high-HP Yoh it functions as a near-uncapped execute (e.g. Yoh at 100 HP removes 100 current HP from any target, bypassing all defenses). Realistic 'big turn' is The Absence of Ignorance (HP-equal removal) or Grand Halo Blade 40 + execute. Theoretical one-turn ceiling listed (~100) assumes a maxed-HP Absence-of-Ignorance landing.
damage_profile.notes: No AoE in the entire kit (all damage is single-target). Halo Blade tops at 30 (Amidamaru) per cast at cooldown 0; Grand Halo Blade is a flat 40 + execute (also cooldown 0, so it can repeat). The Absence of Ignorance is the true ceiling but is delayed one turn and gated behind running Amidamaru + White Swan together. Self-sustain (yoh1 5-10/turn, yoh3 lifesteal up to 20/hit) keeps Yoh's HP high, which directly feeds the Absence-of-Ignorance payload.

economy.color_dependency: Light Green dependency. Of the 4 visible skills only Halo Blade needs a specific pip (Green:1); the three stances each cost Random:1. The hidden swaps cost more Green (Grand Halo Blade Green:1+Random:1; Absence of Ignorance Green:2), so playing the upgraded swap-skill path raises Green dependency.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Stances are cheap but on 4-turn cooldowns, so you set up a stance configuration and then spam the 0-cooldown attack (Halo Blade / Grand Halo Blade) every turn. Absence of Ignorance is cooldown 1. Tempo: 1-2 turns of stance setup, then sustained 0-cd pressure.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Yoh is weakest turn 1 with only base Halo Blade (15). Needs ~1-2 stance activations to reach his real damage/sustain/tank profile, and the two strongest tools (Grand Halo Blade, Absence of Ignorance) require TWO stances active simultaneously, so they come online turn 2-3 at the earliest.

hard_cc: 1-turn stun on Halo Blade while Spirit of Sword active
invuln_or_counter: Spirit of Sword: ignore all Harmful non-damage effects (4 turns) — anti-CC/anti-debuff immunity
White Swan Over Soul: caps incoming damage to 20 per hit (3 turns) — anti-burst mitigation
The Absence of Ignorance: Uncounterable, non-damage HP removal that bypasses shields/DR/counters

internal_synergies: Amidamaru + Halo Blade: doubles basic-attack damage (15->30) while ticking 5-10 self-heal.
Amidamaru + Spirit of Sword: swaps Halo Blade into Grand Halo Blade (40 dmg + 40-HP execute).
Amidamaru + White Swan: swaps Halo Blade into The Absence of Ignorance (uncounterable HP-equal removal).
Self-sustain loop (Amidamaru heal + White Swan lifesteal + White Swan 20-damage cap) keeps Yoh's HP near max, which directly increases the Absence of Ignorance payload.
Spirit of Sword's non-damage-effect immunity protects the stance setup from being disrupted by enemy CC/debuffs.
White Swan's 20-damage cap makes Yoh extremely durable against burst while he ramps.
win_conditions: Stack Amidamaru + White Swan, sustain HP to near-full, then delete a key target with The Absence of Ignorance (ignores all defenses).
Stack Amidamaru + Spirit of Sword and grind targets down with repeatable 0-cooldown Grand Halo Blade hits, finishing with the 40-HP execute.
Outlast: White Swan damage cap + Amidamaru/lifesteal sustain wins attrition vs burst-reliant enemies while chipping with Halo Blade.
strengths: Extremely flexible: one character covers burst (Grand Halo Blade), control (Spirit stun + effect immunity), tank (White Swan damage cap), and an uncounterable execute (Absence of Ignorance).
The Absence of Ignorance bypasses shields, DR, damage caps, and counters entirely (non-damage + Uncounterable) — answer to defensive/tank comps.
Strong self-sustain (5-10 HP/turn + up to 20 lifesteal/hit) makes him hard to grind out and fuels the HP-scaling finisher.
Cheap kit (4 visible pips, only 1 specific color) and a 0-cooldown attack mean great energy efficiency and tempo once set up.
Spirit of Sword's blanket immunity to Harmful non-damage effects hard-counters CC/debuff-reliant characters.
White Swan's 20-damage cap is a brutal answer to single-big-hit burst assassins.
weaknesses: Zero AoE — completely single-target, weak into wide/swarm comps and offers no team utility (no team heals, shields, or buffs; all sustain/defense is self-only).

Ramp-dependent and telegraphed: the best tools require two stances active (turn 2-3+) and Absence of Ignorance has a visible 1-turn delay that can be played around (heal the target, burst/kill Yoh, or drop Yoh's HP).
White Swan's damage cap helps vs big hits but does nothing against many small hits or Affliction/Bleed/Piercing/True chip, and the Absence-of-Ignorance payload shrinks as Yoh loses HP.
Stance mutual exclusivity (Spirit vs White Swan can't coexist) forces a control-vs-tank choice and prevents stacking all defenses.
No cleanse, no energy denial, no stealth — a self-contained duelist; can be focused and CC'd before stances are up (only Spirit grants effect immunity, and only after it's cast).

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-designed, high-skill-ceiling solo duelist. The stance system gives genuine mode flexibility (burst / control / tank / uncounterable execute) on a cheap, mostly-flexible energy cost with a 0-cooldown attack engine. The Absence of Ignorance is a standout: HP-scaling, non-damage, Uncounterable removal that ignores the entire defensive layer of the game and can instant-kill — a real threat to tanks and shield comps, kept honest by a 1-turn telegraph and a two-stance setup requirement. Strong self-sustain and the White Swan damage cap make him durable in 1v1 attrition. Held back from top tier by total lack of AoE/team utility, hard ramp dependence (weak turn 1, best tools online turn 2-3), and exploitable telegraphs. Solid upper-mid: rates ~7 in isolation.
outlier_flags: uncounterable-bypass-all-defenses: The Absence of Ignorance is non-damage + Uncounterable and ignores shields/DR/caps/counters — potential balance outlier vs the defensive layer.
hp-scaling-execute: payload equals Yoh's current HP with no listed cap, and the kit's own sustain pushes that toward an effective full-HP execute.
zero-cooldown-burst: Grand Halo Blade is a repeatable 40-damage + execute hit at cooldown 0.

role: Reflect-tank / taunt-lockdown controller — soaks the enemy team's harmful skills onto a 5-HP invulnerable body and turns ignored damage into reflected punishment
signature_mechanic: Sealed Nightmare passive: HP hard-capped at 5, permanently Isolated, and while she has living allies she ignores ALL harmful effects. Every harmful skill that targets her grants a Terror Incarnate stack; at 2 stacks she unlocks single-target damage reflection (yubel3), and at 6 stacks she unlocks Ultimate Nightmare (yubel5) which permanently reflects all ignored damage to the WHOLE enemy team, doubled.

abilities.name: Sadistic Taunt
abilities.conditional_scaling: Allied damage buff stacks each time Yubel receives a new harmful skill while active (+5 non-Affliction per trigger, stackable, 1 turn)
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible Taunt on 1 enemy for 1 turn (dur 2). Plus a self-mark HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER (dur 2): each time Yubel is hit by a new harmful skill, every other ally gains a stackable +5 non-Affliction damage_mod for 1 turn. Turns enemy aggression into team damage.

abilities.name: Dark Dimension
abilities.conditional_scaling: Taunt duration doubles (1->2 turns) on Invulnerable targets
abilities.effects_summary: Invisible Taunt on the entire enemy team for 1 turn (dur 2), extended to 2 turns (dur 4) on invulnerable targets. Team-wide forced-targeting lock; funnels enemy harmful skills (back into Yubel via her passive synergy / protects allies).

abilities.name: Terror Incarnate
abilities.damage_type: Reflected (returns ignored damage; magnitude = incoming ignored hit)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gated: requires 2+ Terror Incarnate stacks. Reflection magnitude scales with whatever damage enemies throw at her (which she ignores).
abilities.effects_summary: Requires 2+ Terror stacks. Applies a permanent (dur -1) HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER marker: damage Yubel would ignore from enemy skills is reflected back to the attacker. Also applies an ability_swap_effect swapping slot to Ultimate Nightmare (yubel5). Note: JSON says needs 4 stacks but code extra_usable requires >=2.

abilities.name: Malicious Intent
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Applies an invisible ACTION_USE_TRIGGER on 1 enemy for 1 turn (dur 2): if that enemy uses a NEW skill, they are Taunted for 1 turn (dur 3, self/player-facing convention). A reactive trap/punish on a single threat, long 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Ultimate Nightmare
abilities.damage_type: Reflected (doubled return of ignored damage to all enemies)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Gated: code requires 6+ Terror Incarnate stacks (JSON/describe text stale, say 4). Reflection scales with all incoming ignored damage, doubled, hitting the whole enemy team.
abilities.effects_summary: Hidden ultimate (swap target of yubel3). Requires 6+ Terror stacks; consumes all Terror Incarnate stacks. Applies a permanent (dur -1) HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER: for the rest of the game, any damage Yubel would ignore from enemy skills is reflected to the ENTIRE enemy team, doubled. Win-condition payoff for absorbing many harmful skills.

abilities.name: Sealed Nightmare
abilities.conditional_scaling: Ramps Terror Incarnate stacks: +1 per harmful skill that primarily targets her (feeds yubel3 at 2 and yubel5 at 6)
abilities.effects_summary: Permanent passive (auto-applied at startup, HP set to 5). Permanent health cap of 5; permanent Isolate; permanent ignore_damage + ignore_non_damage (ignores ALL harmful effects) — but ONLY while she has targetable living allies (death_trigger strips the ignore effects when she is the last one standing). HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER grants +1 Terror Incarnate stack each time she's the primary harmful target.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: No proactive damage of her own — all 'damage' is reflection-based and entirely dependent on what enemies choose to throw at her. With yubel3 active, single ignored hits bounce back at face value to the attacker; with Ultimate Nightmare (yubel5) every ignored hit is reflected to the whole enemy team DOUBLED, so the ceiling is roughly 2x the enemy team's total incoming damage redirected at them. The +5 stackable non-Affliction allied damage_mod (yubel1) also indirectly raises her team's output as enemies attack her.
damage_profile.notes: Zero base/flat damage in any .gd file. She is a pure enabler/reflector. Effective damage is fully reactive and capped by enemy aggression; a passive enemy team starves her ramp and her reflection. Reflection bypasses nothing special itself, but Affliction/Bleed are explicitly excluded from her yubel1 ally buff.

economy.color_dependency: Light. Across the 4 visible skills: White:2, Red:1, Random:3. Only yubel2 carries the real color load (White+Red+Random); yubel1 is a single White; yubel3 and yubel4 are single Random. Splash-friendly, easy to fit into most teams.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mixed. yubel1 (CD1) and yubel3/Ultimate (CD0) are spammable; yubel2 team-taunt is CD2; yubel4 trap is a slow CD4. Core gameplan (taunt + reflect-toggle) is available nearly every turn.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Both payoff buttons are stack-gated — yubel3 needs 2 Terror stacks, yubel5 needs 6. Stacks only accrue when enemies aim harmful skills at her, so her power curve is gated behind both time AND enemy cooperation. She is weak/inert early until she has soaked several harmful skills.

hard_cc: Taunt (single, yubel1)
Taunt (whole enemy team, yubel2)
Conditional Taunt trap (yubel4)
invuln_or_counter: Permanent self-immunity to ALL harmful effects while allies live (yubel6)
Permanent Isolate on self (yubel6)
Damage reflection to attacker (yubel3)
Doubled AoE damage reflection to whole enemy team (yubel5 Ultimate)

win_conditions: Survive and ramp: soak enemy harmful skills on her unkillable-while-allies-live body to reach 6 Terror stacks, then fire Ultimate Nightmare and let the enemy team kill itself via doubled reflection.
Taunt-lock the enemy team (yubel2) so all enemy harmful skills are funneled — protecting fragile allies while she banks reflection value and feeds her team's +5 damage buff.
Stall/attrition: be an immovable front-line that the enemy cannot ignore (taunt) and cannot profitably attack (immunity + reflection).
internal_synergies: yubel6 passive (immunity + stack-gain) is the engine: every harmful skill enemies send at her is fully negated AND converts into a Terror stack AND (with yubel1 active) buffs her allies AND (with yubel3/5 active) reflects damage — a single enemy action triggers up to four upsides.
yubel2 team-taunt forces the enemy team to attack into her immunity/reflection, accelerating Terror ramp and feeding yubel1's stacking ally damage buff.
yubel3 -> yubel5 swap chain: yubel3 (2 stacks) provides single-target reflection now and transforms into the 6-stack AoE doubled reflection finisher.
yubel1's +5 non-Affliction ally buff stacks per harmful skill received, rewarding the same enemy aggression that fuels everything else.
strengths: Effectively unkillable by harmful skills as long as one ally is alive (permanent ignore of ALL harmful effects) — extremely hard to remove from the board early/mid-game.
Best-in-class taunt suite: single, full-team, and a conditional trap taunt, all invisible (hard to play around).
Punishes the very act of attacking her: immunity + escalating reflection + ally damage buff + free ramp from each incoming harmful skill.
Cheap and color-flexible (6 total pips, half random), easy to splash.
Ultimate Nightmare is a snowballing, permanent, doubled team-wide reflect that can flip a game once online.
weaknesses: Zero proactive damage and no healing/shields/cleanse for allies — contributes nothing on a turn where enemies refuse to attack her.

Entirely dependent on enemy cooperation: a patient opponent who ignores her (or kills her allies first) starves her ramp and never triggers her reflection. Her own taunts mitigate this but cost tempo.
Immunity collapses the instant she is the last living character — death_trigger strips ignore_damage/ignore_non_damage, leaving a 5-HP body that dies to anything.
HP hard-capped at 5 and Isolated (can't receive most ally support); if immunity is bypassed/disabled she is paper.
Affliction/Bleed are explicitly excluded from her ally damage buff, and DoTs may route around the 'harmful skill' targeting that grants stacks, softening her engine vs damage-over-time comps.
Steep ramp gate (6 stacks for the ultimate) means slow games or low-aggression matchups leave her finisher offline.
Note: code/JSON mismatch on stack requirements (yubel3 code 2 vs JSON 4; yubel5 code 6 vs describe text 4) — a balance/clarity risk.

power_assessment.reasoning: A highly specialized control/reflect-tank with a genuinely powerful core: near-total harmful immunity while allies live, an excellent all-around taunt suite, free ramp off enemy aggression, a stacking team damage buff, and a snowballing doubled-AoE reflect finisher — all for a cheap, color-flexible 6-pip kit with low cooldowns. That immunity-plus-taunt package alone makes her a frustrating, sticky front-line. She is held back from top-tier by total dependence on enemy behavior (deals no damage on her own, can be soft-countered by simply not attacking her or by killing allies first to strip her immunity), the 5-HP/Isolate fragility once immunity lapses, the steep 6-stack ultimate gate, and weakness to Affliction/DoT routing around her engine. High skill expression and strong in aggressive metas; mediocre in passive ones. Rated in isolation; reflection magnitude depends on engine handling not visible in these files.
outlier_flags: Permanent unconditional immunity to ALL harmful effects (while any ally lives) is an unusually strong, near-binary defensive primitive.
Deals literally zero self-sourced damage across the entire kit — pure reactive/reflect win condition.
Code vs description mismatch on stack gates (yubel3: code 2 / JSON 4; yubel5: code 6 / text 4).
yubel5 swap originates from yubel3 (slot 3) per ability_swap_effect; visible-bar slotting of the transform should be verified against engine swap handling.

role: Control/utility ramp-finisher: white-energy summoner who locks down enemy offense and, after using his whole kit, executes one target with a guaranteed instant-kill
signature_mechanic: Exodia ramp passive (yugi6): using each of his 5 base skills once grants a stack; at 5 stacks all four visible skills swap to Obliterate! (yugi7), a no-condition instant-kill execute that ignores HP. Casting Obliterate disables Exodia for the rest of the game (one-time payoff).

abilities.name: Kuriboh
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Applies an invisible damage cap of 0 on target enemy for 1 turn (dur 2) so that enemy's newly-dealt damage is reduced to 0 (single-target offense negate / 'Invisible' lock). No damage. Advances an Exodia card.

abilities.name: Dark Magician Girl
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 25 Normal to target enemy. If Swords of Revealing Light is active, ends it on all characters and this slot swaps to Dark Magician (yugi5) for 2 turns. Unstunnable. 0 cooldown / spammable, primary single-target button and cheap Exodia enabler.

abilities.name: Swords of Revealing Light
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Stuns the Harmful skills of ALL characters (both teams) for 3 turns (stun dur 6, class-specific 'Harmful' stun) — team-wide offense lockdown. Swaps this slot to Dark Magician (yugi5) while active. No damage. Long 6-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Big Shield Gardna
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Yugi becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn (default_defend panic button). Pure self-protection; advances Exodia. Cooldown 4.

abilities.name: Dark Magician
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: AoE: strips all Counter and Reflect effects from every enemy, then deals 25 Normal to all enemies. Unstunnable and Uncounterable. Ends Swords of Revealing Light if active. Swap-target alt that yugi2/yugi3 transform into; not directly on the bar at start.

abilities.name: Exodia, the Forbidden One
abilities.conditional_scaling: per unique skill used; 5 stacks triggers transformation
abilities.effects_summary: Passive mark. Each of Yugi's 5 distinct skills, used once, adds a card/stack (tracked via check_card). At 5 unique cards, he ignores non-damage effects for 1 turn and all 4 visible slots swap to Obliterate! (yugi7). Persists until Obliterate is used.

abilities.name: Obliterate!
abilities.conditional_scaling: guaranteed kill regardless of target HP/defenses
abilities.effects_summary: Instantly kills target enemy (target.instant_kill — unconditional execute, not damage-threshold gated, ignores HP/barriers/DR). Casting it removes Exodia and swaps all skills back to base for the rest of the game. The Exodia payoff; only the transformed form can cast it.

damage_profile.notes: Raw printed damage is low: Dark Magician Girl (yugi2) and the Dark Magician alt (yugi5) both deal 25 Normal, no on-kit scaling. The 'damage' identity is misleading — Yugi's true payoff is the Exodia/Obliterate! INSTANT KILL (yugi7), which deletes a full enemy regardless of HP, barriers, or DR. Effective single-target ceiling is 'one guaranteed kill per game' rather than a damage number. custom_behavior AI placeholders list 35/75 but execute() resolves only 0/25 dmg or instant_kill.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: One unconditional instant-kill (Obliterate!) after ramping all 5 skills, plus repeatable 25 single-target (0 cd) and 25 AoE counter-strip (2 cd) once Dark Magician forms are online

economy.color_dependency: Single-color White identity: yugi2 (White:1) and yugi3 (White:2) are the specific pips; yugi1 and yugi4 are Random:1. Visible kit needs 3 White + 3 Random; no off-color splash.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Mixed: yugi2 spammable (cd 0), yugi1 fast (cd 1), yugi4 medium (cd 4), yugi3 slow (cd 6). Dark Magician alt cd 2; Obliterate cd 0.
economy.ramp_dependency: High — the win-condition (Obliterate instant-kill) requires using all 5 distinct skills at least once to reach 5 Exodia stacks, so payoff is back-loaded and early turns are low-impact utility.

soft_cc: Swords of Revealing Light: team-wide Harmful-class stun for 3 turns (both teams)
Kuriboh: single-enemy damage-cap-to-0 for 1 turn (negates their offense)
invuln_or_counter: Big Shield Gardna: self Invulnerable 1 turn
Dark Magician (yugi5): strips all enemy Counter/Reflect effects (anti-counter, Uncounterable itself)

internal_synergies: Exodia passive (yugi6) gates the whole identity: every other skill doubles as an Exodia-stack enabler, incentivizing using each at least once before the finish.
yugi3 Swords (team Harmful stun) buys safe turns to keep ramping while enemies cannot act offensively.
yugi2 and yugi3 both swap into the Dark Magician alt (yugi5), converting a slot into repeatable AoE + counter-strip.
Dark Magician's Uncounterable/Unstunnable tags plus its counter/reflect strip let Yugi push through defensive comps that would otherwise wall him.
Big Shield Gardna (invuln) and Kuriboh (damage negate) keep Yugi alive through the slow ramp so he survives to fire Obliterate.
win_conditions: Ramp all 5 skills to 5 Exodia stacks, then Obliterate! to instantly delete a key enemy (carry/threat) — a guaranteed pick that ignores HP and defenses.
Stall and control with Swords (team stun), Kuriboh (negate), and Gardna (invuln) to outlast while assembling Exodia.
Grind chip with repeatable 25 single-target (Dark Magician Girl, 0 cd) and 25 AoE counter-strip (Dark Magician alt) once forms are online.
strengths: Guaranteed, condition-free instant-kill (Obliterate!) bypasses all HP/barrier/DR — answers any single tank or high-HP carry.
Strong control suite: team-wide Harmful stun (Swords), single-target offense negate (Kuriboh), self-invuln (Gardna).
Cheap, single-color (White) economy with a 0-cooldown spammable damage button and low specific-pip burden.
Anti-defense tech: Dark Magician strips Counter/Reflect and is itself Uncounterable/Unstunnable; multiple Unstunnable skills resist enemy CC.
Built-in survivability (invuln + damage negation) to protect the slow ramp.
weaknesses: Heavily back-loaded: low printed damage (25 max) and no scaling means he is weak until Exodia comes online; if killed early he never gets the payoff.
Exodia requires using all 5 distinct skills, costing many turns/energy and telegraphing the finisher; pressure or burst can race him.
Obliterate is one-time — after casting, Exodia is disabled for the rest of the game and he reverts to a mediocre 25-damage controller.
No healing, no shields/barriers, no energy denial; sustain is purely cooldown-gated invuln/negate.
Swords stuns BOTH teams' Harmful skills, so it can blunt his own allies' offense (double-edged).
If the instant-kill target can be protected (invuln/cheat-death) on the key turn, the entire ramp can be wasted.

power_assessment.reasoning: A guaranteed, unconditional instant-kill is one of the strongest single effects in a roster (it ignores all defenses and HP), and Yugi pairs it with a genuinely good control/survival shell (team Harmful stun, single-target negate, self-invuln, anti-counter AoE). That ceiling is high. But the payoff is gated behind a 5-skill ramp that is slow, energy-hungry, telegraphed, and one-time, and his baseline damage (25, no scaling) is poor. Against fast burst or a comp that can protect the execute target on the key turn the whole plan collapses. Net: a swingy, top-end-defining-but-fragile control/finisher, strong in grindy matchups and weak into aggression. Mid-high, not clearly top-tier, pending roster recalibration of how easy the ramp is to disrupt and how common instant-kill counterplay is.
outlier_flags: Unconditional instant-kill (yugi7 target.instant_kill) — no HP/damage threshold; among the most powerful single effects if it resolves.
custom_behavior AI hints (35 on yugi3/yugi5, 75 on yugi7) do NOT match execute() — actual resolved values are 0/25 dmg and instant_kill; documentation/AI desync.
Swords of Revealing Light stuns ALL characters (both teams), an unusual symmetric drawback that can hurt the user's own team.
Ramp/transformation power that is entirely one-shot (Exodia permanently disabled after Obliterate).

abilities.name: Divergent Fist
abilities.target_type: SINGLE (self-target when Combat Awakening active; retargets 2 random enemies)
abilities.damage_type: Normal (becomes True when Combat Awakening active and HP<50)
abilities.conditional_scaling: +5 base damage per Consume Finger stack (permanent, unbounded). When Combat Awakening mark is active it fires twice at 2 random enemies (can be same target); if HP<50 those hits are True damage and each rolls Black Flash.
abilities.effects_summary: Hits one enemy for 15 Normal (scaling via Consume Finger), then applies a TICKING_TRIGGER that deals 5 True damage to that target next turn. Each True-damage instance (the tick, or a True Divergent Fist) triggers a Black Flash roll. With Combat Awakening: targets two random enemies, optionally as True damage.

abilities.name: Combat Awakening
abilities.conditional_scaling: If HP<50 the queued Divergent Fist also becomes full True damage (mark.mag=1), enabling Black Flash on the main hit and doubling the chances since it strikes two targets.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-mark (permanent until consumed): next Divergent Fist targets two random enemies (same enemy can be picked twice). +20% Black Flash trigger chance immediately. Pure setup/empower, no damage.

abilities.name: Consume Finger
abilities.conditional_scaling: Stacking ramp: each use permanently +5 Divergent Fist initial damage (stackable display mark) and +15% to black_flash_minimum (the floor Black Flash resets to). Repeatable every other turn -> unbounded ramp.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-heal 15 HP, permanently boosts Divergent Fist damage by 5 and raises the minimum/floor Black Flash chance by 15% (also bumps current chance up to the new floor). Core ramp + sustain engine.

abilities.name: Unusual Fortitude
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: default_defend: Yuji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Pure panic button / survivability cooldown.

abilities.name: Black Flash
abilities.conditional_scaling: Ramping proc chance: starts at 10% (mag), +15% on every True-damage instance that fails to proc, resets to black_flash_minimum (raised +15% per Consume Finger) on a successful trigger. Chance caps at 100%.
abilities.effects_summary: Passive that fires whenever Yuji deals True damage (the 5-dmg tick or a True Divergent Fist): on success deals 15 bonus True damage and stuns the target's Harmful skills for 1 turn (stun dur 2). Self-feeding: each True hit advances the chance, making it near-certain over a few turns.

damage_profile.notes: Numbers are pre-mitigation and assume modest ramp. Baseline Divergent Fist = 15 Normal + a 5 True tick the following turn (20 over two turns to one target).
