With Combat Awakening + HP<50, Divergent Fist becomes True and hits 2 random enemies for 15 each (both can land on one target for 30, or 15/15 split as AoE) -- and every True hit plus the ticks rolls Black Flash for +15 True and a Harmful-skill stun. Once Black Flash chance is high (after Consume Finger ramp and Combat Awakening's +20%), a single Combat-Awakened Divergent Fist can chain 2 True hits + 2 Black Flash procs = ~15+15+15+15 = 60 True to one stacked target in a turn. Consume Finger adds +5 per stack to the base hit, pushing the 30 figure higher with no hard ceiling.
damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded but slow: Consume Finger stacks +5 Divergent Fist damage and +15% Black Flash floor per use (every other turn). True-damage output and Black Flash reliability both compound over a long game; effective DPS is gated by getting Yuji below 50 HP (for True Divergent Fists) and by ramp time.

economy.color_dependency: Very low. Only one specific pip in the entire visible kit: Blue:1 on Divergent Fist. Combat Awakening is free, Consume Finger and Unusual Fortitude each take a single Random pip. Splashable on almost any team; Blue identity is nominal.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Excellent. Spammable core (Divergent Fist CD 0), Combat Awakening CD 2, Consume Finger CD 1, only Unusual Fortitude is a long CD 4. He can act meaningfully every turn with minimal energy.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Yuji is weak turn 1 and snowballs: Consume Finger must be cycled to grow Divergent Fist damage and the Black Flash floor, and Combat Awakening/low HP unlocks the True-damage burst loop. Front-loaded matchups punish him.

internal_synergies: Consume Finger is the linchpin: it raises both Divergent Fist's base damage (+5/stack) and the Black Flash minimum chance (+15%/stack), so the True-damage engine and the proc engine ramp together off one button.
Combat Awakening pre-loads +20% Black Flash chance AND makes the next Divergent Fist hit twice -- doubling the number of True-damage instances that can roll Black Flash in a single turn when HP<50.
The 5-True-damage tick from every Divergent Fist is itself a Black Flash trigger, so even baseline Normal Fists feed the passive's ramping chance for free.
Black Flash's stun targets Harmful skills specifically -- pairing the burst with soft lockdown on the enemy's offense.
Unusual Fortitude (invuln) lets Yuji safely dip and stay below 50 HP to keep Combat Awakening's True-damage condition online while surviving.

power_assessment.reasoning: A snowball/ramp DoT-burst character with an exceptionally cheap, low-CD, color-flexible kit and a strong long-game ceiling via stacking True damage that bypasses DR plus a self-feeding stun proc. The defining strength is True-damage spam: Divergent Fist's tick and (when True) its hits ignore mitigation entirely, and Black Flash adds reliable bonus True damage + a Harmful-skill stun that scales toward near-100% reliability over a few turns. He also has built-in sustain (Consume Finger heal) and a hard panic button (1-turn invuln). However, he is very weak early -- baseline output is just 15 Normal + a 5 True tick, his marquee True-damage Divergent Fist loop requires being below 50 HP (a deliberate self-endangerment), and Black Flash is RNG-gated until ramped. No hard CC, no AoE that isn't random-split, no shields/cleanse/energy denial, and no team utility. He wins the long grind but folds to fast burst and to enemies who can keep him healthy/above 50 HP. Solidly above average in isolation but heavily condition- and time-dependent.
outlier_flags: JSON descriptions are stale across the whole kit: yuji1 base damage is 15 in the .gd (JSON says 10), Consume Finger gives +15% Black Flash floor and +5 damage (JSON says 10% and omits the damage), Combat Awakening grants +20% chance (JSON says 15%), and Black Flash ramps +15%/resets to floor (JSON says +5%/5%). Treat .gd as ground truth.
Black Flash minimum starts at 10 in code (character var black_flash_minimum=10), not 5 as the JSON implies.
True-damage-centric kit: a large share of effective output bypasses DR/barriers/shields, making him deceptively strong vs tanky/defensive comps relative to raw numbers.
The 'go below 50 HP for True damage' design intentionally rewards taking damage, an unusual risk-loop that interacts oddly with healing/overheal effects.

role: Single-target True-damage ramp/DoT bruiser with a self-feeding stun proc
signature_mechanic: Black Flash loop: every instance of True damage Yuji deals (the 5-dmg Divergent Fist tick, or a True-damage Divergent Fist) rolls a ramping chance to deal 15 bonus True damage and stun the target's Harmful skills; the chance climbs +15% per True hit and resets to a permanently rising floor that Consume Finger and Combat Awakening keep pushing toward 100%.
strengths: Extremely cheap and color-flexible: 3 total pips across the visible kit, only one specific (Blue) pip -- trivially splashable on any team.
Outstanding cooldown tempo: a CD-0 spammable core attack plus low-CD setup/heal buttons; acts every turn.
Large fraction of damage is True (the tick, Combat-Awakened Fists, Black Flash) that bypasses DR/barriers/shields, punishing tanky/defensive enemies.
Self-feeding snowball: Black Flash proc chance and Divergent Fist damage both ramp permanently via Consume Finger, trending toward guaranteed bonus damage + stun.
Built-in survivability: 15 HP self-heal each cycle plus a 1-turn full invulnerability panic button.
Black Flash stun specifically shuts off the target's Harmful skills, giving disruptive soft-lock on top of burst.
weaknesses: Very weak turn 1 / front-loaded: baseline is only 15 Normal + a 5 True tick; needs several turns of Consume Finger ramp and a sub-50-HP setup to come online.
Marquee True-damage Divergent Fist requires Yuji to be below 50 HP, forcing self-endangerment and making him vulnerable while ramping.
Black Flash is RNG-gated early (10% floor), so burst is unreliable until the chance is built up.
No hard CC (only the conditional Harmful-skill stun), no real AoE (Combat Awakening's two hits are random and can both whiff onto one target), and zero team support/shields/cleanse/energy denial.
Random targeting on the empowered Fist means burst can be wasted on the wrong enemy.
Loses the race to fast single-turn burst comps and to opponents that can keep him above 50 HP or out-heal his DoT.

soft_cc: Black Flash: stun target's Harmful skills for 1 turn (conditional on proc)
invuln_or_counter: Unusual Fortitude: full invulnerability for 1 turn (CD 4)

win_conditions: Survive the early game (heal + invuln), cycle Consume Finger to ramp Divergent Fist damage and the Black Flash floor, then grind down a single target with stacking True damage and increasingly reliable Black Flash procs.
Drop below 50 HP and chain Combat-Awakened True-damage Divergent Fists into Black Flash procs for a burst window of bypass-mitigation damage plus Harmful-skill stuns.
Out-last defensive/tanky comps using True damage that ignores their DR/shields while his sustain keeps him alive.

role: Blue-energy Piercing controller/carry: AoE Shatter+DoT pressure that ramps into a transformation with a 65 invuln-bypassing single-target execute nuke
signature_mechanic: Spirit Dive: Sylph transformation loop. Base skills feed stackable Blue cost-reductions onto the transform (yuno1 on full-team hit, yuno2 while its debuff is active). Activating Spirit Dive grants +1 Blue/turn and 10 DR for 3 turns and swaps the action bar into empowered forms (Gale White Bow 35 AoE, Sylph's Breath AoE Shatter+DoT, Spirit of Zephyr 65 single-target invuln-bypassing nuke). The transformed AoE skills refund Spirit of Zephyr's cost, and a Zephyr kill extends the transformation by 2 turns — a self-sustaining nuke loop.

abilities.name: Wind Blades Shower
abilities.conditional_scaling: If it hits ALL living enemies, stacks a -1 Blue cost reduction on Spirit Dive: Sylph (ramp enabler, not damage scaling)
abilities.effects_summary: 10 Piercing AoE; on full-team hit applies a stackable, per-stack -1 Blue cost-mod to Spirit Dive: Sylph to accelerate the transformation.

abilities.name: Towering Tornado
abilities.conditional_scaling: Reactive: target takes 10 Piercing if they use a new harmful skill while the trigger is active (3 turns)
abilities.effects_summary: Shatters one enemy (def_negate, ~2 turns) and arms a 3-turn HARMFUL_USE trigger dealing 10 Piercing if they cast a harmful skill. While active, applies a -1 Blue cost-mod to Spirit Dive: Sylph. Soft action-tax / def-strip; no upfront damage.

abilities.name: Spirit Dive: Sylph
abilities.cost_breakdown: 2 Blue + 1 Random (reducible to 0 Blue via yuno1/yuno2 ramp)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Duration 3 turns; extended +2 turns each time Spirit of Zephyr (yuno7) lands a kill
abilities.effects_summary: Transformation. Immediate +1 Blue; for 3 turns gains +1 Blue/turn (ticking trigger) and 10 flat damage reduction. Swaps slot1->Gale White Bow, slot2->Sylph's Breath, slot3->Spirit of Zephyr. Removes the Wind Blades Shower cost-mod on activation.

abilities.name: Sylph Block
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). Panic button / tempo-stall on a 4-turn cooldown. Not invuln-bypass-immune to Zephyr-type effects but blocks normal harm.

abilities.name: Gale White Bow
abilities.cost_breakdown: 2 Blue + 1 Random (reducible to 0 Blue via Sylph's Breath / itself)
abilities.conditional_scaling: Per enemy struck, stacks a -1 Blue cost reduction on Spirit of Zephyr (refunds the nuke)
abilities.effects_summary: Transformed slot 1: 35 Piercing AoE. Each enemy hit applies a stackable per-stack -1 Blue cost-mod to Spirit of Zephyr, fueling the single-target nuke loop. Up to -3 Blue vs 3 enemies.

abilities.name: Sylph's Breath
abilities.conditional_scaling: DoT: 10 Piercing/turn for ~2 turns on top of the 10 upfront hit
abilities.effects_summary: Transformed slot 2: 10 Piercing AoE immediately, applies Shatter (def_negate ~1 turn) and a Piercing DoT effect (10/turn) to all enemies. While active applies -2 Blue cost-mod to Spirit of Zephyr. AoE def-strip + sustained DoT controller.

abilities.name: Spirit of Zephyr
abilities.cost_breakdown: 4 Blue + 2 Random (heavily reducible by yuno5/yuno6 cost-mods)
abilities.conditional_scaling: On kill: extends Spirit Dive: Sylph duration by +2 turns (prolongs the whole transformation), enabling repeat casts thanks to 0 cooldown
abilities.effects_summary: Transformed slot 3: 65 Piercing single-target nuke that BYPASSES invulnerability. 0 cooldown (spammable if energy allows). If countered, auto-recasts next turn (counter_response). On kill, prolongs the transformation by 2 turns. Removes Gale White Bow cost-mod on use.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Per-target, not stacking damage scaling. Transformed single-target ceiling: 65 Piercing per Spirit of Zephyr cast, and with 0 cooldown + cost refunds from Gale White Bow it can repeat in consecutive turns while energy lasts. Per-turn AoE ceiling: Gale White Bow 35 + a Sylph's Breath DoT tick 10 = ~45 against a struck enemy, plus 35 to the rest. A Zephyr kill loops the transformation indefinitely if kills keep landing.
damage_profile.notes: ALL damage is Piercing (skips both flat and percent DR), so listed numbers are close to effective damage and ignore most defensive mitigation; only true HP/invuln-bypass interactions matter. Base form is low-damage (10 AoE) and exists mainly to ramp the transform. Real output lives entirely in the transformed kit. Sustained DoT figure = Sylph's Breath 10/turn AoE DoT plus the implicit ~10 from re-hits; reactive Towering Tornado adds 10 Piercing only if the enemy acts harmfully.

economy.color_dependency: Moderate-to-high Blue dependency. Visible kit is 3 specific Blue (yuno2=1, yuno3=2) + 3 Random across 4 skills. Transformed kit is very Blue-heavy (Gale 2B, Breath 2B, Zephyr 4B) but Yuno self-generates +1 Blue/turn during the transform and the cost-mods refund most Blue, so the loop is largely self-funding. Off-Blue teams can still cast the base ramp.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Fast. yuno1 CD1, yuno2 CD2, yuno4 CD4, transform CD4. Transformed: Gale CD1, Breath CD2, Zephyr CD0 (spammable). Low cooldowns enable a continuous Piercing engine once transformed.
economy.ramp_dependency: High. Power is gated behind activating Spirit Dive: Sylph. Base form is weak filler whose job is to discount and enable the transform; the payoff (35 AoE / 65 nuke / DoT) only exists after transforming. Self-sustains via +1 Blue/turn, cost refunds, and kill-based duration extension once online.

soft_cc: Shatter / def_negate (def-strip) on yuno2 single-target and yuno6 AoE
Towering Tornado action-tax: punishes the target for using harmful skills
invuln_or_counter: yuno4 Sylph Block: self-invulnerability 1 turn
yuno3 transform: +10 flat damage reduction for 3 turns
yuno7 Spirit of Zephyr: bypasses enemy invulnerability and auto-recasts if countered (anti-counter)

win_conditions: Land the Spirit Dive: Sylph transformation and chain the empowered kit before it expires
Use Gale White Bow AoE to refund Spirit of Zephyr, then spam the 65 Piercing nuke (0 cooldown) to delete priority targets through invuln/DR
Secure kills with Spirit of Zephyr to extend the transformation and keep the loop running
Grind enemies down with stacked Shatter + Piercing AoE DoT (Sylph's Breath) that bypasses all DR
internal_synergies: yuno1 (full-team hit) and yuno2 (active) both discount Spirit Dive: Sylph, letting you transform a turn or two early
Gale White Bow and Sylph's Breath both discount Spirit of Zephyr, often making the 6-cost nuke nearly free
Sylph's Breath Shatter strips defense, amplifying nothing extra for Piercing but enabling other damage types / allies
Spirit Dive grants +1 Blue/turn which directly funds the Blue-hungry transformed kit
Spirit of Zephyr kill -> +2 turns transformation -> more casts -> more kills (snowball loop)
Zephyr's invuln-bypass + auto-recast-on-counter makes it a reliable finisher against defensive/counter comps
strengths: All damage is Piercing — ignores flat and percent damage reduction, so output is near-unmitigable by conventional defense
Spirit of Zephyr is a 65 single-target nuke that bypasses invulnerability and auto-recasts when countered — extremely hard to defend against
Strong, self-funding energy economy: +1 Blue/turn during transform plus cost refunds make the expensive transformed kit cheap in practice
Excellent AoE pressure once transformed: 35 AoE + AoE Shatter + 10/turn AoE DoT
Self-protection toolkit: 1-turn invuln, 10 DR during transform
0-cooldown nuke with kill-based transformation extension creates a powerful snowball
weaknesses: Heavily ramp-gated: base form deals only 10 AoE and provides no real threat until transformed; a slow or interrupted ramp leaves Yuno passive
No healing, no shields, no team support — purely selfish damage/control
No hard CC (only Shatter/def-strip and a reactive action-tax); cannot reliably lock down a target
Strong Blue color dependency for the payoff kit; off-color teams or energy denial hurt the loop
Transformation is a fixed 3-turn window unless kills extend it — if kills dry up, power evaporates and skills revert
Invuln/DR are short and cooldown-limited; focused burst can punish him during the weak base form or after the transform lapses

power_assessment.reasoning: A high-ceiling scaling carry. The transformed kit is genuinely oppressive: 65 Piercing single-target that bypasses invuln, auto-recasts on counter, has 0 cooldown, and self-funds via refunds and +1 Blue/turn, plus strong Piercing AoE + DoT. Because everything is Piercing it sidesteps most of the game's defensive interactions, which is a large effective-damage multiplier. The kill-extends-transformation loop can snowball out of control. It is held back from being a clear top-tier by being fully ramp-gated — the base form is near-harmless filler, and a disrupted/slow transform or a single defensive turn from the opponent leaves Yuno doing almost nothing. No team support, no hard CC, and notable Blue dependency keep it honest. Rated in isolation; the Piercing-everything design and invuln-bypassing 0-cooldown nuke are the main outlier concerns to recheck against the roster.
outlier_flags: Entire damage kit is Piercing (bypasses flat + percent DR) — unusually low mitigation exposure
Spirit of Zephyr: 0 cooldown + invuln-bypass + auto-recast-on-counter + kill-extends-transform is a stacked set of anti-defense / snowball mechanics on one ability
Self-sustaining cost-refund + energy-generation loop can make a 6-cost nuke effectively free
Transformation can be extended indefinitely via kills

role: Single-target piercing burst assassin with self-buff ramp and defensive evasion
signature_mechanic: Speed of Thunder + Thunder Release are permanent, stacking +5 damage_mods on First Form (Thunderclap and Flash); when BOTH buffs are active, First Form splits into two hits, so each hit receives the full additive bonus and the buffs also re-arm a 1-turn non-Strategic invulnerability AND a 0-damage piercing counter (thorns) — turning the nuke into both a burst and a defensive trigger.

abilities.name: Speed of Thunder
abilities.conditional_scaling: Applies a permanent (dur -1), stackable +5 DAMAGE_MOD to First Form: Thunderclap and Flash and Thunder Release; each recast adds another +5 (stack_mag), so the buff to those two skills grows by +5 per use over a long game.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff. Grants permanent +5 damage to First Form and Thunder Release (stacking). Plants an ACTION_USE_TRIGGER: the next time First Form is used, Zenitsu gains invuln_effect(2, exclude Strategic) = invulnerable to all non-Strategic skills for 1 turn, and the trigger is consumed. Cannot be re-used while its trigger mark is pending (extra_usable false until First Form fires).

abilities.name: Thunder Release
abilities.conditional_scaling: Applies a permanent (dur -1), stackable per_stack +5 DAMAGE_MOD to First Form and Thunder Release; stacks with each recast like Speed of Thunder. With both buffs up, First Form's added bonus is applied to each of its two hits.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff. Grants permanent +5 damage to First Form and Thunder Release (stacking). Plants an ACTION_USE_TRIGGER: the next First Form use arms a permanent HARMFUL_RECEIVE_TRIGGER thorns effect that deals 0 piercing damage to any enemy who uses a new non-Strategic skill on Zenitsu (currently a 0-magnitude counter — flavor/marker, no real retaliation damage). Cannot be re-used while its trigger mark is pending.

abilities.name: First Form: Thunderclap and Flash
abilities.conditional_scaling: Base 30 piercing. If under BOTH Speed of Thunder and Thunder Release, instead resolves as 15 + 15 (two piercing hits). The permanent +5 damage_mods apply PER hit instance, so two hits double the additive bonus: with both single +5 buffs active that is 25+25 = 50 vs a 40 single hit; bonus scales further as the damage_mods stack from repeated recasts. Spammable (cooldown 0).
abilities.effects_summary: Primary damage. 30 piercing single-target (Piercing skips flat + % DR). Also fires Speed of Thunder's trigger (grants 1-turn non-Strategic invuln) and Thunder Release's trigger (arms 0-dmg piercing thorns) if those marks are pending, consuming them. Applies a portrait_change_effect (cosmetic).

abilities.name: Falling Maneuver
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Pure defensive. default_defend → full invulnerability for 1 turn. Long 4-turn cooldown. Strategic-classed so it dodges the panic-button AI heuristic.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: First Form's two-hit mode applies the additive +5 damage_mods per hit, and those mods are permanent and stack +5 each time Speed of Thunder / Thunder Release are recast. Steady state after a few buff recasts: each First Form hit climbs by +5 per stack, so two-hit damage can ramp well past 50 (e.g. +10 per buff = 35+35 = 70) in a long game. No hard cap in code, but cooldown-2 buffs and the consume-on-trigger gating throttle the ramp rate.
damage_profile.notes: All damage is Piercing (bypasses flat and % DR, but NOT barriers/shields). Single-hit baseline 30 (35 with one +5 buff). The 50 peak requires BOTH buffs active, which costs setup turns and consumes the triggers on each First Form. No AoE and no DoT anywhere in the kit.

economy.color_dependency: Very low. Only 1 specific Blue pip (on First Form); the other three pips are Random. Splashable into almost any team.
economy.cooldown_tempo: First Form is cooldown 0 (spammable every turn). Buffs are cooldown 2 but gated by consume-on-trigger (cannot recast until First Form fires their mark). Falling Maneuver is a slow cooldown-4 panic button.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate. Peak output and the invuln/thorns triggers require spending 2 setup turns (Speed of Thunder + Thunder Release) before First Form; the permanent +5 stacks reward a long game but the baseline 30 piercing nuke is usable turn 1.

invuln_or_counter: Falling Maneuver: full invulnerability 1 turn (cd 4)
Speed of Thunder via First Form: invulnerable to all non-Strategic skills 1 turn
Thunder Release via First Form: permanent thorns counter on incoming non-Strategic skills (currently 0 piercing damage — non-functional retaliation)

win_conditions: Set up both Speed of Thunder and Thunder Release, then spam cooldown-0 First Form as a 50+ piercing-per-turn nuke that ignores DR while staying invulnerable to non-Strategic skills on the buffed turns.
Snowball the permanent +5 damage_mod stacks across a long game so First Form's two-hit mode out-races enemy healing/DR.
Use Falling Maneuver + the First-Form-triggered invuln to dodge burst windows and survive into the scaling lategame.
internal_synergies: Speed of Thunder + Thunder Release together flip First Form into two-hit mode, doubling the additive damage_mod and simultaneously arming both the invuln and thorns triggers off a single cooldown-0 cast.
First Form is the only outlet that consumes the buffs' triggers, so the kit is a tight self-contained loop: buff -> First Form (damage + invuln + counter) -> rebuff.
Permanent stacking +5 mods make every buff recast a permanent power increase, rewarding patient play.
Piercing typing pairs with the spammable First Form to grind down high-DR/tank targets.
strengths: Reliable cooldown-0 piercing nuke that bypasses both flat and percentage DR.
Excellent energy economy: only 1 specific pip in the whole kit, 3 Random — fits any team.
Strong self-protection: two independent invuln sources (Falling Maneuver + buffed First Form) make him slippery.
Permanent stacking damage gives a real lategame scaling ceiling.
Buffed First Form delivers burst AND defense on the same turn.
weaknesses: Zero AoE and zero DoT — purely single-target, contributes nothing against spread comps.
No CC, no healing, no shields, no energy denial, no team support whatsoever.
Two-turn setup tax to reach peak (must land both buffs before First Form); triggers are consumed each First Form, requiring constant rebuffing to keep invuln/counter online.
Piercing does NOT bypass barriers/shields — shield-heavy or barrier teams blunt his whole damage output.
Thunder Release's thorns counter is coded at 0 piercing damage, so its retaliation is effectively non-functional (marker only).
Low burst ceiling (~50) before heavy ramp; bad into invuln/dodge enemies since he has no follow-up or off-turn pressure besides First Form.

power_assessment.reasoning: A clean, focused single-target piercing assassin. The cooldown-0 30-piercing baseline (ignoring DR) is solid and the buffed two-hit 50 with simultaneous invuln is a genuinely good burst-plus-defense turn. Low color dependency and two invuln sources make him durable and flexible. But he is one-dimensional: no AoE, no DoT, no CC/support, and his peak requires a 2-turn buff tax that gets consumed each nuke. Piercing not bypassing shields and the 0-damage thorns bug cap his upside. Mid-tier: dependable but narrow, scaling but slow.
outlier_flags: Thunder Release thorns_trigger resolves 0 piercing damage — likely a bug/placeholder; intended retaliation does nothing.
First Form cooldown 0 (no cost gate beyond 2 pips) makes it spammable every turn — high uptime nuke.
Permanent stackable damage_mods (dur -1, stack_mag/per_stack) give unbounded additive scaling with no coded cap.

role: Single-target physical bruiser/duelist with ramp, counters, and execute
signature_mechanic: Master of Swords permanent stacking damage buff (+5 to all skills per use, stacks forever) paired with an Onigiri/Lion Strike action-bar swap; the counter (zoro3) can also trigger the buff for free.

abilities.name: Onigiri
abilities.conditional_scaling: Benefits from Master of Swords damage_mod stacks (+5 per stack, permanent). .gd deals 30 (JSON says 35 - stale).
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 30 Normal damage to one enemy; grants Zoro a 10-point Shield for 1 turn. No cooldown. Note: code does not itself swap to Lion Strike; the swap is driven by Master of Swords/counter.

abilities.name: Master of Swords
abilities.conditional_scaling: Core ramp engine: applies damage_mod_effect(5, dur=-1) which is PERMANENT and stackable (stack_mag=true) - every cast adds +5 to all of Zoro's damage forever.
abilities.effects_summary: Self-buff. Permanently +5 damage to all skills (stacks each cast). For 1 turn, ignores enemy Stun effects (ignore_effect_effect STUN). Swaps Lion Strike (slot 5) into slot 1 over Onigiri for 1 turn. Free cost, 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Three-Sword Style Counter
abilities.conditional_scaling: On counter trigger, fires the full Master of Swords payload for free (permanent +5 stack, stun-ignore, Lion Strike swap) - lets Zoro ramp without spending his slot-2 cooldown.
abilities.effects_summary: Targets Zoro or one ally; counters the FIRST harmful enemy skill used on that character for 1 turn (counter_receive, invisible). On trigger, grants Zoro the Master of Swords buff package (permanent damage stack + stun immunity + Lion Strike swap).

abilities.name: Three-Sword Style Parry
abilities.conditional_scaling: none
abilities.effects_summary: Self invulnerability for 1 turn (default_defend). Panic-button / survivability tool. 1 random pip, 4-turn cooldown.

abilities.name: One-Sword Style: Lion Strike
abilities.conditional_scaling: Benefits from Master of Swords stacks (+5 per stack). execute_attempt(15): instantly kills the target if its HP is <= 15 after the hit. Targets through invulnerability (hostile_target true). Hidden alt swapped into slot 1 by Master of Swords / counter.
abilities.effects_summary: Deals 15 Piercing damage (skips flat+%DR) to one enemy, then attempts execute on targets at/below 15 HP. Bypasses invulnerability. Note: .gd grants NO shield (JSON 10-Shield text is stale). Swaps back to Onigiri context.

damage_profile.scaling_ceiling: Unbounded in theory: each Master of Swords (or counter trigger) adds a permanent stacking +5 to all skills. Onigiri base 30 / Lion Strike base 15 grow by +5 per stack. In a single turn one can chain Onigiri (30) + the swapped/available second hit; realistic same-turn double-hit ~45 early, scaling to 60-90+ as stacks accrue over a long game. Lion Strike's execute is effectively infinite value against sub-15-HP targets.
damage_profile.notes: No native AoE - purely single-target. Lion Strike's 15 Piercing ignores flat and % DR, and its execute threshold (<=15 HP) plus invuln-bypass makes it a strong finisher independent of raw damage. Damage_mod stacks apply to BOTH Onigiri and Lion Strike, so ramp compounds the execute setup (more upfront damage = more targets pushed under 15).

economy.color_dependency: Light mono-Green dependency: Onigiri needs 1 Green, Counter needs 1 Green, Lion Strike needs 1 Green; Parry is fully flexible (random); Master of Swords is free. Easy to fuel, no multi-color requirement.
economy.cooldown_tempo: Very strong tempo: Onigiri (cd 0) and Lion Strike (cd 0) are spammable every turn; Master of Swords cd 4 but free; Counter cd 2; Parry cd 4. Two zero-cooldown damage tools keep pressure up constantly.
economy.ramp_dependency: Moderate ramp payoff but not ramp-gated: kit is functional from turn 1 (cheap 30-damage spam + execute + invuln + counter). Master of Swords stacks are upside that snowballs in longer games; the counter offers a second, cost-free ramp path.

invuln_or_counter: Three-Sword Style Parry (self-invulnerable 1 turn)
Three-Sword Style Counter (counters first harmful skill on self or 1 ally, invisible, ramps on trigger)

win_conditions: Out-tempo opponents with two zero-cooldown single-target hits (Onigiri / Lion Strike) while self-shielding and ramping Master of Swords stacks.
Snowball permanent +5 damage stacks over a long game until Onigiri/Lion Strike one-shot squishies.
Cleanly close out low-HP targets with Lion Strike's Piercing + <=15-HP execute that also bypasses invulnerability/DR.
internal_synergies: Master of Swords (zoro2) + both attacks: permanent +5 stacks scale Onigiri AND Lion Strike simultaneously.
Counter (zoro3) -> on trigger applies the full Master of Swords package for free, giving a second ramp engine and stun immunity without spending the slot-2 cooldown.
Master of Swords / counter swap Lion Strike into the action bar, converting Zoro's basic into a Piercing execute finisher on demand.
Stun-ignore from the buff + Parry invuln + Onigiri shield = layered self-protection that keeps the no-cooldown damage uptime online.
Lion Strike's invuln-bypass + execute punishes defensive/turtling targets that Zoro's ramp has chipped below 15 HP.
strengths: Excellent tempo: two no-cooldown, cheap single-target attacks plus a free buff.
Compounding permanent damage ramp with a redundant (counter-based) way to gain stacks.
Lion Strike combines Piercing (skips DR) + invuln-bypass + a sub-15-HP execute - a near-unconditional finisher.
Strong self-survivability: invulnerability, an ally/self counter, stun immunity windows, and a self-shield.
Cheap, mono-Green/flexible cost with no multi-color dependency - very easy to field.
weaknesses: Zero AoE - completely single-target, weak into wide/swarm comps.
No team utility beyond a single-target ally counter; no healing, cleanse, or energy denial.
Ramp is slow per stack (+5) and rewards long games; behind on burst vs dedicated assassins early.
Stale descriptions (JSON 35 dmg / Lion Strike 10-Shield) overstate his real output; true base numbers are modest (30 / 15).
Defensive tools are on 4-turn cooldowns - limited windows; vulnerable to burst when Parry/Counter are down.

power_assessment.reasoning: A well-rounded, low-cost single-target duelist with strong tempo (two cd-0 attacks), good self-protection (invuln, counter, stun-ignore, shield), a compounding permanent damage ramp, and a genuinely strong Piercing execute that bypasses invulnerability. He is reliable and hard to remove but lacks AoE, team support, and early burst; his ceiling depends on grinding stacks in longer games. Solidly above-average but not an outlier - a dependable mid-tier bruiser/finisher.
outlier_flags: Lion Strike's execute (<=15 HP) + invuln-bypass + Piercing is an unconditional-finisher outlier worth watching against defensive comps
Master of Swords stacks are permanent and stackable with a free secondary trigger via the counter - potential unbounded scaling in very long games
JSON metadata is stale vs .gd (Onigiri 30 not 35; Lion Strike grants no shield) - balance reviews using JSON will misjudge his numbers
